;;; $8000..8000: Table: bit masks ;;;
{
;; Eight single-bit masks, $80 down to $01.
$02:8000                .db $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01 ; Bit masks $80,$40,$20,$10,$08,$04,$02,$01

;;; all.log 028008..028071
;;;
;;; New labels (not in original all.log):
;;;     $7E0DC2 => RAM_ReservedItem
;;;     $7E14C8 => RAM_SpriteAction
;;;     $7E1534 => RAM_BlinkFallFlag
;;; $8008 => DropReservedItem
;;; $8019 => DropRiFindSlot
;;; $8042 => DropRiHaveSlot
;;; $8070 => DropRiEnd
;;;
;;; RAM_SpriteAction andd RAM_BlinkFallFlag are tables for processing 12 common sprites.
;;; The index X must be in range 0..11.
;;;
;;; Values for RAM_SpriteAction,X:
;;; $00 => empty sprite slot
;;; $08 => normal action
;;;   See http://www.smwcentral.net/?p=thread&id=11960 for other values.
;;;
;;; Values for RAM_BlinkFallFlag,X:
;;; $00 => off
;;; $01 => on, tell sprite to blink and fall down through tiles
;;;
;;; RAM_BlinkFallFlag affects only a few sprites (at least the Super Mushroom, Fire Flower, Starman
;;; and 1-up Mushroom) and does not affect the Cape Feather. RAM_BlinkFallFlag might also have an
;;; unknown effect to a few other sprites; the flag seems to cause Super Koopas to flash their capes
;;; (but not to give feathers).
;;;
;;; Values for RAM_ReservedItem:
;;; $00 => empty item box
;;; $01 => sprite $74, Super Mushroom
;;; $02 => sprite $75, Fire Flower
;;; $03 => sprite $76, Starman, flashes gray instead of red until you drop the item
;;; $04 => sprite $77, Cape Feather
;;; $05 => sprite $78, 1-up Mushroom, wrong graphics until you drop the item


;;; JSL subroutine
;;; preserves X
;;;
;;; Drops the reserved item from the item box. If the item box is empty, then this routine does
;;; nothing, else this routine empties the item box and creates a falling sprite for the item.
;;;
;;; When Mario takes damage and powers down, SMW jumps to this routine from $00F5F8.
;;;
;;; You can JSL here whenever you want to drop the reserved item from the item box. The data bank
;;; can be any bank that mirrors $7E0000..$7E1FFF.
;;;
;;; 028008:
}

;;; $8008: Drop item from item box (DropReservedItem) ;;;
{
;; JSL entry. If the item box holds an item, empties it and spawns the item as a falling sprite at screen X + $78, Y + $20.
;; If all 12 sprite slots are full, overwrites slot 10 or 11 (alternating); frees a carried P-balloon's flag.
;; Preserves X. Called when Mario powers down.
;; Called by: $00:C58A (Per-frame Mario state: keyhole, timers, animation), $00:F5F8 (Hurt: shrink to small Mario (PowerDown))
$02:8008  DA            PHX                          ; Preserve X
$02:8009  AD C2 0D      LDA.W RAM_ReservedItem      ; A = [RAM_ReservedItem]
$02:800C  F0 62         BEQ DropRiEnd               ; Item box empty: nothing to drop, go to the end
$02:800E  9C C2 0D      STZ.W RAM_ReservedItem      ; Item box = empty
$02:8011  48            PHA                          ; Save the item number
$02:8012  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:8014  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Sound effect $0C ([$1DFC]): item falls out of the box
$02:8017  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; X = 11: search the sprite slots from the last one
}

;;; $8019: Find free sprite slot for dropped item (DropRiFindSlot) ;;;
{
;; Searches slots 11..0 for status 0; if none, picks slot 10 or 11 by toggling [$1861] (clearing [$13F3] if it was a carried P-balloon).
$02:8019  BD C8 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X    ; A = status of sprite slot X ([RAM_SpriteAction])
$02:801C  F0 24         BEQ DropRiHaveSlot          ; Slot is empty: use it
$02:801E  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:801F  10 F8         BPL DropRiFindSlot          ; / X--, loop while X >= 0

;; If we are here, then all 12 sprite slots are full. We delete
;; one of the twelve sprites so that we have a slot for the item
;; falling from the item box. To delete the sprite, we store its
;; slot number in X and fall through to the code that creates the
;; new sprite.
;;
$02:8021  CE 61 18      DEC.W $1861                 ; \
$02:8024  10 05         BPL $802B             ; |
$02:8026  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; } Toggle [$1861] between 0 and 1 (decrement, wrap to 1)
$02:8028  8D 61 18      STA.W $1861                 ; /
$02:802B  AD 61 18      LDA.W $1861                 ; \
$02:802E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:802F  69 0A         ADC.B #$0A                  ; } X = [$1861] + 10: overwrite sprite slot 10 or 11
$02:8031  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:8032  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:8034  C9 7D         CMP.B #$7D                  ; |
$02:8036  D0 0A         BNE DropRiHaveSlot          ; / Not sprite $7D (P-balloon): reuse the slot as is
$02:8038  BD C8 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X    ; \
$02:803B  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; |
$02:803D  D0 03         BNE DropRiHaveSlot          ; / Not status $0B (carried by Mario): reuse the slot as is
$02:803F  9C F3 13      STZ.W $13F3                 ; P-balloon was being carried: [$13F3] = 0 (probably Mario's balloon pose)

;; X is now an empty sprite slot. We occupy the slot with a sprite
;; of the item falling from the item box.
;; 
}

;;; $8042: Create falling item sprite (DropRiHaveSlot) ;;;
{
;; Sets the slot to status 8, sprite number = item + $73, initializes it, positions it near the top of the screen and sets [RAM_BlinkFallFlag].
$02:8042  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:8044  9D C8 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteAction,X    ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:8047  68            PLA                          ; A = reserved item number
$02:8048  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:8049  69 73         ADC.B #$73                  ; } Sprite number = item + $73 ($74 Super Mushroom .. $78 1-up Mushroom)
$02:804B  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; /
$02:804D  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$02:8051  A9 78         LDA.B #$78                  ; \
$02:8053  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:8054  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:8056  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; |
$02:8058  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
;; carry                  ;  |   $78 + X_pos of screen
$02:805A  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Sprite X position = screen X + $78 (16-bit)
$02:805C  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; /
$02:805F  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:8061  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:8062  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:8064  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:8066  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; |
;; carry                  ;  |   $20 + Y_pos of screen
$02:8068  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Sprite Y position = screen Y + $20 (16-bit)
$02:806A  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:806D  FE 34 15      INC.W RAM_BlinkFallFlag,X   ; [RAM_BlinkFallFlag] = 1: sprite blinks and falls through tiles
}

;;; $8070: Drop item: restore X and return (DropRiEnd) ;;;
{
$02:8070  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:8071  6B            RTL                          ; Return


;;; 028072:
}

{

$02:8072                .db $00,$08,$06,$FA,$F8,$06,$08,$00 ; Explosion puff X offsets: set 0 = $00,$08,$06,$FA,$F8; set 1 = $06,$08,$00,...
$02:807A                .db $F8,$FA                 ; (set 1 continued) $F8,$FA

;;; 02807C:
}

;;; $807C: Table: explosion puff Y offsets (BombExplosionY) ;;;
{
;; Two sets of five signed offsets for the Bob-omb explosion puffs (set 1 = indices 5-9).
$02:807C                .db $F8,$FE,$06,$06,$FE,$FA,$02,$08 ; Explosion puff Y offsets: set 0 = $F8,$FE,$06,$06,$FE; set 1 = $FA,$02,$08,...
$02:8084                .db $02,$FA                 ; (set 1 continued) $02,$FA

;;; 028088:
}

;;; $8086: Bob-omb explosion sprite main (ExplodeBombRt) ;;;
{
;; JSL entry for the explosion sprite; calls ExplodeBombSubRt.
;; Called by: $01:8ADF (Bob-omb explodes (ExplodeBomb))
$02:8086  20 8A 80      JSR.W ExplodeBombSubRt      ; Run the explosion routine (ExplodeBombSubRt)
$02:8089  6B            RTL                          ; Return

;;; 02808A:
}

;;; $808A: Bob-omb explosion: timer and clipping (ExplodeBombSubRt) ;;;
{
;; Makes the sprite unstompable with the explosion hitbox, advances the animation counter and frees the sprite when [$1540] runs out; otherwise draws via ExplodeBombGfx.
;; Called by: $02:8086 (Bob-omb explosion sprite main (ExplodeBombRt))
$02:808A  9E 56 16      STZ.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X     ; [RAM_Tweaker1656] = 0: sprite cannot be stomped
$02:808D  A9 11         LDA.B #$11                  ; \
$02:808F  9D 62 16      STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; / [RAM_Tweaker1662] = $11: clipping index of the explosion hitbox
$02:8092  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite screen position and OAM index (GetDrawInfo2)
$02:8095  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:8097  D0 03         BNE $809C             ; |
$02:8099  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; / Animation counter [$1570]++ unless sprites are locked
$02:809C  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:809F  D0 04         BNE ExplodeBombGfx          ; |
$02:80A1  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; / Timer [$1540] = 0: sprite status = 0 (free the slot)
$02:80A4  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $80A5: Bob-omb explosion: damage and graphics (ExplodeBombGfx) ;;;
{
;; Every 8 frames kills sprites in range; while $10 <= [$1540] <= $2F hurts Mario on contact.
;; Draws five 8x8 puffs (tile $BC) whose offsets accumulate from BombExplosionX/Y so the cloud expands, with palette cycling 0-3.
$02:80A5  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:80A8  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:80A9  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:80AB  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; |
$02:80AD  D0 11         BNE $80C0             ; / Unless ([$1540] >> 1) AND 3 = 3, skip the damage checks
$02:80AF  20 39 81      JSR.W ExplodeSprites        ; Kill sprites touching the explosion (ExplodeSprites)
$02:80B2  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:80B5  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:80B6  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:80B8  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; |
$02:80BA  B0 04         BCS $80C0             ; / Skip the Mario check unless $10 <= [$1540] <= $2F
$02:80BC  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Hurt Mario if he touches the explosion (MarioSprInteract)
$02:80C0  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; \
$02:80C2  84 0F         STY $0F                     ; / $0F = 4: puff counter (five puffs, 4..0)
$02:80C4  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:80C7  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:80C8  48            PHA                          ; / Push [$1540] >> 1
$02:80C9  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; \
$02:80CB  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = ([$1540] >> 1) AND 3: number of offset steps for this frame
$02:80CD  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:80CF  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:80D0  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:80D2  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:80D3  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } $00 = sprite X - screen X + 4: explosion centre on screen
$02:80D5  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:80D7  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:80D9  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:80DA  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:80DC  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:80DD  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } $01 = sprite Y - screen Y + 4
$02:80DF  85 01         STA $01                     ; /

;;; $813B: Explosion: sprite loop body (ExplodeLoopStart) ;;;
{
;; Per-slot test for the loop in ExplodeSprites.
$02:813B  CC E9 15      CPY.W $15E9                 ; Is slot Y the exploding sprite itself ([$15E9])?

$02:8140  5A            PHY                          ; Save Y

$02:814F  60            RTS                          ; Return

;;; $8150: Explosion: kill sprite on contact (ExplodeKillSpr) ;;;
{
;; Kills sprite Y (status 2, Y speed $C0, X speed 0) if it overlaps the explosion hitbox and is not immune ([$167A] bit 1).
;; Parameters: X = explosion sprite, Y = target sprite.
;; Called by: $02:8148 (Explosion: sprite loop body (ExplodeLoopStart))
$02:8150  DA            PHX                          ; Save X (the explosion sprite)
$02:8151  BB            TYX                          ; \
$02:8152  22 E5 B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB    ; / Hitbox B = sprite Y (GetSpriteClippingB)
$02:8156  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:8157  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Hitbox A = explosion sprite (GetSpriteClippingA)
$02:815B  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; \
$02:815F  90 16         BCC $8177            ; / Return if the hitboxes do not overlap (CheckForContact)
$02:8161  B9 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,Y     ; \
$02:8164  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; |
$02:8166  D0 0F         BNE $8177            ; / Return if the sprite is immune to explosions ([$167A] bit 1)
$02:8168  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:816A  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Target sprite status = 2 (killed, falls off screen)
$02:816D  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:816F  99 AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y    ; / Target Y speed = $C0 (pops upward)
$02:8172  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:8174  99 B6 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y    ; / Target X speed = 0
$02:8177  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $827D: Draw parallax background sprites ;;;
{
;; JSL entry, called every frame from $9A6A while a special boss-room level runs. Probably draws a field of background decoration sprites (purpose unclear).
;; Computes scroll offsets at 1x, 1/2x and 1/4x speed, hides ten spare OAM slots, then writes OAM X/Y/tile/attributes for 57 sprites (30 if [$1884] = 1) from the data tables.
;; Sprites with X >= $F0 are duplicated into a spare slot with the X high bit set so they wrap around the screen edge. Tiles are only written once ([$188C]).
;; Unless [$1884] = 1, four of the sprites flicker every 4th frame (random tile swap). Ends by running the falling column code.
;; Called by: $00:9A6A (Boss room frame code (bit 6 set))
$02:827D  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:827F  8D 8D 18      STA.W $188D                 ; [$188D] = screen X low (working copy)
$02:8282  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:8284  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:8285  85 05         STA $05                     ; / $05 = -[screen X low]: full-speed scroll offset
$02:8287  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:8289  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:828A  6E 8D 18      ROR.W $188D                 ; / A = high >> 1, [$188D] = (screen X >> 1) low
$02:828D  48            PHA                          ; Save the shifted high byte
$02:828E  AD 8D 18      LDA.W $188D                 ; \
$02:8291  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:8293  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:8294  85 06         STA $06                     ; / $06 = -(screen X >> 1): half-speed scroll offset
$02:8296  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:8297  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8298  6E 8D 18      ROR.W $188D                 ; / Pull A, [$188D] = (screen X >> 2) low
$02:829B  AD 8D 18      LDA.W $188D                 ; \
$02:829E  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:82A0  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:82A1  8D 8D 18      STA.W $188D                 ; / [$188D] = -(screen X >> 2): quarter-speed scroll offset
$02:82A4  C2 10         REP #$10                    ; Index registers 16-bit
$02:82A6  A0 64 01      LDY.W #$0164                ; \
$02:82A9  A9 66         LDA.B #$66                  ; |
$02:82AB  84 03         STY $03                     ; / $03 = $0164: next spare OAM slot ($66 loaded into A is never used)
$02:82AD  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:82AF  99 0D 02      STA.W $020D,Y               ; / OAM Y of the spare slot = $F0 (hidden)
$02:82B2  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:82B3  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:82B4  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:82B5  C8            INY                          ; / Y += 4
$02:82B6  C0 8C 01      CPY.W #$018C                ; \
$02:82B9  90 F4         BCC $82AF             ; / Loop until Y = $018C: hides 10 spare sprites
$02:82BB  A2 00 00      LDX.W #$0000                ; \
$02:82BE  86 0C         STX $0C                     ; / $0C = 0 (table offset for set 0)
$02:82C0  A2 38 00      LDX.W #$0038                ; \
$02:82C3  A0 E0 00      LDY.W #$00E0                ; / X = $38 (last entry of set 0), Y = $E0 (OAM offset of its sprite)
$02:82C6  AD 84 18      LDA.W $1884                 ; \
$02:82C9  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; |
$02:82CB  D0 0B         BNE $82D8             ; / [$1884] != 1: use set 0
$02:82CD  A2 39 00      LDX.W #$0039                ; \
$02:82D0  86 0C         STX $0C                     ; |
$02:82D2  A2 1D 00      LDX.W #$001D                ; |
$02:82D5  A0 FC 00      LDY.W #$00FC                ; / [$1884] = 1: $0C = $39 (set 1 start), X = $1D (last entry), Y = $FC
$02:82D8  86 00         STX $00                     ; $00 = X: entries left to draw
$02:82DA  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; \
$02:82DC  8A            TXA                          ; |
$02:82DD  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:82DE  65 0C         ADC $0C                     ; |
$02:82E0  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; |
$02:82E2  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; / $0A = X + [$0C]: index into the data tables
$02:82E4  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; \
$02:82E6  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:82E7  A6 0A         LDX $0A                     ; |
$02:82E9  7F 78 81 02   ADC.L $8178,X         ; |
$02:82ED  99 0C 02      STA.W $020C,Y               ; / OAM X = $8178[index] + $06 (half-speed parallax)
$02:82F0  85 02         STA $02                     ; $02 = OAM X (kept for the wrap-around test)
$02:82F2  AD 88 18      LDA.W RAM_Layer1DispYLo     ; \
$02:82F5  85 07         STA $07                     ; |
$02:82F7  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:82F8  66 07         ROR $07                     ; / $07 = [RAM_Layer1DispYLo] >> 1 (sign kept)
$02:82FA  BF CF 81 02   LDA.L $81CF,X         ; \
$02:82FE  3A            DEC A                       ; |
$02:82FF  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8300  E5 07         SBC $07                     ; |
$02:8302  99 0D 02      STA.W $020D,Y               ; / OAM Y = $81CF[index] - 1 - $07
$02:8305  A6 0A         LDX $0A                     ; X = table index
$02:8307  AD 8C 18      LDA.W $188C                 ; \
$02:830A  D0 0C         BNE $8318             ; / [$188C] != 0: tile and attributes already set up, skip them
$02:830C  BF 26 82 02   LDA.L $8226,X         ; \
$02:8310  99 0E 02      STA.W $020E,Y               ; / OAM tile = $8226[index]
$02:8313  A9 0D         LDA.B #$0D                  ; \
$02:8315  99 0F 02      STA.W $020F,Y               ; / OAM attributes = $0D (palette 6)
$02:8318  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:831A  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM offset
$02:831B  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:831C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:831D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:831E  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM offset / 4
$02:831F  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:8321  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:8323  99 23 04      STA.W $0423,Y               ; / OAM size bit = 2 (16x16): [$0420 + Y/4]
$02:8326  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:8328  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:832A  90 3B         BCC $8367             ; / OAM X < $F0: no wrap-around copy needed
$02:832C  AD 84 18      LDA.W $1884                 ; \
$02:832F  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; |
$02:8331  F0 34         BEQ $8367             ; / [$1884] = 1: no wrap-around copy
$02:8333  7A            PLY                          ; \
$02:8334  5A            PHY                          ; / Y = this sprite's OAM offset (pull then push again)
$02:8335  A6 03         LDX $03                     ; X = $03: OAM offset of the spare slot
$02:8337  B9 0C 02      LDA.W $020C,Y               ; \
$02:833A  9D 0C 02      STA.W $020C,X               ; |
$02:833D  B9 0D 02      LDA.W $020D,Y               ; |
$02:8340  9D 0D 02      STA.W $020D,X               ; |
$02:8343  B9 0E 02      LDA.W $020E,Y               ; |
$02:8346  9D 0E 02      STA.W $020E,X               ; |
$02:8349  B9 0F 02      LDA.W $020F,Y               ; |
$02:834C  9D 0F 02      STA.W $020F,X               ; / Copy the four OAM bytes (X, Y, tile, attributes) to the spare slot
$02:834F  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:8351  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:8352  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8353  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8354  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = spare slot offset / 4
$02:8355  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:8357  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:8359  99 23 04      STA.W $0423,Y               ; / Spare sprite size = 3: 16x16 with X high bit set, so it also shows at the left edge
$02:835C  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:835E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:835F  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:8361  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 += 4: next spare slot
$02:8363  90 02         BCC $8367             ; No carry: done
$02:8365  E6 04         INC $04                     ; Carry into the high byte of $03
$02:8367  7A            PLY                          ; Restore the OAM offset
$02:8368  A6 00         LDX $00                     ; X = $00 (entries left)
$02:836A  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:836B  88            DEY                          ; |
$02:836C  88            DEY                          ; |
$02:836D  88            DEY                          ; / Y -= 4: previous OAM slot
$02:836E  CA            DEX                          ; X--
$02:836F  30 03         BMI $8374             ; Done when X < 0
$02:8371  4C D8 82      JMP.W $82D8           ; Draw the next entry

$02:8374  E2 10         SEP #$10                    ; Index registers 8-bit
$02:8376  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:8378  8D 8C 18      STA.W $188C                 ; / [$188C] = 1: tiles and attributes are only written on the first frame
$02:837B  AD 84 18      LDA.W $1884                 ; \
$02:837E  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; |
$02:8380  D0 16         BNE $8398             ; / [$1884] != 1: go to the random flicker code
$02:8382  A9 CD         LDA.B #$CD                  ; \
$02:8384  8D BF 02      STA.W $02BF                 ; |
$02:8387  8D C3 02      STA.W $02C3                 ; |
$02:838A  8D C7 02      STA.W $02C7                 ; |
$02:838D  8D CB 02      STA.W $02CB                 ; |
$02:8390  8D CF 02      STA.W $02CF                 ; |

$02:8398  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \

$02:83A6  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM offset of flicker sprite X ($83C8)

$02:83AB  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; \

$02:83BE  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; |

$02:83C4  20 CE 83      JSR.W $83CE           ; Handle the falling columns ($83CE)
$02:83C7  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $83CE: Falling columns: move and draw ;;;
{
;; Handles two column objects ([$18A8,X] state: 0 off, positive falling, bit 7 set landed; [$18AA,X] Y position).
;; Falling columns freeze sprites and Mario, accelerate until Y = $B0, then shake the ground (timer $30) and play sound $09; a landed column is drawn as nine 16x16 segments.
;; Purpose not confirmed; possibly a falling-pillar boss attack.

$02:864D  A9 53         LDA.B #$53                  ; \
$02:864F  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite number = $53 (Throw Block)
$02:8651  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$02:8655  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:8657  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $FF
$02:865A  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:865C  8D 98 14      STA.W RAM_PickUpImgTimer    ; |
$02:865F  8D 8F 14      STA.W $148F                 ; / [RAM_PickUpImgTimer] = [$148F] = 8: Mario carrying pose
$02:8662  6B            RTL                          ; Return

}

;;; $8663: Shatter block into four pieces (ShatterBlock) ;;;
{
;; Spawns four brick pieces (minor extended sprite 1) around the block at [RAM_BlockXLo]/[RAM_BlockYLo], plays sound $07, and reuses slot [$185D] if all 12 slots are busy.
;; Parameters: A = value stored in each piece's [$1850]. Preserves X.
;; Called by: $01:99FE (Break Throw Block sprite (BreakThrowBlock)), $02:8779 (Break turn block (BreakTurnBlock)), $02:C2B9 (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:C2D6 (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:E48F (Exploding Block main (ExplodingBlkMain)), $03:822D (Big Boo boss: remaining states and helpers)
$02:8663  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:8664  85 00         STA $00                     ; $00 = A: parameter copied to each piece's [$1850]
$02:8666  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: four pieces (3..0)
$02:8668  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; X = $0B: search minor extended sprite slots
$02:866A  BD F0 17      LDA.W $17F0,X               ; \
$02:866D  F0 10         BEQ $867F             ; / Slot free: use it
$02:866F  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:8670  10 F8         BPL $866A             ; / Next slot, loop while X >= 0
$02:8672  CE 5D 18      DEC.W $185D                 ; \
$02:8675  10 05         BPL $867C             ; |
$02:8677  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; |
$02:8679  8D 5D 18      STA.W $185D                 ; / All slots busy: cycle [$185D] through 11..0
$02:867C  AE 5D 18      LDX.W $185D                 ; X = [$185D]: slot to overwrite
$02:867F  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; \
$02:8681  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Sound effect $07 ([$1DFC])
$02:8684  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:8686  9D F0 17      STA.W $17F0,X               ; / Minor extended sprite = 1 (brick piece)
$02:8689  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:868B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:868C  79 46 87      ADC.W $8746,Y         ; |
$02:868F  9D 08 18      STA.W $1808,X               ; / Piece X low = block X low + $8746[Y]
$02:8692  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; \
$02:8694  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:8696  9D EA 18      STA.W $18EA,X               ; / Piece X high = block X high + carry
$02:8699  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:869B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:869C  79 42 87      ADC.W $8742,Y         ; |
$02:869F  9D FC 17      STA.W $17FC,X               ; / Piece Y low = block Y low + $8742[Y]
$02:86A2  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; \
$02:86A4  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:86A6  9D 14 18      STA.W $1814,X               ; / Piece Y high = block Y high + carry
$02:86A9  B9 4A 87      LDA.W $874A,Y         ; \
$02:86AC  9D 20 18      STA.W $1820,X               ; / [$1820+X] = $874A[Y]
$02:86AF  B9 4E 87      LDA.W $874E,Y         ; \
$02:86B2  9D 2C 18      STA.W $182C,X               ; / [$182C+X] = $874E[Y]
$02:86B5  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:86B7  9D 50 18      STA.W $1850,X               ; / [$1850+X] = $00
$02:86BA  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:86BB  10 B2         BPL $866F             ; / Y--, next piece while >= 0
$02:86BD  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:86BE  6B            RTL                          ; Return

}

;;; $86BF: Yoshi stomp: shake ground (YoshiStompRoutine) ;;;
{
;; Creates a hitbox at Mario's feet to hurt sprites and starts the ground shake. Called from the Yoshi ground-stomp code in bank $00. Does nothing if [$1697] is non-zero.
;; Called by: $00:EF8C (Mario block and slope collision (rest))
$02:86BF  AD 97 16      LDA.W $1697                 ; Consecutive enemy stomp counter [$1697]
$02:86C2  D0 28         BNE $86EC            ; Non-zero: do nothing
$02:86C4  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:86C5  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank ($02)
$02:86C6  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:86C7  20 ED 86      JSR.W SprBlkInteract        ; Claim a block-hit hitbox slot Y (SprBlkInteract)
$02:86CA  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Slot status = 2 (Yoshi stomp hitbox)
$02:86CC  99 CD 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkStatus,Y  ; Store status in the slot
$02:86CF  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; Mario X low
$02:86D1  99 D1 16      STA.W $16D1,Y               ; Hitbox X low = Mario X low
$02:86D4  A5 95         LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; Mario X high
$02:86D6  99 DD 16      STA.W $16DD,Y               ; Stored in the Y-high table ($16DD), probably meant $16D5; overwritten below
$02:86D9  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \
$02:86DB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:86DC  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; } Hitbox Y low = Mario Y low + $20 (at his feet)
$02:86DE  99 D9 16      STA.W $16D9,Y               ; /
$02:86E1  A5 97         LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; \
$02:86E3  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Hitbox Y high = Mario Y high + carry
$02:86E5  99 DD 16      STA.W $16DD,Y               ; /
$02:86E8  20 E4 9B      JSR.W $9BE4           ; Shake the ground and spawn dust ($9BE4)
$02:86EB  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:86EC  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

}

;;; $86ED: Claim block-hit hitbox slot (SprBlkInteract) ;;;
{
;; Allocates one of four hitboxes ($16CD-$16DD) at the block position [$98]-[$9B] so sprites on top of a hit block get hurt. Returns: Y = slot. If all slots are used, slot 0 is overwritten. On layer 2 the position is adjusted by [$26]-[$29].
;; Called by: $02:86C7 (Yoshi stomp: shake ground (YoshiStompRoutine)), $02:877D (Break turn block (BreakTurnBlock)), $02:887A (Set up bounce sprite and spawn item (NoResetTurningBlk))
$02:86ED  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: search from the last of the four slots
$02:86EF  B9 CD 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkStatus,Y  ; Slot status [$16CD+Y]
$02:86F2  F0 04         BEQ $86F8             ; Zero: slot is free
$02:86F4  88            DEY                          ; Try previous slot
$02:86F5  10 F8         BPL $86EF             ; Loop for Y = 3..0
$02:86F7  C8            INY                          ; All in use: Y = 0 (overwrite slot 0)
$02:86F8  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; Block X low
$02:86FA  99 D1 16      STA.W $16D1,Y               ; Hitbox X low
$02:86FD  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; Block X high
$02:86FF  99 D5 16      STA.W $16D5,Y               ; Hitbox X high
$02:8702  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; Block Y low
$02:8704  99 D9 16      STA.W $16D9,Y               ; Hitbox Y low
$02:8707  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; Block Y high
$02:8709  99 DD 16      STA.W $16DD,Y               ; Hitbox Y high
$02:870C  AD 33 19      LDA.W $1933                 ; Layer 2 flag [$1933]
$02:870F  F0 1E         BEQ $872F             ; Layer 1: keep the positions as they are
$02:8711  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:8713  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8714  E5 26         SBC $26                     ; } Hitbox X low = block X low - [$26] (layer 2 offset)
$02:8716  99 D1 16      STA.W $16D1,Y               ; /
$02:8719  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; \
$02:871B  E5 27         SBC $27                     ; } Hitbox X high = block X high - [$27] - borrow
$02:871D  99 D5 16      STA.W $16D5,Y               ; /
$02:8720  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:8722  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8723  E5 28         SBC $28                     ; } Hitbox Y low = block Y low - [$28]
$02:8725  99 D9 16      STA.W $16D9,Y               ; /
$02:8728  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; \
$02:872A  E5 29         SBC $29                     ; } Hitbox Y high = block Y high - [$29] - borrow
$02:872C  99 DD 16      STA.W $16DD,Y               ; /
$02:872F  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Slot status = 1 (block hit)
$02:8731  99 CD 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkStatus,Y  ; Activate the slot
$02:8734  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; Lifetime = 6 frames
$02:8736  99 F8 18      STA.W $18F8,Y               ; [$18F8+Y] = 6 (hitbox timer)
$02:8739  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $873A: Table: bounce Y speed (BlockBounceSpeedY) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by direction [$06].
$02:873A                .db $C0,$00,$00,$40         ; Y speed per direction: up -$40, none, none, down +$40

}

;;; $873E: Tables and spawn bounce sprite entry (BlockBounceSpeedX) ;;;
{
;; Bounce X speeds, shatter-piece offset and speed tables, then the entry $028752 that decides between breaking and bouncing. Parameters: [$04] = bounce type.
$02:873E                .db $00,$40,$C0,$00         ; X speed per direction: none, right +$40, left -$C0 (-$40), none

$02:8742                .db $00,$00,$08,$08         ; Shatter piece X offset: $00,$00,$08,$08

$02:8746                .db $00,$08,$00,$08         ; Shatter piece X offset: $00,$08,$00,$08 (low part)

$02:874A                .db $FB,$FB,$FD,$FD         ; Shatter piece Y speed: $FB,$FB,$FD,$FD

$02:874E                .db $FF,$01,$FF,$01         ; Shatter piece X speed: $FF,$01,$FF,$01

$02:8752  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; Entry: Spawn bounce sprite. [$04] = bounce type
$02:8754  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; Type 7 = break the turn block?
$02:8756  D0 3A         BNE NotBreakable            ; No: go spawn a bounce sprite
}

;;; $8758: Break turn block (BreakTurnBlock) ;;;
{
;; Adds 50 points, bounces Mario, spawns shatter pieces, claims a hit hitbox and replaces the block with an empty tile.
$02:8758  AD B3 0D      LDA.W $0DB3                 ; \
$02:875B  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:875C  6D B3 0D      ADC.W $0DB3                 ; } X = [$0DB3] * 3: score offset of the current player
$02:875F  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:8760  BD 34 0F      LDA.W $0F34,X               ; \
$02:8763  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:8764  69 05         ADC.B #$05                  ; } Player score low += 5 (= 50 points, score is in tens)
$02:8766  9D 34 0F      STA.W $0F34,X               ; /
$02:8769  90 08         BCC $8773             ; No carry: done
$02:876B  FE 35 0F      INC.W $0F35,X               ; Carry into the middle score byte
$02:876E  D0 03         BNE $8773             ; No carry: done
$02:8770  FE 36 0F      INC.W $0F36,X               ; Carry into the high score byte
$02:8773  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; A = $D0
$02:8775  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = $D0 (upward): bounces off the broken block
$02:8777  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0: shatter piece type (normal)
$02:8779  22 63 86 02   JSL.L ShatterBlock          ; Spawn the four shatter pieces (ShatterBlock)
$02:877D  20 ED 86      JSR.W SprBlkInteract        ; Claim a block-hit hitbox slot (hurts sprites on top)
$02:8780  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; A = $02
$02:8782  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; Block to generate = $02 (empty tile)
$02:8784  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Replace the block in the map (GenerateTile)
$02:8788  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $8789: Table: bounce sprite property (BlockBounce) ;;;
{
;; Written to [$1901+Y]; indexed by bounce type.
$02:8789                .db $00,$03,$00,$00,$01,$07,$00,$04 ; Bounce sprite property [$1901] per bounce type $00-$08
$02:8791                .db $0A                     ; Type $08: $0A

}

;;; $8792: Spawn bounce sprite (NotBreakable) ;;;
{
;; Finds a free bounce sprite slot (or overwrites the oldest, settling a spinning turn block first) and fills it. Parameters: [$04] type, [$05] sprite to spawn, [$06] direction, [$07] tile to turn into. Also starts sprite/coin spawning.
$02:8792  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: search the four bounce sprite slots
}

;;; $8794: Find bounce sprite slot (FindTurningBlkSlot) ;;;
{
;; Loop over four slots; if none is free rotates [$18CD]. A replaced spinning turn block is first generated as a normal tile so it does not vanish.
$02:8794  B9 99 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,Y    ; Bounce sprite number in slot Y
$02:8797  F0 6E         BEQ $8807             ; Free slot: use it ($028807)
$02:8799  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:879A  10 F8         BPL FindTurningBlkSlot      ; Loop for Y = 3..0
$02:879C  CE CD 18      DEC.W $18CD                 ; No free slot: rotate the overwrite index [$18CD]
$02:879F  10 05         BPL $87A6             ; Still valid
$02:87A1  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; Wrap to 3
$02:87A3  8D CD 18      STA.W $18CD                 ; Store the wrapped index
$02:87A6  AC CD 18      LDY.W $18CD                 ; Y = slot to overwrite
$02:87A9  B9 99 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,Y    ; Number of the bounce sprite being replaced
$02:87AC  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; Is it a spinning turn block (7)?
$02:87AE  D0 54         BNE NoResetTurningBlk       ; No: just overwrite it
$02:87B0  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:87B2  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87B3  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; |
$02:87B5  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87B6  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:87B8  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87B9  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; } Save block position [$98]-[$9B] on the stack
$02:87BB  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:87BC  B9 A5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXLo,Y    ; \
$02:87BF  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:87C1  B9 AD 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXHi,Y    ; } Block X = old bounce sprite X
$02:87C4  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:87C6  B9 A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,Y    ; \
$02:87C9  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:87CA  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:87CC  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:87CE  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:87D0  B9 A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,Y    ; |
$02:87D3  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Block Y = old bounce sprite Y + $0C rounded down to $10
$02:87D5  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:87D7  B9 C1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprBlock,Y  ; \
$02:87DA  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = tile the old sprite was going to become
$02:87DC  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:87DE  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87DF  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; |
$02:87E1  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87E2  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; |
$02:87E4  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:87E5  A5 07         LDA $07                     ; } Save the spawn parameters [$04]-[$07]
$02:87E7  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:87E8  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Settle the old block into the map (GenerateTile)
$02:87EC  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:87ED  85 07         STA $07                     ; |
$02:87EF  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:87F0  85 06         STA $06                     ; |
$02:87F2  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:87F3  85 05         STA $05                     ; |
$02:87F5  68            PLA                          ; } Restore [$04]-[$07]
$02:87F6  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:87F8  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:87F9  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; |
$02:87FB  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:87FC  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:87FE  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:87FF  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; |
$02:8801  68            PLA                          ; } Restore block position [$98]-[$9B]
$02:8802  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; /
}

;;; $8804: Set up bounce sprite and spawn item (NoResetTurningBlk) ;;;
{
;; Writes type, position, speeds, timer and tile, claims a hitbox and then spawns the sprite or coin that was in the block.
$02:8804  AC CD 18      LDY.W $18CD                 ; Y = slot being overwritten
$02:8807  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; Bounce type [$04]
$02:8809  C9 10         CMP.B #$10                  ; Type >= $10?
$02:880B  90 0B         BCC $8818             ; No: use the normal table
$02:880D  64 04         STZ $04                     ; [$04] = 0
$02:880F  AA            TAX                          ; X = original type
$02:8810  BD 80 87      LDA.W $8780,X         ; Property byte read from code at $028780+X (table is the opcode bytes)
$02:8813  99 01 19      STA.W $1901,Y               ; Store as [$1901+Y]
$02:8816  80 12         BRA $882A             ; Continue

$02:8818  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; Bounce type [$04]
$02:881A  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; Type 5?
$02:881C  D0 05         BNE $8823             ; No: skip the sound
$02:881E  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; Sound $0B
$02:8820  8E F9 1D      STX.W $1DF9                 ; Play it on port $1DF9
$02:8823  AA            TAX                          ; X = type
$02:8824  BD 89 87      LDA.W BlockBounce,X         ; Property from BlockBounce table
$02:8827  99 01 19      STA.W $1901,Y               ; Store as [$1901+Y]
$02:882A  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:882C  1A            INC A                       ; } Bounce sprite number = type + 1 (0 means free)
$02:882D  99 99 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,Y    ; /
$02:8830  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:8832  99 9D 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprInit,Y   ; / Init state = 0
$02:8835  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:8837  99 A5 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprXLo,Y    ; |
$02:883A  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; } Bounce sprite X = block X
$02:883C  99 AD 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprXHi,Y    ; /
$02:883F  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:8841  99 A1 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,Y    ; |
$02:8844  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; } Bounce sprite Y = block Y
$02:8846  99 A9 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,Y    ; /
$02:8849  AD 33 19      LDA.W $1933                 ; Layer 2 flag [$1933]
$02:884C  4A            LSR                          ; Shift it into carry
$02:884D  6A            ROR                          ; Into bit 7: $80 if layer 2
$02:884E  85 08         STA $08                     ; [$08] = layer flag
$02:8850  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; X = direction [$06] (0 up, 1 right, 2 left, 3 down)
$02:8852  BD 3A 87      LDA.W BlockBounceSpeedY,X   ; \
$02:8855  99 B1 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,Y  ; / Bounce Y speed from table
$02:8858  BD 3E 87      LDA.W BlockBounceSpeedX,X   ; \
$02:885B  99 B5 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedX,Y  ; / Bounce X speed from table
$02:885E  8A            TXA                          ; A = direction
$02:885F  05 08         ORA $08                     ; Direction | layer flag
$02:8861  99 C9 16      STA.W $16C9,Y               ; Store in [$16C9+Y]
$02:8864  A5 07         LDA $07                     ; \
$02:8866  99 C1 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprBlock,Y  ; / Tile to turn into when it lands = [$07]
$02:8869  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:886B  99 C5 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprTimer,Y  ; / Bounce timer = 8 frames
$02:886E  B9 99 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,Y    ; Bounce sprite number
$02:8871  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; Spinning turn block (7)?
$02:8873  D0 05         BNE $887A             ; No: skip
$02:8875  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; A = $FF
$02:8877  99 CE 18      STA.W $18CE,Y               ; [$18CE+Y] = $FF (turn block timer)
$02:887A  20 ED 86      JSR.W SprBlkInteract        ; Claim a block-hit hitbox slot (hurts sprites on top)
$02:887D  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; Sprite to spawn from the block [$05]
$02:887F  F0 1F         BEQ $88A0            ; 0: nothing to spawn
$02:8881  C9 0A         CMP.B #$0A                  ; $0A?
$02:8883  D0 00         BNE $8885             ; Either way continue (leftover no-op)
$02:8885  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; Sprite index [$05]
$02:8887  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; $08 or more?
$02:8889  B0 51         BCS $88DC             ; Yes: spawn a sprite
$02:888B  C9 06         CMP.B #$06                  ; Below 6?
$02:888D  90 4D         BCC $88DC             ; Yes: spawn a sprite
$02:888F  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; 6 = single coin, 7 = multiple coin block
$02:8891  D0 0A         BNE $889D             ; Single coin: spawn it
$02:8893  AD 6B 18      LDA.W $186B                 ; Multi coin timer [$186B]
$02:8896  D0 05         BNE $889D             ; Already running: spawn coin
$02:8898  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; A = $FF
$02:889A  8D 6B 18      STA.W $186B                 ; Start the multiple coin timer
$02:889D  20 66 8A      JSR.W $8A66           ; Spawn a spinning coin ($8A66)
$02:88A0  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $88A3: Table: sprite spawned from block (SpriteInBlock) ;;;
{

$02:88AB                .db $79,$00,$3E,$7D,$2C,$04,$81,$45 ; $08-$0F: vine, -, POW, balloon, Yoshi egg, Koopa, changing item, directional coin
$02:88B3                .db $80                     ; $10: key

}

{

$02:88BC                .db $79,$00,$3E,$7D,$2C,$04,$81,$45 ; $08-$0F
$02:88C4                .db $80                     ; $10

}

;;; $88C5: Table: status of sprite from block (StatusOfSprInBlk) ;;;
{
;; Plus small tables used for the balloon-slot variants.
$02:88C5                .db $00,$08,$08,$08,$08,$08,$00,$00 ; Sprite status per index: 8 normal, 9 carried/stunned
$02:88CD                .db $08,$00,$09,$08,$09,$09,$08,$08 ; $08-$0F
$02:88D5                .db $09                     ; $10

$02:88D6                .db $80,$7E,$7D             ; Replacements for balloon by block X bits 4-5: key, flying red coin, balloon

$02:88D9                .db $09,$08,$08             ; Matching sprite status: $09, $08, $08

$02:88DC  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; Y = sprite index [$05]
$02:88DE  C0 0B         CPY.B #$0B                  ; Index $0B (P-balloon)?
$02:88E0  D0 08         BNE $88EA             ; No
$02:88E2  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; Block X low
$02:88E4  29 30         AND.B #$30                  ; Bits 4-5
$02:88E6  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; Equal to $20?
$02:88E8  F0 1B         BEQ GenSpriteFromBlk        ; Yes: normal spawn
$02:88EA  C0 10         CPY.B #$10                  ; Key?
$02:88EC  F0 0F         BEQ $88FD             ; Use FindFreeSprSlot
$02:88EE  C0 08         CPY.B #$08                  ; Vine?
$02:88F0  D0 07         BNE $88F9             ; No
$02:88F2  AD 92 16      LDA.W $1692                 ; Sprite memory setting [$1692]
$02:88F5  F0 0E         BEQ GenSpriteFromBlk        ; Zero: normal spawn
$02:88F7  D0 04         BNE $88FD             ; Else FindFreeSprSlot
$02:88F9  C0 0C         CPY.B #$0C                  ; Yoshi egg?
$02:88FB  D0 08         BNE GenSpriteFromBlk        ; No: normal spawn
$02:88FD  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:8901  BB            TYX                          ; X = slot
$02:8902  10 1E         BPL $8922             ; Found: go set it up
$02:8904  6B            RTL                          ; No slot: return long

}

;;; $8905: Spawn sprite from block (GenSpriteFromBlk) ;;;
{
;; Picks a slot, writes status, number and position, plays sound and applies per-sprite initial values. Parameters: [$05] = sprite index, block position in [$98]-[$9B]. Quirk: balloon slot replaced by key/coin/balloon by block X position; directional coin only one at a time.
$02:8905  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; X = $0B: search for a free slot from 11 down to 0
$02:8907  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; Sprite status in slot X
$02:890A  F0 16         BEQ $8922             ; Zero: slot free
$02:890C  CA            DEX                          ; Next slot
$02:890D  E0 FF         CPX.B #$FF                  ; Past slot 0?
$02:890F  D0 F6         BNE $8907             ; No: loop
$02:8911  CE 61 18      DEC.W $1861                 ; No free slot: alternate between slots $0A and $0B with [$1861]
$02:8914  10 05         BPL $891B             ; Still valid
$02:8916  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Wrap: A = 1
$02:8918  8D 61 18      STA.W $1861                 ; [$1861] = 1
$02:891B  AD 61 18      LDA.W $1861                 ; [$1861]
$02:891E  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:891F  69 0A         ADC.B #$0A                  ; + $0A
$02:8921  AA            TAX                          ; X = $0A or $0B
$02:8922  8E 5E 18      STX.W $185E                 ; Remember spawned slot in [$185E]
$02:8925  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; Y = sprite index
$02:8927  B9 C5 88      LDA.W StatusOfSprInBlk,Y    ; Sprite status from table
$02:892A  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; Set sprite status
$02:892D  AD E2 18      LDA.W $18E2                 ; Yoshi present flag [$18E2]
$02:8930  F0 05         BEQ $8937             ; No Yoshi: keep Y
$02:8932  98            TYA                          ; Y to A
$02:8933  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:8934  69 11         ADC.B #$11                  ; + $11: use the second table
$02:8936  A8            TAY                          ; Back to Y
$02:8937  8C 95 16      STY.W $1695                 ; Remember table index in [$1695]
$02:893A  B9 A3 88      LDA.W SpriteInBlock,Y       ; Sprite number from table
$02:893D  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Set sprite number
$02:893F  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; Also in [$0E]
$02:8941  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Sound 2 by default
$02:8943  C9 81         CMP.B #$81                  ; Sprite >= $81?
$02:8945  B0 05         BCS $894C             ; Yes: keep 2
$02:8947  C9 79         CMP.B #$79                  ; Sprite < $79?
$02:8949  90 01         BCC $894C             ; Yes: keep 2
$02:894B  C8            INY                          ; Sound 3 for $79-$80
$02:894C  8C FC 1D      STY.W $1DFC                 ; Play sound effect
$02:894F  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the sprite tables
$02:8953  FE A0 15      INC.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; Flag sprite as off-screen horizontally
$02:8956  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Sprite number
$02:8958  C9 45         CMP.B #$45                  ; Directional coin ($45)?
$02:895A  D0 16         BNE $8972             ; No
$02:895C  AD 32 14      LDA.W $1432                 ; Directional coins already active [$1432]
$02:895F  F0 06         BEQ $8967             ; No: start them
$02:8961  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Yes: kill the new sprite
$02:8964  4C 9D 88      JMP.W $889D           ; Spawn a coin instead

$02:8967  A9 0E         LDA.B #$0E                  ; Music $0E (directional coin music)
$02:8969  8D FB 1D      STA.W $1DFB                 ; Request music
$02:896C  EE 32 14      INC.W $1432                 ; [$1432] = 1 (directional coins active)
$02:896F  9C 0C 19      STZ.W $190C                 ; Clear directional coin timer [$190C]
$02:8972  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:8974  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; / Sprite X low = block X low
$02:8976  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; \
$02:8978  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; / Sprite X high = block X high
$02:897B  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:897D  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Sprite Y low = block Y low
$02:897F  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; \
$02:8981  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; / Sprite Y high = block Y high
$02:8984  AD 33 19      LDA.W $1933                 ; Layer 2 flag
$02:8987  F0 1C         BEQ $89A5             ; Layer 1: skip
$02:8989  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; \
$02:898B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:898C  E5 26         SBC $26                     ; } Sprite X low = block X low - [$26]
$02:898E  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; /
$02:8990  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; \
$02:8992  E5 27         SBC $27                     ; } Sprite X high = block X high - [$27] - borrow
$02:8994  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; /
$02:8997  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:8999  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:899A  E5 28         SBC $28                     ; } Sprite Y low = block Y low - [$28]
$02:899C  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:899E  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; \
$02:89A0  E5 29         SBC $29                     ; } Sprite Y high = block Y high - [$29] - borrow
$02:89A2  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:89A5  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Sprite number
$02:89A7  C9 7D         CMP.B #$7D                  ; Balloon ($7D)?
$02:89A9  D0 28         BNE $89D3             ; No
$02:89AB  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:89AD  29 30         AND.B #$30                  ; Bits 4-5
$02:89AF  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:89B0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:89B1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:89B2  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = (X low & $30) >> 4: random-looking choice by block position
$02:89B3  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:89B4  B9 D9 88      LDA.W $88D9,Y         ; \
$02:89B7  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status from table
$02:89BA  B9 D6 88      LDA.W $88D6,Y         ; \
$02:89BD  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite number from table (key, flying red coin or balloon)
$02:89BF  48            PHA                          ; Save new sprite number
$02:89C0  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the sprite tables
$02:89C4  68            PLA                          ; Restore sprite number
$02:89C5  C9 7D         CMP.B #$7D                  ; Balloon?
$02:89C7  D0 04         BNE $89CD             ; No
$02:89C9  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Sprite direction = 1
$02:89CC  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:89CD  C9 7E         CMP.B #$7E                  ; Flying red coin ($7E)?
$02:89CF  F0 32         BEQ $8A03             ; Yes: advance its state
$02:89D1  80 2E         BRA $8A01             ; Others: set speed and finish

$02:89D3  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; Koopa ($04)?
$02:89D5  F0 31         BEQ $8A08             ; Yes
$02:89D7  C9 3E         CMP.B #$3E                  ; POW ($3E)?
$02:89D9  F0 4F         BEQ $8A2A             ; Yes
$02:89DB  C9 2C         CMP.B #$2C                  ; Yoshi egg ($2C)?
$02:89DD  D0 32         BNE $8A11             ; No: other sprites
$02:89DF  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = $0B: search sprites for a Yoshi
$02:89E1  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; Sprite status
$02:89E4  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Below 8: not active
$02:89E6  90 0B         BCC $89F3             ; Skip
$02:89E8  B9 9E 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; Sprite number
$02:89EB  C9 2D         CMP.B #$2D                  ; Baby Yoshi ($2D)?
$02:89ED  D0 04         BNE $89F3             ; No
$02:89EF  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; Y = 1 (Yoshi exists: egg holds a 1-Up)
$02:89F1  80 08         BRA $89FB             ; Go store it

$02:89F3  88            DEY                          ; Next sprite
$02:89F4  10 EB         BPL $89E1             ; Loop
$02:89F6  AC E2 18      LDY.W $18E2                 ; Yoshi being ridden? [$18E2]
$02:89F9  D0 F4         BNE $89EF             ; Yes: 1-Up
$02:89FB  B9 A1 88      LDA.W $88A1,Y         ; Egg contents from table
$02:89FE  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Store in [$151C]
$02:8A01  80 0A         BRA $8A0D             ; Go set speed

$02:8A03  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Flying red coin: state += 2
$02:8A05  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State += 2 (second INC)
$02:8A07  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:8A08  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; A = $FF
$02:8A0A  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = $FF (Koopa stun timer)
$02:8A0D  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; A = $D0
$02:8A0F  80 07         BRA $8A18             ; Store speed

$02:8A11  A9 3E         LDA.B #$3E                  ; A = $3E
$02:8A13  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = $3E (time to rise out of the block)
$02:8A16  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; A = $D0
$02:8A18  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Sprite Y speed = $D0 (up)
$02:8A1A  A9 2C         LDA.B #$2C                  ; A = $2C
$02:8A1C  9D 4C 15      STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; Disable Mario interaction for $2C frames
$02:8A1F  BD 0F 19      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X     ; Tweaker byte [$190F]
$02:8A22  10 05         BPL $8A29            ; Bit 7 clear: done
$02:8A24  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; A = $10
$02:8A26  9D AC 15      STA.W $15AC,X               ; [$15AC] = $10 (turn timer)
$02:8A29  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:8A2A  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:8A2C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8A2D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8A2E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8A2F  4A            LSR                          ; } A = (X low >> 4) & 1
$02:8A30  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; /
$02:8A32  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; POW colour: [$151C] 0 blue, 1 silver
$02:8A35  A8            TAY                          ; Y = colour
$02:8A36  B9 42 8A      LDA.W $8A42,Y         ; Palette from table
$02:8A39  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; Set sprite palette
$02:8A3C  22 44 8A 02   JSL.L $8A44           ; Spawn smoke at the block
$02:8A40  80 CB         BRA $8A0D             ; Set speed


}

;;; $8A42..8A42: Table: POW palettes ;;;
{

;;; $8A44: Spawn smoke puff at block ;;;
{
;; Adds smoke sprite type 1 at the block (used when a POW appears).
;; Called by: $02:8A3C (Spawn sprite from block (GenSpriteFromBlk)), $02:DEE6 (Sumo Bro lightning main (SumosLightningMain)), $03:D77A (Break bridge one segment at a time (BreakBridge))
$02:8A44  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:8A45  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: find a free smoke slot
$02:8A47  BD C0 17      LDA.W $17C0,X               ; Smoke slot type
$02:8A4A  F0 04         BEQ $8A50             ; Free
$02:8A4C  CA            DEX                          ; Next
$02:8A4D  10 F8         BPL $8A47             ; Loop
$02:8A4F  E8            INX                          ; None free: use slot 0
$02:8A50  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1
$02:8A52  9D C0 17      STA.W $17C0,X               ; Smoke type 1 (puff of smoke)
$02:8A55  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; Block Y low
$02:8A57  9D C4 17      STA.W $17C4,X               ; Smoke Y
$02:8A5A  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; Block X low
$02:8A5C  9D C8 17      STA.W $17C8,X               ; Smoke X
$02:8A5F  A9 1B         LDA.B #$1B                  ; A = $1B
$02:8A61  9D CC 17      STA.W $17CC,X               ; Smoke timer = $1B
$02:8A64  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:8A65  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:8A66  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: find a free spinning coin slot
$02:8A68  BD D0 17      LDA.W $17D0,X               ; Coin slot active flag
$02:8A6B  F0 10         BEQ $8A7D             ; Free
$02:8A6D  CA            DEX                          ; Next
$02:8A6E  10 F8         BPL $8A68             ; Loop
$02:8A70  CE 65 18      DEC.W $1865                 ; None free: cycle [$1865]
$02:8A73  10 05         BPL $8A7A             ; Still valid
$02:8A75  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; Wrap to 3
$02:8A77  8D 65 18      STA.W $1865                 ; Store
$02:8A7A  AE 65 18      LDX.W $1865                 ; X = slot
$02:8A7D  22 4A B3 05   JSL.L $B34A           ; Collect a coin and play the coin sound
$02:8A81  FE D0 17      INC.W $17D0,X               ; Coin slot active = 1
$02:8A84  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; Block X low
$02:8A86  9D E0 17      STA.W $17E0,X               ; Coin X low
$02:8A89  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; Block X high
$02:8A8B  9D EC 17      STA.W $17EC,X               ; Coin X high
$02:8A8E  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; \
$02:8A90  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8A91  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; } Coin Y low = block Y - $10
$02:8A93  9D D4 17      STA.W $17D4,X               ; /
$02:8A96  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; \
$02:8A98  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Coin Y high
$02:8A9A  9D E8 17      STA.W $17E8,X               ; /
$02:8A9D  AD 33 19      LDA.W $1933                 ; Layer flag
$02:8AA0  9D E4 17      STA.W $17E4,X               ; Coin layer
$02:8AA3  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; A = $D0
$02:8AA5  9D D8 17      STA.W $17D8,X               ; Coin Y speed = $D0 (up)
$02:8AA8  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $8AB1: Misc sprite handlers per frame ;;;
{
;; Handles 1-Up awarding, star sparkles, minor extended sprites, bounce sprites, scores, extended sprites, spinning coins, shooters, generators, cape, level sprite loading and sprite respawn.
;; Called by: $00:A2E6 (Game mode 14: in level (InLevelGameMode))
$02:8AB1  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:8AB2  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank ($02)
$02:8AB3  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:8AB4  AD E4 18      LDA.W $18E4                 ; Pending 1-Up counter [$18E4]
$02:8AB7  F0 1C         BEQ $8AD5             ; None
$02:8AB9  AD E5 18      LDA.W $18E5                 ; Delay [$18E5]
$02:8ABC  F0 05         BEQ $8AC3             ; Zero: award
$02:8ABE  CE E5 18      DEC.W $18E5                 ; Count down delay
$02:8AC1  80 12         BRA $8AD5             ; Continue

$02:8AC3  CE E4 18      DEC.W $18E4                 ; One less pending 1-Up
$02:8AC6  F0 05         BEQ $8ACD             ; Zero left: no delay
$02:8AC8  A9 23         LDA.B #$23                  ; A = $23
$02:8ACA  8D E5 18      STA.W $18E5                 ; Delay between awards = $23
$02:8ACD  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:8ACF  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play 1-Up sound
$02:8AD2  EE BE 0D      INC.W RAM_StatusLives       ; Lives + 1
$02:8AD5  AD 90 14      LDA.W $1490                 ; \
$02:8AD8  F0 11         BEQ $8AEB             ; / Branch if Mario has no star
$02:8ADA  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Timer < 8: treat as no star
$02:8ADC  90 0D         BCC $8AEB             ; \
$02:8ADE  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8ADF  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8AE0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8AE1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8AE2  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = star timer >> 5
$02:8AE3  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:8AE4  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; Frame counter
$02:8AE6  39 A9 8A      AND.W $8AA9,Y         ; Mask by timer: sparkle more often early
$02:8AE9  80 0A         BRA $8AF5             ; Continue

$02:8AEB  AD D3 18      LDA.W $18D3                 ; Sparkle timer [$18D3]
$02:8AEE  F0 15         BEQ $8B05             ; None
$02:8AF0  CE D3 18      DEC.W $18D3                 ; Count down
$02:8AF3  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Every other frame
$02:8AF5  05 7F         ORA $7F                     ; OR Mario offscreen flag [$7F]
$02:8AF7  05 81         ORA $81                     ; OR [$81]
$02:8AF9  D0 0A         BNE $8B05             ; Not on screen or wrong frame: skip
$02:8AFB  A5 80         LDA $80                     ; Mario screen Y [$80]
$02:8AFD  C9 D0         CMP.B #$D0                  ; Below $D0?
$02:8AFF  B0 04         BCS $8B05             ; Yes: skip
$02:8B01  22 8F 85 02   JSL.L $858F           ; Spawn a sparkle at Mario
$02:8B05  20 67 8B      JSR.W $8B67           ; Minor extended sprites
$02:8B08  20 2D 90      JSR.W $902D           ; Bounce sprites
$02:8B0B  20 A4 AD      JSR.W ScoreSprGfx           ; Score sprites
$02:8B0E  20 0A 9B      JSR.W $9B0A           ; Extended sprites
$02:8B11  20 D2 99      JSR.W $99D2           ; Spinning coins from blocks
$02:8B14  20 87 B3      JSR.W $B387           ; Shooters
$02:8B17  20 FE AF      JSR.W CallGenerator         ; Generators
$02:8B1A  20 F5 94      JSR.W $94F5           ; Cape interaction
$02:8B1D  20 FC A7      JSR.W LoadSprFromLevel      ; Load sprites from level data
$02:8B20  AD C0 18      LDA.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn   ; \
$02:8B23  F0 40         BEQ $8B65             ; / Return if respawn timer not set
$02:8B25  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:8B27  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:8B29  05 9D         ORA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; |
$02:8B2B  0D BF 18      ORA.W $18BF                 ; } Only every other frame and while sprites are unlocked
$02:8B2E  D0 35         BNE $8B65             ; /
$02:8B30  CE C0 18      DEC.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn   ; \
$02:8B33  D0 30         BNE $8B65             ; / Decrement; return unless it hit zero
$02:8B35  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; \
$02:8B39  30 2A         BMI $8B65             ; / Return if no free slot
$02:8B3B  BB            TYX                          ; X = slot
$02:8B3C  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \

;;; $8CB8: Minor extended sprite 0A: Boo stream (BooStreamTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile table (12 slots) followed by the main routine of minor extended sprite 0A, the Boo stream trail (probably from the Boo ring/stream effect).
;; Hurts Mario on contact (8x8 hitbox offset +4,+4), counts down the timer in [$1850,X] and draws one 16x16 tile (BooStreamTiles[slot]).
;; Parameters: X = minor extended sprite slot (0-11), also in [$1698].
$02:8CB8                .db $88,$A8,$AA,$8C,$8E,$AE,$88,$A8 ; Tile numbers per slot X = 0-11 (first two groups of six: alternating 16x16 Boo stream frames)
$02:8CC0                .db $AA,$8C,$8E,$AE         ; Tiles for slots 8-11

$02:8CC4  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:8CC6  D0 37         BNE $8CFF             ; / Skip the hitbox and timer when sprites are locked
$02:8CC8  BD 08 18      LDA.W $1808,X               ; \
$02:8CCB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:8CCC  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } $04 = minor extended sprite X low + 4 (hitbox X)
$02:8CCE  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:8CD0  BD EA 18      LDA.W $18EA,X               ; \
$02:8CD3  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $0A = X high (plus carry)
$02:8CD5  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; /
$02:8CD7  BD FC 17      LDA.W $17FC,X               ; \
$02:8CDA  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:8CDB  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } $05 = Y low + 4 (hitbox Y)
$02:8CDD  85 05         STA $05                     ; /
$02:8CDF  BD 14 18      LDA.W $1814,X               ; \
$02:8CE2  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $0B = Y high (plus carry)
$02:8CE4  85 0B         STA $0B                     ; /
$02:8CE6  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:8CE8  85 06         STA $06                     ; } $06 = $07 = 8 (hitbox width and height)
$02:8CEA  85 07         STA $07                     ; /
$02:8CEC  22 64 B6 03   JSL.L GetMarioClipping      ; Get Mario's hitbox
$02:8CF0  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Compare the hitboxes
$02:8CF4  90 04         BCC $8CFA             ; No contact: skip
$02:8CF6  22 B7 F5 00   JSL.L HurtMario             ; Hurt Mario
$02:8CFA  DE 50 18      DEC.W $1850,X               ; Count down the lifetime timer
$02:8CFD  F0 63         BEQ $8D62             ; Timer ran out: delete this sprite
$02:8CFF  BC 78 8B      LDY.W BrokenBlock,X         ; Y = OAM index for this slot
$02:8D02  BD 08 18      LDA.W $1808,X               ; \
$02:8D05  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8D06  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } $00 = X position on screen (low byte)
$02:8D08  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:8D0A  BD EA 18      LDA.W $18EA,X               ; \
$02:8D0D  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; } Different screen page horizontally: do not draw
$02:8D0F  D0 30         BNE $8D41            ; /
$02:8D11  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:8D13  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X = screen X
$02:8D16  BD FC 17      LDA.W $17FC,X               ; \
$02:8D19  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8D1A  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } Y on screen; $F0 or more is off-screen
$02:8D1C  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; /
$02:8D1E  B0 42         BCS $8D62             ; Off-screen: delete the sprite
$02:8D20  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y = screen Y
$02:8D23  BD B8 8C      LDA.W BooStreamTiles,X      ; \
$02:8D26  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = BooStreamTiles[slot]
$02:8D29  BD 2C 18      LDA.W $182C,X               ; \
$02:8D2C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8D2D  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; |
$02:8D2F  49 40         EOR.B #$40                  ; |
$02:8D31  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:8D33  09 0F         ORA.B #$0F                  ; } Prop = flip X when moving right, | [$64] priority | palette 7
$02:8D35  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:8D38  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:8D39  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8D3A  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:8D3B  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:8D3C  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:8D3E  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / OAM size bit = 2 (16x16)
$02:8D41  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $8DD7: Minor extended sprite 06/08/09: floating Z (RipVanFishZsTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile table and routine shared by types 06, 08 and 09 (06 = Rip Van Fish Z; 08/09 draw fixed tile $7F; type 09 moves the opposite way).
;; X speed wobbles by 1 every 16 frames, rises 1 pixel every 4th timer step and is deleted when the timer hits $14.
;; The AND #$00 at $028DEA makes a test always fall through (leftover from an earlier design).
$02:8DD7                .db $F1,$F0,$E1,$E0         ; Rip Van Fish Z tile numbers, indexed by [timer] / 32 mod 4

$02:8DDB  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:8DDD  D0 41         BNE $8E20             ; / Skip movement when sprites are locked
$02:8DDF  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8DE2  F0 03         BEQ $8DE7             ; } Count the timer down if it is non-zero
$02:8DE4  DE 50 18      DEC.W $1850,X               ; /
$02:8DE7  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8DEA  29 00         AND.B #$00                  ; } (AND #$00 makes this test never branch: always run the speed wobble)
$02:8DEC  D0 10         BNE $8DFE             ; /
$02:8DEE  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8DF1  FE 2C 18      INC.W $182C,X               ; |
$02:8DF4  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; } X speed += 1, then -= 2 unless bit 4 of timer set: speed wobbles +/-1 every 16 frames
$02:8DF6  D0 06         BNE $8DFE             ; /
$02:8DF8  DE 2C 18      DEC.W $182C,X               ; X speed -= 1
$02:8DFB  DE 2C 18      DEC.W $182C,X               ; X speed -= 1 (net -1)
$02:8DFE  BD 2C 18      LDA.W $182C,X               ; \
$02:8E01  48            PHA                          ; / Save X speed on the stack
$02:8E02  BC F0 17      LDY.W $17F0,X               ; \
$02:8E05  C0 09         CPY.B #$09                  ; } Y = sprite type; type 9 moves the other way
$02:8E07  D0 06         BNE $8E0F             ; /
$02:8E09  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:8E0B  1A            INC A                       ; } Type 9: X speed = -[X speed] (speed is restored below)
$02:8E0C  9D 2C 18      STA.W $182C,X               ; /
$02:8E0F  20 BC B5      JSR.W $B5BC           ; Move X position by the speed
$02:8E12  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:8E13  9D 2C 18      STA.W $182C,X               ; / Restore the original X speed
$02:8E16  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8E19  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Every 4th timer value: float upward
$02:8E1B  D0 03         BNE $8E20             ; /
$02:8E1D  DE FC 17      DEC.W $17FC,X               ; Y position -= 1
$02:8E20  BC 78 8B      LDY.W BrokenBlock,X         ; Y = OAM index for this slot
$02:8E23  BD 08 18      LDA.W $1808,X               ; \
$02:8E26  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8E27  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:8E29  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Screen X below $08: off-screen
$02:8E2B  90 49         BCC $8E76             ; /
$02:8E2D  C9 FC         CMP.B #$FC                  ; \
$02:8E2F  B0 45         BCS $8E76             ; / Screen X $FC or more: off-screen
$02:8E31  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X = screen X
$02:8E34  BD FC 17      LDA.W $17FC,X               ; \
$02:8E37  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8E38  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:8E3A  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; } Y on screen; $F0 or more is off-screen
$02:8E3C  B0 38         BCS $8E76             ; /
$02:8E3E  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y = screen Y
$02:8E41  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:8E43  09 03         ORA.B #$03                  ; } Prop = [$64] | palette 1 | name table 1
$02:8E45  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:8E48  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8E4B  C9 14         CMP.B #$14                  ; } Timer = $14: delete
$02:8E4D  F0 27         BEQ $8E76             ; /
$02:8E4F  BD F0 17      LDA.W $17F0,X               ; \
$02:8E52  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Type >= 8: use fixed tile $7F
$02:8E54  A9 7F         LDA.B #$7F                  ; /
$02:8E56  B0 0E         BCS $8E66             ; A = $7F (carry set for types 8 and 9)
$02:8E58  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8E5B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8E5C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8E5D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8E5E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8E5F  4A            LSR                          ; } Type < 8: frame = ([timer] / 32) & 3
$02:8E60  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; /
$02:8E62  AA            TAX                          ; \
$02:8E63  BD D7 8D      LDA.W RipVanFishZsTiles,X   ; / OAM tile = RipVanFishZsTiles[frame]
$02:8E66  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile = A
$02:8E69  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:8E6A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8E6B  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:8E6C  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:8E6D  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:8E6F  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / OAM size bit = 0 (8x8)
$02:8E72  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; Restore X = slot index
$02:8E75  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:8E76  9E F0 17      STZ.W $17F0,X               ; Delete this minor extended sprite
$02:8E79  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

{
;; Moves by its X/Y speed with gravity (Y speed += 2 per frame), draws tile $6F with flips taken from timer bits 6-7. Deleted when ([$1850] & $3F) = 0 or off-screen.

$02:8E97  BD FC 17      LDA.W $17FC,X               ; \
$02:8E9A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8E9B  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } Screen Y; $F0 or more is off-screen
$02:8E9D  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; /
$02:8E9F  B0 36         BCS $8ED7             ; Off-screen: delete
$02:8EA1  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y = screen Y

$02:8EA7  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:8EA8  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } Screen X; $F8 or more is off-screen
$02:8EAA  C9 F8         CMP.B #$F8                  ; /
$02:8EAC  B0 29         BCS $8ED7             ; Off-screen: delete
$02:8EAE  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X = screen X
$02:8EB1  A9 6F         LDA.B #$6F                  ; \
$02:8EB3  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = $6F
$02:8EB6  BD 50 18      LDA.W $1850,X               ; \
$02:8EB9  29 C0         AND.B #$C0                  ; |
$02:8EBB  09 03         ORA.B #$03                  ; |

$02:8EBF  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:8EC2  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:8EC3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:8EC4  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:8EC5  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:8EC6  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:8EC8  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / OAM size bit = 0 (8x8)
$02:8ECB  60            RTS                          ; Return


}
