$02:9032  90 07         BCC $903B             ; /
$02:9034  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9036  D0 03         BNE $903B             ; / Frozen while sprites are locked
$02:9038  CE 6B 18      DEC.W $186B                 ; Count the multiple coin block timer down
$02:903B  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: start with the last bounce sprite slot
$02:903D  8E 98 16      STX.W $1698                 ; [$1698] = current bounce sprite slot
$02:9040  20 4D 90      JSR.W $904D           ; Run the bounce sprite's main routine
$02:9043  20 98 93      JSR.W $9398           ; Bounce sprite interaction with sprites and the player
$02:9046  20 C0 96      JSR.W $96C0           ; Run extended sprite slot X (shares the loop)
$02:9049  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:904A  10 F1         BPL $903D             ; / Next slot; loop for X = 3..0
$02:904C  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:904D  BD 99 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,X    ; \
$02:9050  F0 FA         BEQ $904C            ; / No bounce sprite in this slot: return
$02:9052  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9054  D0 08         BNE $905E             ; / Skip timer when sprites are locked
$02:9056  BC C5 16      LDY.W RAM_BounceSprTimer,X  ; \
$02:9059  F0 03         BEQ $905E             ; / Timer [$16C5] is 0: skip
$02:905B  DE C5 16      DEC.W RAM_BounceSprTimer,X  ; Timer -= 1
$02:905E  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Jump to the routine for this bounce sprite type

}

;;; $9062: Pointer table: bounce sprite routines (BounceSpritePtrs) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by bounce sprite type [$1699,X] (via ExecutePtr). Types 01-06 share BounceBlockSpr; type 07 is TurnBlockSpr.
;; Also holds $9072 at $029072 (4 bytes, Y acceleration for the turn block).
$02:9062  4C 90         .dw $904C            ; 00 - Nothing (bypassed above)
$02:9064  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 01 - Turn block (not spinning)
$02:9066  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 02 - Music block
$02:9068  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 03 - Question block
$02:906A  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 04 - Sideways bounce block
$02:906C  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 05 - Translucent block
$02:906E  DE 90         .dw BounceBlockSpr          ; 06 - On/off block
$02:9070  76 90         .dw TurnBlockSpr            ; 07 - Turn block (spinning, can break)

$02:9072                .db $13,$00,$00,$ED         ; Y acceleration per direction [$16C9], used by turn block: down, none, none, up

}

;;; $9076: Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine (TurnBlockSpr) ;;;
{
;; Handles the spinning turn block: first frame creates an invisible solid block, applies Y gravity while bouncing and on the last frame snaps to the 16-pixel grid and generates the final block.
;; Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.
$02:9076  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9078  D0 53         BNE $90CD            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:907A  BD 9D 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprInit,X   ; \
$02:907D  D0 06         BNE $9085             ; / Already initialized: skip
$02:907F  FE 9D 16      INC.W RAM_BounceSprInit,X   ; Mark initialized
$02:9082  20 B8 91      JSR.W InvisSldFromBncSpr    ; Generate an invisible solid block at the sprite's position
$02:9085  BD C5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprTimer,X  ; \
$02:9088  F0 31         BEQ $90BB             ; / Timer = 0: skip to the end handling
$02:908A  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; \
$02:908C  D0 1A         BNE $90A8             ; / Timer = 1 (last frame of the bounce)?
$02:908E  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:9091  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9092  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Round Y position to a 16-pixel block row
$02:9094  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; /
$02:9096  9D A1 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; Store low byte
$02:9099  BD A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; \
$02:909C  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Store high byte
$02:909E  9D A9 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; /
$02:90A1  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; A = $05: block to generate (spinning turn block)
$02:90A3  20 BA 91      JSR.W TileFromBounceSpr1    ; Generate it at the sprite's position
$02:90A6  80 13         BRA $90BB             ; Go to the spin timer check

$02:90A8  20 26 B5      JSR.W $B526           ; Move Y position by Y speed
$02:90AB  BC C9 16      LDY.W $16C9,X               ; Y = direction
$02:90AE  BD B1 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; \
$02:90B1  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:90B2  79 72 90      ADC.W $9072,Y         ; } Y speed += $9072[direction]
$02:90B5  9D B1 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; /
$02:90B8  20 F8 91      JSR.W BounceSprGfx          ; Draw the bounce sprite
$02:90BB  BD CE 18      LDA.W $18CE,X               ; \
$02:90BE  F0 04         BEQ $90C4             ; / Spin timer [$18CE] is 0: finish
$02:90C0  DE CE 18      DEC.W $18CE,X               ; Spin timer -= 1
$02:90C3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:90C4  BD C1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprBlock,X  ; \
$02:90C7  20 BA 91      JSR.W TileFromBounceSpr1    ; / Generate the block this sprite turns into
$02:90CA  9E 99 16      STZ.W RAM_BounceSprNum,X    ; Free the bounce sprite slot
$02:90CD  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $90CE..90DA: Data: bounce block acceleration and Mario speed tables ;;;
{
;; Four 4-byte tables indexed by direction ([$16C9,X] & 3): Y acceleration, X acceleration, Mario Y speed, Mario X speed ($80 = leave alone).
$02:90CE                .db $10,$00,$00,$F0         ; Y acceleration per direction (bounce block): down, none, none, up

$02:90D2                .db $00,$F0,$10,$00         ; X acceleration per direction: none, left, right, none

$02:90D6                .db $80,$80,$80,$00         ; Mario Y speed set at start per direction ($80 = leave alone)

$02:90DA                .db $80,$E0,$20,$80         ; Mario X speed set at start per direction ($80 = leave alone)

}

;;; $90DE: Bounce sprite 01-06: bounce block routine (BounceBlockSpr) ;;;
{
;; Shared routine for bounce blocks (turn without spin, music, question, sideways, translucent, on/off). Draws itself, sets up an invisible solid block once, moves by its speeds
;; and accelerates it back. Direction 3 carries Mario on top, then launches him ($A0) when the timer ends. At the end it turns into the final block (TileFromBounceSpr0).
;; Type 6 (on/off block) also toggles [RAM_OnOffStatus] and plays sound $0B.
;; Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.
$02:90DE  20 F8 91      JSR.W BounceSprGfx          ; Draw the bounce sprite
$02:90E1  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:90E3  D0 E8         BNE $90CD            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:90E5  BD 9D 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprInit,X   ; \
$02:90E8  D0 21         BNE $910B             ; / Already initialized: skip
$02:90EA  FE 9D 16      INC.W RAM_BounceSprInit,X   ; Mark initialized
$02:90ED  20 65 92      JSR.W $9265           ; Call $9265 (one-time setup at block position)
$02:90F0  20 B8 91      JSR.W InvisSldFromBncSpr    ; Generate an invisible solid block at the sprite's position
$02:90F3  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:90F6  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = direction ([$16C9] & 3)
$02:90F8  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:90F9  B9 D6 90      LDA.W $90D6,Y         ; \
$02:90FC  C9 80         CMP.B #$80                  ; } Mario Y speed table value $80: leave alone
$02:90FE  F0 02         BEQ $9102             ; /
$02:9100  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = table value
$02:9102  B9 DA 90      LDA.W $90DA,Y         ; \
$02:9105  C9 80         CMP.B #$80                  ; } Mario X speed table value $80: leave alone
$02:9107  F0 02         BEQ $910B             ; /
$02:9109  85 7B         STA RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; Mario X speed = table value
$02:910B  20 26 B5      JSR.W $B526           ; Move Y position by Y speed
$02:910E  20 1A B5      JSR.W $B51A           ; Move X position by X speed
$02:9111  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:9114  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = direction
$02:9116  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:9117  BD B1 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; \
$02:911A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:911B  79 CE 90      ADC.W $90CE,Y         ; } Y speed += $90CE[direction]
$02:911E  9D B1 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; /
$02:9121  BD B5 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedX,X  ; \
$02:9124  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9125  79 D2 90      ADC.W $90D2,Y         ; } X speed += $90D2[direction]
$02:9128  9D B5 16      STA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedX,X  ; /
$02:912B  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:912E  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:9130  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; } Direction 3 (pushed down)? Otherwise skip
$02:9132  D0 2A         BNE $915E             ; /
$02:9134  A5 71         LDA RAM_MarioAnimation      ; \
$02:9136  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; } Mario animation 0 (normal)? Otherwise skip
$02:9138  B0 24         BCS $915E             ; /
$02:913A  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; A = $20: Mario height above block
$02:913C  AC 7A 18      LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; \
$02:913F  F0 02         BEQ $9143             ; / On Yoshi?
$02:9141  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; A = $30 (Mario on Yoshi is taller)
$02:9143  85 00         STA $00                     ; $00 = offset
$02:9145  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:9148  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9149  E5 00         SBC $00                     ; } Mario Y position = block Y - [$00] (stand on the block)
$02:914B  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; /
$02:914D  BD A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; \
$02:9150  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Mario Y position high
$02:9152  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; /
$02:9154  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:9156  8D 71 14      STA.W $1471                 ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is standing on a platform
$02:9159  8D 02 14      STA.W $1402                 ; [$1402] = 1 (flag set while riding the block, purpose unclear)
$02:915C  64 7D         STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = 0
$02:915E  BD C5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprTimer,X  ; \
$02:9161  D0 39         BNE $919C            ; / Timer still running: return
$02:9163  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:9166  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Direction 3?
$02:9168  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; /
$02:916A  D0 16         BNE $9182             ; Not 3: skip the bounce
$02:916C  A9 A0         LDA.B #$A0                  ; \
$02:916E  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; / Mario Y speed = $A0 (launched upward)
$02:9170  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \
$02:9172  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9173  E9 02         SBC.B #$02                  ; |
$02:9175  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; |
$02:9177  A5 97         LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; |
$02:9179  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Mario Y position -= 2
$02:917B  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; /
$02:917D  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:917F  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $08
$02:9182  20 9F 91      JSR.W TileFromBounceSpr0    ; Turn into the final block
$02:9185  BC 99 16      LDY.W RAM_BounceSprNum,X    ; \
$02:9188  C0 06         CPY.B #$06                  ; / Y = bounce sprite type
$02:918A  90 0D         BCC $9199             ; Types below 6: just free the slot
$02:918C  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:918E  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect $0B (on/off switch)
$02:9191  AD AF 14      LDA.W RAM_OnOffStatus       ; \
$02:9194  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Toggle the on/off status
$02:9196  8D AF 14      STA.W RAM_OnOffStatus       ; /
$02:9199  9E 99 16      STZ.W RAM_BounceSprNum,X    ; Free the bounce sprite slot
$02:919C  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $919D..919D: Data: unreferenced bytes ;;;
{
$02:919D                .db $01,$00                 ; Unreferenced data

}

;;; $919F: Turn bounce sprite into its block (TileFromBounceSpr0) ;;;
{
;; Chooses the block to generate from [RAM_BounceSprBlock,X]. Multiple coin blocks ($0A/$0B) become a used block ($0D) on their last hit ([$186B] = 1). Falls to TileFromBounceSpr1.
;; Parameters: X = bounce sprite slot.
;; Called by: $02:9182 (Bounce sprite 01-06: bounce block routine (BounceBlockSpr))
$02:919F  BD C1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprBlock,X  ; \
$02:91A2  C9 0A         CMP.B #$0A                  ; / A = block this sprite becomes; $0A?
$02:91A4  F0 04         BEQ $91AA             ; Yes: check the multiple coin timer
$02:91A6  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:91A8  D0 0C         BNE $91B6             ; / $0B? Other values go straight to the block
$02:91AA  AC 6B 18      LDY.W $186B                 ; \
$02:91AD  C0 01         CPY.B #$01                  ; / [$186B] (multiple coin timer) = 1: last hit?
$02:91AF  D0 05         BNE $91B6             ; No: keep the block
$02:91B1  9C 6B 18      STZ.W $186B                 ; Clear the multiple coin timer
$02:91B4  A9 0D         LDA.B #$0D                  ; A = $0D: used block
$02:91B6  80 02         BRA TileFromBounceSpr1      ; Generate the block

}

;;; $91B8: Generate invisible solid block (InvisSldFromBncSpr) ;;;
{
;; Sets the block to generate to $09 (invisible solid) and falls into TileFromBounceSpr1.
;; Called by: $02:9082 (Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine (TurnBlockSpr)), $02:90F0 (Bounce sprite 01-06: bounce block routine (BounceBlockSpr)), $02:9347 (Draw bounce sprite, check coin tile (BounceSprGfx))
$02:91B8  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; A = $09: invisible solid block
}

;;; $91BA: Generate block at bounce sprite position (TileFromBounceSpr1) ;;;
{
;; Sets [RAM_BlockBlock] = A, block position = bounce sprite position + 8 rounded down to a 16-pixel grid, [$1933] = layer flag, then JSL GenerateTile.
;; Parameters: A = block number; X = bounce sprite slot.
;; Called by: $02:90A3 (Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine (TurnBlockSpr)), $02:90C7 (Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine (TurnBlockSpr))
$02:91BA  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; Set the block number to generate
$02:91BC  BD A5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXLo,X    ; \
$02:91BF  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:91C0  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } X position + 8, rounded to a 16-pixel column
$02:91C2  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; /
$02:91C4  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; Set block X low
$02:91C6  BD AD 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXHi,X    ; \
$02:91C9  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Block X high
$02:91CB  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:91CD  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:91D0  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:91D1  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Y position + 8, rounded to a 16-pixel row
$02:91D3  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; /
$02:91D5  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; Set block Y low
$02:91D7  BD A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; \
$02:91DA  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Block Y high
$02:91DC  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:91DE  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:91E1  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:91E2  2A            ROL                          ; |
$02:91E3  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } [$1933] = layer flag (bit 7 of direction/layer byte)
$02:91E5  8D 33 19      STA.W $1933                 ; /
$02:91E8  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the block
$02:91EC  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $91ED..91ED: Data: bounce sprite OAM indexes ;;;
{
;; OAM offsets for bounce sprite slots 0-2 ($10,$14,$18); slot 3 reads the first byte of BounceSpriteTiles.
$02:91ED                .db $10,$14,$18             ; OAM indexes for bounce sprite slots 0-2 (slot 3 reads the next byte)

}

;;; $91F0: Table: bounce sprite tile numbers (BounceSpriteTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers indexed by bounce sprite type (0-7), used by BounceSprGfx.
$02:91F0                .db $1C,$40,$6B,$2A,$42,$EA,$8A,$40 ; Tile numbers indexed by bounce sprite type

}

;;; $91F8: Draw bounce sprite, check coin tile (BounceSprGfx) ;;;
{
;; $0291F8: draws bounce sprite [$1698] as one 16x16 OAM tile (position relative to the camera of its layer, tile from BounceSpriteTiles).
;; Returns without drawing if the sprite is off-screen.
;; $029265: finds the Map16 tile at the bounce sprite. If it is a coin ($002B) the coin is removed (tile type 9 generated) and a
;; spinning coin is spawned ($029356, uses a free slot of [$17D0]-[$17D3]), as when hitting a block with a coin above it.
;; Parameters: X: bounce sprite slot.
;; Called by: $02:90B8 (Bounce sprite 07: turn block routine (TurnBlockSpr)), $02:90DE (Bounce sprite 01-06: bounce block routine (BounceBlockSpr))
$02:91F8  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: layer 1 camera
$02:91FA  BD C9 16      LDA.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:91FD  10 02         BPL $9201             ; |
$02:91FF  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; / Y = 4 (layer 2 camera) if [$16C9] bit 7 is set
$02:9201  B9 1C 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYLo,Y  ; \
$02:9204  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = camera Y low of that layer
$02:9206  B9 1A 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y  ; \
$02:9209  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 = camera X low
$02:920B  B9 1D 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi,Y  ; \
$02:920E  85 04         STA $04                     ; / $04 = camera Y high
$02:9210  B9 1B 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryXHi,Y  ; \
$02:9213  85 05         STA $05                     ; / $05 = camera X high
$02:9215  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:9218  C5 02         CMP $02                     ; |
$02:921A  BD A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; |
$02:921D  E5 04         SBC $04                     ; |
$02:921F  D0 CB         BNE $91EC            ; / Return if the bounce sprite is more than a screen away vertically
$02:9221  BD A5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXLo,X    ; \
$02:9224  C5 03         CMP $03                     ; |
$02:9226  BD AD 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXHi,X    ; |
$02:9229  E5 05         SBC $05                     ; |
$02:922B  D0 BF         BNE $91EC            ; / Return if the bounce sprite is more than a screen away horizontally
$02:922D  BC ED 91      LDY.W $91ED,X         ; Y = OAM index for this bounce slot ($10, $14, $18, $1C)
$02:9230  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:9233  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9234  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; |
$02:9236  85 01         STA $01                     ; |
$02:9238  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / OAM Y = $01 = bounce sprite Y - camera Y
$02:923B  BD A5 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprXLo,X    ; \
$02:923E  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:923F  E5 03         SBC $03                     ; |
$02:9241  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:9243  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X = $00 = bounce sprite X - camera X
$02:9246  BD 01 19      LDA.W $1901,X               ; \
$02:9249  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:924B  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / OAM properties = [$1901] (YXPPCCCT) OR priority bits [$64]
$02:924E  BD 99 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprNum,X    ; \
$02:9251  AA            TAX                          ; / X = bounce sprite number (type)
$02:9252  BD F0 91      LDA.W BounceSpriteTiles,X   ; \
$02:9255  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = BounceSpriteTiles[type]
$02:9258  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9259  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:925A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:925B  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: index into the OAM size table
$02:925C  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:925E  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / Size bit = 2: 16x16 sprite
$02:9261  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; X = current bounce slot again
$02:9264  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9265  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1: bit mask for "layer 1 is vertical"
$02:9267  BC C9 16      LDY.W $16C9,X               ; \
$02:926A  84 0F         STY $0F                     ; / $0F = [$16C9] (bit 7: layer 2)
$02:926C  10 01         BPL $926F             ; Layer 1: keep mask 1
$02:926E  0A            ASL                          ; Layer 2: mask 2 (layer 2 vertical)
$02:926F  25 5B         AND RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:9271  F0 57         BEQ $92CA             ; / Branch if that layer is horizontal ($92CA)
$02:9273  BD A1 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:9276  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9277  E9 03         SBC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:9279  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:927B  85 00         STA $00                     ; / $00 = (bounce Y low - 3) rounded to a tile row (high nibble)
$02:927D  BD A9 16      LDA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; \
$02:9280  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; / A = bounce Y high - borrow: screen number (vertical level)
$02:9282  C5 5D         CMP RAM_ScreensInLvl        ; \
$02:9284  B0 43         BCS $92C9            ; / Return if beyond the last screen of the level
$02:9286  85 03         STA $03                     ; $03 = screen number

;;; $9394: Bounce block and cape hit sprites ;;;
{
;; $029394: frees a bounce slot. $029398: per-frame bounce block interaction. Counts down [$18F8,X]; in the last 2 frames checks every
;; sprite (X = $0B-0) against the bounce hitbox, or the cape hitbox when $0E is non-zero ($0293AE), and hits them with $9404.
;; $029404: knocks one sprite: 8 frame interaction lockout, kill with score, stunned (status 9) if it can be jumped on, Y speed up,
;; X speed away from Mario. Special cases: changing item ($81), baby Yoshi, Bob-omb, Lakitu.
;; Parameters: X: sprite slot, $0E: 0 = bounce block, $35 = ground pound, other = cape.
$02:9394  9E CD 16      STZ.W RAM_BouncBlkStatus,X  ; Free this bounce sprite slot
$02:9397  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9398  BD CD 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkStatus,X  ; \
$02:939B  F0 FA         BEQ $9397            ; / Return if the bounce slot is free
$02:939D  DE F8 18      DEC.W $18F8,X               ; \
$02:93A0  F0 F2         BEQ $9394             ; / Decrement the slot timer; free the slot when it reaches 0
$02:93A2  BD F8 18      LDA.W $18F8,X               ; \
$02:93A5  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; |
$02:93A7  B0 E8         BCS $9391            ; / Only interact with sprites during the last 2 frames of the bounce
$02:93A9  AC 98 16      LDY.W $1698                 ; Y = current bounce slot
$02:93AC  64 0E         STZ $0E                     ; $0E = 0: bounce block mode (not cape)
$02:93AE  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; X = $0B: loop over all 12 sprite slots
$02:93B0  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; [$15E9] = current sprite slot
$02:93B3  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:93B6  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; |
$02:93B8  F0 3D         BEQ $93F7             ; / Skip sprites with status $0B (carried)
$02:93BA  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:93BC  90 39         BCC $93F7             ; / Skip sprites with status < 8 (dead, initializing)
$02:93BE  BD 6E 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X     ; \
$02:93C1  29 20         AND.B #$20                  ; |
$02:93C3  1D D0 15      ORA.W $15D0,X               ; |
$02:93C6  1D 4C 15      ORA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; |
$02:93C9  1D E2 1F      ORA.W $1FE2,X               ; |

$02:93CE  BD 32 16      LDA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X   ; A = sprite is behind scenery flag
$02:93D1  5A            PHY                          ; Protect Y

$02:93D8  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y
$02:93D9  4D F9 13      EOR.W RAM_IsBehindScenery   ; \
$02:93DC  D0 19         BNE $93F7             ; / Skip sprites on a different layer than Mario ([$13F9] XOR flags)
$02:93DE  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Get the sprite's hitbox (hitbox A)
$02:93E2  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:93E4  F0 05         BEQ $93EB             ; / Bounce block: $0E = 0
$02:93E6  20 96 96      JSR.W $9696           ; Cape: get the cape hitbox (hitbox B)
$02:93E9  80 03         BRA $93EE             ; Skip the block hitbox

$02:93EB  20 63 96      JSR.W $9663           ; Get the bounce block hitbox (hitbox B)
$02:93EE  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Check whether hitbox A and B overlap
$02:93F2  90 03         BCC $93F7             ; No contact: next sprite

$02:93F7  AC 98 16      LDY.W $1698                 ; Y = current bounce slot
$02:93FA  CA            DEX                          ; Next sprite slot
$02:93FB  30 03         BMI $9400             ; All slots checked: finish
$02:93FD  4C B0 93      JMP.W $93B0           ; Loop

$02:9400  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; X = current bounce slot
$02:9403  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9404  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \

$02:9415  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \

$02:9419  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \

$02:9421  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \

$02:9427  C9 2D         CMP.B #$2D                  ; \
$02:9429  F0 1D         BEQ $9448             ; / Baby Yoshi (sprite $2D): go on at 029448
$02:942B  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; \
$02:942E  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; |
$02:9430  D0 70         BNE $94A2             ; / Sprite tweaker [$167A] bit 1 set: skip the kill, just launch it (0294A2)
$02:9432  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:9435  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |

$02:943D  F0 09         BEQ $9448
$02:943F  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:9441  F0 05         BEQ $9448             ; / State 0: go on at 029448
$02:9443  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:9445  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $FF (stun timer)
$02:9448  9E 58 15      STZ.W $1558,X               ; Clear [$1558]
$02:944B  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:944D  C9 35         CMP.B #$35                  ; |
$02:944F  F0 04         BEQ $9455             ; / Ground pound ($0E = $35): skip the contact graphic
$02:9451  22 6F AB 01   JSL.L $AB6F           ; Spawn a contact star at the sprite
$02:9455  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:9457  22 E5 AC 02   JSL.L GivePoints            ; / Give points (score step 0)
$02:945B  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:945D  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$02:9460  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:9462  C9 1E         CMP.B #$1E                  ; |
$02:9464  D0 05         BNE $946B             ; / Lakitu (sprite $1E)?
$02:9466  A9 1F         LDA.B #$1F                  ; \
$02:9468  8D 49 15      STA.W $1549                 ; / Lakitu: [$1549] = $1F
$02:946B  BD 62 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; \
$02:946E  29 80         AND.B #$80                  ; |
$02:9470  D0 30         BNE $94A2             ; / Tweaker [$1662] bit 7 set: skip the shell conversion
$02:9472  BD 56 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X     ; \
$02:9475  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; |
$02:9477  F0 29         BEQ $94A2             ; / Skip if it cannot be jumped on
$02:9479  BD 56 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1656,X     ; \

$02:947E  D0 22         BNE $94A2             ; / Skip if it dies when jumped on
$02:9480  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:9482  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 9 (carryable)
$02:9485  1E F6 15      ASL.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:9488  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9489  7E F6 15      ROR.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; / Set the Y flip bit of the sprite palette byte (upside down)
$02:948C  BD 86 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,X     ; \

$02:9491  F0 0F         BEQ $94A2             ; / Tweaker [$1686] bit 6 clear: keep the sprite as is

;;; $94C1: Ground pound: shake ground (GroundPound) ;;;
{
;; Called by Mario's code (JSL from $00EFB2). Sets the ground shake timer [$1887] = $30, then hits every grounded sprite.
;; Falls into KillSprLoopStart.
;; Called by: $00:EFB2 (Cape ground pound on landing (CallGroundPound))
$02:94C1  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:94C3  8D 87 18      STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer    ; / Ground shake timer = $30
$02:94C6  9C A9 14      STZ.W $14A9                 ; Clear [$14A9]
$02:94C9  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:94CA  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:94CB  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank ($02)
$02:94CC  A2 09         LDX.B #$09                  ; X = 9: loop over sprite slots 9 to 0
}

;;; $94CE: Ground pound: hit grounded sprites (KillSprLoopStart) ;;;
{
;; For sprite slots 9 to 0: skips dead sprites, sprites in the air, sprites that cannot be killed by the cape/are eaten/have
;; interaction disabled; the others are hit with $0E = $35 through $9404.
$02:94CE  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:94D1  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |
$02:94D3  90 1B         BCC GroundPoundNextSpr      ; / Skip sprites with status < 8
$02:94D5  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:94D8  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:94DA  F0 14         BEQ GroundPoundNextSpr      ; / Skip sprites that are not on the ground
$02:94DC  BD 6E 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X     ; \
$02:94DF  29 20         AND.B #$20                  ; |
$02:94E1  1D D0 15      ORA.W $15D0,X               ; |
$02:94E4  1D 4C 15      ORA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; |
$02:94E7  D0 07         BNE GroundPoundNextSpr      ; / Skip if tweaker bit $20, being eaten or interaction disabled
$02:94E9  A9 35         LDA.B #$35                  ; \
$02:94EB  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; / $0E = $35: ground pound mode
$02:94ED  20 04 94      JSR.W $9404           ; Knock the sprite up
}

;;; $94F0: Ground pound loop end; cape interaction (GroundPoundNextSpr) ;;;
{
;; $0294F0: next sprite of the ground pound loop, restores the data bank and returns long.
;; $0294F5: cape interaction. Does nothing unless [$13E8] is set. On odd frames hits sprites and extended sprites; every frame
;; tests the Map16 tile at the cape ($02950B), also on layer 2 if bit 7 of [$5B] is set.
$02:94F0  CA            DEX                          ; Next sprite
$02:94F1  10 DB         BPL KillSprLoopStart        ; Loop until X < 0
$02:94F3  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:94F4  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

;Handles cape interaction
$02:94F5  AD E8 13      LDA.W $13E8                 ; \
$02:94F8  F0 10         BEQ $950A            ; / Return if the cape is not active ([$13E8] = 0)
$02:94FA  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; $0E = [$13E8]: not a bounce block
$02:94FC  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \

{

$02:956A  79 3E 95      ADC.W $953E,Y         ; |

$02:956F  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; / $01 = BlockXLo = cape X + offset
$02:9571  AD EA 13      LDA.W $13EA                 ; \

$02:957A  85 02         STA $02                     ; \

$02:957E  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \

$02:9582  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9583  4A            LSR                          ; |

$02:958E  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; |
$02:9590  F0 04         BEQ $9596             ; |
$02:9592  BF 8E BA 00   LDA.L $BA8E,X         ; |
$02:9596  18            CLC                          ; |

$02:959B  BF BC BA 00   LDA.L $BABC,X         ; \
$02:959F  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; |
$02:95A1  F0 04         BEQ $95A7             ; |
$02:95A3  BF CA BA 00   LDA.L $BACA,X         ; |

$02:95B2  79 3C 95      ADC.W $953C,Y         ; |
$02:95B5  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:95B7  85 00         STA $00                     ; |

$02:95BB  AD EC 13      LDA.W $13EC                 ; \
$02:95BE  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:95C0  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; |

$02:95C4  85 02         STA $02                     ; \

$02:95CC  79 3E 95      ADC.W $953E,Y         ; |

$02:95D3  AD EA 13      LDA.W $13EA                 ; \
$02:95D6  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:95D8  C5 5D         CMP RAM_ScreensInLvl        ; |
$02:95DA  B0 D1         BCS $95AD            ; / Return if beyond the last screen
$02:95DC  85 03         STA $03                     ; \
$02:95DE  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; / $03 = BlockXHi = screen number
$02:95E0  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:95E2  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:95E3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:95E4  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:95E5  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:95E6  05 00         ORA $00                     ; |
$02:95E8  85 00         STA $00                     ; / $00 = YYYYXXXX: tile row | tile column within the screen
$02:95EA  A6 03         LDX $03                     ; X = screen number
$02:95EC  BF 60 BA 00   LDA.L $BA60,X         ; \
$02:95F0  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; |
$02:95F2  F0 04         BEQ $95F8             ; |
$02:95F4  BF 70 BA 00   LDA.L $BA70,X         ; |
$02:95F8  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:95F9  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |

$02:95FD  BF 9C BA 00   LDA.L $BA9C,X         ; \
$02:9601  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; |
$02:9603  F0 04         BEQ $9609             ; |

$02:960B  85 06         STA $06                     ; / $06 = Map16 pointer high
$02:960D  A9 7E         LDA.B #$7E                  ; \

$02:9622  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:9624  8D 33 19      STA.W $1933                 ; / [$1933] = layer
$02:9627  AD 93 16      LDA.W $1693                 ; A = tile number low byte
$02:962A  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0

$02:9692  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 = height
$02:9694  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X

$02:9696  AD E9 13      LDA.W $13E9                 ; \
$02:9699  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:969A  E9 02         SBC.B #$02                  ; |

;;; $96DF: Smoke sprite types 1-2 (puff, burst) ;;;
{
;; Handlers for smoke sprite slots $17C0,X types 1 and 2, called from the smoke dispatcher at $0296C0 (pointer table at $0296CB).
;; Type 1: a 16x16 puff, frame = timer / 4, drawn from the timer [$17CC,X]; blinks via X-flip in its last 8 frames.
;; Type 2: four 8x8 tiles ($7C/$7D) forming a 16x16 burst that flips with the timer. Uses OAM $02F0, or $0390 in boss rooms.
;; Slot is freed when the timer ends or the sprite leaves the screen. The first routine at $0296DF only frees the slot.
$02:96DF  9E C0 17      STZ.W $17C0,X               ; Free the smoke sprite slot

$02:96E3  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; Smoke type 1 (puff): timer [$17CC,X] = 0?
$02:96E6  F0 F7         BEQ $96DF             ; Yes: free the slot
$02:96E8  BD C0 17      LDA.W $17C0,X               ; A = smoke type byte [$17C0,X]
$02:96EB  30 04         BMI $96F1             ; Bit 7 set: count down even while sprites are locked
$02:96ED  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:96EF  D0 03         BNE $96F4             ; / Sprites locked: do not count down

$02:96FD  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; Bit 6 set: boss room, use the other OAM slots
$02:96FF  F0 49         BEQ $974A             ; Not a boss room: use the normal OAM slots
$02:9701  BC BC 96      LDY.W $96BC,X         ; Y = OAM index for this slot from $96BC ($0300 area)
$02:9704  BD C8 17      LDA.W $17C8,X               ; \
$02:9707  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9708  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / A = smoke X on screen = [$17C8,X] - [$1A]
$02:970A  C9 F4         CMP.B #$F4                  ; \
$02:970C  B0 D1         BCS $96DF             ; / Off-screen horizontally ($F4 or more): free the slot
$02:970E  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; OAM X
$02:9711  BD C4 17      LDA.W $17C4,X               ; \
$02:9714  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9715  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / A = smoke Y on screen = [$17C4,X] - [$1C]
$02:9717  C9 E0         CMP.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:9719  B0 C4         BCS $96DF             ; / Off-screen vertically ($E0 or more): free the slot
$02:971B  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; OAM Y
$02:971E  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; A = timer
$02:9721  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Timer >= 8?
$02:9723  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0 (no flip)
$02:9725  B0 06         BCS $972D             ; Yes: no flip
$02:9727  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:9728  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9729  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:972A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:972B  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; / Timer < 8: X-flip bit toggles every 2 frames (blink)
$02:972D  05 64         ORA $64                     ; Add the sprite priority bits [$64]
$02:972F  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM properties
$02:9732  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; A = timer

$02:9737  4A            LSR                          ; |

;;; $98CA: Smoke type 5: sparkle spawner ;;;
{
;; Smoke type 5, created when a coin is collected. Every 4th frame while its timer counts down it spawns a minor extended sprite (type 2, timer $17)
;; at an offset around the smoke position. Reuses the oldest slot ([$185D] round-robin) when all 12 slots are busy.
$02:98CA  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; Smoke type 5 (sparkle spawner): timer = 0?
$02:98CD  F0 EF         BEQ $98BE             ; Yes: free the slot
$02:98CF  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Y = [RAM_SpritesLocked]
$02:98D1  D0 4E         BNE $9921            ; Locked: return
$02:98D3  DE CC 17      DEC.W $17CC,X               ; Timer--
$02:98D6  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; \
$02:98D8  D0 47         BNE $9921            ; / Only spawn every 4th frame (old timer AND 3 = 0)
$02:98DA  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = 11: search the 12 minor extended sprite slots
$02:98DC  B9 F0 17      LDA.W $17F0,Y               ; \
$02:98DF  F0 10         BEQ $98F1             ; / Slot [$17F0,Y] free? Yes: use it
$02:98E1  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:98E2  10 F8         BPL $98DC             ; / Next slot, loop
$02:98E4  CE 5D 18      DEC.W $185D                 ; \
$02:98E7  10 05         BPL $98EE             ; / All slots busy: step the round-robin index [$185D] down...
$02:98E9  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; ...wrapping around to 11
$02:98EB  8D 5D 18      STA.W $185D                 ; Store the wrapped index
$02:98EE  AC 5D 18      LDY.W $185D                 ; Y = slot to overwrite
$02:98F1  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Minor extended sprite type 2
$02:98F3  99 F0 17      STA.W $17F0,Y               ; Set the slot's type
$02:98F6  BD C4 17      LDA.W $17C4,X               ; A = smoke Y
$02:98F9  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = smoke Y
$02:98FB  BD C8 17      LDA.W $17C8,X               ; A = smoke X
$02:98FE  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = smoke X
$02:9900  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; \
$02:9903  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9904  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9905  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / A = timer / 4 AND 3: offset index
$02:9907  DA            PHX                          ; Save the smoke slot
$02:9908  AA            TAX                          ; X = offset index
$02:9909  BD C2 98      LDA.W $98C2,X         ; \
$02:990C  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:990D  65 00         ADC $00                     ; / A = X + $98C2[X]
$02:990F  99 08 18      STA.W $1808,Y               ; New sprite X low
$02:9912  BD C6 98      LDA.W $98C6,X         ; \
$02:9915  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9916  65 01         ADC $01                     ; / A = Y + $98C6[X]
$02:9918  99 FC 17      STA.W $17FC,Y               ; New sprite Y low
$02:991B  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the smoke slot
$02:991C  A9 17         LDA.B #$17                  ; Initial timer = $17
$02:991E  99 50 18      STA.W $1850,Y               ; New sprite timer
$02:9921  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $9927: Smoke type 3 and spinning coin loop ;;;
{
;; Smoke type 3: 8x8 puff that rises 1 pixel every 8 frames and changes tile with the timer. Draws into the $0200 or $0300 OAM area depending on [$A5], [$140F], [$0D9B].
;; $0299D2 (separate routine): main loop over the 4 spinning coin slots of coins from blocks, calling $99F1 for each used slot ([$17D0,X] != 0).
;; $0299E3: clears the current spinning coin slot.
$02:9927  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; Smoke type 3 (rising puff): timer = 0?
$02:992A  D0 15         BNE $9941             ; No: keep running
$02:992C  2C 9B 0D      BIT.W $0D9B                 ; Test [$0D9B] bit 6 (boss room)
$02:992F  50 0D         BVC $993E             ; Not a boss room: just free the slot
$02:9931  AD 0F 14      LDA.W $140F                 ; A = [$140F]
$02:9934  D0 08         BNE $993E             ; Non-zero: just free the slot
$02:9936  BC BC 96      LDY.W $96BC,X         ; Y = OAM index for the boss room slot
$02:9939  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; Y position $F0 = off-screen
$02:993B  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Hide the sprite
$02:993E  4C 93 97      JMP.W $9793           ; Free the slot

$02:9941  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Y = [RAM_SpritesLocked]
$02:9943  D0 0A         BNE $994F             ; Locked: do not count down
$02:9945  DE CC 17      DEC.W $17CC,X               ; Timer--
$02:9948  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; \
$02:994A  D0 03         BNE $994F             ; / Every 8th frame (old timer AND 7 = 0)...
$02:994C  DE C4 17      DEC.W $17C4,X               ; ...the puff rises 1 pixel: Y--
$02:994F  A5 A5         LDA $A5                     ; A = [$A5]
$02:9951  C9 A9         CMP.B #$A9                  ; [$A5] = $A9?
$02:9953  F0 17         BEQ $996C             ; Yes: use the normal OAM slot
$02:9955  AD 0F 14      LDA.W $140F                 ; A = [$140F]
$02:9958  D0 12         BNE $996C             ; Non-zero: use the normal OAM slot
$02:995A  AD 9B 0D      LDA.W $0D9B                 ; A = [$0D9B]
$02:995D  10 0D         BPL $996C             ; Bit 7 clear (not a Mode 7 boss room): normal OAM slot
$02:995F  C9 C1         CMP.B #$C1                  ; [$0D9B] = $C1?
$02:9961  F0 04         BEQ $9967             ; Yes: use the boss room slot
$02:9963  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; A = [$0D9B] AND $40
$02:9965  D0 38         BNE $999F             ; Bit 6 set: draw into the $0300 area
$02:9967  BC BC 96      LDY.W $96BC,X         ; Y = OAM index from $96BC
$02:996A  80 03         BRA $996F             ; Go draw

$02:996C  BC B8 96      LDY.W $96B8,X         ; Y = OAM index from $96B8
$02:996F  BD C8 17      LDA.W $17C8,X               ; \
$02:9972  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9973  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / A = X on screen = [$17C8,X] - [$1A]
$02:9975  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X
$02:9978  BD C4 17      LDA.W $17C4,X               ; \
$02:997B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:997C  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / A = Y on screen = [$17C4,X] - [$1C]
$02:997E  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y
$02:9981  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; A = sprite priority bits [$64]
$02:9983  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; OAM properties
$02:9986  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; \
$02:9989  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:998A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:998B  AA            TAX                          ; / X = timer / 4: tile frame
$02:998C  BD 22 99      LDA.W $9922,X         ; A = tile from $9922
$02:998F  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; Restore X = [$1698] (smoke slot)
$02:9992  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile number
$02:9995  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9996  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9997  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9998  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:9999  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size = 0: 8x8 sprite
$02:999B  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Write OAM size/X high bits
$02:999E  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:999F  BC BC 96      LDY.W $96BC,X         ; Y = OAM index from $96BC ($0300 area)
$02:99A2  BD C8 17      LDA.W $17C8,X               ; \
$02:99A5  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:99A6  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / A = X on screen = [$17C8,X] - [$1A]
$02:99A8  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; OAM X
$02:99AB  BD C4 17      LDA.W $17C4,X               ; \
$02:99AE  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:99AF  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / A = Y on screen = [$17C4,X] - [$1C]
$02:99B1  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; OAM Y
$02:99B4  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; A = sprite priority bits [$64]
$02:99B6  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM properties
$02:99B9  BD CC 17      LDA.W $17CC,X               ; \
$02:99BC  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:99BD  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:99BE  AA            TAX                          ; / X = timer / 4: tile frame
$02:99BF  BD 22 99      LDA.W $9922,X         ; A = tile from $9922
$02:99C2  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; Restore X = [$1698] (smoke slot)
$02:99C5  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile number
$02:99C8  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:99C9  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:99CA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:99CB  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:99CC  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size = 0: 8x8 sprite
$02:99CE  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Write OAM size/X high bits
$02:99D1  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:99D2  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; \
$02:99D4  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; / X = 3: loop over the 4 spinning coin slots; [$15E9] = current slot
$02:99D7  BD D0 17      LDA.W $17D0,X               ; \
$02:99DA  F0 03         BEQ $99DF             ; / Slot [$17D0,X] in use?
$02:99DC  20 F1 99      JSR.W $99F1           ; Yes: run the spinning coin
$02:99DF  CA            DEX                          ; Next slot
$02:99E0  10 F2         BPL $99D4             ; Loop until X < 0
$02:99E2  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:99E3  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Spinning coin slot = 0 (unused)
$02:99E5  9D D0 17      STA.W $17D0,X               ; Clear the slot
$02:99E8  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

{
;; OAM indexes of the 4 spinning coin slots: $30,$38,$40,$48. The other 4 bytes ($EC,$EA,$E8,$EC) look unused.
$02:99E9                .db $30,$38,$40,$48,$EC,$EA,$E8,$EC ; OAM indexes of the 4 spinning coin slots ($0230-$0248); last 4 bytes look unused

}

;;; $99F1: Spinning coin from block ;;;
{
;; Handles one spinning coin slot X ([$17D0,X] != 0). Unless sprites are locked: applies speed and gravity (+3 per frame); once Y speed reaches $20 the coin is collected ($9AA8).
;; Draws a 16x16 face tile $E8 relative to its layer ([$17E4,X] picks layer 1 or 2). Frame (slot + [RAM_FrameCounterB]) / 4 AND 3 selects the face or the edge-on frame.
;; Erases the coin if it is off-screen horizontally; does not draw if off-screen vertically.
;; Parameters: X: coin slot.
;; Called by: $02:99DC (Smoke type 3 and spinning coin loop)
$02:99F1  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Spinning coin from block: sprites locked?
$02:99F3  D0 13         BNE $9A08             ; Yes: skip movement, just draw
$02:99F5  20 8E B5      JSR.W $B58E           ; Apply the coin's speed to its position
$02:99F8  BD D8 17      LDA.W $17D8,X               ; \
$02:99FB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:99FC  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:99FE  9D D8 17      STA.W $17D8,X               ; / Coin Y speed [$17D8,X] += 3 (gravity)
$02:9A01  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; Speed >= $20?
$02:9A03  30 03         BMI $9A08             ; No (or negative): keep drawing
$02:9A05  4C A8 9A      JMP.W $9AA8           ; Fell far enough: collect the coin

$02:9A08  BD E4 17      LDA.W $17E4,X               ; A = coin layer [$17E4,X] (0 or 1)
$02:9A0B  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:9A0C  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9A0D  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = layer * 4: offset of that layer's scroll position
$02:9A0E  B9 1C 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYLo,Y  ; \
$02:9A11  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = layer Y position low
$02:9A13  B9 1A 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y  ; \
$02:9A16  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = layer X position low
$02:9A18  B9 1D 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi,Y  ; \
$02:9A1B  85 04         STA $04                     ; / [$04] = layer Y position high
$02:9A1D  BD D4 17      LDA.W $17D4,X               ; \
$02:9A20  C5 02         CMP $02                     ; |
$02:9A22  BD E8 17      LDA.W $17E8,X               ; |
$02:9A25  E5 04         SBC $04                     ; |
$02:9A27  D0 44         BNE $9A6D            ; / If the coin is not on the same screen row as the layer Y, return (not drawn)
$02:9A29  BD E0 17      LDA.W $17E0,X               ; \
$02:9A2C  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9A2D  E5 03         SBC $03                     ; / A = coin X - layer X (8-bit)
$02:9A2F  C9 F8         CMP.B #$F8                  ; Off-screen horizontally ($F8 or more)?
$02:9A31  B0 B0         BCS $99E3             ; Yes: erase the coin
$02:9A33  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = X on screen
$02:9A35  BD D4 17      LDA.W $17D4,X               ; \
$02:9A38  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9A39  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; / A = coin Y - layer Y
$02:9A3B  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = Y on screen
$02:9A3D  BC E9 99      LDY.W $99E9,X         ; Y = OAM index from $99E9
$02:9A40  84 0F         STY $0F                     ; [$0F] = OAM index
$02:9A42  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; Y = OAM index (redundant reload)
$02:9A44  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = X on screen
$02:9A46  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X
$02:9A49  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = Y on screen
$02:9A4B  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y
$02:9A4E  A9 E8         LDA.B #$E8                  ; Tile $E8: the coin face
$02:9A50  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile number
$02:9A53  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; Properties: palette 2
$02:9A55  05 64         ORA $64                     ; Add the sprite priority bits [$64]
$02:9A57  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; OAM properties
$02:9A5A  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9A5B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A5C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A5D  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:9A5E  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Size = 2: 16x16 sprite
$02:9A60  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Write OAM size/X high bits
$02:9A63  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:9A64  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9A65  65 14         ADC RAM_FrameCounterB       ; |
$02:9A67  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A68  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A69  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / A = (slot + [RAM_FrameCounterB]) / 4 AND 3: coin animation frame
$02:9A6B  D0 04         BNE $9A71             ; Non-zero: show the edge-on frame instead
$02:9A6D  60            RTS                          ; Frame 0: keep the face tile, return


}

;;; $9A6E: Coin edge frames, coin collect, extended sprite loop (RollingCoinTiles) ;;;
{
;; $029A6E: tiles for the edge-on coin ($EA, $FA, $EA); drawn as two 8x8 halves by $029A71, the bottom half Y-flipped.
;; $029AA8: coin collected: spawns a 10 point score sprite at the coin, a sparkle (smoke type 5) via $029ADA, clears the coin slot.
;; $029ADA: finds a free smoke slot and makes it type 5 (timer $10), at the coin position minus [$26]/[$28] on layer 2.
;; $029B0A: main loop over the 10 extended sprite slots (X = 9..0, [$15E9] = X) calling $029B16.
;; $029B16: per-slot dispatcher: skips empty slots, counts down the timer [$176F,X] unless sprites are locked, then jumps via ExtendedSpritePtrs.
$02:9A6E                .db $EA,$FA,$EA             ; Edge-on coin tiles (top half; frames 1-3)
;The spinning coin, when showing a frame image of its edge facing towards the screen
;takes *2* OAM slot so that it can reuse the tile $EA and $FA, Y flipped for the bottom
;half
$02:9A71  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; Y = OAM index
$02:9A73  DA            PHX                          ; Save the coin slot
$02:9A74  AA            TAX                          ; X = frame (1-3)
$02:9A75  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:9A77  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9A78  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; / A = X on screen + 4 (centre the thin coin)
$02:9A7A  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X of the top half
$02:9A7D  99 04 02      STA.W $0204,Y               ; OAM X of the bottom half
$02:9A80  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:9A82  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9A83  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; / A = Y on screen + 8
$02:9A85  99 05 02      STA.W $0205,Y               ; OAM Y of the bottom half
$02:9A88  BF 6D 9A 02   LDA.L $9A6D,X        ; A = RollingCoinTiles[frame - 1] (reads $029A6D + X)
$02:9A8C  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; Top half tile
$02:9A8F  99 06 02      STA.W $0206,Y               ; Bottom half tile
$02:9A92  B9 03 02      LDA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; \
$02:9A95  09 80         ORA.B #$80                  ; / Bottom half properties = top half properties
$02:9A97  99 07 02      STA.W $0207,Y               ; ...with the Y-flip bit added
$02:9A9A  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9A9B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A9C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9A9D  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:9A9E  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size = 0: 8x8 sprites
$02:9AA0  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Size of the top half
$02:9AA3  99 21 04      STA.W $0421,Y               ; Size of the bottom half
$02:9AA6  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the coin slot
$02:9AA7  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9AA8  22 34 AD 02   JSL.L $AD34           ; Find a free score sprite slot (Y)
$02:9AAC  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Score sprite type 1 = 10 points
$02:9AAE  99 E1 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,Y     ; Set the score sprite type
$02:9AB1  BD D4 17      LDA.W $17D4,X               ; Coin Y low
$02:9AB4  99 E7 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,Y     ; Score sprite Y low
$02:9AB7  BD E8 17      LDA.W $17E8,X               ; Coin Y high
$02:9ABA  99 F9 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,Y     ; Score sprite Y high
$02:9ABD  BD E0 17      LDA.W $17E0,X               ; Coin X low
$02:9AC0  99 ED 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,Y     ; Score sprite X low
$02:9AC3  BD EC 17      LDA.W $17EC,X               ; Coin X high
$02:9AC6  99 F3 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXHi,Y     ; Score sprite X high
$02:9AC9  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; Initial Y speed of the score sprite = $30
$02:9ACB  99 FF 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,Y  ; Set the score sprite Y speed
$02:9ACE  BD E4 17      LDA.W $17E4,X               ; Coin layer
$02:9AD1  99 05 17      STA.W $1705,Y               ; Score sprite layer
$02:9AD4  20 DA 9A      JSR.W $9ADA           ; Spawn the sparkle (smoke type 5)
$02:9AD7  4C E3 99      JMP.W $99E3           ; Clear the coin slot and return

$02:9ADA  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: search the 4 smoke sprite slots
$02:9ADC  B9 C0 17      LDA.W $17C0,Y               ; \
$02:9ADF  F0 04         BEQ $9AE5             ; / Slot [$17C0,Y] free? Yes: use it
$02:9AE1  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:9AE2  10 F8         BPL $9ADC             ; / Next slot, loop
$02:9AE4  60            RTS                          ; No free slot: return

$02:9AE5  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; Smoke type 5 (sparkle spawner)
$02:9AE7  99 C0 17      STA.W $17C0,Y               ; Set the slot's type
$02:9AEA  BD E4 17      LDA.W $17E4,X               ; A = coin layer
$02:9AED  4A            LSR                          ; Carry = layer bit 0
$02:9AEE  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:9AEF  BD E0 17      LDA.W $17E0,X               ; A = coin X low
$02:9AF2  90 02         BCC $9AF6             ; Layer 0: leave as is
$02:9AF4  E5 26         SBC $26                     ; Layer 1: X -= [$26]
$02:9AF6  99 C8 17      STA.W $17C8,Y               ; Smoke X
$02:9AF9  BD D4 17      LDA.W $17D4,X               ; A = coin Y low
$02:9AFC  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:9AFD  90 02         BCC $9B01             ; Layer 0: leave as is
$02:9AFF  E5 28         SBC $28                     ; Layer 1: Y -= [$28]
$02:9B01  99 C4 17      STA.W $17C4,Y               ; Smoke Y
$02:9B04  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; Timer = $10
$02:9B06  99 CC 17      STA.W $17CC,Y               ; Set the smoke timer
$02:9B09  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9B0A  A2 09         LDX.B #$09                  ; \
$02:9B0C  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; / X = 9: loop over the 10 extended sprite slots; [$15E9] = current slot
$02:9B0F  20 16 9B      JSR.W $9B16           ; Run this extended sprite
$02:9B12  CA            DEX                          ; Next slot
$02:9B13  10 F7         BPL $9B0C             ; Loop until X < 0
$02:9B15  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9B16  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:9B19  F0 FA         BEQ $9B15            ; / Extended sprite number 0 = empty slot: return
$02:9B1B  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9B1D  D0 08         BNE $9B27             ; / Sprites locked: leave the timer alone
$02:9B1F  BC 6F 17      LDY.W $176F,X               ; Y = [$176F,X] (timer / frame counter)
$02:9B22  F0 03         BEQ $9B27             ; Already 0: nothing to count down
$02:9B24  DE 6F 17      DEC.W $176F,X               ; Timer--
$02:9B27  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Jump to the main routine for this extended sprite number

}

;;; $9B2B: Pointer table: extended sprite routines (ExtendedSpritePtrs) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for each extended sprite number, indexed by [RAM_ExSpriteNum,X].
$02:9B2B  15 9B         .dw $9B15            ; 00 - Empty slot
$02:9B2D  4F A3         .dw SmokePuff               ; 01 - Puff of smoke
$02:9B2F  6B A1         .dw ReznorFireball          ; 02 - Reznor fireball
$02:9B31  19 A2         .dw FlameRemnant            ; 03 - Tiny flame left by a hopping flame
$02:9B33  EF A2         .dw Hammer                  ; 04 - Hammer
$02:9B35  AF 9F         .dw MarioFireball           ; 05 - Mario fireball
$02:9B37  54 A2         .dw Baseball                ; 06 - Bone
$02:9B39  86 9E         .dw LavaSplash              ; 07 - Lava splash
$02:9B3B  3D 9E         .dw LauncherArm             ; 08 - Torpedo Ted launcher arm
$02:9B3D  9D 9D         .dw UnusedExtendedSpr       ; 09 - Unused (red thing flickering 16x16 / 8x8)
$02:9B3F  B5 9C         .dw CloudCoin               ; 0A - Cloud game coin
$02:9B41  EF A2         .dw Hammer                  ; 0B - Piranha plant fireball
$02:9B43  51 9B         .dw VolcanoLotusFire        ; 0C - Volcano Lotus fire
$02:9B45  54 A2         .dw Baseball                ; 0D - Baseball
$02:9B47  B5 9C         .dw CloudCoin               ; 0E - Wiggler flower
$02:9B49  3E 9C         .dw SmokeTrail              ; 0F - Smoke trail
$02:9B4B  83 9C         .dw SpinJumpStars           ; 10 - Spin jump star
$02:9B4D  61 9F         .dw YoshiFireball           ; 11 - Yoshi fireball
$02:9B4F  EE 9E         .dw WaterBubble             ; 12 - Water bubble

}

;;; $9B51: Extended sprite: Volcano Lotus fire (VolcanoLotusFire) ;;;
{
;; Extended sprite $0C: a seed fired by a Volcano Lotus. Draws an 8x8 tile ($A6/$B6, alternating) on the extended OAM area, frees itself when off-screen,
;; is destroyed by the cape, moves by its X and Y speed, accelerates downward (+1 every 4 frames up to $18) and, when falling, wobbles +/-8 in X speed every 8 frames.
$02:9B51  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index from $A153
$02:9B54  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:9B57  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9B58  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:9B5A  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = X on screen = ExSprite X low - [$1A]
$02:9B5C  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; \
$02:9B5F  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:9B61  D0 77         BNE $9BDA             ; / Different screen column: free the slot
$02:9B63  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:9B66  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9B67  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:9B69  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = Y on screen = ExSprite Y low - [$1C]
$02:9B6B  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; \
$02:9B6E  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; / A = Y screen difference (high bytes)
$02:9B70  F0 04         BEQ $9B76             ; Same screen: draw
$02:9B72  30 31         BMI $9BA5             ; Above the screen: skip drawing, keep moving
$02:9B74  10 64         BPL $9BDA             ; Below the screen: free the slot
$02:9B76  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = X on screen
$02:9B78  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X
$02:9B7B  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = Y on screen
$02:9B7D  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:9B7F  B0 24         BCS $9BA5             ; / Y off-screen ($F0 or more): skip drawing
$02:9B81  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y
$02:9B84  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; Properties: palette 4, sprite tile page
$02:9B86  05 64         ORA $64                     ; Add the sprite priority bits [$64]
$02:9B88  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; OAM properties
$02:9B8B  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:9B8D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9B8E  4D E9 15      EOR.W $15E9                 ; |
$02:9B91  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9B92  4A            LSR                          ; / Carry = bit 1 of ([RAM_FrameCounterB] / 2 EOR slot): flips every 4 frames
$02:9B93  A9 A6         LDA.B #$A6                  ; Tile $A6...
$02:9B95  90 02         BCC $9B99             ; ...unless carry is set
$02:9B97  A9 B6         LDA.B #$B6                  ; Tile $B6
$02:9B99  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile number
$02:9B9C  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9B9D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9B9E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9B9F  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:9BA0  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size = 0: 8x8 sprite
$02:9BA2  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Write OAM size/X high bits
$02:9BA5  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9BA7  D0 30         BNE $9BD9            ; / Sprites locked: no movement
$02:9BA9  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Let the cape destroy it
$02:9BAC  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; Apply X speed
$02:9BAF  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; Apply Y speed
$02:9BB2  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:9BB4  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:9BB6  D0 0A         BNE $9BC2             ; / Only every 4th frame...
$02:9BB8  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; A = Y speed
$02:9BBB  C9 18         CMP.B #$18                  ; Terminal speed $18 reached?
$02:9BBD  10 03         BPL $9BC2             ; Yes: do not accelerate further
$02:9BBF  FE 3D 17      INC.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; Y speed++ (gravity)
$02:9BC2  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; A = Y speed
$02:9BC5  30 12         BMI $9BD9            ; Rising: no sideways wobble
$02:9BC7  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:9BC8  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9BC9  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9BCA  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9BCB  65 13         ADC RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:9BCD  A0 08         LDY.B #$08                  ; |
$02:9BCF  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; |
$02:9BD1  D0 02         BNE $9BD5             ; |
$02:9BD3  A0 F8         LDY.B #$F8                  ; |
$02:9BD5  98            TYA                          ; / Falling: X speed = +8 or -8, switching every 8 frames (offset by slot)
$02:9BD6  9D 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; Set the X speed
$02:9BD9  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9BDA  9E 0B 17      STZ.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; Clear the extended sprite
$02:9BDD  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $9BDE..9BE2: Tables: Yoshi stomp smoke offsets ;;;
{
;; Per trail (0 = right, 1 = left): X offset from Mario ($08,$F8), its high byte ($00,$FF) and starting X speed ($18,$E8).
$02:9BDE                .db $08,$F8                 ; X offsets from Mario of the two smoke trails: +8, -8

$02:9BE0                .db $00,$FF                 ; X offset high bytes: $00, $FF

$02:9BE2                .db $18,$E8                 ; Initial X speeds of the two trails: +$18, -$18

}

;;; $9BE4: Yoshi ground stomp: shake and smoke ;;;
{
;; Starts the screen shake (ground shake timer = 5), plays sound $09 on [$1DFC] and spawns two smoke trail extended sprites (type $0F) at Mario's feet,
;; moving left and right. $029BF5 does the spawn for the trail in [$00]; it does nothing if all 8 slots checked are busy.
;; Parameters: none (falls through to spawn the second trail).
;; Called by: $02:86E8 (Yoshi stomp: shake ground (YoshiStompRoutine))
$02:9BE4  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:9BE6  8D 87 18      STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer    ; / Ground shake timer [RAM_ShakeGrndTimer] = 5
$02:9BE9  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:9BEB  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $09 via [$1DFC]
$02:9BEE  64 00         STZ $00                     ; [$00] = 0: first (right) trail
$02:9BF0  20 F5 9B      JSR.W $9BF5           ; Spawn the first smoke trail
$02:9BF3  E6 00         INC $00                     ; [$00] = 1: second (left) trail
$02:9BF5  A0 07         LDY.B #$07                  ; Y = 7: search the extended sprite slots
$02:9BF7  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; \
$02:9BFA  F0 04         BEQ $9C00             ; / Slot free? Yes: use it
$02:9BFC  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:9BFD  10 F8         BPL $9BF7             ; / Next slot, loop
$02:9BFF  60            RTS                          ; No free slot: return

$02:9C00  A9 0F         LDA.B #$0F                  ; Extended sprite $0F (smoke trail)
$02:9C02  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; Set the slot's type
$02:9C05  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \
$02:9C07  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9C08  69 28         ADC.B #$28                  ; / Y = Mario Y low + $28 (at his feet)
$02:9C0A  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; Extended sprite Y low
$02:9C0D  A5 97         LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; \
$02:9C0F  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; / Y high with carry
$02:9C11  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; Extended sprite Y high
$02:9C14  A6 00         LDX $00                     ; X = which trail
$02:9C16  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:9C18  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9C19  7D DE 9B      ADC.W $9BDE,X         ; / X = Mario X low + $9BDE[X]
$02:9C1C  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; Extended sprite X low
$02:9C1F  A5 95         LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; \
$02:9C21  7D E0 9B      ADC.W $9BE0,X         ; / X high with $9BE0[X]
$02:9C24  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; Extended sprite X high
$02:9C27  BD E2 9B      LDA.W $9BE2,X         ; A = $9BE2[X]
$02:9C2A  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; Extended sprite X speed
$02:9C2D  A9 15         LDA.B #$15                  ; Lifetime = $15 frames
$02:9C2F  99 6F 17      STA.W $176F,Y               ; Set the extended sprite timer
$02:9C32  60            RTS                          ; Return


}
