;;; $9C3E: Extended sprite: smoke trail (SmokeTrail) ;;;
{
;; Extended sprite $0F (Yoshi stomp smoke). Draws a 16x16 tile chosen by its timer, with flip bits cycling every 4 frames, moves horizontally, halves its X speed when the
;; timer reaches 6, and is freed when the timer hits 0.
$02:9C3E  20 A4 A1      JSR.W $A1A4           ; Common extended sprite code (probably position / despawn)
$02:9C41  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index from $A153
$02:9C44  BD 6F 17      LDA.W $176F,X               ; A = timer [$176F,X]
$02:9C47  4A            LSR                          ; A = timer / 2
$02:9C48  DA            PHX                          ; Save the slot
$02:9C49  AA            TAX                          ; X = tile frame
$02:9C4A  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:9C4C  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9C4D  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9C4E  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9C4F  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9C50  29 C0         AND.B #$C0                  ; / A = ([RAM_FrameCounterB] << 4) AND $C0: flip bits cycle every 4 frames
$02:9C52  09 32         ORA.B #$32                  ; Add palette 1, priority 3 ($32)
$02:9C54  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; OAM properties
$02:9C57  BD 33 9C      LDA.W SmokeTrailTiles,X     ; A = tile from SmokeTrailTiles
$02:9C5A  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile number
$02:9C5D  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9C5E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9C5F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9C60  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:9C61  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Size = 2: 16x16 sprite
$02:9C63  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Write OAM size/X high bits
$02:9C66  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the slot
$02:9C67  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:9C69  D0 13         BNE $9C7E            ; Yes: do not move
$02:9C6B  BD 6F 17      LDA.W $176F,X               ; A = timer
$02:9C6E  F0 0F         BEQ $9C7F             ; Timer 0: free the slot
$02:9C70  C9 06         CMP.B #$06                  ; Timer = 6?
$02:9C72  D0 07         BNE $9C7B             ; No: just move
$02:9C74  BD 47 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; \
$02:9C77  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:9C78  7E 47 17      ROR.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; / Timer = 6: halve the X speed (arithmetic shift right)
$02:9C7B  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; Apply X speed
$02:9C7E  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9C7F  9E 0B 17      STZ.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; Clear the extended sprite
$02:9C82  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $9C83: Extended sprite: spin jump star (SpinJumpStars) ;;;
{
;; Extended sprite $10. Draws star tile $EF (palette 2) and moves by its X/Y speed, slowing down as its timer runs out
;; (movement mask from $9CB0 indexed by timer / 4). Freed when the timer is 0.
$02:9C83  BD 6F 17      LDA.W $176F,X               ; A = timer [$176F,X]
$02:9C86  F0 F7         BEQ $9C7F             ; Timer 0: free the slot
$02:9C88  20 A4 A1      JSR.W $A1A4           ; Common extended sprite code (probably position / despawn)
$02:9C8B  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index from $A153
$02:9C8E  A9 34         LDA.B #$34                  ; Properties: palette 2, priority 3 ($34)
$02:9C90  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; OAM properties
$02:9C93  A9 EF         LDA.B #$EF                  ; Tile $EF (star)
$02:9C95  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; OAM tile number
$02:9C98  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:9C9A  D0 13         BNE $9CAF            ; / Sprites locked: do not move
$02:9C9C  BD 6F 17      LDA.W $176F,X               ; \
$02:9C9F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9CA0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9CA1  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = timer / 4
$02:9CA2  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; A = [RAM_FrameCounter]
$02:9CA4  39 B0 9C      AND.W $9CB0,Y         ; AND $9CB0[Y]: movement frequency
$02:9CA7  D0 06         BNE $9CAF            ; Non-zero: skip movement this frame
$02:9CA9  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; \
$02:9CAC  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; / Apply X and Y speed
$02:9CAF  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $9CB0..9CB0: Table: spin jump star movement masks ;;;
{
;; Indexed by timer / 4: $FF,$07,$01,$00,$00; the star only moves on frames where [RAM_FrameCounter] AND mask = 0.
$02:9CB0                .db $FF,$07,$01,$00,$00     ; Move mask by timer / 4: $FF = rarely, $00 = every frame

}

;;; $9CB5: Extended sprite: wiggler flower / coin cloud coin (CloudCoin) ;;;
{
;; Handles extended sprite $0E (flower dropped by Wiggler) and the smiley coin from the coin game cloud.
;; Applies gravity; the flower sways left and right, the coin bounces once on the floor and can be collected by the cape.
;; Draws as 8x8 (flower) or 16x16 (coin) and deletes the sprite when offscreen.
$02:9CB5  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Skip physics while sprites are locked
$02:9CB7  D0 3F         BNE $9CF8
$02:9CB9  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; Update Y position from Y speed
$02:9CBC  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; \
$02:9CBF  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; |
$02:9CC1  10 06         BPL $9CC9             ; |
$02:9CC3  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:9CC4  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; } Gravity: Y speed += 2 until it reaches terminal speed $30
$02:9CC6  9D 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; /
$02:9CC9  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:9CCC  C9 0E         CMP.B #$0E                  ; } Extended sprite $0E (wiggler flower)? Otherwise it is the coin game cloud coin
$02:9CCE  D0 13         BNE $9CE3             ; /
$02:9CD0  A0 08         LDY.B #$08                  ; \
$02:9CD2  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; |
$02:9CD4  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; |
$02:9CD6  F0 02         BEQ $9CDA             ; |
$02:9CD8  A0 F8         LDY.B #$F8                  ; |
$02:9CDA  98            TYA                          ; } X speed = +8 or -8, flipping every 8 frames (flower wobbles)
$02:9CDB  9D 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; /
$02:9CDE  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; Update X position from X speed
$02:9CE1  80 15         BRA $9CF8             ; Go draw

$02:9CE3  BD 65 17      LDA.W $1765,X               ; Coin: bounce counter [$1765]
$02:9CE6  D0 0D         BNE $9CF5             ; Already bounced once: skip floor check
$02:9CE8  20 6E A5      JSR.W $A56E           ; Interact with the floor (carry set if standing on something)
$02:9CEB  90 08         BCC $9CF5             ; No contact: skip
$02:9CED  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:9CEF  9D 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; / Bounce: Y speed = $D0 (upward)
$02:9CF2  FE 65 17      INC.W $1765,X               ; Count the bounce
$02:9CF5  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Cape can collect this coin (handled in $A3F6)
$02:9CF8  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:9CFB  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9CFC  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:9CFE  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:9D00  B0 58         BCS $9D5A             ; } [$01] = Y position on screen; delete if below the visible area (>= $F0)
$02:9D02  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:9D04  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:9D07  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:9D09  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; |
$02:9D0C  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; } Return if offscreen horizontally
$02:9D0E  D0 4D         BNE $9D5D            ; /
$02:9D10  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; \
$02:9D13  84 0F         STY $0F                     ; / Y = [$0F] = OAM index for this extended sprite slot
$02:9D15  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:9D18  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9D19  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } [$00] = X position on screen
$02:9D1B  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:9D1D  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; OAM X position
$02:9D20  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:9D23  C9 0E         CMP.B #$0E                  ; } Not the flower ($0E): go draw the coin
$02:9D25  D0 1E         BNE $9D45             ; /
$02:9D27  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:9D29  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:9D2A  E9 05         SBC.B #$05                  ; } Flower OAM Y = screen Y - 5
$02:9D2C  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; /
$02:9D2F  A9 98         LDA.B #$98                  ; \
$02:9D31  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / Flower tile $98
$02:9D34  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:9D36  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Properties = $0B (palette 5, priority 2) | [$64] (sprite priority bits)
$02:9D38  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:9D3B  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:9D3C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9D3D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:9D3E  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:9D3F  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; } Size = 8x8 for this OAM slot
$02:9D41  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; /
$02:9D44  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9D45  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:9D47  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / OAM Y position
$02:9D4A  A9 C2         LDA.B #$C2                  ; \
$02:9D4C  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / Coin tile $C2
$02:9D4F  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:9D51  20 36 9D      JSR.W $9D36           ; / Run the property store above with A = $04 (returns here after setting size 8x8)
$02:9D54  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:9D56  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / Size = 16x16 (overrides the 8x8 just set)
$02:9D59  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:9D5A  9E 0B 17      STZ.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; Delete extended sprite
$02:9D5D  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:9FFF  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A002  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A003  F9 A2 9F      SBC.W $9FA2,Y         ; } Y position -= $9FA2[Y] (push out of the block)

;;; $A0AC: Fireball hits sprites: entry (ProcessFireball) ;;;
{
;; Runs only every 4th frame per slot. Saves the extended sprite index to [$185E] and starts the loop over sprites 9..0.
;; Called by: $02:9F6B (Extended sprite: Yoshi fireball (YoshiFireball)), $02:9FC5 (Extended sprite: Mario fireball (MarioFireball))
$02:A0AC  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:A0AD  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:A0AF  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Return unless (sprite index EOR frame counter) & 3 = 0
$02:A0B1  D0 F5         BNE $A0A8            ; /
$02:A0B3  DA            PHX                          ; Save extended sprite index
$02:A0B4  9B            TXY                          ; Y = extended sprite index
$02:A0B5  8C 5E 18      STY.W $185E                 ; [$185E] = extended sprite index
$02:A0B8  A2 09         LDX.B #$09                  ; X = 9: loop over normal sprites 9 down to 0
}

;;; $A0BA: Fireball vs. sprite loop (FireRtLoopStart) ;;;
{
;; For each normal sprite: skips dead, fire-immune, eaten or other-layer sprites, tests contact with the fireball, then kills it, turns it into a coin or counts hits (Chuck).
;; Parameters: [$185E] = extended sprite index.
;; Called by: $02:A149 (Fireball loop: next sprite (FireRtNextSprite))
$02:A0BA  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; [$15E9] = current sprite index
$02:A0BD  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:A0C0  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Skip sprite if status < 8
$02:A0C2  90 7F         BCC FireRtNextSprite        ; /
$02:A0C4  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; \
$02:A0C7  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; |
$02:A0C9  1D D0 15      ORA.W $15D0,X               ; |
$02:A0CC  1D 32 16      ORA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,X   ; |
$02:A0CF  59 79 17      EOR.W $1779,Y               ; } Skip if fire-immune, being eaten, or on a different layer than the fireball
$02:A0D2  D0 6F         BNE FireRtNextSprite        ; /
$02:A0D4  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Get sprite clipping A
$02:A0D8  20 47 A5      JSR.W $A547           ; Get extended sprite clipping B
$02:A0DB  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Check for contact
$02:A0DF  90 62         BCC FireRtNextSprite        ; No contact: next sprite
$02:A0E1  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; \
$02:A0E4  C9 11         CMP.B #$11                  ; } Is it a Yoshi fireball ($11)?
$02:A0E6  F0 06         BEQ $A0EE             ; /
$02:A0E8  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:A0E9  BB            TYX                          ; |
$02:A0EA  20 45 A0      JSR.W $A045           ; } Mario fireball hit: play sound, smoke puff
$02:A0ED  FA            PLX                          ; /
$02:A0EE  BD 6E 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker166E,X     ; \
$02:A0F1  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; } Skip if the sprite is immune to fire
$02:A0F3  D0 4E         BNE FireRtNextSprite        ; /
$02:A0F5  BD 0F 19      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,X     ; \
$02:A0F8  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; } One hit kills unless sprite takes multiple fireballs (Chuck)
$02:A0FA  F0 28         BEQ TurnSpriteToCoin        ; /
$02:A0FC  FE 28 15      INC.W $1528,X               ; Chuck: hit count [$1528]++
$02:A0FF  BD 28 15      LDA.W $1528,X               ; \
$02:A102  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; } Fewer than 5 hits: next sprite
$02:A104  90 3D         BCC FireRtNextSprite        ; /
}

;;; $A106: Kill sprite by fireball (ChuckFireKill) ;;;
{
;; Plays sound 2, sets the sprite to status 2 (killed) with death speeds away from Mario and awards 80 points.
$02:A106  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:A108  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect 2
$02:A10B  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:A10D  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$02:A110  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:A112  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Death Y speed = $D0
$02:A114  20 8D 84      JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk2        ; Which side is Mario on? (Y = 0 or 1)
$02:A117  B9 51 A1      LDA.W FireKillSpeedX,Y      ; \
$02:A11A  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Death X speed from FireKillSpeedX (away from Mario)
$02:A11C  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:A11E  22 E5 AC 02   JSL.L GivePoints            ; / Give points (index 4)
$02:A122  80 1F         BRA FireRtNextSprite        ; Next sprite

}

;;; $A124: Turn sprite into moving coin (TurnSpriteToCoin) ;;;
{
;; Plays the coin sound, changes the sprite to $21 (moving coin) status 8, re-inits its tables and launches it upward.
$02:A124  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:A126  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect 3 (coin)
$02:A129  A9 21         LDA.B #$21                  ; \
$02:A12B  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin)
$02:A12D  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:A12F  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:A132  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Reset sprite tables
$02:A136  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:A138  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Upward speed = $D0
$02:A13A  20 8D 84      JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk2        ; Which side is Mario on?
$02:A13D  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:A13E  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Sprite direction = side EOR 1
$02:A140  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
}

;;; $A143: Fireball loop: next sprite (FireRtNextSprite) ;;;
{
;; Decrements the loop index and restores [$15E9] when finished.
$02:A143  AC 5E 18      LDY.W $185E                 ; Y = extended sprite index
$02:A146  CA            DEX                          ; Next sprite
$02:A147  30 03         BMI $A14C             ; Done when X < 0
$02:A149  4C BA A0      JMP.W FireRtLoopStart       ; Loop

$02:A14C  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:A14D  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; Restore [$15E9] = sprite index
$02:A150  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $A151: Table: fireball kill X speeds and OAM indices (FireKillSpeedX) ;;;
{
;; $F0/$10: death X speed. $A153: OAM index per extended sprite slot.
$02:A151                .db $F0,$10                 ; Death X speed: $F0 (left), $10 (right)

$02:A153                .db $90,$94,$98,$9C,$A0,$A4,$A8,$AC ; OAM index in $0200 per extended sprite slot
}

;;; $A15B: Table: fireball tiles and properties (FireballTiles) ;;;
{
$02:A15B                .db $2C,$2D,$2C,$2D         ; Fireball tiles

$02:A15F                .db $04,$04,$C4,$C4         ; Fireball properties (palette 2, Y flip in last two)

}

;;; $A163: Table: Reznor fireball tiles and properties (ReznorFireTiles) ;;;
{
$02:A163                .db $26,$2A,$26,$2A         ; Reznor fireball tiles

$02:A167                .db $35,$35,$F5,$F5         ; Reznor fireball properties

}

;;; $A16B: Extended sprite: Reznor fireball (ReznorFireball) ;;;
{
;; Moves by its speed; in normal levels it uses the generic 8x8 fireball drawing, in Mode 7 boss rooms ([$0D9B] bit 7) a 16x16 animated fireball.
;; Also contains the generic extended sprite drawing routine at $02A1A4, which is shared by many extended sprites, and the delete routine at $02A211.
$02:A16B  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:A16D  D0 09         BNE $A178             ; / Skip physics while sprites are locked
$02:A16F  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; Update X position from X speed
$02:A172  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; Update Y position from Y speed
$02:A175  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Cape can destroy it
$02:A178  AD 9B 0D      LDA.W $0D9B                 ; \
$02:A17B  10 27         BPL $A1A4             ; / [$0D9B] bit 7 clear (normal level): use the generic 8x8 fireball code
$02:A17D  20 A4 A1      JSR.W $A1A4           ; Generic extended sprite drawing first
$02:A180  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index
$02:A183  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:A185  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A186  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A187  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } X = (frame counter B >> 2) & 3
$02:A189  DA            PHX                          ; /
$02:A18A  AA            TAX                          ;|
$02:A18B  BD 63 A1      LDA.W ReznorFireTiles,X     ; \
$02:A18E  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile from ReznorFireTiles
$02:A191  BD 67 A1      LDA.W $A167,X         ; \
$02:A194  45 00         EOR $00                     ; } OAM properties = $A167 EOR [$00]
$02:A196  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A199  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:A19A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A19B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A19C  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:A19D  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; } Size = 16x16 for this OAM slot
$02:A19F  9D 20 04      STA.W $0420,X               ; /
$02:A1A2  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:A1A3  60            RTS                          ; Return

;8x8 fireball. This is also the base code for many extended sprites.
$02:A1A4  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index
$02:A1A7  BD 47 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; \
$02:A1AA  29 80         AND.B #$80                  ; |
$02:A1AC  49 80         EOR.B #$80                  ; |
$02:A1AE  4A            LSR                          ; } [$00] = $40 when moving right (X flip)
$02:A1AF  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:A1B1  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:A1B4  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A1B5  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } [$01] = X position on screen
$02:A1B7  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:A1B9  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; \
$02:A1BC  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; } Delete if offscreen horizontally
$02:A1BE  D0 51         BNE $A211             ; /
$02:A1C0  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A1C3  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A1C4  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } [$02] = Y position on screen
$02:A1C6  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:A1C8  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; \
$02:A1CB  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; } Delete if offscreen vertically
$02:A1CD  D0 42         BNE $A211             ; /
$02:A1CF  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:A1D1  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; } Delete if in the bottom part of the screen
$02:A1D3  B0 3C         BCS $A211             ; /
$02:A1D5  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; OAM Y position
$02:A1D8  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:A1DA  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X position
$02:A1DD  BD 79 17      LDA.W $1779,X               ; \
$02:A1E0  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = behind layers flag
$02:A1E2  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:A1E4  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A1E5  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A1E6  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:A1E8  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:A1E9  BD 5B A1      LDA.W FireballTiles,X       ; } Tile = FireballTiles[(frame counter B >> 2) & 3]
$02:A1EC  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; /
$02:A1EF  BD 5F A1      LDA.W $A15F,X         ; \
$02:A1F2  45 00         EOR $00                     ; |
$02:A1F4  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } OAM properties = $A15F EOR [$00] ORA [$64]
$02:A1F6  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A1F9  A6 01         LDX $01                     ; \
$02:A1FB  F0 07         BEQ $A204             ; |
$02:A1FD  29 CF         AND.B #$CF                  ; |
$02:A1FF  09 10         ORA.B #$10                  ; } If behind layers: priority bits = 01
$02:A201  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A204  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:A205  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A206  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A207  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:A208  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; } Size = 8x8 for this OAM slot
$02:A20A  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; /
$02:A20D  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; Restore X = current sprite index
$02:A210  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A211  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:A213  9D 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; / Clear extended sprite number
$02:A216  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $A217: Table: small flame tiles (SmallFlameTiles) ;;;
{
$02:A217                .db $AC,$AD                 ; Small flame tiles

}

;;; $A219: Extended sprite: small flame remnant (FlameRemnant) ;;;
{
;; Animated 8x8 flame that flickers out during the last $50 frames of its timer [$176F] and can be destroyed by the cape.
$02:A219  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:A21B  D0 12         BNE $A22F             ; / Skip timer logic while sprites are locked
$02:A21D  FE 65 17      INC.W $1765,X               ; Animation counter [$1765]++
$02:A220  BD 6F 17      LDA.W $176F,X               ; \
$02:A223  F0 EC         BEQ $A211             ; / Timer [$176F] = 0: delete
$02:A225  C9 50         CMP.B #$50                  ; \
$02:A227  B0 06         BCS $A22F             ; / Timer >= $50: always draw
$02:A229  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; \
$02:A22B  D0 26         BNE $A253            ; } Last frames: flicker (draw on even frames only)
$02:A22D  F0 03         BEQ $A232             ; /
$02:A22F  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Cape can destroy it
$02:A232  20 A4 A1      JSR.W $A1A4           ; Generic extended sprite drawing
$02:A235  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index
$02:A238  BD 65 17      LDA.W $1765,X               ; \
$02:A23B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A23C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A23D  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:A23F  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:A240  BD 17 A2      LDA.W SmallFlameTiles,X     ; } Tile = SmallFlameTiles[([$1765] >> 2) & 1]
$02:A243  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; /
$02:A246  B9 03 02      LDA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; \
$02:A249  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:A24B  09 05         ORA.B #$05                  ; } Properties: keep Y/X flip, palette 2, priority 0
$02:A24D  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A250  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; Restore X = current sprite index
$02:A253  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $A254: Extended sprite: baseball and bone (Baseball) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for extended sprite $0D (baseball thrown by Chargin' Chuck) and, from $A2C3, extended sprite $06 (bone thrown by Dry Bones).
;; Unless sprites are locked: moves by X speed, advances the spin counter [$1765] (1.5 per frame), tests contact with Mario.
;; Baseball: drawn as one 8x8 tile $AD that spins via flip bits; deleted if off screen and moving away, or off screen vertically.
;; Bone: uses the shared 16x16 spinning code ($A317) and picks tile $80 or $82.
$02:A254  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Skip movement and animation while sprites are locked
$02:A256  D0 12         BNE $A26A             ; Locked: go straight to drawing
$02:A258  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; Move horizontally by X speed
$02:A25B  FE 65 17      INC.W $1765,X               ; Animation counter [$1765] += 1
$02:A25E  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:A260  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Every other frame add 1 more (counter runs at 1.5x)
$02:A262  D0 03         BNE $A267             ; /
$02:A264  FE 65 17      INC.W $1765,X               ; Extra increment on even frames
$02:A267  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Contact with Mario ($A3F6)
$02:A26A  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:A26D  C9 0D         CMP.B #$0D                  ; } Not extended sprite $0D (baseball)? Then it is the bone, go to $A2C3
$02:A26F  D0 52         BNE $A2C3             ; /
$02:A271  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:A274  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A275  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } $00 = X position on screen (low byte)
$02:A277  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:A279  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; \
$02:A27C  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; } Horizontal screen high byte difference: zero means on screen, go draw it
$02:A27E  F0 07         BEQ $A287             ; /
$02:A280  5D 47 17      EOR.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,X     ; \
$02:A283  10 3A         BPL $A2BF             ; / Off screen: if it moves further away (same sign as X speed), delete it
$02:A285  30 37         BMI $A2BE            ; Moving back toward the screen: keep it, draw nothing
$02:A287  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index for this extended sprite
$02:A28A  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:A28C  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X = $00
$02:A28F  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A292  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A293  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } $01 = Y position on screen (low byte)
$02:A295  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:A297  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; \
$02:A29A  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; } Vertically off screen: delete the sprite
$02:A29C  D0 21         BNE $A2BF             ; /
$02:A29E  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:A2A0  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / OAM Y = $01
$02:A2A3  A9 AD         LDA.B #$AD                  ; \
$02:A2A5  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = $AD (baseball)
$02:A2A8  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:A2AA  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:A2AB  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:A2AC  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:A2AD  0A            ASL                          ; } Flip bits from the frame counter: baseball spins, X/Y flip flicker
$02:A2AE  29 C0         AND.B #$C0                  ; /
$02:A2B0  09 39         ORA.B #$39                  ; \
$02:A2B2  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / OAM properties = flip bits | $39 (priority 3, palette 4, tile page 1)
$02:A2B5  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:A2B6  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A2B7  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table)
$02:A2B8  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:A2B9  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:A2BB  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / Size = 0 (8x8)
$02:A2BE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A2BF  9E 0B 17      STZ.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; Delete the extended sprite
$02:A2C2  60            RTS                          ; Return

;Extended sprite: $06 = bone
$02:A2C3  20 17 A3      JSR.W $A317           ; Bone: draw with the shared 16x16 spinning graphics code
$02:A2C6  B9 02 02      LDA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; \
$02:A2C9  C9 26         CMP.B #$26                  ; |
$02:A2CB  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; |
$02:A2CD  B0 02         BCS $A2D1             ; |
$02:A2CF  A9 82         LDA.B #$82                  ; } Bone tile: $80 when the shared code drew tile $6D, $82 when it drew $08
$02:A2D1  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; /
$02:A2D4  B9 03 02      LDA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; \
$02:A2D7  29 F1         AND.B #$F1                  ; |
$02:A2D9  09 02         ORA.B #$02                  ; } Properties: keep flip and priority bits, palette 1
$02:A2DB  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A2DE  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $A2DF: Table: hammer and bone spin tiles (HammerTiles) ;;;
{
;; 8 spin frames: tile $08 or $6D.
$02:A2DF                .db $08,$6D,$6D,$08,$08,$6D,$6D,$08 ; Tiles per spin frame: $08 (hammer), $6D (hammer, second view)
}

;;; $A2E7: Table: hammer spin properties (HammerGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; OAM properties (YXPPCCCT) for the 8 spin frames: flip combinations, palette 3.
$02:A2E7                .db $47,$47,$07,$07,$87,$87,$C7,$C7 ; Properties per spin frame: flips (YXPPCCCT), palette 3

}

;;; $A2EF: Extended sprite: hammer (and shared 16x16 spinner) (Hammer) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for extended sprite $04 (hammer thrown by Hammer Bros.) and, via $A30C, $0B (Piranha Plant fireball).
;; Moves by X and Y speed, applies gravity (Y speed += 2 until $40), tests contact with Mario, advances the spin counter [$1765].
;; $A317 draws a 16x16 sprite using tile and properties tables indexed by [$1765] / 8 (also used by the bone). Piranha fireballs use the Reznor fireball drawing instead.
$02:A2EF  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Skip movement while sprites are locked
$02:A2F1  D0 19         BNE $A30C             ; Locked: go to drawing
$02:A2F3  20 54 B5      JSR.W $B554           ; \
$02:A2F6  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; / Move by X speed and Y speed
$02:A2F9  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; \
$02:A2FC  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; |
$02:A2FE  10 06         BPL $A306             ; |
$02:A300  FE 3D 17      INC.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; } Gravity: Y speed += 2 until it reaches $40 (terminal velocity)
$02:A303  FE 3D 17      INC.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; /
$02:A306  20 F6 A3      JSR.W $A3F6           ; Contact with Mario ($A3F6)
$02:A309  FE 65 17      INC.W $1765,X               ; Spin animation counter [$1765] += 1
$02:A30C  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:A30F  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; } Not extended sprite $0B (Piranha Plant fireball)? Then draw as a spinning sprite
$02:A311  D0 04         BNE $A317             ; /
$02:A313  20 78 A1      JSR.W $A178           ; Piranha fireball: use the Reznor fireball drawing code
$02:A316  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A317  20 A4 A1      JSR.W $A1A4           ; Base 8x8 fireball code (position, offscreen delete, $00 = X flip bit)
$02:A31A  BC 53 A1      LDY.W $A153,X         ; Y = OAM index
$02:A31D  BD 65 17      LDA.W $1765,X               ; \
$02:A320  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A321  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A322  4A            LSR                          ; } Spin frame = [$1765] / 8 mod 8
$02:A323  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; /
$02:A325  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:A326  AA            TAX                          ; / Save X, X = spin frame
$02:A327  BD DF A2      LDA.W HammerTiles,X         ; \
$02:A32A  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = HammerTiles[frame]
$02:A32D  BD E7 A2      LDA.W HammerGfxProp,X       ; \
$02:A330  45 00         EOR $00                     ; |
$02:A332  49 40         EOR.B #$40                  ; |
$02:A334  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } OAM properties = table ^ X flip ^ $40 | priority [$64]
$02:A336  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; /
$02:A339  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:A33A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A33B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A33C  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:A33D  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; } Size = 2 (16x16) in the OAM size table
$02:A33F  9D 20 04      STA.W $0420,X               ; /
$02:A342  FA            PLX                          ; Restore extended sprite index
$02:A343  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A344  4C 11 A2      JMP.W $A211           ; Delete the extended sprite

$02:A3B4  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \

$02:A3BA  C9 F8         CMP.B #$F8                  ; } X on screen; $F8 or more: off screen, delete
$02:A3BC  B0 F0         BCS $A3AE             ; /

;;; $A4B5: Turn extended sprite into smoke puff ;;;
{

$02:A4B5  BD 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; \
$02:A4B8  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; } Hammer ($04)? Skip the position shift
$02:A4BA  F0 22         BEQ $A4DE             ; /
$02:A4BC  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:A4BF  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A4C0  E9 04         SBC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:A4C2  9D 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; |
$02:A4C5  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; |
$02:A4C8  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } X position -= 4
$02:A4CA  9D 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; /
$02:A4CD  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A4D0  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A4D1  E9 04         SBC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:A4D3  9D 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; |
$02:A4D6  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; |
$02:A4D9  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Y position -= 4 (center the puff)
$02:A4DB  9D 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; /
$02:A4DE  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; \
$02:A4E0  9D 6F 17      STA.W $176F,X               ; / Smoke puff timer [$176F] = 7
$02:A4E3  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1 (smoke puff)

{
;; Stores 1 in the extended sprite number ($170B+X), turning it into a smoke puff, and returns. Assembled by hand as raw text (lowercase 'x'); its operand bytes overlap the start of the next table.
$02:A4E5                STA.W $170B,x               ; Extended sprite number = 1: turn into a smoke puff

$02:A4E8  60            RTS                          ; Return

;;; $A519: Extended sprite hitbox, tile collision, level start ;;;
{
;; $02A519: builds the extended sprite's hitbox for CheckForContact: $04/$0A = X, $05/$0B = Y, $06 = width, $07 = height. Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; $02A547: hitbox of extended sprite [Y] as a fixed 12x19 box at (-2,-4): $00/$08 X, $01/$09 Y, $02 width, $03 height.
;; $02A56E: object interaction. Returns carry set when the sprite's spot (X+4, Y+8) is solid on layer 1 or 2 ([$0E] bit per layer, [$0C]/[$0D] tile numbers). Special cases for Mode 7 boss rooms.
;; $02A611: tests one layer: finds the Map16 tile, treats tiles below $11 and $D8+ as ledges (top 6 pixels), $11-$6D as solid, $6E-$D7 as slopes.
;; $02A751 (JSL, called from level loading): resets the sprite load flags, loads the sprites for the starting screens, resets Mario carry state, and spawns Yoshi if he was brought from the overworld.
;; Called by: $02:963D (Cape hits block and extended sprites), $02:A402 (Extended sprite: smoke puff, contact with Mario (SmokePuff))
$02:A519  BC 0B 17      LDY.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,X     ; Y = extended sprite number
$02:A51C  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:A51F  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A520  79 E7 A4      ADC.W ADDR_02A4E7,Y         ; } $04 = X position + hitbox X offset
$02:A523  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:A525  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; \
$02:A528  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $0A = X position high byte
$02:A52A  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; /
$02:A52C  B9 FF A4      LDA.W $A4FF,Y         ; \
$02:A52F  85 06         STA $06                     ; / $06 = hitbox width
$02:A531  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A534  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A535  79 F3 A4      ADC.W $A4F3,Y         ; } $05 = Y position + hitbox Y offset
$02:A538  85 05         STA $05                     ; /
$02:A53A  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; \
$02:A53D  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $0B = Y position high byte
$02:A53F  85 0B         STA $0B                     ; /
$02:A541  B9 0B A5      LDA.W $A50B,Y         ; \
$02:A544  85 07         STA $07                     ; / $07 = hitbox height
$02:A546  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A547  B9 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; \
$02:A54A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A54B  E9 02         SBC.B #$02                  ; } $00 = X position of extended sprite [Y] - 2
$02:A54D  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:A54F  B9 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; \
$02:A552  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } $08 = X high byte
$02:A554  85 08         STA $08                     ; /
$02:A556  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:A558  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = width $0C
$02:A55A  B9 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; \
$02:A55D  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A55E  E9 04         SBC.B #$04                  ; } $01 = Y position - 4
$02:A560  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:A562  B9 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; \
$02:A565  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } $09 = Y high byte
$02:A567  85 09         STA $09                     ; /
$02:A569  A9 13         LDA.B #$13                  ; \
$02:A56B  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 = height $13
$02:A56D  60            RTS                          ; Return

;Object interaction with extended sprites.
$02:A56E  64 0F         STZ $0F                     ; [$0F] = 0 (check layer 1 first)
$02:A570  64 0E         STZ $0E                     ; [$0E] = 0 (result bits)
$02:A572  64 0B         STZ $0B                     ; [$0B] = 0
$02:A574  9C 94 16      STZ.W $1694                 ; Clear the slope height [$1694]
$02:A577  AD 0F 14      LDA.W $140F                 ; \
$02:A57A  D0 40         BNE $A5BC             ; / [$140F] set: normal tile check
$02:A57C  AD 9B 0D      LDA.W $0D9B                 ; \
$02:A57F  10 3B         BPL $A5BC             ; / Not a Mode 7 boss room: normal tile check
$02:A581  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; \
$02:A583  F0 0D         BEQ $A592             ; / Bit 6 clear (Iggy/Larry): use the tilting platform check at $A592
$02:A585  AD 9B 0D      LDA.W $0D9B                 ; \
$02:A588  C9 C1         CMP.B #$C1                  ; } Bowser's room ($C1): normal tile check
$02:A58A  F0 30         BEQ $A5BC             ; /
$02:A58C  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A58F  C9 A8         CMP.B #$A8                  ; / Other boss rooms: compare Y with $A8 (carry set = on the floor)
$02:A591  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A592  BD 1F 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,X     ; \
$02:A595  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A596  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } $14B4 = X position + 4
$02:A598  8D B4 14      STA.W $14B4                 ; /
$02:A59B  BD 33 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,X     ; \
$02:A59E  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $14B5 = X high byte
$02:A5A0  8D B5 14      STA.W $14B5                 ; /
$02:A5A3  BD 15 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:A5A6  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A5A7  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } $14B6 = Y position + 8
$02:A5A9  8D B6 14      STA.W $14B6                 ; /
$02:A5AC  BD 29 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; \
$02:A5AF  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } $14B7 = Y high byte
$02:A5B1  8D B7 14      STA.W $14B7                 ; /

;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;This subroutine handles spawning sprites onto the screen when the player were to
;scroll it to where the sprite would be in. It is also used by generators to spawn
;sprites continuously.
;
;This runs every even frames (when $7E0013's bit 0 is clear) during a level.
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
}

;;; $A7FC: Spawn sprites from level data on scroll (LoadSprFromLevel) ;;;
{
;; Called every frame during a level, acts only on even frames. Computes the screen column (or row, in vertical levels) just entering the view, plus an offset from $A7F6/F9 by scroll direction [$55], and walks the level sprite list at [$CE] (3 bytes per sprite: YYYYEEsy, XXXXSSSS, number).
;; Stops at the $FF terminator. Used by generators too.
;; Called by: $02:8B1D (Misc sprite handlers per frame)
$02:A7FC  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:A7FE  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Only run on even frames
$02:A800  D0 49         BNE $A84B            ; /
$02:A802  A4 55         LDY $55                     ; Y = screen scroll direction [$55]
$02:A804  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:A806  4A            LSR                          ; } Horizontal level: go to $A817
$02:A807  90 0E         BCC $A817             ; /
$02:A809  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:A80B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A80C  79 F6 A7      ADC.W $A7F6,Y         ; |
$02:A80F  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; } $00 = (screen Y + offset) rounded down to 16
$02:A811  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:A813  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:A815  80 0C         BRA $A823             ; / A = screen Y high byte, go on

$02:A817  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:A819  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A81A  79 F6 A7      ADC.W $A7F6,Y         ; |
$02:A81D  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; } $00 = (screen X + offset) rounded down to 16
$02:A81F  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:A821  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high byte
$02:A823  79 F9 A7      ADC.W $A7F9,Y         ; \
$02:A826  30 23         BMI $A84B            ; / Add high offset; negative: before the start of the level, return
$02:A828  85 01         STA $01                     ; $01 = screen to spawn sprites from
$02:A82A  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; X = 0: sprite number in the level
$02:A82C  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; Y = 1: offset in the level sprite data (skip header)
}

;;; $A82E: Sprite list loop: check screen (LoadSpriteLoopStrt) ;;;
{
;; Reads the next sprite's screen number and skips sprites before the target screen; returns when it passes it.
;; Called by: $02:A9DB (Spawn sprite from level data (LoadNormalSprite)), $02:ABEF (Load shooter, clear sprites, preload level (LoadShooter))
$02:A82E  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; A = byte YYYYEEsy
$02:A830  C9 FF         CMP.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:A832  F0 17         BEQ $A84B            ; / $FF: end of sprite list, return
$02:A834  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:A835  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:A836  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:A837  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; } $02 = bit 4 if the 's' bit is set (screen number bit 4)
$02:A839  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:A83B  C8            INY                          ; Next byte
$02:A83C  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:A83E  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } Sprite screen number (s SSSS)
$02:A840  05 02         ORA $02                     ; /
$02:A842  C5 01         CMP $01                     ; \
$02:A844  B0 06         BCS $A84C             ; / If at or after the target screen, go test further
}

;;; $A846: Skip to next sprite entry and spawn matching one (LoadNextSprite) ;;;
{
;; LoadNextSprite advances 3 bytes and counts the sprite, then loops. The code after $02A84C spawns the sprite when it sits exactly at the target column and has not already been loaded ([$1938] flags), marks it loaded, and dispatches on its number: scroll sprites ($E7+), 5 Eeries ($DE), 3 Platforms ($E0), shooters/generators ($CB and up) or normal sprites.
$02:A846  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:A847  C8            INY                          ; / Skip to the next sprite entry (3 bytes)
$02:A848  E8            INX                          ; Count the sprite
$02:A849  80 E3         BRA LoadSpriteLoopStrt      ; Loop

$02:A84B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A84C  D0 FD         BNE $A84B            ; Sprite screen is past the target: stop
$02:A84E  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:A850  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:A852  C5 00         CMP $00                     ; } Skip if not at the target column ($00)
$02:A854  D0 F0         BNE LoadNextSprite          ; /
$02:A856  BD 38 19      LDA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; \
$02:A859  D0 EB         BNE LoadNextSprite          ; / Skip if already loaded or killed
$02:A85B  86 02         STX $02                     ; $02 = sprite number in the level
$02:A85D  FE 38 19      INC.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; Mark the sprite as loaded
$02:A860  C8            INY                          ; Next byte (sprite number)
$02:A861  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:A863  85 05         STA $05                     ; / $05 = sprite number
$02:A865  88            DEY                          ; Back to byte 2
$02:A866  C9 E7         CMP.B #$E7                  ; \
$02:A868  90 22         BCC $A88C             ; / Sprite number below $E7: normal or special sprite, go to $A88C
}

;;; $A86A: Start a scroll command sprite (LoadScrollSprite) ;;;
{
;; Sprite numbers $E7 and up are scroll commands. Unless one is already active, stores the type ([$143E] = number - $E7) and command ([$1440]), runs $BCD6, then continues with the list. Followed by the special handling for 5 Eeries ($DE) and 3 Chain Platforms ($E0), which are loaded together to keep them synchronised.
$02:A86A  AD 3E 14      LDA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum      ; \
$02:A86D  0D 3F 14      ORA.W $143F                 ; } A scroll command is already active: skip this one
$02:A870  D0 18         BNE $A88A             ; /
$02:A872  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:A873  DA            PHX                          ; / Save Y and X
$02:A874  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:A876  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A877  E9 E7         SBC.B #$E7                  ; } Scroll sprite type [$143E] = sprite number - $E7
$02:A879  8D 3E 14      STA.W RAM_ScrollSprNum      ; /
$02:A87C  88            DEY                          ; Back to byte YYYYEEsy
$02:A87D  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:A87F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A880  4A            LSR                          ; } Scroll command [$1440] = byte >> 2
$02:A881  8D 40 14      STA.W $1440                 ; /
$02:A884  22 D6 BC 05   JSL.L $BCD6           ; Start the scroll sprite ($BCD6)
$02:A888  FA            PLX                          ; \
$02:A889  7A            PLY                          ; / Restore X and Y
$02:A88A  80 BA         BRA LoadNextSprite          ; Next sprite

$02:A88C  C9 DE         CMP.B #$DE                  ; \
$02:A88E  D0 0C         BNE $A89C             ; / Not $DE (5 Eeries)? Go on
$02:A890  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:A891  DA            PHX                          ; / Save Y and X
$02:A892  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:A893  84 03         STY $03                     ; / $03 = data offset
$02:A895  20 9D AF      JSR.W Load5Eeries           ; Load the 5 Eeries together
$02:A898  FA            PLX                          ; \
$02:A899  7A            PLY                          ; / Restore X and Y
$02:A89A  80 AA         BRA LoadNextSprite          ; Next sprite

$02:A89C  C9 E0         CMP.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:A89E  D0 0C         BNE $A8AC             ; / Not $E0 (3 Platforms on Chain)? Go on
$02:A8A0  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:A8A1  DA            PHX                          ; / Save Y and X
$02:A8A2  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:A8A3  84 03         STY $03                     ; / $03 = data offset
$02:A8A5  20 33 AF      JSR.W Load3Platforms        ; Load the 3 platforms together
$02:A8A8  FA            PLX                          ; \
$02:A8A9  7A            PLY                          ; / Restore X and Y
$02:A8AA  80 EE         BRA $A89A             ; Next sprite

$02:A8AC  C9 CB         CMP.B #$CB                  ; \
$02:A8AE  90 24         BCC $A8D4             ; / Sprite number below $CB: normal sprite
$02:A8B0  C9 DA         CMP.B #$DA                  ; \
$02:A8B2  B0 0C         BCS $A8C0             ; / $DA or more: at $A8C0, otherwise shooter or generator
}

;;; $A8B4: Init generator sprite (InitGenerator) ;;;
{
;; Level sprites $CB-$D9: records the generator type in [$18B9] = sprite number - $CA, marks the sprite not loaded in the level table and loads the next sprite.
;; Also holds the shell ($DA-$E0) and cluster ($E1+) hand-off at $02A8C0 and the shooter hand-off at $02A8D4.
$02:A8B4  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:A8B5  E9 CB         SBC.B #$CB                  ; |
$02:A8B7  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:A8B8  8D B9 18      STA.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; } [$18B9] = generator type = sprite number - $CA (sprites $CB-$D9)
$02:A8BB  9E 38 19      STZ.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; / Mark this level sprite as not loaded, so it can be loaded again (generator stays active)
$02:A8BE  80 DA         BRA $A89A             ; Load next sprite

$02:A8C0  C9 E1         CMP.B #$E1                  ; \
$02:A8C2  90 0C         BCC $A8D0             ; / Sprite number < $E1 (the shells $DA-$E0): go set status 9 at $02A8D0
$02:A8C4  DA            PHX                          ; Save X and Y
$02:A8C5  5A            PHY                          ; Save X and Y
$02:A8C6  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:A8C7  84 03         STY $03                     ; / $03 = data index of the sprite's first byte
$02:A8C9  20 C0 AA      JSR.W $AAC0           ; Load cluster sprite generator (sprites $E1-$E6)
$02:A8CC  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y
$02:A8CD  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:A8CE  80 CA         BRA $A89A             ; Load next sprite

$02:A8D0  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; Sprite status 9 (stationary shell)
$02:A8D2  80 0B         BRA $A8DF             ; Go store it in $04 and load a normal sprite

$02:A8D4  C9 C9         CMP.B #$C9                  ; \
$02:A8D6  90 05         BCC LoadNormalSprite        ; / Sprite number < $C9: normal sprite
$02:A8D8  20 78 AB      JSR.W LoadShooter           ; Sprite number >= $C9: load a shooter
$02:A8DB  80 BD         BRA $A89A             ; Load next sprite

}

;;; $A8DD: Spawn sprite from level data (LoadNormalSprite) ;;;
{
;; Finds a free sprite slot (honouring the reserved-slot ranges of the current sprite memory setting [$1692]) and fills it from the level data at [$CE],Y.
;; Sets position, status ([$04]), sprite number (shells $DA-$DD become Koopas 4-7 with status 9; Koopas recolour if [$1EEB] bit 7), level index [$161A,X],
;; and runs InitSpriteTables. With the silver P-switch active ([$14AE]) most sprites turn into moving coins instead.
;; If no slot is free the sprite is marked unloaded so it is tried again. Jumps back into LoadSpriteLoopStrt.
$02:A8DD  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Status 1 (initialisation) for a normal sprite
$02:A8DF  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = initial sprite status
$02:A8E1  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:A8E2  84 03         STY $03                     ; / [$03] = data index of the sprite's first byte
$02:A8E4  AC 92 16      LDY.W $1692                 ; Y = [$1692] (sprite memory setting)
$02:A8E7  BE 73 A7      LDX.W SpriteSlotMax,Y       ; X = highest slot to search, from SpriteSlotMax[Y]
$02:A8EA  B9 AC A7      LDA.W SpriteSlotStart,Y     ; \
$02:A8ED  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = lowest slot to search, from SpriteSlotStart[Y]
$02:A8EF  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:A8F1  D9 D2 A7      CMP.W ReservedSprite1,Y     ; |
$02:A8F4  D0 08         BNE $A8FE             ; / Is it this memory setting's first reserved sprite?
$02:A8F6  BE 86 A7      LDX.W SpriteSlotMax1,Y      ; Yes: use its own slot range, highest slot
$02:A8F9  B9 BF A7      LDA.W SpriteSlotStart1,Y    ; \
$02:A8FC  85 06         STA $06                     ; / ...and lowest slot
$02:A8FE  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:A900  D9 E4 A7      CMP.W ReservedSprite2,Y     ; |
$02:A903  D0 11         BNE $A916             ; / Is it this memory setting's second reserved sprite?
$02:A905  C9 64         CMP.B #$64                  ; \
$02:A907  D0 06         BNE $A90F             ; / Is it sprite $64?
$02:A909  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:A90B  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; |
$02:A90D  F0 07         BEQ $A916             ; / Sprite $64 only uses the reserved slots if bit 4 of [$00] is set
$02:A90F  BE 99 A7      LDX.W SpriteSlotMax2,Y      ; X = highest slot for the second reserved sprite
$02:A912  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:A914  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = $FF: search all the way down to slot 0
$02:A916  86 0F         STX $0F                     ; [$0F] = first slot searched (kept for the goal tape fallback)
$02:A918  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; Sprite status of slot X
$02:A91B  F0 1F         BEQ $A93C             ; Free slot (status 0): use it
$02:A91D  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:A91E  E4 06         CPX $06                     ; |
$02:A920  D0 F6         BNE $A918             ; } Try the next lower slot until X = [$06]
$02:A922  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; / Sprite number
$02:A924  C9 7B         CMP.B #$7B                  ; \
$02:A926  D0 0E         BNE $A936             ; / Anything but the goal tape ($7B) gives up
$02:A928  A6 0F         LDX $0F                     ; Goal tape: restart at the first slot searched
$02:A92A  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; Tweaker bits of slot X
$02:A92D  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; \
$02:A92F  F0 0B         BEQ $A93C             ; / Bit 1 clear (killable by star, cape, fire and bricks): overwrite this slot
$02:A931  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:A932  E4 06         CPX $06                     ; |
$02:A934  D0 F4         BNE $A92A             ; / Next slot, keep looping until X = [$06]
$02:A936  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; Gave up: X = this sprite's index in the level data
$02:A938  9E 38 19      STZ.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; Mark it not loaded so it is tried again later
$02:A93B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:A93C  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = data index of the sprite's first byte
$02:A93E  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:A940  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:A941  90 18         BCC $A95B             ; / Horizontal level: go to $02A95B
$02:A943  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:A945  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:A946  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:A948  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; } Vertical level: X position low = high nibble of the first byte
$02:A94A  68            PLA                          ; /
$02:A94B  29 0D         AND.B #$0D                  ; \
$02:A94D  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } X position high = bits 0, 2 and 3 of the first byte (extra bits ride along)
$02:A950  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:A952  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; } Y position = adjusted screen boundary [$00]/[$01]
$02:A954  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:A956  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:A959  80 16         BRA $A971             ; Continue at $02A971

$02:A95B  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; Horizontal level: first byte is YYYYEEsy
$02:A95D  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:A95E  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:A960  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; } Y position low = high nibble of the first byte
$02:A962  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:A963  29 0D         AND.B #$0D                  ; |
$02:A965  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Y position high = bits 0, 2 and 3 (the extra bits)
$02:A968  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:A96A  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; |
$02:A96C  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:A96E  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } X position = adjusted screen boundary [$00]/[$01]
$02:A971  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:A972  C8            INY                          ; / Skip to the sprite number byte
$02:A973  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:A975  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = [$04]
$02:A978  C9 09         CMP.B #$09                  ; Status >= 9 (shell) sets carry
$02:A97A  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; A = sprite number from the level data
$02:A97C  90 06         BCC $A984             ; Status < 9: store the number as it is
$02:A97E  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:A97F  E9 DA         SBC.B #$DA                  ; |
$02:A981  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:A982  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } Shell sprite $DA-$DD becomes Koopa number 4-7
$02:A984  5A            PHY                          ; Save Y
$02:A985  AC EB 1E      LDY.W $1EEB                 ; Y = [$1EEB] (bit 7 probably set once the Special Zone is cleared)
$02:A988  10 0C         BPL $A996             ; Bit 7 clear: store the number unchanged
$02:A98A  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; \
$02:A98C  D0 02         BNE $A990             ; / Number 4 (green Koopa)?
$02:A98E  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; Becomes 7 (yellow Koopa) when the flag is set
$02:A990  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; \
$02:A992  D0 02         BNE $A996             ; / Number 5 (red Koopa)?
$02:A994  A9 06         LDA.B #$06`                 ; Becomes 6 (blue Koopa) when the flag is set
$02:A996  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Store the sprite number
$02:A998  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y
$02:A999  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:A99B  9D 1A 16      STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X   ; / [$161A,X] = index of this sprite in the level data
$02:A99E  AD AE 14      LDA.W RAM_SilverPowTimer    ; \
$02:A9A1  F0 26         BEQ $A9C9             ; / Silver P-switch timer: if zero, skip the coin conversion
$02:A9A3  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:A9A4  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:A9A6  AA            TAX                          ; / X = sprite number
$02:A9A7  BF 59 F6 07   LDA.L Sprite190FVals,X      ; Sprite property table (Sprite190FVals)
$02:A9AB  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:A9AC  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; \
$02:A9AE  D0 19         BNE $A9C9             ; / Bit 6 set: sprite is left alone
$02:A9B0  A9 21         LDA.B #$21                  ; \
$02:A9B2  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Otherwise it becomes sprite $21 (moving coin)
$02:A9B4  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:A9B6  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Status 8 (normal)
$02:A9B9  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the sprite tables
$02:A9BD  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:A9C0  29 F1         AND.B #$F1                  ; |
$02:A9C2  09 02         ORA.B #$02                  ; |
$02:A9C4  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; } Sprite palette = 1 (silver coin colours), other bits kept
$02:A9C7  80 04         BRA $A9CD             ; Continue at $02A9CD

$02:A9C9  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the sprite tables (reset everything)
$02:A9CD  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:A9CF  9D A0 15      STA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; / Offscreen horizontally flag = 1
$02:A9D2  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:A9D4  9D E2 1F      STA.W $1FE2,X               ; / [$1FE2,X] = 4 (purpose unclear)
$02:A9D7  C8            INY                          ; Advance Y to the next sprite's entry
$02:A9D8  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; \
$02:A9DA  E8            INX                          ; / X = next sprite number in the level
$02:A9DB  4C 2E A8      JMP.W LoadSpriteLoopStrt    ; Continue the loading loop

}

;;; $A9DE: Find free sprite slot, keep 2 free (FindFreeSlotLowPri) ;;;
{
;; Sets [$0E] = 2 so FindFreeSlotRt leaves the last two slots unused, then falls into FindFreeSprSlot.
;; Returns: A and Y = slot, or $FF if none. Long call (RTL).
;; Called by: $02:B03C (Generate Bowser statue fire (GenerateFire)), $02:B082 (Spawn Bullet Bill from shooter (GenerateBullet)), $02:B115 (Spawn one Bullet Bill of a group (GEN_MULTI_BULLET)), $02:B161 (Generate jumping fish (GenerateFish)), $02:B1C2 (Generate Super Koopa (GenSuperKoopa)), $02:B20D (Generate bubble (GenerateBubble)), $02:B2DC (Generate Eerie (GenerateEerie)), $02:B32F (Generate para-enemies; run shooters (GenParaEnemy)), $02:B3E5 (Torpedo Ted launcher shooter (LaunchTorpedo)), $02:B4A1 (Bullet Bill shooter (ShootBullet))
$02:A9DE  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:A9E0  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; |
$02:A9E2  80 02         BRA $A9E6             ; } [$0E] = 2: leave the last 2 slots free (low priority spawn); join FindFreeSprSlot

}

;;; $A9E4: Find free sprite slot (FindFreeSprSlot) ;;;
{
;; Long-call wrapper around FindFreeSlotRt with [$0E] = 0 and the data bank set to $02.
;; Returns: A and Y = free slot number, or $FF.
;; Called by: $00:FC8F (Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)), $01:849B (Init Lakitu and spawn cloud (InitLakitu)), $01:96E1 (Spawn shelless Koopa from shell (GeneralResetSpr)), $01:EA21 (Spawn item from sprite; Yoshi on-Mario update), $01:EC84 (Yoshi physics, mounting and dismount), $01:F5C1 (Split Pokey when eaten (SpltPokeyInto2Sprs)), $02:862F (Spawn splashes, sparkles and Throw Block), $02:88FD (Table: status of sprite from block (StatusOfSprInBlk)), $02:8B35 (Misc sprite handlers per frame), $02:AF45 (Spawn three chained grey platforms (Load3Platforms)), $02:AFAF (Spawn group of five wave Eeries (Load5Eeries)), $02:B82E (Spawn flying Pokey segment, and tables (PokeyUnsetBit)) ...
$02:A9E4  64 0E         STZ $0E                     ; [$0E] = 0: no slots left free
$02:A9E6  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:A9E7  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:A9E8  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank (02)
$02:A9E9  20 EF A9      JSR.W FindFreeSlotRt        ; Find a free slot (Y = slot or $FF)
$02:A9EC  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:A9ED  98            TYA                          ; A = Y
$02:A9EE  6B            RTL                          ; Return long, A and Y = free slot or $FF

}

;;; $A9EF: Search for free sprite slot (FindFreeSlotRt) ;;;
{
;; Searches downward from SpriteSlotMax - [$0E] to SpriteSlotStart for status 0 in [$14C8,X]; slot range depends on [$1692].
;; Parameters: [$0E] = number of top slots to skip. Returns: Y = free slot or $FF.
;; Called by: $02:A9E9 (Find free sprite slot (FindFreeSprSlot))
$02:A9EF  AC 92 16      LDY.W $1692                 ; Y = [$1692] (sprite memory setting)
$02:A9F2  B9 AC A7      LDA.W SpriteSlotStart,Y     ; \
$02:A9F5  85 0F         STA $0F                     ; / [$0F] = lowest slot to search
$02:A9F7  B9 73 A7      LDA.W SpriteSlotMax,Y       ; \
$02:A9FA  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:A9FB  E5 0E         SBC $0E                     ; |
$02:A9FD  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = highest slot - slots to leave free
$02:A9FE  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; Sprite status of slot Y
$02:AA01  F0 07         BEQ $AA0A            ; Free (0): return it
$02:AA03  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:AA04  C4 0F         CPY $0F                     ; |
$02:AA06  D0 F6         BNE $A9FE             ; / Next lower slot until [$0F]
$02:AA08  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; No free slot: Y = $FF
$02:AA0A  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $AA0B..AA1B: Table: cluster type 7 coordinates 1 ;;;
{
$02:AA0B                .db $31,$71,$A1,$43,$93,$C3,$14,$65 ; Cluster type 7 table 1: Y low byte (high nibble) and X low (low nibble, shifted up)
$02:AA13                .db $E5,$36,$A7,$39,$99,$F9,$1A,$7A ; Cluster type 7 table 1 (continued)
$02:AA1B                .db $DA,$4C,$AD,$ED         ; Cluster type 7 table 1 (last 4 entries)

}

;;; $AA1F..AA2F: Table: cluster type 7 coordinates 2 ;;;
{
$02:AA1F                .db $01,$51,$91,$D1,$22,$62,$A2,$73 ; Cluster type 7 table 2: second coordinate (high nibble) and low nibble
$02:AA27                .db $E3,$C7,$88,$29,$5A,$AA,$EB,$2C ; Cluster type 7 table 2 (continued)
$02:AA2F                .db $8C,$CC,$FC,$5D         ; Cluster type 7 table 2 (last 4 entries)

}

;;; $AA33: Spawn cluster type 8 (15 entries) ;;;
{
;; Reached through the jump stub at $02AABD for sprite $E4 (the original label says unreachable, but it is entered via that stub).
;; Fills 15 cluster entries with random X near the screen and a Y from the level byte.
$02:AA33  A2 0E         LDX.B #$0E                  ; 15 entries (X = $0E down to 0): cluster sprite type 8
$02:AA35  9E 66 1E      STZ.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:AA38  9E 86 0F      STZ.W $0F86,X               ; / Clear two cluster tables ($1E66 and $0F86)
$02:AA3B  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:AA3D  9D 92 18      STA.W $1892,X               ; / Cluster sprite type [$1892,X] = 8
$02:AA40  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; Random number
$02:AA44  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:AA45  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:AA47  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:AA4A  9D 4A 0F      STA.W $0F4A,X               ; } Cluster X position low = random + screen X (also copied to $0F4A)
$02:AA4D  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; \
$02:AA4F  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AA51  9D 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,X               ; } Cluster X position high
$02:AA54  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = data index of the sprite
$02:AA56  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; \
$02:AA58  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:AA59  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:AA5B  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; } Cluster Y position low = high nibble of the level byte
$02:AA5E  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:AA5F  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:AA61  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; } Cluster Y position high = bit 0
$02:AA64  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AA65  10 CE         BPL $AA35             ; / Next cluster entry (loop while X >= 0)
$02:AA67  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:AA6C  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; \

$02:AA73  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \

$02:AA7E  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \

$02:AA85  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AA86  9D 4A 0F      STA.W $0F4A,X               ; } [$0F4A,X] = X * 4 (per-entry phase/offset, probably)
$02:AA89  CA            DEX                          ; \

$02:AA8C  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:AA8D  9C 0A 19      STZ.W $190A                 ; [$190A] = 0
$02:AA90  A2 13         LDX.B #$13                  ; X = $13: 20 cluster entries
$02:AA92  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; \
$02:AA94  9D 92 18      STA.W $1892,X               ; / Cluster sprite type [$1892,X] = 7
$02:AA97  BD 0B AA      LDA.W $AA0B,X         ; \
$02:AA9A  48            PHA                          ; / A = table 1 value, saved
$02:AA9B  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:AA9D  9D 66 1E      STA.W $1E66,X               ; / [$1E66,X] = high nibble of table 1 value
$02:AAA0  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:AAA1  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAA2  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAA3  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAA4  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAA5  9D 52 1E      STA.W $1E52,X               ; } [$1E52,X] = low nibble of table 1 value, shifted up
$02:AAA8  BD 1F AA      LDA.W $AA1F,X         ; \
$02:AAAB  48            PHA                          ; / A = table 2 value, saved
$02:AAAC  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:AAAE  9D 8E 1E      STA.W $1E8E,X               ; / [$1E8E,X] = high nibble of table 2 value
$02:AAB1  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:AAB2  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAB3  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAB4  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAB5  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AAB6  9D 7A 1E      STA.W $1E7A,X               ; } [$1E7A,X] = low nibble of table 2 value, shifted up
$02:AAB9  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AABA  10 D6         BPL $AA92             ; / Next entry
$02:AABC  60            RTS                          ; Return


}
