;;; $AAC0: Load cluster sprites ;;;
{
;; Handles sprites $E1-$E6: sets [$18B8] = 1 and dispatches by number. $E1 = 20 type 3 entries (random position),
;; $E2/$E3 = up to two groups of 10 type 4 entries, $E4 = type 8, $E5 = type 7, $E6 = type 5.
;; Parameters: A = sprite number, [$03] = data index. Cluster type names are unconfirmed.
;; Called by: $02:A8C9 (Init generator sprite (InitGenerator))
$02:AAC0  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; \
$02:AAC2  8C B8 18      STY.W $18B8                 ; / [$18B8] = 1: cluster sprites are in use
$02:AAC5  C9 E4         CMP.B #$E4                  ; \
$02:AAC7  F0 F4         BEQ $AABD             ; / Sprite $E4: spawn type 8 via the stub at $02AABD
$02:AAC9  C9 E6         CMP.B #$E6                  ; \
$02:AACB  F0 9F         BEQ $AA6C             ; / Sprite $E6: spawn type 5 ($02AA6C)
$02:AACD  C9 E5         CMP.B #$E5                  ; \
$02:AACF  F0 BC         BEQ $AA8D             ; / Sprite $E5: spawn type 7 ($02AA8D)
$02:AAD1  C9 E2         CMP.B #$E2                  ; \
$02:AAD3  B0 3C         BCS $AB11             ; / Sprite $E2 and above ($E2, $E3): go to $02AB11
$02:AAD5  A2 13         LDX.B #$13                  ; Sprite $E1: 20 cluster entries (X = $13 down to 0), type 3
$02:AAD7  9E 66 1E      STZ.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:AADA  9E 86 0F      STZ.W $0F86,X               ; / Clear two cluster tables ($1E66 and $0F86)
$02:AADD  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:AADF  9D 92 18      STA.W $1892,X               ; / Cluster sprite type [$1892,X] = 3
$02:AAE2  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; Random number
$02:AAE6  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:AAE7  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:AAE9  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:AAEC  9D 4A 0F      STA.W $0F4A,X               ; } Cluster X position low = random + screen X (also copied to $0F4A)
$02:AAEF  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; \
$02:AAF1  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AAF3  9D 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,X               ; } Cluster X position high
$02:AAF6  AD 8E 14      LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2       ; \
$02:AAF9  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:AAFB  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:AAFD  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:AAFE  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:AB00  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; } Y position low = ([$148E] & $3F) + 8 + screen Y
$02:AB03  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:AB05  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AB07  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; } Y position high
$02:AB0A  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AB0B  10 CA         BPL $AAD7             ; / Next entry
$02:AB0D  EE BA 18      INC.W $18BA                 ; Count another cluster group: [$18BA]++
$02:AB10  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:AB11  AC BA 18      LDY.W $18BA                 ; \
$02:AB14  C0 02         CPY.B #$02                  ; |
$02:AB16  B0 5F         BCS $AB77            ; / At most 2 groups ($18BA) of this cluster type: return if already 2
$02:AB18  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; \
$02:AB1A  C9 E2         CMP.B #$E2                  ; |
$02:AB1C  F0 02         BEQ $AB20             ; |
$02:AB1E  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:AB20  84 0F         STY $0F                     ; } [$0F] = 1 for sprite $E2, $FF for $E3 (probably direction)
$02:AB22  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:AB24  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; / [$0E] = 9: ten entries per group, index counted down
$02:AB26  A2 13         LDX.B #$13                  ; X = $13: search all 20 cluster entries
$02:AB28  BD 92 18      LDA.W $1892,X               ; \
$02:AB2B  D0 44         BNE $AB71             ; / Entry already in use: skip it
$02:AB2D  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:AB2F  9D 92 18      STA.W $1892,X               ; / Cluster sprite type [$1892,X] = 4
$02:AB32  AD BA 18      LDA.W $18BA                 ; \
$02:AB35  9D 86 0F      STA.W $0F86,X               ; / [$0F86,X] = group number [$18BA]
$02:AB38  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:AB3A  9D 72 0F      STA.W $0F72,X               ; / [$0F72,X] = index within the group ([$0E])
$02:AB3D  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:AB3F  9D 4A 0F      STA.W $0F4A,X               ; / [$0F4A,X] = [$0F]
$02:AB42  64 0F         STZ $0F                     ; \
$02:AB44  F0 27         BEQ $AB6D             ; / Only the first entry of a group records the spawn info below
$02:AB46  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = data index of the sprite
$02:AB48  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; First byte of the sprite's level data
$02:AB4A  AC BA 18      LDY.W $18BA                 ; Y = group number [$18BA]
$02:AB4D  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:AB4E  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:AB50  99 B6 0F      STA.W $0FB6,Y               ; } [$0FB6,Y] = Y position low (high nibble)
$02:AB53  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:AB54  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:AB56  99 B8 0F      STA.W $0FB8,Y               ; } [$0FB8,Y] = Y position high bit
$02:AB59  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:AB5B  99 B2 0F      STA.W $0FB2,Y               ; / [$0FB2,Y] = adjusted screen boundary low
$02:AB5E  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:AB60  99 B4 0F      STA.W $0FB4,Y               ; / [$0FB4,Y] = adjusted screen boundary high
$02:AB63  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:AB65  99 BA 0F      STA.W $0FBA,Y               ; / [$0FBA,Y] = 0
$02:AB68  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:AB6A  99 BC 0F      STA.W $0FBC,Y               ; / [$0FBC,Y] = index of the sprite in the level
$02:AB6D  C6 0E         DEC $0E                     ; \
$02:AB6F  30 03         BMI $AB74             ; / Count down [$0E]; negative = group of 10 complete
$02:AB71  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AB72  10 B4         BPL $AB28             ; / Next cluster entry
$02:AB74  EE BA 18      INC.W $18BA                 ; Count the group: [$18BA]++
$02:AB77  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $AB78: Load shooter, clear sprites, preload level (LoadShooter) ;;;
{
;; Loads a shooter (sprites $C9-$CA) into one of 8 slots at $1783 (type = number - $C8, position from level data, timer $10); a full table replaces round-robin ([$18FF]).
;; $02ABF2: called on level exit; clears all level load flags, keeps a carried sprite (status $0B) in slot 0, clears RAM $1693-$190D.
;; $02AC5C: preloads all sprites around the screen by calling $A802 over 32 steps of $10 pixels, vertical or horizontal depending on the level.
;; Called by: $02:A8D8 (Init generator sprite (InitGenerator))
$02:AB78  86 02         STX $02                     ; [$02] = index of the sprite in the level
$02:AB7A  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:AB7B  84 03         STY $03                     ; / [$03] = data index of the sprite's first byte
$02:AB7D  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = sprite number
$02:AB7F  A2 07         LDX.B #$07                  ; X = 7: eight shooter slots
$02:AB81  BD 83 17      LDA.W $1783,X               ; Shooter type of slot X
$02:AB84  F0 18         BEQ $AB9E             ; Free slot (0): use it
$02:AB86  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AB87  10 F8         BPL $AB81             ; / Next slot
$02:AB89  CE FF 18      DEC.W $18FF                 ; \
$02:AB8C  10 05         BPL $AB93             ; / All slots full: next victim = ([$18FF] - 1)
$02:AB8E  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; \
$02:AB90  8D FF 18      STA.W $18FF                 ; / Wrap round to 7
$02:AB93  AE FF 18      LDX.W $18FF                 ; X = slot to replace
$02:AB96  BC B3 17      LDY.W $17B3,X               ; Y = level index of the shooter in that slot
$02:AB99  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:AB9B  99 38 19      STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y   ; / Allow that shooter to be loaded again later
$02:AB9E  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = data index of the sprite
$02:ABA0  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:ABA2  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:ABA3  E9 C8         SBC.B #$C8                  ; |
$02:ABA5  9D 83 17      STA.W $1783,X               ; } Shooter type [$1783,X] = sprite number - $C8
$02:ABA8  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:ABAA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:ABAB  90 1A         BCC $ABC7             ; / Horizontal level: go to $02ABC7
$02:ABAD  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; Vertical level: first byte of the level data
$02:ABAF  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:ABB0  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:ABB2  9D 9B 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; } Shooter X low = high nibble
$02:ABB5  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:ABB6  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:ABB8  9D A3 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterXHi,X      ; } Shooter X high = bit 0
$02:ABBB  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:ABBD  9D 8B 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; } Shooter Y = adjusted screen boundary
$02:ABC0  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:ABC2  9D 93 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterYHi,X      ; |
$02:ABC5  80 18         BRA $ABDF             ; / Continue at $02ABDF

$02:ABC7  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; First byte of the level data
$02:ABC9  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:ABCA  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:ABCC  9D 8B 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; } Shooter Y low = high nibble
$02:ABCF  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:ABD0  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:ABD2  9D 93 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterYHi,X      ; } Shooter Y high = bit 0
$02:ABD5  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:ABD7  9D 9B 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; } Shooter X = adjusted screen boundary
$02:ABDA  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:ABDC  9D A3 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterXHi,X      ; /
$02:ABDF  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:ABE1  9D B3 17      STA.W $17B3,X               ; / [$17B3,X] = index in the level (for reloading)
$02:ABE4  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:ABE6  9D AB 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; / Shooter timer = $10
$02:ABE9  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:ABEA  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:ABEB  C8            INY                          ; / Skip the 3 data bytes of the sprite
$02:ABEC  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; \
$02:ABEE  E8            INX                          ; / X = next sprite number in the level
$02:ABEF  4C 2E A8      JMP.W LoadSpriteLoopStrt    ; Continue the loading loop

$02:ABF2  A2 3F         LDX.B #$3F                  ; Probably called on level exit. X = $3F: all 64 sprites
$02:ABF4  9E 38 19      STZ.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; Allow every level sprite to be loaded again
$02:ABF7  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:ABF8  10 FA         BPL $ABF4             ; / Next sprite
$02:ABFA  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:ABFC  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = $FF: no sprite is being carried yet
$02:ABFE  A2 0B         LDX.B #$0B                  ; X = $0B: all 12 sprite slots
$02:AC00  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:AC02  9D 1A 16      STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X   ; / Level index $FF: never reload this sprite
$02:AC05  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:AC08  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; / Status $0B?
$02:AC0A  F0 05         BEQ $AC11             ; \
$02:AC0C  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; / No: erase the sprite (status 0)
$02:AC0F  80 02         BRA $AC13             ; Skip

$02:AC11  86 00         STX $00                     ; Remember the slot with status $0B in [$00]
$02:AC13  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:AC14  10 EA         BPL $AC00             ; / Next slot
$02:AC16  A6 00         LDX $00                     ; \
$02:AC18  30 2E         BMI $AC48             ; / No such sprite: skip to RAM clearing
$02:AC1A  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Free the old slot
$02:AC1D  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:AC1F  8D C8 14      STA.W $14C8                 ; / Slot 0: status $0B (carried between areas)
$02:AC22  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:AC24  85 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum           ; / Copy sprite number to slot 0
$02:AC26  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:AC28  85 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo           ; / Copy X position low
$02:AC2A  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:AC2D  8D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi         ; / Copy X position high
$02:AC30  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:AC32  85 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo           ; / Copy Y position low
$02:AC34  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:AC37  8D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi         ; / Copy Y position high
$02:AC3A  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:AC3D  48            PHA                          ; / Save its palette
$02:AC3E  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; X = 0
$02:AC40  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise slot 0's sprite tables
$02:AC44  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:AC45  8D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal         ; / Restore the palette
$02:AC48  C2 10         REP #$10                    ; Index registers 16-bit
$02:AC4A  A2 7A 02      LDX.W #$027A                ; X = $027A
$02:AC4D  9E 93 16      STZ.W $1693,X               ; \
$02:AC50  CA            DEX                          ; |
$02:AC51  10 FA         BPL $AC4D             ; } Clear RAM $1693-$190D
$02:AC53  E2 10         SEP #$10                    ; Index registers 8-bit
$02:AC55  9C 3E 14      STZ.W RAM_ScrollSprNum      ; Scroll sprite number = 0
$02:AC58  9C 3F 14      STZ.W $143F                 ; [$143F] = 0
$02:AC5B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:AC5C  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:AC5E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:AC5F  90 40         BCC $ACA1             ; / Horizontal level: go to $02ACA1
$02:AC61  A5 55         LDA $55                     ; \
$02:AC63  48            PHA                          ; / Save [$55]
$02:AC64  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:AC66  85 55         STA $55                     ; / [$55] = 1 (purpose unclear)
$02:AC68  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:AC6A  48            PHA                          ; / Save screen Y low
$02:AC6B  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:AC6C  E9 60         SBC.B #$60                  ; |
$02:AC6E  85 1C         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } Screen Y -= $60 (vertical level), low
$02:AC70  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:AC72  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:AC73  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AC75  85 1D         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; } Screen Y -= $60, high (saved first)
$02:AC77  9C B6 18      STZ.W $18B6                 ; [$18B6] = 0: step counter
$02:AC7A  20 02 A8      JSR.W $A802           ; Load sprites at this boundary (twice, covers both edges)
$02:AC7D  20 02 A8      JSR.W $A802           ; Load sprites at this boundary (twice, covers both edges)
$02:AC80  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:AC82  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:AC83  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:AC85  85 1C         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } Screen Y += $10, low
$02:AC87  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:AC89  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AC8B  85 1D         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; } Screen Y high carry
$02:AC8D  EE B6 18      INC.W $18B6                 ; \

$02:AC9A  68            PLA                          ; |

$02:AC9D  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:AC9E  85 55         STA $55                     ; } Restore screen Y high, screen Y low and [$55]
$02:ACA0  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:ACA1  A5 55         LDA $55                     ; \
$02:ACA3  48            PHA                          ; / Horizontal level: save [$55]
$02:ACA4  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:ACA6  85 55         STA $55                     ; / [$55] = 1
$02:ACA8  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:ACAA  48            PHA                          ; / Save screen X low
$02:ACAB  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:ACAC  E9 60         SBC.B #$60                  ; |
$02:ACAE  85 1A         STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } Screen X -= $60, low
$02:ACB0  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; \
$02:ACB2  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:ACB3  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |

$02:ACBD  20 02 A8      JSR.W $A802           ; Load sprites at this boundary (twice)

$02:ACC2  18            CLC                          ; |

$02:ACC7  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; \

$02:ACD0  AD B6 18      LDA.W $18B6                 ; |
$02:ACD3  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; |
$02:ACD5  90 E3         BCC $ACBA             ; } [$18B6]++, repeat for 32 steps
$02:ACD7  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:ACD8  85 1B         STA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:ACDA  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:ACDB  85 1A         STA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:ACDD  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:ACDE  85 55         STA $55                     ; } Restore screen X high, screen X low and [$55]
$02:ACE0  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:ACE1  DA            PHX                          ; Entry for Y = sprite slot: save X
$02:ACE2  BB            TYX                          ; X = Y
$02:ACE3  80 01         BRA $ACE6             ; Continue in GivePoints

}

;;; $ACE5: Spawn score sprite (GivePoints) ;;;
{
;; $02ACE5 (GivePoints): A = score type - 5, X = sprite slot that was hit. $02ACE1: same with Y as the sprite slot.
;; $02ACEF: creates the score sprite at the sprite's position, 8 pixels higher; type 1=10, 2=20, 3=40, 4=80, 5=100 ... 9=1000, A=2000, B=4000, C=8000, D=1UP.
;; $02AD34: returns Y = free score slot (6 slots), or round-robin slot [$18F7].
;; Called by: $00:FC0E (Level-end coin sprite and helpers (LvlEndSprCoinsRt)), $01:A306 (Baby Yoshi: stunned/carried logic and draw (StunBabyYoshi)), $01:A667 (Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce), $01:A6C1 (Sprite contact outcomes: kill or bounce), $01:A85A (Default Mario interaction: star kill (DefaultInteractR)), $01:AB64 (Push Mario out of a sprite), $01:B149 (Cheep Cheep main (Fish)), $01:C2A0 (Balloon, flying coin, 1-up and key main (BalloonKeyFlyObjs)), $01:C4EC (Power-up behaviour, contact and spark effect (DrawBerryGfx)), $01:C576 (Give Mario a power-up (grow, star) (GiveMarioMushroom)), $01:C5A3 (Give Mario a cape (GiveMarioCape)), $01:C604 (Give 1-up score (GiveMario1Up)) ...
$02:ACE5  DA            PHX                          ; Entry for X = sprite slot: save X
$02:ACE6  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:ACE7  69 05         ADC.B #$05                  ; / A = A + 5: type in the score sprite table
$02:ACE9  22 EF AC 02   JSL.L $ACEF           ; Create the score sprite
$02:ACED  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:ACEE  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:ACEF  5A            PHY                          ; Save Y
$02:ACF0  48            PHA                          ; Save the score type
$02:ACF1  22 34 AD 02   JSL.L $AD34           ; Y = free score sprite slot
$02:ACF5  68            PLA                          ; Restore the score type
$02:ACF6  99 E1 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,Y     ; Store the score type
$02:ACF9  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:ACFB  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:ACFC  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:ACFE  99 E7 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,Y     ; } Score Y low = sprite Y low - 8
$02:AD01  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:AD02  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:AD05  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AD07  99 F9 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,Y     ; } Score Y high = sprite Y high (borrow)
$02:AD0A  68            PLA                          ; Restore Y low
$02:AD0B  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:AD0C  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:AD0E  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:AD10  90 10         BCC $AD22             ; / Y relative to screen top >= $F0: off the top of the screen?
$02:AD12  B9 E7 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,Y     ; \
$02:AD15  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:AD17  99 E7 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,Y     ; } Yes: move the score sprite down by $10
$02:AD1A  B9 F9 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,Y     ; \
$02:AD1D  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:AD1F  99 F9 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,Y     ; } Score Y high
$02:AD22  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:AD24  99 ED 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,Y     ; / Score X low = sprite X low
$02:AD27  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:AD2A  99 F3 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXHi,Y     ; / Score X high = sprite X high
$02:AD2D  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:AD2F  99 FF 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,Y  ; / Score Y speed = $30 (also its lifetime timer)
$02:AD32  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y
$02:AD33  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:AD34  A0 05         LDY.B #$05                  ; Y = 5: search the six score slots
$02:AD36  B9 E1 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,Y     ; Score type of slot Y
$02:AD39  F0 10         BEQ $AD4B            ; Empty slot: return it
$02:AD3B  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:AD3C  10 F8         BPL $AD36             ; / Next slot
$02:AD3E  CE F7 18      DEC.W $18F7                 ; \
$02:AD41  10 05         BPL $AD48             ; |
$02:AD43  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; / All full: [$18F7] is a round-robin counter, decrement
$02:AD45  8D F7 18      STA.W $18F7                 ; \
$02:AD48  AC F7 18      LDY.W $18F7                 ; / Wrap round to 5, return it in Y
$02:AD4B  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $AD4C: Table: score sprite left tiles (PointTile1) ;;;
{
;; Tile for the left half of each score type (0-$15).
$02:AD4C                .db $00,$83,$83,$83,$83,$44,$54,$46 ; Score tile, left half, by score type 0-$15
$02:AD54                .db $47,$44,$54,$46,$47,$56,$29,$39 ; Score tile, left half, types 8-$F
$02:AD5C                .db $38,$5E,$5E,$5E,$5E,$5E ; Score tile, left half, types $10-$15

}

;;; $AD62: Table: score sprite right tiles (PointTile2) ;;;
{
;; Tile for the right half of each score type (0-$15).
$02:AD62                .db $00,$44,$54,$46,$47,$45,$45,$45 ; Score tile, right half, by score type 0-7
$02:AD6A                .db $45,$55,$55,$55,$55,$57,$57,$57 ; Score tile, right half, types 8-$F
$02:AD72                .db $57,$4E,$44,$4F,$54,$5D ; Score tile, right half, types $10-$15

}

;;; $AD78: Table: score value low byte (PointMultiplierLo) ;;;
{
;; Score divided by 10 for each type, low byte.
$02:AD78                .db $00,$01,$02,$04,$08,$0A,$14,$28 ; Score / 10, low byte, types 0-7
$02:AD80                .db $50,$64,$C8,$90,$20,$00,$00,$00 ; Score / 10, low byte, types 8-$F
$02:AD88                .db $00                     ; Score / 10, low byte, type $10

}

;;; $AD89: Table: score value high byte (PointMultiplierHi) ;;;
{
;; Score divided by 10 for each type, high byte.
$02:AD89                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Score / 10, high byte, types 0-7
$02:AD91                .db $00,$00,$00,$01,$03,$00,$00,$00 ; Score / 10, high byte, types 8-$F
$02:AD99                .db $00                     ; Score / 10, high byte, type $10

}

;;; $AD9A: Table: score sprite speeds and OAM slots (PointSpeedY) ;;;
{
;; PointSpeedY: 4 bytes. $AD9E: 6 OAM indices, one per score sprite. Exact use is unconfirmed.
$02:AD9A                .db $03,$01,$00,$00         ; Y speed step values (probably indexed by timer bits)

$02:AD9E                .db $B0,$B8,$C0,$C8,$D0,$D8 ; OAM buffer indices, one per score sprite slot ($B0-$D8)

}

;;; $ADA4: Update score sprites (ScoreSprGfx) ;;;
{
;; Loops over the six score sprite slots and runs the update/draw routine for each active one. Skips everything for Bowser's room ([$0D9B] = $C1).
;; Hides OAM entries 1-2 in other Mode 7 boss rooms (bit 6 of [$0D9B]). The routine beyond $02ADD5 is in the next chunk.
;; Called by: $02:8B0B (Misc sprite handlers per frame)
$02:ADA4  2C 9B 0D      BIT.W $0D9B                 ; Bit 6 of [$0D9B]: Mode 7 boss room
$02:ADA7  50 0F         BVC $ADB8             ; Bit 6 clear: draw normally
$02:ADA9  AD 9B 0D      LDA.W $0D9B                 ; \
$02:ADAC  C9 C1         CMP.B #$C1                  ; |
$02:ADAE  F0 18         BEQ $ADC8            ; } [$0D9B] = $C1 (Bowser fight): draw no score sprites
$02:ADB0  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:ADB2  8D 05 02      STA.W $0205                 ; |
$02:ADB5  8D 09 02      STA.W $0209                 ; } Hide OAM entries 1 and 2 (Y = $F0, off-screen)
$02:ADB8  A2 05         LDX.B #$05                  ; X = 5: six score sprite slots
$02:ADBA  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; [$15E9] = current slot
$02:ADBD  BD E1 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; Score type of slot X
$02:ADC0  F0 03         BEQ $ADC5             ; None: next slot
$02:ADC2  20 C9 AD      JSR.W $ADC9           ; Update and draw this score sprite
$02:ADC5  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:ADC6  10 F2         BPL $ADBA             ; / Next slot
$02:ADC8  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:ADC9  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; A = [$9D] (sprites locked)

}

;;; $ADCB: Data: BEQ opcode bytes inside score update (Instr02ADCB) ;;;
{
;; F0 03 is a BEQ +3 that the disassembler shows as data.
$02:ADCB                .db $F0,$03                 ; BEQ +3 (data bytes F0 03): not locked, continue

$02:ADCD  4C 5B AE      JMP.W $AE5B           ; Sprites locked: only draw it

$02:ADD0  BD FF 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,X  ; Score sprite Y speed

}

;;; $ADD3: Data: BNE opcode bytes inside score update (Instr02ADD3) ;;;
{
;; D0 0F is a BNE +$0F that the disassembler shows as data.
$02:ADD3                .db $D0,$0F                 ; BNE +$0F (data bytes D0 0F): continue while non-zero

$02:ADD5  9E E1 16      STZ.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; Speed 0: score has finished, free the slot
$02:ADD8  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $ADD9: Table: coins given by coin type (CoinsToGive) ;;;
{
;; Probably the number of coins awarded per coin sprite/block type.
$02:ADD9                .db $01,$02,$03,$05,$05,$0A,$0F,$14 ; Coins awarded by coin type 0-8 (1, 2, 3, 5, 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 probably)
$02:ADE1                .db $19                     ; Coins awarded (last entry)

}

;;; $ADE2: Score sprite: timer, scoring, movement and OAM (2Up3UpAttr) ;;;
{
;; Main routine of a score sprite (6 slots at $16E1-$1705 hold number, position and timer). Entered at $02ADE4.
;; Timer [$16FF+X] counts down from $30. When it reaches $2A the award is made: points are added to the current player's 24-bit score at
;; $0F34 (in units of 10), 1UP-5UP numbers ($0D-$10) add lives to [$18E4], and numbers $11-$15 give 5-25 coins.
;; Then the sprite floats upward (slower while the timer is high, stops 4 pixels below the screen top), is clipped against the screen and
;; drawn as two 8x8 tiles; coin rewards also get a coin icon. Parameters: X = score sprite slot.
$02:ADE2                .db $04,$06                 ; Properties for 2UP and 3UP score sprites: $04, $06 (indexed by number - $0E)

$02:ADE4  DE FF 16      DEC.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,X  ; Score sprite timer --
$02:ADE7  C9 2A         CMP.B #$2A                  ; Timer reached $2A (6 frames after spawn)?
$02:ADE9  D0 4D         BNE $AE38             ; No: skip the scoring, go move/draw
$02:ADEB  BC E1 16      LDY.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; Y = score sprite number
$02:ADEE  C0 0D         CPY.B #$0D                  ; Number < $0D (point score)?
$02:ADF0  90 20         BCC $AE12             ; Yes: add points
$02:ADF2  C0 11         CPY.B #$11                  ; Number < $11 (1UP-5UP)?
$02:ADF4  90 0D         BCC $AE03             ; Yes: add lives
$02:ADF6  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:ADF7  5A            PHY                          ; / Save X and Y
$02:ADF8  B9 CC AD      LDA.W ADDR_02ADCC,Y         ; A = number of coins from the table at $02ADD9 (5, 10, 15, 20, 25)
$02:ADFB  22 29 B3 05   JSL.L $B329           ; Give A coins to Mario ($05:B329)
$02:ADFF  7A            PLY                          ; \
$02:AE00  FA            PLX                          ; / Restore Y and X
$02:AE01  80 0F         BRA $AE12             ; Done, go draw

$02:AE03  B9 CC AD      LDA.W ADDR_02ADCC,Y         ; A = number of lives from CoinsToGive table (1, 2, 3, 5)
$02:AE06  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:AE07  6D E4 18      ADC.W $18E4                 ; |
$02:AE0A  8D E4 18      STA.W $18E4                 ; } Lives to add [$18E4] += A, [$18E5] = 0
$02:AE0D  9C E5 18      STZ.W $18E5                 ; /
$02:AE10  80 23         BRA $AE35             ; Done, go restore X

$02:AE12  AD B3 0D      LDA.W $0DB3                 ; \
$02:AE15  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AE16  6D B3 0D      ADC.W $0DB3                 ; } X = [$0DB3] * 3: offset of the current player score
$02:AE19  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:AE1A  BD 34 0F      LDA.W $0F34,X               ; Score (24-bit, in units of 10 points) low byte
$02:AE1D  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:AE1E  79 78 AD      ADC.W PointMultiplierLo,Y   ; \
$02:AE21  9D 34 0F      STA.W $0F34,X               ; / Score low += PointMultiplierLo[num]
$02:AE24  BD 35 0F      LDA.W $0F35,X               ; \
$02:AE27  79 89 AD      ADC.W PointMultiplierHi,Y   ; } Score middle += PointMultiplierHi[num] with carry
$02:AE2A  9D 35 0F      STA.W $0F35,X               ; /
$02:AE2D  BD 36 0F      LDA.W $0F36,X               ; \
$02:AE30  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Score high += carry
$02:AE32  9D 36 0F      STA.W $0F36,X               ; /
$02:AE35  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = score sprite slot
$02:AE38  BD FF 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,X  ; A = timer
$02:AE3B  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:AE3C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:AE3D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:AE3E  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = timer / 16: index into PointSpeedY
$02:AE3F  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:AE40  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; A = frame counter
$02:AE42  39 9A AD      AND.W PointSpeedY,Y         ; Mask with PointSpeedY[Y] (3, 1, 0, 0): rises slower while the timer is high
$02:AE45  D0 14         BNE $AE5B             ; Masked bits non-zero: do not move this frame
$02:AE47  BD E7 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,X     ; Y = sprite Y low byte (old value)
$02:AE4A  A8            TAY                          ; \
$02:AE4B  38            SEC                          ; } Compare screen-relative Y with 4
$02:AE4C  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; /
$02:AE4E  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; Stop rising when within 4 pixels of the top of the screen
$02:AE50  90 09         BCC $AE5B             ; Near the top: do not move
$02:AE52  DE E7 16      DEC.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,X     ; Sprite Y -= 1
$02:AE55  98            TYA                          ; Old Y low byte = 0: borrow needed
$02:AE56  D0 03         BNE $AE5B             ; Not zero: no borrow
$02:AE58  DE F9 16      DEC.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,X     ; Y high byte -= 1
$02:AE5B  BD 05 17      LDA.W $1705,X               ; \
$02:AE5E  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:AE5F  0A            ASL                          ; } Y = layer index * 4: offset to the layer 1 or layer 2 scroll in $1A-$21
$02:AE60  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:AE61  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:AE63  B9 1C 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYLo,Y  ; A = screen Y of that layer ($1C or $20); stored as $02
$02:AE66  85 02         STA $02                     ; $02 = screen Y
$02:AE68  B9 1A 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryXLo,Y  ; A = screen X ($1A or $1E)
$02:AE6B  85 04         STA $04                     ; $04 = screen X
$02:AE6D  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:AE6F  BD ED 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,X     ; \
$02:AE72  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:AE73  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:AE75  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:AE76  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:AE77  E5 04         SBC $04                     ; |
$02:AE79  BD F3 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXHi,X     ; |
$02:AE7C  E5 05         SBC $05                     ; |
$02:AE7E  28            PLP                          ; } A = high byte of (sprite X + $0C - screen X), with carries
$02:AE7F  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; /
$02:AE81  D0 78         BNE $AEFB            ; Not zero: off-screen to the right, return
$02:AE83  BD ED 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,X     ; \
$02:AE86  C5 04         CMP $04                     ; |
$02:AE88  BD F3 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXHi,X     ; } Sprite X - screen X (16-bit): negative = off-screen left
$02:AE8B  E5 05         SBC $05                     ; /
$02:AE8D  D0 6C         BNE $AEFB            ; Off-screen: return
$02:AE8F  BD E7 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,X     ; \
$02:AE92  C5 02         CMP $02                     ; |
$02:AE94  BD F9 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,X     ; } Sprite Y - screen Y (16-bit)
$02:AE97  E5 03         SBC $03                     ; /
$02:AE99  D0 60         BNE $AEFB            ; Not within 256 pixels below the screen top: return
$02:AE9B  BC 9E AD      LDY.W $AD9E,X         ; Y = OAM index of this score slot ($B0 + 8 * slot)
$02:AE9E  2C 9B 0D      BIT.W $0D9B                 ; Mode 7 boss room flag [$0D9B] bit 6?
$02:AEA1  50 02         BVC $AEA5             ; No: keep the index
$02:AEA3  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; Boss room: use OAM index $04 instead (slots left free there)
$02:AEA5  BD E7 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,X     ; \
$02:AEA8  38            SEC                          ; } Y position on screen = sprite Y - screen Y
$02:AEA9  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; /
$02:AEAB  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; First tile Y
$02:AEAE  99 05 02      STA.W $0205,Y               ; Second tile Y
$02:AEB1  BD ED 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,X     ; \
$02:AEB4  38            SEC                          ; } X position on screen = sprite X - screen X
$02:AEB5  E5 04         SBC $04                     ; /
$02:AEB7  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; First tile X
$02:AEBA  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:AEBB  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; / Second tile X = first + 8
$02:AEBD  99 04 02      STA.W $0204,Y               ; Store second tile X
$02:AEC0  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:AEC1  BD E1 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; A = score sprite number
$02:AEC4  AA            TAX                          ; X = number
$02:AEC5  BD 4C AD      LDA.W PointTile1,X          ; First tile from PointTile1
$02:AEC8  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; Store first tile number
$02:AECB  BD 62 AD      LDA.W PointTile2,X          ; Second tile from PointTile2
$02:AECE  99 06 02      STA.W $0206,Y               ; Store second tile number
$02:AED1  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:AED2  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM index
$02:AED3  BC E1 16      LDY.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; Y = score sprite number
$02:AED6  C0 0E         CPY.B #$0E                  ; Number < $0E?
$02:AED8  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; A = $08 (palette 4)
$02:AEDA  90 03         BCC $AEDF             ; Yes: keep $08 (point scores and 1UP)
$02:AEDC  B9 D4 AD      LDA.W ADDR_02ADD4,Y         ; Otherwise read the property from the table at $02ADD4 + number (2UP: $04, 3UP: $06)
$02:AEDF  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:AEE0  09 30         ORA.B #$30                  ; Add priority 3 (in front of layers)
$02:AEE2  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; First tile properties
$02:AEE5  99 07 02      STA.W $0207,Y               ; Second tile properties
$02:AEE8  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:AEE9  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:AEEA  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4: slot in the size table
$02:AEEB  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:AEEC  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size = 0 (8x8), X bit 8 = 0
$02:AEEE  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; First tile size bits
$02:AEF1  99 21 04      STA.W $0421,Y               ; Second tile size bits
$02:AEF4  BD E1 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; A = score sprite number
$02:AEF7  C9 11         CMP.B #$11                  ; Number >= $11 (coin reward)?
$02:AEF9  B0 01         BCS $AEFC             ; Yes: also draw the coin icon
$02:AEFB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:AEFC  A0 4C         LDY.B #$4C                  ; Y = $4C: OAM index of a spare slot for the coin
$02:AEFE  BD ED 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,X     ; \
$02:AF01  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:AF02  E5 04         SBC $04                     ; |
$02:AF04  38            SEC                          ; } Coin X = sprite X - screen X - 8
$02:AF05  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; /
$02:AF07  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; Store coin X
$02:AF0A  BD E7 16      LDA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,X     ; \
$02:AF0D  38            SEC                          ; } Coin Y = sprite Y - screen Y
$02:AF0E  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; /
$02:AF10  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; Store coin Y
$02:AF13  A9 5F         LDA.B #$5F                  ; Tile $5F (coin)
$02:AF15  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; Store tile
$02:AF18  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; Palette 2
$02:AF1A  09 30         ORA.B #$30                  ; Add priority 3
$02:AF1C  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; Store properties
$02:AF1F  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:AF20  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:AF21  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:AF22  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:AF23  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; Size 0 (8x8)
$02:AF25  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; Store size bits
$02:AF28  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:AF29  9E E1 16      STZ.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,X     ; Unreachable: clear the score sprite
$02:AF2C  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $AF2D..AF30: Table: platform start angles ;;;
{
;; Low and high bytes of the 3 starting angles used by Load3Platforms ($0000, $00AA, $0154: 120 degrees apart on a 9-bit circle).
$02:AF2D                .db $00,$AA,$54             ; Platform start angle low byte: $00, $AA, $54 (120 degrees apart)

$02:AF30                .db $00,$00,$01             ; Platform start angle high byte: $00, $00, $01

}

;;; $AF33: Spawn three chained grey platforms (Load3Platforms) ;;;
{
;; Level loader for the three-platform rotating chain sprite group. Spawns 3 sprites $A3 (grey platform on chain) at one position with
;; start angles 120 degrees apart. Only the first spawned one gets the level sprite index.
;; Parameters: [$00]-[$01]: X position, [$02]: level sprite index, [$03]: offset into level sprite data at [$CE]. Returns early if no free slot.
;; Called by: $02:A8A5 (Start a scroll command sprite (LoadScrollSprite))
$02:AF33  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = index of this sprite in the level sprite data
$02:AF35  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; A = first byte: YYYY---H (Y position, Y screen bit)
$02:AF37  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:AF38  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; Keep the high nibble
$02:AF3A  85 08         STA $08                     ; $08 = Y position low
$02:AF3C  68            PLA                          ; Get the byte back
$02:AF3D  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0
$02:AF3F  85 09         STA $09                     ; $09 = Y position high
$02:AF41  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Spawn counter = 2 (three platforms)
$02:AF43  85 04         STA $04                     ; $04 = counter
$02:AF45  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:AF49  30 3B         BMI $AF86            ; None free: return
$02:AF4B  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:AF4C  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Status = 1 (initialize)
$02:AF4E  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; Set sprite status
$02:AF51  A9 A3         LDA.B #$A3                  ; Sprite $A3 = grey platform on chain
$02:AF53  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Set sprite number
$02:AF55  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Clear/initialize the sprite tables
$02:AF59  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; X position low from $00
$02:AF5B  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Set X low
$02:AF5D  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; X position high from $01
$02:AF5F  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Set X high
$02:AF62  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; Y position low
$02:AF64  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Set Y low
$02:AF66  A5 09         LDA $09                     ; Y position high
$02:AF68  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Set Y high
$02:AF6B  A4 04         LDY $04                     ; Y = counter
$02:AF6D  B9 2D AF      LDA.W $AF2D,Y         ; Angle low from table
$02:AF70  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; [$1602] = angle low (probably)
$02:AF73  B9 30 AF      LDA.W $AF30,Y         ; Angle high from table
$02:AF76  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; [$151C] = angle high (probably)
$02:AF79  C0 02         CPY.B #$02                  ; First spawned (counter = 2)?
$02:AF7B  D0 05         BNE $AF82             ; No: skip
$02:AF7D  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; A = level sprite index from caller
$02:AF7F  9D 1A 16      STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X   ; Remember it so only this platform respawns the group
$02:AF82  C6 04         DEC $04                     ; Counter--
$02:AF84  10 BF         BPL $AF45             ; Loop for 3 platforms
$02:AF86  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $AF87: Table: Eerie group X offsets low (EerieGroupDispXLo) ;;;
{
$02:AF87                .db $E0,$F0,$00,$10,$20     ; X offsets low from group centre: -$20, -$10, 0, $10, $20

}

;;; $AF8C: Table: Eerie group X offsets high (EerieGroupDispXHi) ;;;
{
$02:AF8C                .db $FF,$FF,$00,$00,$00     ; X offsets high byte

}

;;; $AF91: Table: Eerie group Y speeds (EerieGroupSpeedY) ;;;
{
$02:AF91                .db $17,$E9,$17,$E9,$17     ; Initial Y speed: alternating $17 (down) and $E9 (up)

}

;;; $AF96: Table: Eerie group states (EerieGroupState) ;;;
{
$02:AF96                .db $00,$01,$00,$01,$00     ; Initial sprite state: 0, 1, 0, 1, 0

}

;;; $AF9B: Table: Eerie group X speeds (toward Mario) (EerieGroupSpeedX) ;;;
{
$02:AF9B                .db $10,$F0                 ; Initial X speed: $10 (right) or $F0 (left)

}

;;; $AF9D: Spawn group of five wave Eeries (Load5Eeries) ;;;
{
;; Level loader for a row of 5 wave Eeries ($39), spaced $10 pixels apart, alternating Y speed and state, X speed pointing toward Mario.
;; Only the first spawned one gets the level sprite index.
;; Parameters: [$00]-[$01]: X position, [$02]: level sprite index, [$03]: offset into level sprite data at [$CE].
;; Called by: $02:A895 (Start a scroll command sprite (LoadScrollSprite))
$02:AF9D  A4 03         LDY $03                     ; Y = index of this sprite in the level sprite data
$02:AF9F  B7 CE         LDA [$CE],Y                 ; A = first byte: YYYY---H
$02:AFA1  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:AFA2  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; Keep the high nibble
$02:AFA4  85 08         STA $08                     ; $08 = Y position low
$02:AFA6  68            PLA                          ; Get the byte back
$02:AFA7  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0
$02:AFA9  85 09         STA $09                     ; $09 = Y position high
$02:AFAB  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; Spawn counter = 4 (five Eeries)
$02:AFAD  85 04         STA $04                     ; $04 = counter
$02:AFAF  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:AFB3  30 48         BMI $AFFD            ; None free: return
$02:AFB5  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:AFB6  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; Status = 8 (normal)
$02:AFB8  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; Set sprite status
$02:AFBB  A9 39         LDA.B #$39                  ; Sprite $39 = wave Eerie
$02:AFBD  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Set sprite number
$02:AFBF  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Clear/initialize the sprite tables
$02:AFC3  A4 04         LDY $04                     ; Y = counter
$02:AFC5  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = X position low from $00
$02:AFC7  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:AFC8  79 87 AF      ADC.W EerieGroupDispXLo,Y   ; Add the X offset for this Eerie
$02:AFCB  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Set X low
$02:AFCD  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = X position high from $01
$02:AFCF  79 8C AF      ADC.W EerieGroupDispXHi,Y   ; Add the X offset high byte
$02:AFD2  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Set X high
$02:AFD5  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; Y position low
$02:AFD7  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Set Y low
$02:AFD9  A5 09         LDA $09                     ; Y position high
$02:AFDB  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Set Y high
$02:AFDE  B9 91 AF      LDA.W EerieGroupSpeedY,Y    ; Y speed from table
$02:AFE1  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Set Y speed
$02:AFE3  B9 96 AF      LDA.W EerieGroupState,Y     ; State from table
$02:AFE6  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Set sprite state
$02:AFE8  C0 04         CPY.B #$04                  ; First spawned (counter = 4)?
$02:AFEA  D0 05         BNE $AFF1             ; No: skip
$02:AFEC  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; A = level sprite index from caller
$02:AFEE  9D 1A 16      STA.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X   ; Remember it so only this Eerie respawns the group
$02:AFF1  20 8D 84      JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk2        ; Y = 0 if Mario is right of the sprite, 1 if left
$02:AFF4  B9 9B AF      LDA.W EerieGroupSpeedX,Y    ; X speed toward Mario ($10 or $F0)
$02:AFF7  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Set X speed
$02:AFF9  C6 04         DEC $04                     ; Counter--
$02:AFFB  10 B2         BPL $AFAF             ; Loop for 5 Eeries
$02:AFFD  60            RTS                          ; Return

This area handles all the generator sprites.


}

;;; $AFFE: Run the current generator (CallGenerator) ;;;
{
;; Runs the sprite generator selected by [$18B9] (0 = none) unless sprites are locked. Pointer index = number - 1.
;; Called by: $02:8B17 (Misc sprite handlers per frame)
$02:AFFE  AD B9 18      LDA.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; A = current generator number
$02:B001  F0 27         BEQ $B02A            ; 0 = no generator: return
$02:B003  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Y = sprites locked flag
$02:B005  D0 23         BNE $B02A            ; Locked: return
$02:B007  3A            DEC A                       ; Number - 1 = pointer index
$02:B008  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Jump to the generator routine

}

;;; $B00C: Pointer table: generator routines (GeneratorPtrs) ;;;
{
$02:B00C  D6 B2         .dw GenerateEerie           ; 00 - Eerie
$02:B00E  29 B3         .dw GenParaEnemy            ; 01 - Para-Goomba
$02:B010  29 B3         .dw GenParaEnemy            ; 02 - Para-Bomb
$02:B012  29 B3         .dw GenParaEnemy            ; 03 - Para-Bomb and Para-Goomba
$02:B014  6C B2         .dw GenerateDolphin         ; 04 - Dolphin, left
$02:B016  6C B2         .dw GenerateDolphin         ; 05 - Dolphin, right
$02:B018  5B B1         .dw GenerateFish            ; 06 - Jumping fish
$02:B01A  2B B0         .dw TurnOffGen2             ; 07 - Turn off generator 2 (sprite E5)
$02:B01C  BC B1         .dw GenSuperKoopa           ; 08 - Super Koopa
$02:B01E  07 B2         .dw GenerateBubble          ; 09 - Bubble with Goomba and Bob-omb
$02:B020  7C B0         .dw GenerateBullet          ; 0A - Bullet Bill
$02:B022  CD B0         .dw GenMultiBullets         ; 0B - Bullet Bill surrounded
$02:B024  CD B0         .dw GenMultiBullets         ; 0C - Bullet Bill diagonal
$02:B026  36 B0         .dw GenerateFire            ; 0D - Bowser statue fire
$02:B028  32 B0         .dw TurnOffGenerators       ; 0E - Turn off standard generators

$02:B02A  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B02B: Stop sprite respawning (TurnOffGen2) ;;;
{
;; Increments [$18BF] and clears the time-till-respawn counter so nothing respawns (generator $08, sprite E5).
$02:B02B  EE BF 18      INC.W $18BF                 ; [$18BF]++ (read elsewhere, purpose unclear)
$02:B02E  9C C0 18      STZ.W RAM_TimeTillRespawn   ; Time till respawn = 0: stop sprites from respawning
$02:B031  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B032: Turn off generator (TurnOffGenerators) ;;;
{
;; Sets [$18B9] = 0 so that no generator runs.
$02:B032  9C B9 18      STZ.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Generator number = 0: no generator
$02:B035  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B036: Generate Bowser statue fire (GenerateFire) ;;;
{
;; Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Bowser statue fireball ($B3) just right of the screen at a random row, facing left. Plays sound $17.
$02:B036  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B038  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $80
$02:B03A  D0 3F         BNE $B07B            ; /
$02:B03C  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B040  30 39         BMI $B07B            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B042  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B043  A9 17         LDA.B #$17                  ; \
$02:B045  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $17
$02:B048  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B04A  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B04D  A9 B3         LDA.B #$B3                  ; \
$02:B04F  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Bowser statue fire ($B3)
$02:B051  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B055  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B059  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; Keep 0-$7F
$02:B05B  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; + $20
$02:B05D  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y
$02:B05F  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; Round to a 16 pixel row
$02:B061  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B063  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B065  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B067  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B06A  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:B06C  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B06D  69 FF         ADC.B #$FF                  ; + $FF: one pixel left of the right edge of the screen
$02:B06F  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B071  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B073  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B075  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B078  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction = 1: face left
$02:B07B  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B07C: Spawn Bullet Bill from shooter (GenerateBullet) ;;;
{
;; Plays sound effect 9, creates a Bullet Bill sprite ($1C, status 1) just above the shooter and shows a smoke puff.
;; Parameters: X = shooter index, Y = new sprite slot.
$02:B07C  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B07E  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $80
$02:B080  D0 46         BNE $B0C8            ; /
$02:B082  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B086  30 40         BMI $B0C8            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B088  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:B08A  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $09 (Bullet Bill shot)
$02:B08D  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B08E  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B090  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B093  A9 1C         LDA.B #$1C                  ; \
$02:B095  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Bullet Bill ($1C)
$02:B097  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B09B  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B09F  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:B0A0  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; Keep 0-$7F
$02:B0A2  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; + $20
$02:B0A4  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y
$02:B0A6  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; Round to a 16 pixel row
$02:B0A8  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B0AA  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B0AC  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B0AE  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B0B1  68            PLA                          ; Restore the random number
$02:B0B2  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0: side to spawn on
$02:B0B4  A8            TAY                          ; Y = side (0 left, 1 right)
$02:B0B5  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:B0B7  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B0B8  79 B8 B1      ADC.W $B1B8,Y         ; + spawn offset ($E0 or $10)
$02:B0BB  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B0BD  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B0BF  79 BA B1      ADC.W $B1BA,Y         ; + offset high byte ($FF or $01)
$02:B0C2  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B0C5  98            TYA :|\ ; A = side
$02:B0C6  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Sprite state = side (sets its direction)
$02:B0C8  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B0C9..B0C9: Table: multi-bullet start index and count ;;;
{
;; Read with generator number $0C/$0D: $04,$08 first index; $04,$03 loop count.
$02:B0C9                .db $04,$08,$04,$03         ; Read at $B0C9/$B0CA: first table index for surround ($04) / diagonal ($08); $B0CB/$B0CC: loop count $04 / $03

}

;;; $B0CD: Generate surrounding or diagonal Bullet Bills (GenMultiBullets) ;;;
{
;; Every 320 frames (timer [$18FE] steps on even frames, triggers at $A0): plays sound $09 and spawns a ring of Bullet Bills via GEN_MULTI_BULLET.
;; Surround ([$18B9] = $0C): 5 bullets from tables index 0-4. Diagonal ($0D): 4 bullets from index 8-5.
$02:B0CD  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B0CF  4A            LSR                          ; } Return on odd frames
$02:B0D0  B0 27         BCS $B0F9            ; /
$02:B0D2  AD FE 18      LDA.W $18FE                 ; \
$02:B0D5  EE FE 18      INC.W $18FE                 ; |
$02:B0D8  C9 A0         CMP.B #$A0                  ; } Timer [$18FE]++; continue only when it was $A0
$02:B0DA  D0 1D         BNE $B0F9            ; /
$02:B0DC  9C FE 18      STZ.W $18FE                 ; Reset the timer
$02:B0DF  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:B0E1  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $09
$02:B0E4  AC B9 18      LDY.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Y = generator number
$02:B0E7  B9 BD B0      LDA.W $B0BD,Y         ; A = first table index: $04 (surround, number $0C) or $08 (diagonal, $0D)
$02:B0EA  BE BF B0      LDX.W $B0BF,Y         ; X = bullets - 1: $04 or $03
$02:B0ED  85 0D         STA $0D                     ; $0D = first table index
$02:B0EF  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:B0F0  20 15 B1      JSR.W GEN_MULTI_BULLET      ; Spawn one bullet
$02:B0F3  C6 0D         DEC $0D                     ; $0D-- (next table entry)
$02:B0F5  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:B0F6  CA            DEX                          ; X--
$02:B0F7  10 F6         BPL $B0EF             ; Loop until X < 0
$02:B0F9  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B0FA..B102: Table: multi-bullet X offsets ;;;
{
$02:B0FA                .db $00,$00,$40,$C0,$F0,$00,$00,$F0 ; X offsets from screen left: 0-4 surround, 5-8 diagonal
$02:B102                .db $F0                     ; Index 8

}

;;; $B103..B10B: Table: multi-bullet Y offsets ;;;
{
$02:B103                .db $50,$B0,$E0,$E0,$80,$00,$E0,$E0 ; Y offsets from screen top: 0-4 surround, 5-8 diagonal
$02:B10B                .db $00                     ; Index 8

}

;;; $B10C..B114: Table: multi-bullet states ;;;
{
$02:B10C                .db $00,$00,$02,$02,$01,$05,$04,$07 ; Bullet Bill state: 0-4 surround, 5-8 diagonal (4-7)
$02:B114                .db $06                     ; Index 8

}

;;; $B115: Spawn one Bullet Bill of a group (GEN_MULTI_BULLET) ;;;
{
;; Spawns a Bullet Bill at screen X/Y plus table offsets indexed by [$0D], with the state from the table.
;; Parameters: [$0D]: table index. Returns early if no free slot.
;; Called by: $02:B0F0 (Generate surrounding or diagonal Bullet Bills (GenMultiBullets))
$02:B115  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B119  30 37         BMI $B152            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B11B  A9 1C         LDA.B #$1C                  ; \
$02:B11D  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite = Bullet Bill ($1C)
$02:B120  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B122  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B125  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B126  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B12A  A6 0D         LDX $0D                     ; X = table index from $0D
$02:B12C  BD FA B0      LDA.W $B0FA,X         ; X offset
$02:B12F  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B130  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; + screen X low
$02:B132  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; Sprite X low
$02:B135  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B137  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B139  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; Sprite X high
$02:B13C  BD 03 B1      LDA.W $B103,X         ; Y offset
$02:B13F  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B140  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y low
$02:B142  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; Sprite Y low
$02:B145  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B147  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B149  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B14C  BD 0C B1      LDA.W $B10C,X         ; State from table
$02:B14F  99 C2 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y     ; Sprite state = direction/side
$02:B152  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B153..B157: Table: fish X offsets and speeds ;;;
{
$02:B153                .db $10,$18,$20,$28         ; Jumping fish X offsets from a screen edge: $10, $18, $20, $28

$02:B157                .db $18,$1A,$1C,$1E         ; Jumping fish X speeds: $18, $1A, $1C, $1E

;;; $B15B: Generate jumping fish (GenerateFish) ;;;
{
;; Every $20 ticks of [$14]: spawns a flying fish ($17) at the bottom of the screen, near the left or right edge, with an upward speed of $B8
;; and a random X speed toward the screen.
$02:B15B  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B15D  29 1F         AND.B #$1F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $20
$02:B15F  D0 56         BNE $B1B7            ; /
$02:B161  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B165  30 50         BMI $B1B7            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B167  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B168  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B16A  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B16D  A9 17         LDA.B #$17                  ; \
$02:B16F  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Flying fish ($17)
$02:B171  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B175  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:B177  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B178  69 C0         ADC.B #$C0                  ; } Sprite Y = screen Y + $C0 (bottom of the screen)
$02:B17A  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:B17C  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:B17E  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Sprite Y high = screen Y high + carry
$02:B180  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:B183  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:B187  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; / A = random number, set N flag from it
$02:B189  08            PHP                          ; \
$02:B18A  08            PHP                          ; / Push the flags twice
$02:B18B  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; \
$02:B18D  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = random & 3
$02:B18E  B9 53 B1      LDA.W $B153,Y         ; A = X offset from table
$02:B191  28            PLP                          ; Pull flags
$02:B192  10 02         BPL $B196             ; Random number positive: keep offset
$02:B194  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; Negative: mirror it (offset becomes near the other edge)
$02:B196  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B197  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; + screen X low
$02:B199  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B19B  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B19D  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B19F  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B1A2  AD 8E 14      LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2       ; \
$02:B1A5  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = second random byte & 3
$02:B1A7  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:B1A8  B9 57 B1      LDA.W $B157,Y         ; A = X speed from table
$02:B1AB  28            PLP                          ; Pull flags
$02:B1AC  10 03         BPL $B1B1             ; Positive: keep speed
$02:B1AE  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:B1B0  1A            INC A                       ; / Negate the speed (move toward the screen)
$02:B1B1  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Sprite X speed
$02:B1B3  A9 B8         LDA.B #$B8                  ; \
$02:B1B5  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Sprite Y speed = $B8 (jump upward)
$02:B1B7  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B1B8: Table: spawn X offsets, left or right (SIDE_ENTER_XGEN) ;;;
{
$02:B1B8                .db $E0,$10                 ; Spawn X offsets low: $E0 (left of screen), $10 (right of screen)

$02:B1BA                .db $FF,$01                 ; Spawn X offsets high: $FF, $01

}

;;; $B1BC: Generate Super Koopa (GenSuperKoopa) ;;;
{
;; Every $40 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Super Koopa ($71) at a random height on the left or right of the screen, Y speed $28, facing inward.
$02:B1BC  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B1BE  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $40
$02:B1C0  D0 44         BNE $B206            ; /
$02:B1C2  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B1C6  30 3E         BMI $B206            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B1C8  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B1C9  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B1CB  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B1CE  A9 71         LDA.B #$71                  ; \
$02:B1D0  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Super Koopa ($71)
$02:B1D2  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B1D6  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B1DA  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:B1DB  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; Keep 0-$3F
$02:B1DD  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; + $20
$02:B1DF  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y low
$02:B1E1  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B1E3  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B1E5  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B1E7  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B1EA  A9 28         LDA.B #$28                  ; \
$02:B1EC  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Sprite Y speed = $28 (downward)
$02:B1EE  68            PLA                          ; Restore the random number
$02:B1EF  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0
$02:B1F1  A8            TAY                          ; Y = side (0 left, 1 right)
$02:B1F2  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:B1F4  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B1F5  79 B8 B1      ADC.W SIDE_ENTER_XGEN,Y     ; + spawn offset
$02:B1F8  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B1FA  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B1FC  79 BA B1      ADC.W $B1BA,Y         ; + offset high byte
$02:B1FF  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B202  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B203  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction = side it enters from
$02:B206  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B207: Generate bubble (GenerateBubble) ;;;
{
;; Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a bubble ($9D) at a random height on one side of the screen; state = contents (probably).
$02:B207  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B209  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $80
$02:B20B  D0 4C         BNE $B259            ; /
$02:B20D  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B211  30 46         BMI $B259            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B213  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B214  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B216  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B219  A9 9D         LDA.B #$9D                  ; \
