$02:B21D  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B221  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B225  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:B226  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; Keep 0-$3F
$02:B228  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; + $20
$02:B22A  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y low
$02:B22C  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B22E  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B230  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B232  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B235  68            PLA                          ; Restore the random number
$02:B236  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0
$02:B238  A8            TAY                          ; Y = side (0 left, 1 right)
$02:B239  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:B23B  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B23C  79 B8 B1      ADC.W SIDE_ENTER_XGEN,Y     ; + spawn offset
$02:B23F  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B241  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B243  79 BA B1      ADC.W $B1BA,Y         ; + offset high byte
$02:B246  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B249  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B24A  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction = side it enters from
$02:B24D  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B251  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Keep 0-3
$02:B253  A8            TAY                          ; Y = random
$02:B254  B9 5A B2      LDA.W $B25A,Y         ; A = 0, 1, 2 or 0 from table
$02:B257  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Sprite state = contents of the bubble (probably)
$02:B259  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B25A..B265: Table: bubble contents and dolphin spawn values ;;;
{
;; Bubble contents at $B25A; other bytes are dolphin tables indexed by generator number 5 and 6.
$02:B25A                .db $00                     ; Bubble contents: $00, $01, $02, $00 (this and next two rows)

$02:B25B                .db $01,$02                 ; Dolphin/bubble tables, overlapping: bubble contents $00,$01,$02,$00; X high $01/$FF read at $B260/$B261

$02:B25D                .db $00,$10,$E0,$01,$FF,$E8 ; Dolphin tables, read at $B25E-$B262: X low offset $10 / $E0, X speed $E8 / $18

$02:B263                .db $18                     ; Dolphin Y speed table $F0, $E0, $00, $10 starts at $B264

$02:B264                .db $F0                     ; Y speeds

$02:B265                .db $E0,$00,$10,$04,$09,$FF,$04 ; Dolphin slot ranges: starts $04 / $09, loop end $FF / $04 (generator 5 / 6)

}

;;; $B26C: Generate dolphin (GenerateDolphin) ;;;
{
;; Every $20 ticks of [$14]: looks for a free sprite slot in a group of 5 (slots 0-4 for generator 5, 5-9 for generator 6) and spawns a dolphin ($41)
;; at a random height on the right (gen 5) or left (gen 6) side, moving across the screen.
$02:B26C  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B26E  29 1F         AND.B #$1F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $20
$02:B270  D0 5D         BNE $B2CF            ; /
$02:B272  AC B9 18      LDY.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Y = generator number (5 = left dolphins, 6 = right dolphins)
$02:B275  BE 63 B2      LDX.W $B263,Y         ; X = first sprite slot to test: 4 or 9
$02:B278  B9 65 B2      LDA.W $B265,Y         ; A = slot at which to stop: $FF or 4
$02:B27B  85 00         STA $00                     ; $00 = stop slot
$02:B27D  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; Is this sprite slot empty?
$02:B280  F0 06         BEQ $B288             ; Yes: spawn a dolphin there
$02:B282  CA            DEX                          ; Next slot
$02:B283  E4 00         CPX $00                     ; Reached the stop slot?
$02:B285  D0 F6         BNE $B27D             ; No: keep looking
$02:B287  60            RTS                          ; All five slots in use: return

$02:B288  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B28A  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B28D  A9 41         LDA.B #$41                  ; \
$02:B28F  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Dolphin ($41)
$02:B291  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B295  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B299  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; Keep 0-$7F
$02:B29B  69 40         ADC.B #$40                  ; + $40
$02:B29D  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y low
$02:B29F  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B2A1  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B2A3  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B2A5  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B2A8  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B2AC  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Keep 0-3
$02:B2AE  A8            TAY                          ; Y = random
$02:B2AF  B9 64 B2      LDA.W $B264,Y         ; Y speed from table: $F0, $E0, $00 or $10
$02:B2B2  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Sprite Y speed
$02:B2B4  AC B9 18      LDY.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Y = generator number
$02:B2B7  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; A = screen X low
$02:B2B9  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B2BA  79 59 B2      ADC.W $B259,Y        ; + X offset ($10 for gen 5, $E0 for gen 6)
$02:B2BD  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B2BF  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B2C1  79 5B B2      ADC.W $B25B,Y         ; + offset high byte ($01 or $FF)
$02:B2C4  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B2C7  B9 5D B2      LDA.W $B25D,Y         ; \
$02:B2CA  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Sprite X speed = $E8 (gen 5) or $18 (gen 6)
$02:B2CC  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; [$151C]++ (sprite specific flag, probably marks the dolphin as generated)
$02:B2CF  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B2D0..B2D4: Table: Eerie spawn offsets and speeds ;;;
{
$02:B2D0                .db $F0,$FF                 ; Eerie X offsets low: $F0 (left of screen), $FF (right)

$02:B2D2                .db $FF,$00                 ; Eerie X offsets high: $FF, $00

$02:B2D4                .db $10,$F0                 ; Eerie X speeds: $10 (right), $F0 (left)

}

;;; $B2D6: Generate Eerie (GenerateEerie) ;;;
{
;; Every $40 ticks of [$14]: spawns an Eerie ($38) at a random height just off the left or right of the screen, moving inward.
$02:B2D6  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B2D8  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $40
$02:B2DA  D0 42         BNE $B31E            ; /
$02:B2DC  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B2E0  30 3C         BMI $B31E            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B2E2  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B2E3  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B2E5  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B2E8  A9 38         LDA.B #$38                  ; \
$02:B2EA  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite = Eerie ($38)
$02:B2EC  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B2F0  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B2F4  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; Keep 0-$7F
$02:B2F6  69 40         ADC.B #$40                  ; + $40
$02:B2F8  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; + screen Y low
$02:B2FA  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low
$02:B2FC  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; A = screen Y high
$02:B2FE  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add carry
$02:B300  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high
$02:B303  AD 8E 14      LDA.W RAM_RandomByte2       ; A = random byte 2
$02:B306  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; Keep bit 0
$02:B308  A8            TAY                          ; Y = side
$02:B309  B9 D0 B2      LDA.W $B2D0,Y         ; A = X offset low
$02:B30C  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B30D  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; + screen X low
$02:B30F  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B311  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B313  79 D2 B2      ADC.W $B2D2,Y         ; + offset high byte
$02:B316  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B319  B9 D4 B2      LDA.W $B2D4,Y         ; \
$02:B31C  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Sprite X speed = $10 or $F0 (toward the screen)
$02:B31E  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B31F..B325: Table: para enemy sprites and speeds ;;;
{
$02:B31F                .db $3F,$40,$3F,$3F,$40,$40 ; Sprites for para generators: $3F Para-Goomba, $40 Para-Bomb (read from $B31F)

$02:B325                .db $FA,$FB,$FC,$FD         ; Para-enemy X speeds: $FA, $FB, $FC, $FD

}

;;; $B329: Generate para-enemies; run shooters (GenParaEnemy) ;;;
{
;; Every $80 ticks of [$14]: spawns a Para-Goomba ($3F) or Para-Bomb ($40) above the screen at a random X, with a random slow leftward speed.
;; Generator 2 = Goomba, 3 = bomb, 4 = either.
;; $02B387 (separate routine): runs the 8 shooter slots ($1783..) each frame; the shooter timer counts down every other frame.
$02:B329  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B32B  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; } Return unless [$14] is a multiple of $80
$02:B32D  D0 57         BNE $B386            ; /
$02:B32F  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B333  30 51         BMI $B386            ; / Find a free low-priority slot, return if none
$02:B335  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:B336  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B338  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B33B  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:B33F  4A            LSR                          ; Random bit 0 into carry
$02:B340  AC B9 18      LDY.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Y = generator number (2 goomba, 3 bomb, 4 both)
$02:B343  90 03         BCC $B348             ; Carry clear: use the entry as is
$02:B345  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:B346  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 3
$02:B347  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:B348  B9 1D B3      LDA.W ADDR_02B31D,Y         ; A = sprite number from table ($3F or $40)
$02:B34B  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Set sprite number
$02:B34D  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the sprite tables
$02:B351  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:B353  38            SEC                          ; } Sprite Y = screen Y - $20 (above the screen)
$02:B354  E9 20         SBC.B #$20                  ; /
$02:B356  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Set Y low
$02:B358  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:B35A  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; / Sprite Y high = screen Y high - borrow
$02:B35C  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Set Y high
$02:B35F  AD 8D 14      LDA.W RAM_RandomByte1       ; A = random byte 1
$02:B362  29 FF         AND.B #$FF                  ; No-op mask
$02:B364  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:B365  69 30         ADC.B #$30                :|keeping to see if it ; + $30
$02:B367  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B368  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; + screen X low
$02:B36A  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low
$02:B36C  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B36D  29 0E         AND.B #$0E                  ; Keep a pseudo-random 0-$0E value from the X position
$02:B36F  9D 70 15      STA.W $1570,X               ; Store in [$1570] (initial animation/wing state, probably)
$02:B372  4A            LSR                          ; A / 2
$02:B373  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Keep 0-3
$02:B375  A8            TAY                          ; Y = random 0-3
$02:B376  B9 25 B3      LDA.W $B325,Y         ; X speed from table
$02:B379  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Set X speed
$02:B37B  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:B37D  28            PLP                          ; Restore second carry
$02:B37E  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add it
$02:B380  28            PLP                          ; Restore first carry
$02:B381  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Add it
$02:B383  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high
$02:B386  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B387  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked flag
$02:B389  D0 1F         BNE $B3AA            ; Locked: return
$02:B38B  A2 07         LDX.B #$07                  ; X = 7: eight shooter slots
$02:B38D  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; [$15E9] = current shooter index
$02:B390  BD 83 17      LDA.W $1783,X               ; A = shooter type + 1 ($1783 table)
$02:B393  F0 12         BEQ $B3A7             ; Empty slot: next
$02:B395  BC AB 17      LDY.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; Y = shooter timer
$02:B398  F0 0A         BEQ $B3A4             ; Timer is zero: run the shooter
$02:B39A  48            PHA                          ; Save shooter type
$02:B39B  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; A = frame counter
$02:B39D  4A            LSR                          ; Bit 0 to carry
$02:B39E  90 03         BCC $B3A3             ; Odd frame: skip
$02:B3A0  DE AB 17      DEC.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; Timer-- every other frame
$02:B3A3  68            PLA                          ; Restore shooter type
$02:B3A4  20 AB B3      JSR.W $B3AB           ; Run the shooter routine
$02:B3A7  CA            DEX                          ; Next slot
$02:B3A8  10 E3         BPL $B38D             ; Loop for 8 slots
$02:B3AA  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B3AB  3A            DEC A                       ; Type - 1 = pointer index
$02:B3AC  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Jump to the shooter routine

}

;;; $B3B0: Pointer table: shooter routines (ShooterPtrs) ;;;
{
$02:B3B0  66 B4         .dw ShootBullet             ; 00 - Bullet Bill shooter
$02:B3B2  B6 B3         .dw LaunchTorpedo           ; 01 - Torpedo Ted launcher
$02:B3B4  AA B3         .dw $B3AA            ; 02 - Unused (just returns)

}

;;; $B3B6: Torpedo Ted launcher shooter (LaunchTorpedo) ;;;
{
;; Shooter routine: every $50 frames, while on the screen's X/Y page and not near the left edge, spawns a Torpedo Ted
;; sprite ($44) at the shooter position facing Mario, plus an extended sprite arm.
;; Parameters: X = shooter index.
$02:B3B6  BD AB 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; Shooter timer ([$17AB+X]) still running?
$02:B3B9  D0 71         BNE $B42C            ; Yes: return
$02:B3BB  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:B3BD  9D AB 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; / Reset the shooter timer to $50 frames
$02:B3C0  BD 8B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; \

$02:B40A  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; /

$02:B413  20 8D 84      JSR.W SubHorzPosBnk2        ; \

$02:B417  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /

$02:B41C  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \

;;; $B466: Bullet Bill shooter (ShootBullet) ;;;
{
;; Shooter routine: every $60 frames, if the shooter is on the screen and Mario is not right next to it,
;; finds a free sprite slot and falls into GenerateBullet.
;; Parameters: X = shooter index.
$02:B466  BD AB 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; Shooter timer ([$17AB+X]) still running?
$02:B469  D0 72         BNE $B4DD            ; Yes: return
$02:B46B  A9 60         LDA.B #$60                  ; \
$02:B46D  9D AB 17      STA.W RAM_ShooterTimer,X    ; / Reset the shooter timer to $60 frames
$02:B470  BD 8B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; \
$02:B473  C5 1C         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:B475  BD 93 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYHi,X      ; |
$02:B478  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; } Return if the shooter is off the screen vertically
$02:B47A  D0 61         BNE $B4DD            ; /
$02:B47C  BD 9B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; \
$02:B47F  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:B481  BD A3 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXHi,X      ; |
$02:B484  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; } Return if the shooter is off the screen horizontally
$02:B486  D0 55         BNE $B4DD            ; /
$02:B488  BD 9B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; \

$02:B48B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:B48C  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:B48E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B48F  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:B491  C9 10         CMP.B #$10                  ; } Return if too close to the left screen edge
$02:B493  90 48         BCC $B4DD            ; /
$02:B495  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:B497  FD 9B 17      SBC.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; |
$02:B49A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B49B  69 11         ADC.B #$11                  ; |
$02:B49D  C9 22         CMP.B #$22                  ; } Return if Mario is within $11 pixels of the shooter
$02:B49F  90 3C         BCC $B4DD            ; /
$02:B4A1  22 DE A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSlotLowPri    ; \
$02:B4A5  30 36         BMI $B4DD            ; / Find a free sprite slot (low priority); return if none
}

;;; $B4A7: Spawn Bullet Bill from shooter (GenerateBullet) ;;;
{
;; Plays sound effect 9, creates a Bullet Bill sprite ($1C, status 1) just above the shooter and shows a smoke puff.
;; Parameters: X = shooter index, Y = new sprite slot.
$02:B4A7  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:B4A9  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect 9 (Bullet Bill shot)
$02:B4AC  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:B4AE  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 1 (initialize)
$02:B4B1  A9 1C         LDA.B #$1C                  ; \
$02:B4B3  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $1C (Bullet Bill)
$02:B4B6  BD 9B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; \
$02:B4B9  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; |
$02:B4BC  BD A3 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXHi,X      ; } New sprite X = shooter X
$02:B4BF  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; /
$02:B4C2  BD 8B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; \
$02:B4C5  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:B4C6  E9 01         SBC.B #$01                  ; |
$02:B4C8  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; |
$02:B4CB  BD 93 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYHi,X      ; |
$02:B4CE  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } New sprite Y = shooter Y - 1
$02:B4D0  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; /
$02:B4D3  DA            PHX                          ; Save shooter index
$02:B4D4  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite index
$02:B4D5  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$02:B4D9  FA            PLX                          ; X = shooter index
$02:B4DA  20 DE B4      JSR.W ShowShooterSmoke      ; Spawn the shooter smoke puff
$02:B4DD  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B4DE: Show shooter smoke puff (ShowShooterSmoke) ;;;
{
;; Starts a search of the four smoke slots for a free one (continues in FindFreeSmokeSlot).
;; Called by: $02:B4DA (Spawn Bullet Bill from shooter (GenerateBullet))
$02:B4DE  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: search the four smoke slots
}

;;; $B4E0: Find free smoke slot (FindFreeSmokeSlot) ;;;
{
;; Searches $17C0+Y for an empty smoke slot and branches to SetShooterSmoke; returns if all four are used.
$02:B4E0  B9 C0 17      LDA.W $17C0,Y               ; Smoke slot Y free?
$02:B4E3  F0 06         BEQ SetShooterSmoke         ; Yes: use it
$02:B4E5  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:B4E6  10 F8         BPL FindFreeSmokeSlot       ; Loop for Y = 3..0
$02:B4E8  60            RTS                          ; Return (no free slot)


}

;;; $B4E9: Table: shooter smoke X offset (ShooterSmokeDispX) ;;;
{
$02:B4E9                .db $F4,$0C                 ; Smoke X offset by side of Mario: $F4 left of the shooter, $0C right

}

;;; $B4EB: Set up shooter smoke and speed helpers (SetShooterSmoke) ;;;
{
;; Fills smoke slot Y at the shooter: type 1 (puff), Y = shooter Y, timer $1B, X = shooter X offset to Mario's side.
;; Parameters: X = shooter index, Y = smoke slot. Restores X from [$15E9].
;; Also holds unreferenced-looking helpers $02B51A-$02B5EB that apply fixed-point speed to position for bounce sprites, extended
;; sprites, another 4-slot effect table and minor extended sprites (speed * 16 into a subpixel accumulator, then the sign-extended high part).
$02:B4EB  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:B4ED  99 C0 17      STA.W $17C0,Y               ; / Smoke type [$17C0+Y] = 1 (puff of smoke)
$02:B4F0  BD 8B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterYLo,X      ; \
$02:B4F3  99 C4 17      STA.W $17C4,Y               ; / Smoke Y = shooter Y
$02:B4F6  A9 1B         LDA.B #$1B                  ; \
$02:B4F8  99 CC 17      STA.W $17CC,Y               ; / Smoke timer [$17CC+Y] = $1B
$02:B4FB  BD 9B 17      LDA.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; \
$02:B4FE  48            PHA                          ; / Save shooter X low
$02:B4FF  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:B501  DD 9B 17      CMP.W RAM_ShooterXLo,X      ; |
$02:B504  A5 95         LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; |
$02:B506  FD A3 17      SBC.W RAM_ShooterXHi,X      ; |
$02:B509  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; |
$02:B50B  90 01         BCC $B50E             ; } X = 0 if Mario is left of the shooter, else 1
$02:B50D  E8            INX                          ; /
$02:B50E  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:B50F  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B510  7D E9 B4      ADC.W ShooterSmokeDispX,X   ; } Smoke X = shooter X + ShooterSmokeDispX[X]
$02:B513  99 C8 17      STA.W $17C8,Y               ; /
$02:B516  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = current sprite index ([$15E9])
$02:B519  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B51A  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:B51B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B51C  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } X += 4: the X tables follow the Y tables
$02:B51E  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:B51F  20 26 B5      JSR.W $B526           ; Apply speed to position (same routine as Y)
$02:B522  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; Restore X from [$1698]
$02:B525  60            RTS                          ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update bounce block sprite position by speed. This is similar to Player's
;version at $00DC4F, and even more similar to $01ABD8 (SubSprYPosNoGrvty).
;
;Due to the table format differences (such as low and high
;bytes of positions) the code has to be different in order to work.
;If X index is:
;$00-$03 (00-03): Handle Y speed
;$04-$07 (04-07): Handle X speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$02:B526  BD B1 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; \
$02:B529  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B52A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B52B  0A            ASL                          ; } Y speed * 16: fraction part for the subpixel accumulator
$02:B52C  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:B52D  18            CLC 
$02:B52E  7D B9 16      ADC.W $16B9,X               ; \
$02:B531  9D B9 16      STA.W $16B9,X               ; / Add to subpixel accumulator [$16B9+X]
$02:B534  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B535  BD B1 16      LDA.W RAM_BouncBlkSpeedY,X  ; \
$02:B538  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B539  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B53A  4A            LSR                          ; } A = speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$02:B53B  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:B53C  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Negative speed? (>= 8 after shifting)
$02:B53E  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = $00: high byte for a positive speed
$02:B540  90 03         BCC $B545             ; Positive: skip sign extension
$02:B542  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; Sign-extend the low byte
$02:B544  88            DEY                          ; Y = $FF: high byte for a negative speed
$02:B545  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry from the subpixel add
$02:B546  7D A1 16      ADC.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; \
$02:B549  9D A1 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYLo,X    ; / Y position low += whole pixels + carry
$02:B54C  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B54D  7D A9 16      ADC.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; } Y position high += sign extension + carry
$02:B550  9D A9 16      STA.W RAM_BounceSprYHi,X    ; /
$02:B553  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B554  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:B555  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B556  69 0A         ADC.B #$0A                  ; } X += 10: the X tables follow the Y tables
$02:B558  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:B559  20 60 B5      JSR.W $B560           ; Apply speed to position
$02:B55C  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = current sprite index ([$15E9])
$02:B55F  60            RTS                          ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update extended sprite position by speed. This is similar to Player's
;version at $00DC4F, and even more similar to $01ABD8 (SubSprYPosNoGrvty).
;
;Due to the table format differences (such as low and high
;bytes of positions) the code has to be different in order to work.
;If X index is:
;$00-$09 (00-09): Handle Y speed
;$0A-$13 (10-19): Handle X speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$02:B560  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; \
$02:B563  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B564  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B565  0A            ASL                          ; } Y speed * 16: fraction part
$02:B566  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:B567  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B568  7D 51 17      ADC.W $1751,X               ; } Add to subpixel accumulator [$1751+X]
$02:B56B  9D 51 17      STA.W $1751,X               ; /
$02:B56E  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B56F  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = $00: high byte for a positive speed
$02:B571  BD 3D 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,X     ; \
$02:B574  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B575  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B576  4A            LSR                          ; } A = Y speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$02:B577  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:B578  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Negative speed?
$02:B57A  90 03         BCC $B57F             ; Positive: skip sign extension
$02:B57C  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; Sign-extend the low byte
$02:B57E  88            DEY                          ; Y = $FF: high byte for a negative speed
$02:B57F  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:B580  7D 15 17      ADC.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; \
$02:B583  9D 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,X     ; / Extended sprite Y low += whole pixels + carry
$02:B586  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B587  7D 29 17      ADC.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; } Extended sprite Y high += sign extension + carry
$02:B58A  9D 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,X     ; /
$02:B58D  60            RTS                          ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update Spinning coin sprite (from block) Y position by speed. This is similar to Player's
;version at $00DC4F.
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$02:B58E  BD D8 17      LDA.W $17D8,X               ; \
$02:B591  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B592  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B593  0A            ASL                          ; } Speed [$17D8+X] * 16: fraction part
$02:B594  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:B595  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B596  7D DC 17      ADC.W $17DC,X               ; } Add to subpixel accumulator [$17DC+X]
$02:B599  9D DC 17      STA.W $17DC,X               ; /
$02:B59C  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B59D  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = $00: high byte for a positive speed
$02:B59F  BD D8 17      LDA.W $17D8,X               ; \
$02:B5A2  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B5A3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B5A4  4A            LSR                          ; } A = speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$02:B5A5  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:B5A6  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Negative speed?
$02:B5A8  90 03         BCC $B5AD             ; Positive: skip sign extension
$02:B5AA  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; Sign-extend the low byte
$02:B5AC  88            DEY                          ; Y = $FF: high byte for a negative speed
$02:B5AD  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:B5AE  7D D4 17      ADC.W $17D4,X               ; \
$02:B5B1  9D D4 17      STA.W $17D4,X               ; / Position low [$17D4+X] += whole pixels + carry
$02:B5B4  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B5B5  7D E8 17      ADC.W $17E8,X               ; } Position high [$17E8+X] += sign extension + carry
$02:B5B8  9D E8 17      STA.W $17E8,X               ; /
$02:B5BB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B5BC  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:B5BD  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B5BE  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; } X += 12: minor extended sprite X tables follow the Y tables
$02:B5C0  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:B5C1  20 C8 B5      JSR.W $B5C8           ; Apply speed to position
$02:B5C4  AE 98 16      LDX.W $1698                 ; Restore X from [$1698]
$02:B5C7  60            RTS                          ; Return
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
;Update minor extended sprite position by speed. This is similar to
;Player's version at $00DC4F, and even more similar to $01ABD8 (SubSprYPosNoGrvty).
;
;Due to the table format differences (such as low and high
;bytes of positions) the code has to be different in order to work.
;If X index is:
;$00-$0B (00-11): Handle Y speed
;$0C-$17 (12-23): Handle X speed
;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;;
$02:B5C8  BD 20 18      LDA.W $1820,X               ; \
$02:B5CB  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B5CC  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B5CD  0A            ASL                          ; } Minor extended sprite Y speed [$1820+X] * 16: fraction
$02:B5CE  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:B5CF  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B5D0  7D 38 18      ADC.W $1838,X               ; } Add to subpixel accumulator [$1838+X]
$02:B5D3  9D 38 18      STA.W $1838,X               ; /
$02:B5D6  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:B5D7  BD 20 18      LDA.W $1820,X               ; \
$02:B5DA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B5DB  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B5DC  4A            LSR                          ; } A = speed / 16 (whole pixels)
$02:B5DD  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:B5DE  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; Negative speed?
$02:B5E0  90 02         BCC $B5E4             ; Positive: skip sign extension
$02:B5E2  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; Sign-extend
$02:B5E4  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:B5E5  7D FC 17      ADC.W $17FC,X               ; \
$02:B5E8  9D FC 17      STA.W $17FC,X               ; / Y position [$17FC+X] += whole pixels + carry
$02:B5EB  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:B5F4                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B5FC                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B604                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B60C                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B614                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B61C                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B624                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:B62C                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF

}

;;; $B630: Table: Pokey clipping index by segments (PokeyClipIndex) ;;;
{
$02:B630                .db $1B,$1B,$1A,$19,$18,$17

}

;;; $B636: Pokey main (long call wrapper) (PokeyMain) ;;;
{
;; Runs PokeyMainRt, then counts the segments left in [$C2] and sets the clipping index [$1662].
;; Called by: $01:87ED (Pokey (Pokey))
$02:B636  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:B637  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (old bank saved)
$02:B638  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:B639  20 72 B6      JSR.W PokeyMainRt           ; Pokey main routine: move, interact and draw
$02:B63C  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = segment bitmask (bit set = segment present)
$02:B63E  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:B63F  A2 04         LDX.B #$04                  ; X = 4: five segment bits
$02:B641  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: segment count
}

;;; $B643: Pokey: count segment bits (PokeyLoopStart) ;;;
{
;; Loop body: shifts the next segment bit out of A and counts it in Y.
$02:B643  4A            LSR                          ; Shift the next segment bit into carry
$02:B644  90 01         BCC BitNotSet               ; Bit clear: skip
$02:B646  C8            INY                          ; Segment present: count it
}

;;; $B647: Pokey: set clipping index (BitNotSet) ;;;
{
;; Finishes the segment count and stores PokeyClipIndex[count] to [$1662+X].
$02:B647  CA            DEX                          ; Next bit
$02:B648  10 F9         BPL PokeyLoopStart          ; Loop for X = 4..0
$02:B64A  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:B64B  B9 30 B6      LDA.W PokeyClipIndex,Y      ; \
$02:B64E  9D 62 16      STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; / Clipping index [$1662+X] = PokeyClipIndex[segment count]
$02:B651  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:B652  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $B653..B65B: Tables: Pokey segment masks ;;;
{
$02:B653                .db $01,$02,$04,$08         ; Segment bit masks: bits 0-3

$02:B657                .db $00,$01,$03,$07         ; Mask for the segments below a removed one (kept as is)

$02:B65B                .db $FF,$FE,$FC,$F8         ; Mask for the segments above a removed one (shifted down)

}

;;; $B65F: Table: Pokey wiggle X offsets (PokeyTileDispX) ;;;
{
$02:B65F                .db $00,$01,$00,$FF         ; X wobble per frame of the wiggle animation: 0, +1, 0, -1

}

;;; $B663: Tables: Pokey speed and squish offsets (PokeySpeed) ;;;
{
$02:B663                .db $02,$FE                 ; Walking X speed by direction: $02 right, $FE left

$02:B665                .db $00,$05,$09,$0C,$0E,$0F,$10,$10 ; Squish Y offset by timer [$1540] ($00 up to $10)
$02:B66D                .db $10,$10,$10,$10,$10

;;; $B672: Pokey main routine entry (PokeyMainRt) ;;;
{
;; Pokey sprite ($70). [$C2] = bitmask of segments (5 bits). [$1534] != 0 marks a detached flying segment.
;; Detached segments are drawn as one tile and fall; normal Pokeys run PokeyAlive.
;; Called by: $02:B639 (Pokey main (long call wrapper) (PokeyMain))
$02:B672  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; [$1534] = 0 (normal Pokey)?
$02:B675  D0 0A         BNE $B681             ; Non-zero (detached segment): go to $02B681
$02:B677  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:B67A  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; / Sprite status 8 (normal)?
$02:B67C  F0 29         BEQ $B6A7             ; Yes: run the alive code at $02B6A7
$02:B67E  4C 26 B7      JMP.W $B726           ; Otherwise just draw ($02B726)

$02:B681  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Detached segment: draw with the generic 16x16 routine
$02:B685  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = sprite OAM index
$02:B688  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:B68A  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; / Any segments left in the state?
$02:B68C  A9 8A         LDA.B #$8A                  ; Tile $8A (head) if none
$02:B68E  90 02         BCC $B692             ; State = 0: keep tile $8A
$02:B690  A9 E8         LDA.B #$E8                  ; Otherwise tile $E8 (body)
$02:B692  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store the tile
$02:B695  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:B698  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; / Sprite status 8 (normal)?
$02:B69A  D0 0A         BNE $B6A6            ; No: return
$02:B69C  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to position (no gravity routine)
$02:B69F  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:B6A1  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed += 2 (fall)
$02:B6A3  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:B6A6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B6A7  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:B6A9  D0 04         BNE PokeyAlive              ; / No segments remain: erase the sprite
$02:B6AB  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Sprite status = 0 (erase)
$02:B6AE  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B6AF: Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive) ;;;
{
;; Erases the Pokey when no segments are left. Otherwise walks (direction re-picked every $80 frames), falls, turns at
;; walls, checks hits from kicked sprites, closes gaps in the segment bitmask and draws five 16x16 tiles with a wiggle.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Contains the segment collision check at $02B7AC.
$02:B6AF  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; \
$02:B6B1  B0 F8         BCS $B6AB             ; / Segment bits >= $20 are invalid: erase the sprite
$02:B6B3  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:B6B5  D0 6F         BNE $B726             ; Yes: skip movement, just draw
$02:B6B7  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:B6BA  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Interact with Mario
$02:B6BE  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:B6C1  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; } Walk timer [$1570]++, mod $80
$02:B6C4  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; /
$02:B6C6  D0 07         BNE $B6CF             ; Not zero: keep direction
$02:B6C8  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Every $80 frames: pick direction toward Mario (probably)
$02:B6CB  98            TYA                          ; A = new direction
$02:B6CC  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Store it
$02:B6CF  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = sprite direction
$02:B6D2  B9 63 B6      LDA.W PokeySpeed,Y          ; \
$02:B6D5  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = PokeySpeed[direction]
$02:B6D7  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Apply X speed to position
$02:B6DA  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to position
$02:B6DD  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:B6DF  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; } Y speed < $40? (terminal fall speed)
$02:B6E1  10 05         BPL $B6E8             ; /
$02:B6E3  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B6E4  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; } Gravity: Y speed += 2
$02:B6E6  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:B6E8  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Object interaction (floor and walls)
$02:B6EC  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:B6EF  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground? (bit 2 of the object status)
$02:B6F1  F0 02         BEQ $B6F5             ; /
$02:B6F3  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Yes: Y speed = 0
$02:B6F5  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:B6F8  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Touching a wall? (bits 0-1)
$02:B6FA  F0 08         BEQ $B704             ; /
$02:B6FC  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:B6FF  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Wall: flip direction (unused label in the original)
$02:B701  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:B704  20 AC B7      JSR.W $B7AC           ; Check collision with kicked sprites
$02:B707  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: segment gap compaction loop
$02:B709  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = segment bitmask
$02:B70B  39 53 B6      AND.W $B653,Y         ; \
$02:B70E  D0 11         BNE $B721             ; / Segment Y present? Skip if so
$02:B710  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = segment bitmask
$02:B712  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:B713  39 57 B6      AND.W $B657,Y         ; \
$02:B716  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = segments below the gap, unchanged
$02:B718  68            PLA                          ; Restore bitmask
$02:B719  4A            LSR                          ; Shift the segments above down by one
$02:B71A  39 5B B6      AND.W $B65B,Y         ; Keep only the segments above the gap
$02:B71D  05 00         ORA $00                     ; Merge with the unchanged lower segments
$02:B71F  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Store the compacted bitmask
$02:B721  C8            INY                          ; Next segment
$02:B722  C0 04         CPY.B #$04                  ; All four checked?
$02:B724  D0 E3         BNE $B709             ; No: loop
$02:B726  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get the sprite's drawing info
$02:B729  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:B72B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B72C  69 40         ADC.B #$40                  ; } [$01] = Y + $40: Y of the bottom segment
$02:B72E  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:B730  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:B732  85 02         STA $02                     ; } [$02] = [$07] = segment bitmask
$02:B734  85 07         STA $07                     ; /
$02:B736  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:B739  85 04         STA $04                     ; / [$04] = [$151C] (bitmask before the last hit)
$02:B73B  BC 40 15      LDY.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:B73E  B9 65 B6      LDA.W $B665,Y         ; } [$03] = squish offset from [$1540]
$02:B741  85 03         STA $03                     ; /
$02:B743  64 05         STZ $05                     ; [$05] = 0: current squish offset
$02:B745  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = sprite OAM index
$02:B748  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:B749  A2 04         LDX.B #$04                  ; X = 4: segment counter
$02:B74B  86 06         STX $06                     ; Segment loop: [$06] = segment number
$02:B74D  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B74F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B750  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B751  4A            LSR                          ; } A = frame counter / 8 + segment number
$02:B752  18            CLC                          ; /
$02:B753  65 06         ADC $06
$02:B755  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Wiggle phase 0-3
$02:B757  AA            TAX                          ; X = wiggle phase
$02:B758  A5 07         LDA $07                     ; \
$02:B75A  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; } Only one segment left?
$02:B75C  D0 02         BNE $B760             ; /
$02:B75E  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; Yes: no wiggle
$02:B760  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = sprite X on screen
$02:B762  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B763  7D 5F B6      ADC.W PokeyTileDispX,X      ; } Tile X = [$00] + PokeyTileDispX[phase]
$02:B766  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:B769  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; X = segment number
$02:B76B  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = this segment's Y
$02:B76D  46 02         LSR $02                     ; Segment present? (bit into carry)
$02:B76F  90 10         BCC $B781             ; No: skip drawing its Y
$02:B771  46 04         LSR $04                     ; Shift the previous-state bit
$02:B773  B0 06         BCS $B77B             ; Set: segment did not move, no squish
$02:B775  48            PHA                          ; Save Y
$02:B776  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:B778  85 05         STA $05                     ; / Segment moved: [$05] = squish offset [$03]
$02:B77A  68            PLA                          ; Restore Y
$02:B77B  38            SEC                          ; Subtract the squish offset from Y
$02:B77C  E5 05         SBC $05
$02:B77E  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store tile Y
$02:B781  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:B783  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:B784  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; } [$01] -= $10: Y of the next segment up
$02:B786  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:B788  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:B78A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:B78B  A9 E8         LDA.B #$E8                  ; |
$02:B78D  B0 02         BCS $B791             ; } Tile = $E8 (body) if another segment is above, else $8A (head)
$02:B78F  A9 8A         LDA.B #$8A                  ; /
$02:B791  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store the tile
$02:B794  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:B796  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Palette/properties = 5 | [$64]
$02:B798  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:B79B  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:B79C  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:B79D  C8            INY                          ; } Next OAM slot (Y += 4)
$02:B79E  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:B79F  CA            DEX                          ; Next segment
$02:B7A0  10 A9         BPL $B74B             ; Loop for 5 segments
$02:B7A2  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:B7A3  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; A = 4: five tiles
$02:B7A5  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:B7A7  22 B3 B7 01   JSL.L FinishOAMWrite        ; Finish the OAM write
$02:B7AB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B7AC  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Y = 9: sprite slots to test
$02:B7AE  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:B7AF  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:B7B1  4A            LSR                          ; } Test only every other slot per frame (parity vs frame counter)
$02:B7B2  B0 1E         BCS $B7D2             ; /
$02:B7B4  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:B7B7  C9 0A         CMP.B #$0A                  ; } Slot Y status = $0A (kicked)?
$02:B7B9  D0 17         BNE $B7D2             ; /
$02:B7BB  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:B7BC  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; |
$02:B7BE  48            PHA                          ; } Set data bank to $03
$02:B7BF  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:B7C0  DA            PHX                          ; Save Pokey index
$02:B7C1  BB            TYX                          ; X = other sprite slot
$02:B7C2  22 E5 B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB    ; Get its clipping box (B)
$02:B7C6  FA            PLX                          ; X = Pokey index
$02:B7C7  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Get the Pokey's clipping box (A)
$02:B7CB  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Check for contact
$02:B7CF  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:B7D0  B0 04         BCS $B7D6             ; Contact: go to $02B7D6
$02:B7D2  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:B7D3  10 D9         BPL $B7AE             ; Loop for Y = 9..0
$02:B7D5  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B7D6  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; \
$02:B7D9  D0 FA         BNE $B7D5            ; / Return if the hit cooldown [$1558] is running
$02:B7DB  B9 D8 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; \
$02:B7DE  38            SEC                          ; } A = kicked sprite Y - Pokey Y: which segment was hit
$02:B7DF  F5 D8         SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:B7E1  5A            PHY                          ; Save the other sprite's slot
$02:B7E2  8C 95 16      STY.W $1695                 ; [$1695] = hitting sprite slot
$02:B7E5  20 ED B7      JSR.W RemovePokeySgmntRt    ; Remove the segment that was hit
$02:B7E8  7A            PLY                          ; Restore the slot
$02:B7E9  20 2E B8      JSR.W $B82E           ; Spawn the flying segment
$02:B7EC  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B7ED: Remove Pokey segment (RemovePokeySgmntRt) ;;;
{
;; Clears the segment hit and starts the squish animation.
;; Parameters: A = Y offset of the hitting sprite relative to the Pokey (selects the segment).
;; Called by: $02:B7E5 (Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)), $02:B81F (Remove Pokey segment (long wrapper) (RemovePokeySegment))
$02:B7ED  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: segment index from the Y offset in A
$02:B7EF  C9 09         CMP.B #$09                  ; \
$02:B7F1  30 10         BMI $B803             ; / Offset < $09: segment 0
$02:B7F3  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:B7F4  C9 19         CMP.B #$19                  ; } Offset < $19: segment 1
$02:B7F6  30 0B         BMI $B803             ; /
$02:B7F8  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:B7F9  C9 29         CMP.B #$29                  ; } Offset < $29: segment 2
$02:B7FB  30 06         BMI $B803             ; /
$02:B7FD  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:B7FE  C9 39         CMP.B #$39                  ; } Offset < $39: segment 3, else segment 4
$02:B800  30 01         BMI $B803             ; /
$02:B802  C8            INY                          ; Segment 4 (top)
$02:B803  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:B805  39 24 B8      AND.W PokeyUnsetBit,Y       ; } Clear the segment's bit in the bitmask
$02:B808  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; /
$02:B80A  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Remember the new bitmask in [$151C]
$02:B80D  B9 29 B8      LDA.W $B829,Y         ; \
$02:B810  85 0D         STA $0D                     ; / [$0D] = mask of segments to throw off
$02:B812  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:B814  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Squish timer [$1540] = $0C
$02:B817  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:B818  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; / Hit cooldown [$1558] = $18
$02:B81B  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B81C: Remove Pokey segment (long wrapper) (RemovePokeySegment) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank and calls RemovePokeySgmntRt. Called from bank 1.
;; Called by: $01:F5BC (Split Pokey when eaten (SpltPokeyInto2Sprs))
$02:B81C  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:B81D  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (old bank saved)
$02:B81E  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:B81F  20 ED B7      JSR.W RemovePokeySgmntRt    ; Remove a segment
$02:B822  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:B823  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $B824: Spawn flying Pokey segment, and tables (PokeyUnsetBit) ;;;
{
;; Tables at $02B824/$02B829 (segment clear masks), then $B82E at $02B82E spawns a killed-status Pokey sprite
;; carrying the thrown-off segments, with half the hitter's X speed and Y speed $E0.
$02:B824                .db $EF,$F7,$FB,$FD,$FE     ; Bit masks that clear one segment bit by index

$02:B829                .db $E0,$F0,$F8,$FC,$FE     ; Masks of the segments above and including the hit one

$02:B82E  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; \
$02:B832  30 4D         BMI $B881            ; / Find a free sprite slot; return if none
$02:B834  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:B836  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$02:B839  A9 70         LDA.B #$70                  ; \
$02:B83B  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $70 (Pokey)
$02:B83E  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:B840  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; |
$02:B843  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } New sprite X = Pokey X
$02:B846  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; /
$02:B849  DA            PHX                          ; Save Pokey index
$02:B84A  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite index
$02:B84B  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the new sprite's tables
$02:B84F  AE 95 16      LDX.W $1695                 ; X = the hitting sprite
$02:B852  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:B854  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; |
$02:B857  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } New sprite Y = hitting sprite Y
$02:B85A  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; /
$02:B85D  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:B85F  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:B861  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:B862  66 00         ROR $00                     ; } [$00] = hitting sprite X speed / 2 (sign kept)
$02:B864  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; /
$02:B866  99 B6 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y    ; Detached piece X speed = half of it
$02:B869  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:B86B  99 AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y    ; / Detached piece Y speed = $E0 (up)
$02:B86E  FA            PLX                          ; X = Pokey index
$02:B86F  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:B871  25 0D         AND $0D                     ; } Piece segments = Pokey's segments & [$0D]
$02:B873  99 C2 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteState,Y     ; /
$02:B876  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:B878  99 34 15      STA.W $1534,Y               ; / [$1534] = 1: flag as a detached segment
$02:B87B  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:B87D  22 E1 AC 02   JSL.L $ACE1           ; / Spawn score/smoke effect ($ACE1, A = 1)
$02:B881  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B882: Torpedo Ted main (long wrapper) (TorpedoTedMain) ;;;
{
;; Sets the data bank and runs the Torpedo Ted routine at $02B88A: draw, interact, launch, fly.
;; Called by: $01:8838 (Torpedo Ted (TorpedoTed))
$02:B882  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:B883  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (old bank saved)
$02:B884  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:B885  20 8A B8      JSR.W $B88A           ; Run the Torpedo Ted sprite
$02:B888  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:B889  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:B88A  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:B88C  48            PHA                          ; / Save the draw priority [$64]
$02:B88D  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:B890  F0 04         BEQ $B896             ; |
$02:B892  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; } If launching ([$1540] != 0): [$64] = $10, drawn behind objects
$02:B894  85 64         STA $64                     ; /
$02:B896  20 F7 B8      JSR.W TorpedoGfxRt          ; Draw the sprite
$02:B899  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:B89A  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Restore [$64]
$02:B89C  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:B89E  D0 17         BNE $B8B7            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:B8A0  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:B8A3  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Interact with Mario and other sprites
$02:B8A7  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:B8AA  F0 10         BEQ $B8BC             ; / Not launching: go to the flight code at $02B8BC
$02:B8AC  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B8AE  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Launch: Y speed = 8
$02:B8B0  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to position
$02:B8B3  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:B8B5  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $10 (after the launch move)
$02:B8B7  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B8B8: Table: Torpedo Ted max X speed (TorpedoMaxSpeed) ;;;
{
$02:B8B8                .db $20,$F0                 ; Max X speed by direction: $20 right, $F0 left

}

;;; $B8BA: Torpedo Ted flight movement (TorpedoAccel) ;;;
{
;; Table of X acceleration, then the flight code: accelerates in X every 4 frames to its max speed, levels out Y speed and
;; spawns trail puffs every 8 frames.
$02:B8BA                .db $01,$FF                 ; X acceleration by direction: $01 right, $FF left

$02:B8BC  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:B8BE  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Accelerate only every 4 frames
$02:B8C0  D0 10         BNE $B8D2             ; /
$02:B8C2  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = direction
$02:B8C5  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; A = X speed
$02:B8C7  D9 B8 B8      CMP.W TorpedoMaxSpeed,Y     ; At max speed?
$02:B8CA  F0 06         BEQ $B8D2             ; Yes: no change
$02:B8CC  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:B8CD  79 BA B8      ADC.W TorpedoAccel,Y        ; } X speed += acceleration
$02:B8D0  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; /
$02:B8D2  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Apply X speed to position
$02:B8D5  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to position
$02:B8D8  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = 0?
$02:B8DA  F0 08         BEQ $B8E4             ; Yes: skip
$02:B8DC  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:B8DE  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Only every other frame
$02:B8E0  D0 02         BNE $B8E4             ; /
$02:B8E2  D6 AA         DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed-- (levels out)
$02:B8E4  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:B8E5  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B8E6  65 14         ADC RAM_FrameCounterB       ; |
$02:B8E8  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; } Every 8 frames (staggered by sprite index)
$02:B8EA  D0 03         BNE $B8EF            ; /
$02:B8EC  20 52 B9      JSR.W $B952           ; Spawn a trail puff behind it
$02:B8EF  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $B8F0..B8F5: Tables: Torpedo Ted tile layout ;;;
{
$02:B8F0                .db $10                     ; Tile 1 X offset for direction 0 (right)

$02:B8F1                .db $00,$10,$80,$82         ; Tile 1 X offset for direction 1 (left); tile 2 X offsets $00/$10; $80/$82 tile numbers

$02:B8F5                .db $40,$00                 ; Tile properties by direction: $40 (X flip) right, $00 left

}

;;; $B8F7: Torpedo Ted graphics (TorpedoGfxRt) ;;;
{
;; Draws two 16x16 tiles side by side, facing the sprite direction; the second tile animates ($A0/$82).
;; Jumps to FinishOAMWrite via $02B7A7.
;; Called by: $02:B896 (Torpedo Ted main (long wrapper) (TorpedoTedMain))
$02:B8F7  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get the sprite's drawing info
$02:B8FA  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:B8FC  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; } Both tiles' Y = [$01]
$02:B8FF  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; /
$02:B902  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:B903  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:B906  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } [$02] = sprite palette | draw priority [$64]
$02:B908  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:B90A  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:B90D  AA            TAX                          ; / X = sprite direction
$02:B90E  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:B910  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B911  7D F0 B8      ADC.W $B8F0,X         ; } Tile 1 X = [$00] + $B8F0[direction]
$02:B914  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:B917  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:B919  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B91A  7D F1 B8      ADC.W $B8F1,X         ; } Tile 2 X = [$00] + $B8F1[direction]
$02:B91D  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; /
$02:B920  BD F5 B8      LDA.W $B8F5,X         ; \
$02:B923  05 02         ORA $02                     ; |
$02:B925  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; } Both tiles' properties = $B8F5[direction] | [$02]
$02:B928  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; /
$02:B92B  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:B92C  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; \
$02:B92E  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile 1 = $80
$02:B931  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:B934  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; / Launching ([$1540] != 0)?
$02:B936  A9 82         LDA.B #$82                  ; Tile 2 = $82
$02:B938  B0 0A         BCS $B944             ; Launching: keep $82
$02:B93A  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:B93C  4A            LSR                          ; } Flying: alternate tile 2 by frame counter bit 2
$02:B93D  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:B93E  A9 A0         LDA.B #$A0                  ; A = $A0 (alternate tile)
$02:B940  90 02         BCC $B944             ; Bit clear: use $A0
$02:B942  A9 82         LDA.B #$82                  ; Bit set: tile $82
$02:B944  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Store tile 2
$02:B947  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1: two tiles
$02:B949  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:B94B  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish the OAM write (shared with Pokey)


}

;;; $B94E..B950: Table: Torpedo Ted trail X offset ;;;
{
$02:B94E                .db $F4,$1C                 ; Trail puff X offset by direction: $F4 left side, $1C

$02:B950                .db $FF,$00                 ; Trail puff X high byte offset: $FF, $00

}

;;; $B952: Spawn Torpedo Ted trail puff ;;;
{
;; Finds a free smoke slot (or reuses one round-robin via [$18E9]) and creates a smoke puff $0F frames long behind the sprite,
;; if it is on the screen.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by: $02:B8EC (Torpedo Ted flight movement (TorpedoAccel))
$02:B952  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: search the four smoke slots
$02:B954  B9 C0 17      LDA.W $17C0,Y               ; \
$02:B957  F0 10         BEQ $B969             ; / Smoke slot Y free?
$02:B959  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:B95A  10 F8         BPL $B954             ; Loop for Y = 3..0
$02:B95C  CE E9 18      DEC.W $18E9                 ; All used: [$18E9]-- (round-robin slot)
$02:B95F  10 05         BPL $B966             ; Still >= 0
$02:B961  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:B963  8D E9 18      STA.W $18E9                 ; / Wrap [$18E9] to 3
$02:B966  AC E9 18      LDY.W $18E9                 ; Y = round-robin slot
$02:B969  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:B96B  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:B96D  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } [$00]/[$01] = sprite X (16-bit)
$02:B970  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:B972  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:B973  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:B976  AA            TAX                          ; / X = sprite direction
$02:B977  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:B979  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:B97A  7D 4E B9      ADC.W $B94E,X         ; } [$02] = X low + $B94E[direction]
$02:B97D  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:B97F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:B981  7D 50 B9      ADC.W $B950,X         ; } A = X high + $B950[direction]; save
$02:B984  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:B985  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:B987  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:B989  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:B98A  FA            PLX                          ; } Is the puff on the screen? (16-bit compare with the left edge)
$02:B98B  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; /
$02:B98D  D0 14         BNE $B9A3            ; No: return
$02:B98F  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:B991  99 C0 17      STA.W $17C0,Y               ; / Smoke type [$17C0+Y] = 1
$02:B994  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:B996  99 C8 17      STA.W $17C8,Y               ; / Smoke X = [$02]
$02:B999  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:B99B  99 C4 17      STA.W $17C4,Y               ; / Smoke Y = sprite Y
$02:B99E  A9 0F         LDA.B #$0F                  ; \
$02:B9A0  99 CC 17      STA.W $17CC,Y               ; / Smoke timer [$17CC+Y] = $0F
$02:B9A3  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $B9A4: Block and sprite helpers: berries and silver coins (GenTileFromSpr0) ;;;
{
;; Starts with the GenTileFromSpr0 entry: generates the block in A at the current sprite's position (A = block number).
;; Then $B9BD: silver P-switch effect, turns every alive sprite without bit 6 of tweaker $190F into a silver moving coin (sprite $21).
;; Then $B9FA: Yoshi berry pick-up. Looks up the map16 tile at the position [$00]/[$08] (X), [$01]/[$09] (Y); if it is a berry
;; tile ($45-$47) spawns a berry (mushroom sprite $74) there and replaces the tile with the tree behind it. Sets [$18D6] = berry type.
;; Quirk: the vertical-level lookup at $B9FE is unreachable because [$0F] is always cleared first.
$02:B9A4  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; A = block to generate: [$9C] = tile number
$02:B9A6  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:B9A8  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; /  Block X position = sprite X position (lo)
$02:B9AA  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:B9AD  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; / Block X position (hi) = sprite X position (hi)
$02:B9AF  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:B9B1  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; /  Block Y position = sprite Y position (lo)
$02:B9B3  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:B9B6  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; / Block Y position (hi) = sprite Y position (hi)
$02:B9B8  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the block (GenerateTile)
$02:B9BC  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:B9BD  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:B9BF  8D DD 18      STA.W $18DD                 ; / [$18DD] = 2 (probably the silver P-switch active state)
$02:B9C2  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Y = $09: sprite slot index, counting down to 0
$02:B9C4  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; Sprite status of slot Y
$02:B9C7  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B9C9  90 0A         BCC $B9D5             ; / Skip if status < 8 (not alive)
$02:B9CB  B9 0F 19      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker190F,Y     ; \
$02:B9CE  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; |
$02:B9D0  D0 03         BNE $B9D5             ; / Skip if bit 6 of the sprite's tweaker $190F is set (immune to the conversion)
$02:B9D2  20 D9 B9      JSR.W $B9D9           ; Turn this sprite into a coin ($B9D9)
$02:B9D5  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:B9D6  10 EC         BPL $B9C4             ; / Next slot, loop for Y = 9..0
$02:B9D8  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:B9D9  A9 21         LDA.B #$21                  ; \
$02:B9DB  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $21 (moving coin)
$02:B9DE  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:B9E0  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:B9E3  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:B9E4  BB            TYX                          ; X = new coin's slot
$02:B9E5  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Reset the sprite tables
$02:B9E9  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:B9EC  29 F1         AND.B #$F1                  ; |
$02:B9EE  09 02         ORA.B #$02                  ; |
$02:B9F0  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; / Sprite palette: clear bits 1-3, then palette bits = 2 (silver coin colors)
$02:B9F3  A9 D8         LDA.B #$D8                  ; \
$02:B9F5  9D AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X    ; / Y speed = $D8 (pops upward)
$02:B9F8  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:B9F9  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:B9FA  64 0F         STZ $0F                     ; [$0F] = 0: use the horizontal level map16 layout
$02:B9FC  80 4A         BRA $BA48             ; Go look up the map16 tile at the position

$02:B9FE  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BA00  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:BA02  85 04         STA $04                     ; / Unreachable vertical-level version: row bits of Y low into [$04]
$02:BA04  A5 09         LDA $09                     ; \
$02:BA06  C5 5D         CMP RAM_ScreensInLvl        ; / Y high byte [$09] must be < number of screens, else return
$02:BA08  B0 3D         BCS $BA47            ; Return if out of range
$02:BA0A  85 05         STA $05                     ; [$05] = Y high byte (screen)
$02:BA0C  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BA0E  85 07         STA $07                     ; / [$07] = X low
$02:BA10  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:BA12  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; / X high [$08] must be < 2, else return
$02:BA14  B0 31         BCS $BA47            ; Return if out of range
$02:BA16  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; [$0A] = X high
$02:BA18  A5 07         LDA $07                     ; \
$02:BA1A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA1B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA1C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA1D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA1E  05 04         ORA $04                     ; } [$04] = column (X low >> 4) | row (Y low & $F0)
$02:BA20  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:BA22  A6 05         LDX $05                     ; X = screen number
$02:BA24  BF 80 BA 00   LDA.L $BA80,X         ; Low byte of the screen's map16 base address
$02:BA28  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; \
$02:BA2A  F0 04         BEQ $BA30             ; / If [$0F] != 0 use the second table
$02:BA2C  BF 8E BA 00   LDA.L $BA8E,X         ; Second table (vertical layout)
$02:BA30  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BA31  65 04         ADC $04                     ; } [$05] = low byte of the map16 address
$02:BA33  85 05         STA $05                     ; /
$02:BA35  BF BC BA 00   LDA.L $BABC,X         ; High byte of the screen's map16 base address
$02:BA39  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; \
$02:BA3B  F0 04         BEQ $BA41             ; / If [$0F] != 0 use the second table
$02:BA3D  BF CA BA 00   LDA.L $BACA,X         ; Second table (vertical layout)
$02:BA41  65 0A         ADC $0A                     ; \
$02:BA43  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = high byte of the map16 address
$02:BA45  80 4B         BRA $BA92             ; / Continue at the tile check

$02:BA47  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:BA48  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BA4A  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; } [$04] = Y low & $F0 (map16 row * 16)
$02:BA4C  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:BA4E  A5 09         LDA $09                     ; \
$02:BA50  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; / Y high [$09] must be < 2, else return
$02:BA52  B0 F3         BCS $BA47            ; Return if out of range
$02:BA54  85 0D         STA $0D                     ; \
$02:BA56  8D B3 18      STA.W $18B3                 ; / [$0D] = $18B3 = Y high
$02:BA59  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BA5B  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = X low
$02:BA5D  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:BA5F  C5 5D         CMP RAM_ScreensInLvl        ; / X high [$08] must be < number of screens, else return
$02:BA61  B0 E4         BCS $BA47            ; Return if out of range
$02:BA63  85 07         STA $07                     ; [$07] = X high (screen)
$02:BA65  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; \
$02:BA67  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA68  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA69  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA6A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BA6B  05 04         ORA $04                     ; } [$04] = column (X low >> 4) | row (Y low & $F0)
$02:BA6D  85 04         STA $04                     ; /
$02:BA6F  A6 07         LDX $07                     ; X = screen number
$02:BA71  BF 60 BA 00   LDA.L $BA60,X         ; Low byte of the screen's map16 base address
$02:BA75  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; \
$02:BA77  F0 04         BEQ $BA7D             ; / If [$0F] != 0 use the second table
$02:BA79  BF 70 BA 00   LDA.L $BA70,X         ; Second table (vertical layout)
$02:BA7D  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BA7E  65 04         ADC $04                     ; |
$02:BA80  85 05         STA $05                     ; / [$05] = low byte of the map16 address of the tile
$02:BA82  BF 9C BA 00   LDA.L $BA9C,X         ; High byte of the screen's map16 base address
$02:BA86  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; \
$02:BA88  F0 04         BEQ $BA8E             ; / If [$0F] != 0 use the second table
$02:BA8A  BF AC BA 00   LDA.L $BAAC,X         ; Second table (vertical layout)
$02:BA8E  65 0D         ADC $0D                     ; \
$02:BA90  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = high byte of the map16 address (plus Y screen)
$02:BA92  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:BA95  A9 7E         LDA.B #$7E                  ; \
$02:BA97  85 07         STA $07                     ; / [$07] = $7E: pointer [$05] points at the map16 low bytes
$02:BA99  A7 05         LDA [$05]                   ; \
$02:BA9B  8D 93 16      STA.W $1693                 ; / [$1693] = map16 tile number (low byte)
$02:BA9E  E6 07         INC $07                     ; [$07] = $7F: same address in the high-byte map
$02:BAA0  A7 05         LDA [$05]                   ; \
$02:BAA2  D0 1B         BNE $BABF            ; / Return if the tile's high byte is non-zero
$02:BAA4  AD 93 16      LDA.W $1693                 ; \
$02:BAA7  C9 45         CMP.B #$45                  ; |
$02:BAA9  90 14         BCC $BABF            ; / Return if tile < $45 (red berry): not a berry
$02:BAAB  C9 48         CMP.B #$48                  ; \
$02:BAAD  B0 10         BCS $BABF            ; / Return if tile >= $48
$02:BAAF  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:BAB0  E9 44         SBC.B #$44                  ; |
$02:BAB2  8D D6 18      STA.W $18D6                 ; / [$18D6] = berry type: 1 = red, 2 = pink, 3 = green (tile - $44)
$02:BAB5  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = $0B: search for a free sprite slot
$02:BAB7  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:BABA  F0 04         BEQ $BAC0             ; / Slot free (status 0): use it
$02:BABC  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:BABD  10 F8         BPL $BAB7             ; / Next slot
$02:BABF  6B            RTL                          ; Return if there is no free slot

$02:BAC0  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:BAC2  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:BAC5  A9 74         LDA.B #$74                  ; \
$02:BAC7  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $74 (mushroom, used as the berry)
$02:BACA  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BACC  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; |
$02:BACF  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:BAD1  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; |
$02:BAD3  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; |
$02:BAD6  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; / Sprite X and block X position = [$00]/[$08] (the berry tile)
$02:BAD8  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BADA  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; |
$02:BADD  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:BADF  A5 09         LDA $09                     ; |
$02:BAE1  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; |
$02:BAE4  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; / Sprite Y and block Y position = [$01]/[$09]
$02:BAE6  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BAE7  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite's slot
$02:BAE8  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Reset the sprite tables
$02:BAEC  FE 0E 16      INC.W $160E,X               ; [$160E]++ (probably flags this mushroom as a berry)
$02:BAEF  BD 62 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; \
$02:BAF2  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:BAF4  09 0C         ORA.B #$0C                  ; } Clipping table index = $0C: smaller berry hitbox
$02:BAF6  9D 62 16      STA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; /
$02:BAF9  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; \
$02:BAFC  29 BF         AND.B #$BF                  ; |
$02:BAFE  9D 7A 16      STA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; / Clear bit 6 of tweaker $167A: no longer gives a powerup when eaten
$02:BB01  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BB02  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:BB04  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = $04 (tree behind the berry)
$02:BB06  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Replace the berry tile with it (GenerateTile)
$02:BB0A  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}
