;;; $BB1F: Table: Yoshi wing sizes, then draw Yoshi wings (YoshiWingsSize) ;;;
{
;; Table of OAM size bits, followed by the routine that draws one wing tile on Yoshi's back in extended OAM slot $F8.
;; Parameters: A: wing frame (0 or 1); X: sprite index of Yoshi. Draws nothing when Yoshi is off-screen.
$02:BB1F                .db $00,$02,$00,$02         ; Wing OAM size bits (0 = 8x8, 2 = 16x16)

$02:BB23  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = A (wing frame 0 or 1)
$02:BB25  20 C9 D0      JSR.W IsSprOffScreenBnk2    ; \
$02:BB28  D0 5D         BNE $BB87            ; / Return if the sprite is off-screen
$02:BB2A  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:BB2C  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = sprite X low
$02:BB2E  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:BB31  85 04         STA $04                     ; / [$04] = sprite X high
$02:BB33  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:BB35  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = sprite Y low
$02:BB37  A0 F8         LDY.B #$F8                  ; Y = $F8: use OAM slot $F8 (reserved for the wings)
$02:BB39  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BB3A  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:BB3D  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:BB3E  65 02         ADC $02                     ; |
$02:BB40  AA            TAX                          ; / X = direction * 2 + frame (table index)
$02:BB41  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BB43  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BB44  7F 0B BB 02   ADC.L $BB0B,X         ; } [$00] = X + wing X offset (low byte)
$02:BB48  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:BB4A  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:BB4C  7F 0F BB 02   ADC.L $BB0F,X         ; |
$02:BB50  48            PHA                          ; / A = X high + offset high byte, saved on the stack
$02:BB51  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BB53  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:BB54  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:BB56  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X = wing X - screen X (low byte)
$02:BB59  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:BB5A  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:BB5C  D0 28         BNE $BB86             ; / Off-screen horizontally (high byte of the difference != 0): skip
$02:BB5E  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BB60  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:BB61  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:BB63  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BB64  7F 13 BB 02   ADC.L $BB13,X         ; |
$02:BB68  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / OAM Y = sprite Y - screen Y + wing Y offset
$02:BB6B  BF 17 BB 02   LDA.L YoshiWingsTiles,X     ; \
$02:BB6F  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = wing tile
$02:BB72  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:BB74  1F 1B BB 02   ORA.L YoshiWingsGfxProp,X   ; |
$02:BB78  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / OAM properties = [$64] (sprite priority) | wing properties
$02:BB7B  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:BB7C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BB7D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BB7E  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table)
$02:BB7F  BF 1F BB 02   LDA.L YoshiWingsSize,X      ; \
$02:BB83  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / OAM size bits = wing size ($0420 table)
$02:BB86  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BB87  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $BB88..BB8E: Table: dolphin acceleration and speed limits ;;;

$02:BB8E                .db $E8,$18,$F8,$08,$00,$00 ; X speed limit: $E8/$18 long jump, $F8/$08 short jump, 0 vertical

;;; $BB94: Dolphin main routine (DolphinMain) ;;;
{
;; Main routine for the dolphin sprites ($41, $42 horizontal; $43 vertical). Draws, moves, applies gravity, floats in water and
;; launches the dolphin out of the water at the end of each swim. Acts as a platform Mario can stand on (InvisBlkMainRt).
;; Quirk: the frame counter mask $00 means gravity applies every frame.
;; Called by: $01:888A (Dolphin (Dolphin))
$02:BB94  20 14 BC      JSR.W $BC14           ; Draw the dolphin ($BC14)
$02:BB97  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:BB99  D0 64         BNE $BBFF            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:BB9B  20 1F D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:BB9E  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:BBA1  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:BBA4  9D 28 15      STA.W $1528,X               ; [$1528] = A (probably X movement this frame, used to carry Mario)
$02:BBA7  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BBA9  29 00         AND.B #$00                  ; |
$02:BBAB  D0 0A         BNE $BBB7             ; / Frame counter & $00 = 0: gravity applies every frame
$02:BBAD  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:BBAF  30 04         BMI $BBB5             ; / Y speed negative (rising): add gravity
$02:BBB1  C9 3F         CMP.B #$3F                  ; \
$02:BBB3  B0 02         BCS $BBB7             ; / Y speed >= $3F: at terminal speed, skip
$02:BBB5  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Gravity: Y speed++
$02:BBB7  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:BBB8  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:BBBA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BBBB  90 04         BCC $BBC1             ; / Every other frame (staggered by sprite index): skip the interaction below
$02:BBBD  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Sprite <-> block interaction ($9138)
$02:BBC1  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:BBC3  30 36         BMI $BBFB             ; / Rising: skip to the platform code
$02:BBC5  BD 4A 16      LDA.W $164A,X               ; \
$02:BBC8  F0 31         BEQ $BBFB             ; / Not in water ([$164A] = 0): skip to the platform code
$02:BBCA  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:BBCC  F0 09         BEQ $BBD7             ; / Y speed 0: skip the buoyancy step
$02:BBCE  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:BBCF  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:BBD1  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / In water and falling: Y speed -= 8 (buoyancy)
$02:BBD3  10 02         BPL $BBD7             ; \
$02:BBD5  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Clamp at 0
$02:BBD7  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:BBDA  D0 1B         BNE $BBF7             ; / [$151C] non-zero: skip the sideways acceleration and jump out
$02:BBDC  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:BBDE  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BBDF  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:BBE0  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; |
$02:BBE2  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:BBE3  E9 41         SBC.B #$41                  ; |
$02:BBE5  28            PLP                          ; |
$02:BBE6  2A            ROL                          ; |
$02:BBE7  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = (sprite number - $41) * 2 + (state bit 0): table index
$02:BBE8  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:BBEA  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BBEB  79 88 BB      ADC.W $BB88,Y         ; |
$02:BBEE  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed += acceleration from $BB88
$02:BBF0  D9 8E BB      CMP.W $BB8E,Y         ; \
$02:BBF3  D0 06         BNE $BBFB             ; / Not yet at the X speed limit: skip the jump
$02:BBF5  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++ (reverses direction)
$02:BBF7  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:BBF9  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $C0: jump out of the water
$02:BBFB  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Act as a solid platform for Mario (InvisBlkMainRt)
$02:BBFF  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:BC00  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BC02  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:BC04  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BC05  4A            LSR                          ; } Direction = frame counter bit 2 (toggles every 4 frames)
$02:BC06  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:BC09  22 5F 9D 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt1      ; Draw with the generic sprite graphics routine
$02:BC0D  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $BC0E: Table: dolphin tile 1 (DolphinTiles1) ;;;
{
$02:BC0E                .db $E2,$88                 ; Tile 1 (head), two animation frames

;;; $BC10: Table: dolphin tile 2 (DolphinTiles2) ;;;
{
$02:BC10                .db $E7,$A8                 ; Tile 2 (body), two animation frames

;;; $BC12: Table: dolphin tile 3, then draw dolphin (DolphinTiles3) ;;;
{
;; Table of the third dolphin tile, followed by $BC00 (vertical dolphin graphics) and $BC14 (horizontal dolphin graphics).
;; The horizontal dolphin is three 16x16 tiles, X-flipped when moving right, animated by the frame counter.
$02:BC12                .db $E8,$A9                 ; Tile 3 (tail), two animation frames

$02:BC14  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BC16  C9 43         CMP.B #$43                  ; |
$02:BC18  D0 03         BNE $BC1D             ; / Sprite $43 (vertical dolphin): use the generic graphics
$02:BC1A  4C 00 BC      JMP.W $BC00           ; Go draw it ($BC00)

$02:BC1D  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite position on screen: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y, Y = OAM index
$02:BC20  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:BC22  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = X speed
$02:BC24  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = on-screen X
$02:BC26  06 02         ASL $02                     ; Carry = sign of the X speed (set: moving left)
$02:BC28  08            PHP                          ; Save the carry for the flip decision
$02:BC29  90 11         BCC $BC3C             ; Moving right: go to the second layout
$02:BC2B  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Moving left: tile 1 at X
$02:BC2E  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BC2F  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:BC31  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; / Tile 2 at X + $10
$02:BC34  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BC35  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:BC37  99 08 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y      ; / Tile 3 at X + $18
$02:BC3A  80 12         BRA $BC4E             ; Continue at the Y positions

$02:BC3C  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BC3D  69 18         ADC.B #$18                  ; |
$02:BC3F  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / Moving right: tile 1 at X + $18
$02:BC42  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:BC43  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:BC45  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; / Tile 2 at X + 8
$02:BC48  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:BC49  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:BC4B  99 08 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y      ; / Tile 3 at X
$02:BC4E  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BC50  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; |
$02:BC53  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; |
$02:BC56  99 09 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y      ; / All three tiles at the same Y
$02:BC59  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BC5A  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BC5C  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; |
$02:BC5E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BC5F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BC60  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BC61  AA            TAX                          ; / X = animation frame (frame counter bit 3)
$02:BC62  BD 0E BC      LDA.W DolphinTiles1,X       ; \
$02:BC65  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile 1
$02:BC68  BD 10 BC      LDA.W DolphinTiles2,X       ; \
$02:BC6B  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; / Tile 2
$02:BC6E  BD 12 BC      LDA.W DolphinTiles3,X       ; \
$02:BC71  99 0A 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y           ; / Tile 3
$02:BC74  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BC75  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:BC78  05 64         ORA $64                     ; / Properties = sprite palette | priority [$64]
$02:BC7A  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:BC7B  B0 02         BCS $BC7F             ; Moving left: keep unflipped
$02:BC7D  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; Moving right: X-flip
$02:BC7F  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; \
$02:BC82  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Same properties for all three tiles
$02:BC85  99 0B 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y       ; /
$02:BC88  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; A = 2: three tiles
$02:BC8A  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:BC8C  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish the OAM write ($B7A7)


}

;;; $BC8F..BCBF: Table: wall-follower speeds and masks ;;;
{
;; Per-state tables for the wall-following sprites: movement speeds, probe speeds, blocked-direction masks, Spike Top frames and flips.
$02:BC8F                .db $08,$00,$F8,$00,$F8,$00,$08,$00 ; X speed by state: 0-3 clockwise, 4-7 counter-clockwise (+8 right, -8 left)
$02:BC97                .db $00,$08,$00,$F8,$00,$08,$00,$F8 ; Y speed by state: 0-3 clockwise, 4-7 counter-clockwise (+8 down, -8 up)
$02:BC9F                .db $01,$FF,$FF,$01,$FF,$01,$01,$FF ; X probe speed by state (1 pixel/frame)
$02:BCA7                .db $01,$01,$FF,$FF,$01,$01,$FF,$FF ; Y probe speed by state (1 pixel/frame)
$02:BCAF                .db $01,$04,$02,$08,$02,$04,$01,$08 ; Blocked-direction mask by state for [$1588]: 1 right, 2 left, 4 down, 8 up
$02:BCB7                .db $00,$02,$00,$02,$00,$02,$00,$02 ; Spike Top frame by state (second row: turning frames)
$02:BCBF                .db $05,$04,$05,$04,$05,$04,$05,$04 ; Spike Top frame by state, turning (continued)

$02:BCCF                .db $80,$C0,$40,$00,$C0,$80,$00,$40 ; Spike Top flip bits by state while turning
}

;;; $BCD7..BCD7: Table: Urchin animation sequence ;;;
{
$02:BCD7                .db $00,$01,$02,$01         ; Urchin animation frame sequence

;;; $BCDB: Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics (WallFollowersMain) ;;;
{
;; Shared main routine of Spike Top ($2E), the Urchins ($3A-$3C) and the ground-guided Fuzzball/Sparky ($A5) and Hothead ($A6).
;; Draws the sprite by type, kills it when not in normal status, otherwise interacts with Mario and runs the movement code.
;; [$1558] is an eye/face timer, randomly set to $0C about once in 256 frames.
;; Called by: $01:8863 (Wall followers: Spike Top, Urchin, Fuzzy (WallFollowers))
$02:BCDB  22 32 80 01   JSL.L SprSprInteract        ; Sprite <-> sprite interaction
$02:BCDF  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; Random number
$02:BCE3  29 FF         AND.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:BCE5  05 9D         ORA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; |
$02:BCE7  D0 05         BNE $BCEE             ; / Nonzero (nearly always, or sprites locked): skip
$02:BCE9  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:BCEB  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; / 1 in 256 frames: [$1558] = $0C (eye/face timer)
$02:BCEE  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BCF0  C9 2E         CMP.B #$2E                  ; |
$02:BCF2  D0 2F         BNE $BD23             ; / Not Spike Top: go to the other graphics
$02:BCF4  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = state (orientation)
$02:BCF6  BD 64 15      LDA.W $1564,X               ; \
$02:BCF9  F0 09         BEQ $BD04             ; / [$1564] (turning timer) = 0: normal animation
$02:BCFB  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:BCFC  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BCFD  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:BCFF  A8            TAY                          ; / Turning: use the second half of the tables (Y += 8)
$02:BD00  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:BD02  80 07         BRA $BD0B             ; / Animation frame 0

$02:BD04  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BD06  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BD07  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BD08  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BD09  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Animation frame = frame counter bit 3
$02:BD0B  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:BD0C  79 B7 BC      ADC.W $BCB7,Y         ; |
$02:BD0F  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / [$1602] = animation frame + base frame for this state
$02:BD12  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:BD15  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:BD17  19 C7 BC      ORA.W $BCC7,Y         ; |
$02:BD1A  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; / Sprite palette bits: keep low 6, set X/Y flip from table
$02:BD1D  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$02:BD21  80 0C         BRA $BD2F             ; Continue at the alive check

$02:BD23  C9 A5         CMP.B #$A5                  ; \
$02:BD25  90 05         BCC $BD2C             ; / Sprite < $A5 (Urchin): draw it at $BF5C
$02:BD27  20 4E BE      JSR.W $BE4E           ; \
$02:BD2A  80 03         BRA $BD2F             ; / Fuzzball/Sparky or Hothead: draw ($BE4E)

$02:BD2C  20 5C BF      JSR.W $BF5C           ; Draw the Urchin
$02:BD2F  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:BD32  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; / Sprite status 8 (normal)? Yes: run the main code
$02:BD34  F0 09         BEQ $BD3F             ; Dead or carried: skip ahead
$02:BD36  9E 28 15      STZ.W $1528,X               ; [$1528] = 0
$02:BD39  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:BD3B  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; / [$1558] = $FF
$02:BD3E  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:BD3F  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:BD41  D0 31         BNE $BD74            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:BD43  20 17 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen3Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:BD46  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Mario <-> sprite interaction
$02:BD4A  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BD4C  C9 2E         CMP.B #$2E                  ; |
$02:BD4E  F0 57         BEQ $BDA7             ; / Spike Top: go to its position check
$02:BD50  C9 3C         CMP.B #$3C                  ; \
$02:BD52  F0 5F         BEQ $BDB3             ; / Wall-follow Urchin: go to wall-follow movement
$02:BD54  C9 A5         CMP.B #$A5                  ; \
$02:BD56  F0 5B         BEQ $BDB3             ; / Ground-guided Fuzzball/Sparky: go to wall-follow movement
$02:BD58  C9 A6         CMP.B #$A6                  ; \
$02:BD5A  F0 57         BEQ $BDB3             ; / Ground-guided Hothead: go to wall-follow movement
$02:BD5C  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:BD5E  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Other Urchins: state bit 0 selects the routine
$02:BD60  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; / Run the state pointer below

}

;;; $BD64: Urchin states and wall-following movement (UrchinPtrs?) ;;;
{
;; Starts with a two-entry state pointer table for the Urchins: state 0 waits, state 1 moves and bounces off walls.
;; $BDA7 and $BDB3 then implement wall-following for Spike Top, wall-follow Urchin, Fuzzball/Sparky and Hothead: states 0-3 loop
;; one way around a surface, states 4-7 the other way, turning when the surface ends or a wall blocks the way.
$02:BD64  68 BD         .dw $BD68             ; State 0: wait, then start moving
$02:BD66  75 BD         .dw $BD75             ; State 1: move, bounce off walls

$02:BD68  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:BD6B  D0 07         BNE $BD74            ; / Wait while [$1540] is non-zero
$02:BD6D  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; \
$02:BD6F  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $80: moving time
$02:BD72  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++
$02:BD74  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:BD75  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BD77  C9 3B         CMP.B #$3B                  ; |
$02:BD79  F0 05         BEQ $BD80             ; / Wall-detect Urchin: always move
$02:BD7B  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:BD7E  F0 11         BEQ $BD91             ; / Fixed Urchin: when [$1540] runs out, reverse
$02:BD80  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:BD83  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:BD86  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Sprite <-> block interaction
$02:BD8A  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:BD8D  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; |
$02:BD8F  F0 15         BEQ $BDA6            ; / No wall contact: keep going
$02:BD91  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:BD93  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:BD95  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:BD96  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = -X speed
$02:BD98  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:BD9A  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:BD9C  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:BD9D  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = -Y speed
$02:BD9F  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:BDA1  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $40: pause before moving again
$02:BDA4  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++
$02:BDA6  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:BDA7  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:BDA9  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:BDAA  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:BDAC  C9 E0         CMP.B #$E0                  ; / Spike Top: Y position relative to the screen >= $E0?
$02:BDAE  90 03         BCC $BDB3             ; Not below the screen: stay alive
$02:BDB0  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Fell off the bottom: erase the sprite
$02:BDB3  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:BDB6  D0 2F         BNE $BDE7             ; / [$1540] non-zero: skip the movement
$02:BDB8  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = state
$02:BDBA  B9 A7 BC      LDA.W $BCA7,Y         ; \
$02:BDBD  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = probe speed (+/-1)
$02:BDBF  B9 9F BC      LDA.W $BC9F,Y         ; \
$02:BDC2  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = probe speed (+/-1)
$02:BDC4  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Sprite <-> block interaction
$02:BDC8  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:BDCB  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; |
$02:BDCD  D0 18         BNE $BDE7             ; / Touching a surface: keep following it
$02:BDCF  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:BDD1  9D 64 15      STA.W $1564,X               ; / No surface: [$1564] = 8 (turning animation)
$02:BDD4  A9 38         LDA.B #$38                  ; A = $38: corner timer for the wall-follow Urchin
$02:BDD6  B4 9E         LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BDD8  C0 3C         CPY.B #$3C                  ; |
$02:BDDA  F0 08         BEQ $BDE4             ; / Wall-follow Urchin: use $38
$02:BDDC  A9 1A         LDA.B #$1A                  ; A = $1A for the others
$02:BDDE  C0 A5         CPY.B #$A5                  ; \
$02:BDE0  D0 02         BNE $BDE4             ; / Not Fuzzball/Sparky: use $1A
$02:BDE2  4A            LSR                          ; Fuzzball/Sparky: A = $0D (it moves faster)
$02:BDE3  EA            NOP                          ; No operation
$02:BDE4  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = corner timer
$02:BDE7  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; A = $20: turn threshold for the wall-follow Urchin
$02:BDE9  B4 9E         LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BDEB  C0 3C         CPY.B #$3C                  ; |
$02:BDED  F0 08         BEQ $BDF7             ; / Wall-follow Urchin: use $20
$02:BDEF  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; A = $10 for the others
$02:BDF1  C0 A5         CPY.B #$A5                  ; \
$02:BDF3  D0 02         BNE $BDF7             ; / Not Fuzzball/Sparky: use $10
$02:BDF5  4A            LSR                          ; Fuzzball/Sparky: A = $08
$02:BDF6  EA            NOP                          ; No operation
$02:BDF7  DD 40 15      CMP.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:BDFA  D0 12         BNE $BE0E             ; / Timer reached the threshold? If not, skip the turn
$02:BDFC  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++ (turn the next way around)
$02:BDFE  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:BE00  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; |
$02:BE02  D0 02         BNE $BE06             ; / State 4: wrap back to 0
$02:BE04  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0
$02:BE06  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:BE08  D0 04         BNE $BE0E             ; / State 8: wrap back to 4
$02:BE0A  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:BE0C  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = 4
$02:BE0E  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = state
$02:BE10  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:BE13  39 AF BC      AND.W $BCAF,Y         ; |
$02:BE16  F0 17         BEQ $BE2F             ; / Blocked in the travel direction ([$1588] & mask)? No: move on
$02:BE18  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:BE1A  9D 64 15      STA.W $1564,X               ; / [$1564] = 8 (turning animation)
$02:BE1D  D6 C2         DEC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State-- (turn back the other way)
$02:BE1F  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:BE21  10 04         BPL $BE27             ; / State >= 0: skip the wrap
$02:BE23  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:BE25  80 06         BRA $BE2D             ; / State = 3 (wrap -1 to 3)

$02:BE27  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; \
$02:BE29  D0 04         BNE $BE2F             ; / Went from 4 to 3? Otherwise keep
$02:BE2B  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; A = 7
$02:BE2D  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = A
$02:BE2F  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = state
$02:BE31  B9 97 BC      LDA.W $BC97,Y         ; \
$02:BE34  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed from table (+/-8 or 0)
$02:BE36  B9 8F BC      LDA.W $BC8F,Y         ; \
$02:BE39  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed from table (+/-8 or 0)
$02:BE3B  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BE3D  C9 A5         CMP.B #$A5                  ; |
$02:BE3F  D0 04         BNE $BE45             ; / Not Fuzzball/Sparky: keep speeds
$02:BE41  16 B6         ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed *= 2
$02:BE43  16 AA         ASL RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed *= 2
$02:BE45  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:BE48  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:BE4B  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $BE4C..BE4C: Table: Fuzzball/Sparky properties ;;;
{
$02:BE4C                .db $05,$45                 ; Fuzzball/Sparky OAM properties, alternating frames

;;; $BE4E: Fuzzball/Sparky and Hothead graphics ;;;
{
;; Draws the ground-guided Fuzzball/Sparky ($A5, one 16x16 tile with a replaced tile and properties) and falls into the Hothead drawing.
;; Called by: $02:BD27 (Wall-follower sprites main and Spike Top graphics (WallFollowersMain))
$02:BE4E  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:BE50  C9 A5         CMP.B #$A5                  ; |
$02:BE52  D0 61         BNE $BEB5             ; / Hothead: go to its graphics
$02:BE54  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the 16x16 sprite (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$02:BE58  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index of the sprite
$02:BE5B  AD 2B 19      LDA.W $192B                 ; \
$02:BE5E  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; |
$02:BE60  D0 17         BNE $BE79             ; / [$192B] != 2: go to the other variant
$02:BE62  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BE63  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BE65  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BE66  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:BE67  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:BE69  AA            TAX                          ; / X = animation frame (frame counter bit 2)
$02:BE6A  A9 C8         LDA.B #$C8                  ; \
$02:BE6C  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = $C8
$02:BE6F  BD 4C BE      LDA.W $BE4C,X         ; \
$02:BE72  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:BE74  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = table | priority [$64]
$02:BE77  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BE78  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:BE79  A9 0A         LDA.B #$0A                  ; \
$02:BE7B  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = $0A
$02:BE7E  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BE80  29 0C         AND.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:BE82  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:BE83  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:BE84  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:BE85  0A            ASL                          ; / Flip bits = (frame counter & $0C) << 3: spinning appearance
$02:BE86  59 03 03      EOR.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; \
$02:BE89  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Toggle X/Y flip in the OAM properties
$02:BE8C  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $BE8D..BE91: Table: Hothead body tile offsets ;;;

;;; $BE95: Hothead tables and graphics (HotheadTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tables for the Hothead body and eye, followed by $BEB5, which draws four 16x16 body tiles in a 2x2 square and an 8x8 eye tile
;; whose position depends on the state (the side of the surface it is on).
$02:BE95                .db $0C,$0E,$0E,$0C,$0E,$0C,$0C,$0E ; Hothead body tiles, two animation frames
$02:BE9D                .db $05,$05,$C5,$C5,$45,$45,$85,$85 ; Hothead body tile properties (flip bits)
$02:BEA5                .db $07,$07,$01,$01,$01,$01,$07,$07 ; Hothead eye X offset by state
$02:BEAD                .db $00,$08,$08,$00,$00,$08,$08,$00 ; Hothead eye Y offset by state

$02:BEB5  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite position on screen: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y, Y = OAM index
$02:BEB8  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:BEB9  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BEBA  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:BEBC  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; } OAM index += 4 (first slot is kept for the eye)
$02:BEBF  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:BEC0  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:BEC2  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / [$03] = animation frame offset (frame counter bit 2)
$02:BEC4  85 03         STA $03                     ; /
$02:BEC6  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BEC7  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: four body tiles
$02:BEC9  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BECB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BECC  7D 8D BE      ADC.W $BE8D,X         ; |
$02:BECF  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = [$00] + tile X offset
$02:BED2  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BED4  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BED5  7D 91 BE      ADC.W $BE91,X         ; |
$02:BED8  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = [$01] + tile Y offset
$02:BEDB  DA            PHX                          ; Save the tile counter
$02:BEDC  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:BEDD  05 03         ORA $03                     ; |
$02:BEDF  AA            TAX                          ; / X = tile counter | animation frame
$02:BEE0  BD 95 BE      LDA.W HotheadTiles,X        ; \
$02:BEE3  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = Hothead body tile
$02:BEE6  BD 9D BE      LDA.W $BE9D,X         ; \
$02:BEE9  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:BEEB  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = table | priority [$64]
$02:BEEE  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the tile counter
$02:BEEF  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:BEF0  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:BEF1  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:BEF2  C8            INY                          ; / OAM index += 4
$02:BEF3  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:BEF4  10 D3         BPL $BEC9             ; / Next tile, loop for X = 3..0
$02:BEF6  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BEF7  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BEF9  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:BEFA  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:BEFC  48            PHA                          ; / Save [$00] and [$01] on the stack
$02:BEFD  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:BEFF  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: four tiles
$02:BF01  20 A7 B7      JSR.W $B7A7           ; Finish the OAM write for the body ($B7A7)
$02:BF04  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:BF05  85 01         STA $01                     ; |
$02:BF07  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:BF08  85 00         STA $00                     ; / Restore [$00] and [$01]
$02:BF0A  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; A = $09: eye tile
$02:BF0C  BC 58 15      LDY.W $1558,X               ; \
$02:BF0F  F0 02         BEQ $BF13             ; / [$1558] (eye timer) = 0: keep it
$02:BF11  A9 19         LDA.B #$19                  ; A = $19: other eye tile
$02:BF13  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = eye tile
$02:BF15  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:BF18  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:BF19  E9 04         SBC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:BF1B  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; } OAM index -= 4 (back to the reserved slot)
$02:BF1E  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:BF1F  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:BF20  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:BF22  AA            TAX                          ; / X = state
$02:BF23  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BF25  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BF26  7D A5 BE      ADC.W $BEA5,X         ; |
$02:BF29  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = [$00] + eye X offset
$02:BF2C  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BF2E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BF2F  7D AD BE      ADC.W $BEAD,X         ; |
$02:BF32  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = [$01] + eye Y offset
$02:BF35  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:BF37  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = eye tile
$02:BF3A  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:BF3C  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:BF3E  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = 5 | priority [$64]
$02:BF41  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:BF42  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: 8x8 tile
$02:BF44  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0: one tile
$02:BF46  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish the OAM write for the eye ($B7A7)


}

;;; $BF58: Urchin graphics (UrchinTiles) ;;;
{
;; Table of Urchin spike tiles, followed by $BF5C: animates the Urchin and draws five tiles (center eye plus four spikes).
$02:BF58                .db $C4,$C6,$C8,$C6         ; Urchin spike tiles by animation frame

$02:BF5C  BD 3E 16      LDA.W $163E,X               ; \
$02:BF5F  D0 08         BNE $BF69             ; / [$163E] (animation timer) non-zero: skip
$02:BF61  FE 28 15      INC.W $1528,X               ; [$1528]++ (next animation frame)
$02:BF64  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:BF66  9D 3E 16      STA.W $163E,X               ; / [$163E] = $0C
$02:BF69  BD 28 15      LDA.W $1528,X               ; \
$02:BF6C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:BF6E  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = [$1528] & 3
$02:BF6F  B9 D7 BC      LDA.W $BCD7,Y         ; \
$02:BF72  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / [$1602] = animation frame from the sequence
$02:BF75  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite position on screen: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y, Y = OAM index
$02:BF78  64 05         STZ $05                     ; [$05] = 0: tile counter
$02:BF7A  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:BF7D  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = animation frame
$02:BF7F  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; \
$02:BF82  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = [$1558] (eye timer)
$02:BF84  A6 05         LDX $05                     ; X = tile counter
$02:BF86  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:BF88  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BF89  7D 49 BF      ADC.W $BF49,X         ; |
$02:BF8C  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = [$00] + tile X offset
$02:BF8F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:BF91  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:BF92  7D 4E BF      ADC.W $BF4E,X         ; |
$02:BF95  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = [$01] + tile Y offset
$02:BF98  BD 53 BF      LDA.W $BF53,X         ; \
$02:BF9B  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties from table
$02:BF9E  E0 00         CPX.B #$00                  ; \
$02:BFA0  D0 0A         BNE $BFAC             ; / Not the center tile: go to the spike tiles
$02:BFA2  A9 CA         LDA.B #$CA                  ; A = $CA: center tile (eye open)
$02:BFA4  A6 03         LDX $03                     ; \
$02:BFA6  F0 02         BEQ $BFAA             ; / [$1558] = 0: keep it
$02:BFA8  A9 CC         LDA.B #$CC                  ; A = $CC: other center tile
$02:BFAA  80 05         BRA $BFB1             ; Go store the tile

$02:BFAC  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; \
$02:BFAE  BD 58 BF      LDA.W UrchinTiles,X         ; / Spike tile for the animation frame
$02:BFB1  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile = A
$02:BFB4  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:BFB5  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:BFB6  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:BFB7  C8            INY                          ; / OAM index += 4
$02:BFB8  E6 05         INC $05                     ; [$05]++ (next tile)
$02:BFBA  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:BFBC  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; |
$02:BFBE  D0 C4         BNE $BF84             ; / Loop for all 5 tiles
$02:BFC0  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:BFC3  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:BFC5  4C 2B C8      JMP.W $C82B           ; A = 4 (five tiles) and finish the OAM write ($C82B)


}

;;; $BFCD: Rip Van Fish main routine (RipVanFishMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 0x37. Draws the fish, skips logic while sprites are locked, handles Mario contact and object collision, then runs the state routine.
;; While Mario has a star the speeds are negated just for the position update (probably so the fish swims away); the real speeds are restored after.
;; Outside water ([$164A] = 0) the fish gets Y speed $10 and sinks. States: 0 = asleep, 1 = chasing Mario.
;; Called by: $01:8858 (Rip Van Fish (RipVanFish))
$02:BFCD  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the fish
$02:BFD1  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:BFD3  D0 F7         BNE $BFCC            ; Yes: return
$02:BFD5  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:BFD8  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Mario contact / sprite-sprite interaction
$02:BFDC  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:BFDE  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:BFDF  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; } Save X and Y speed
$02:BFE1  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:BFE2  AC 90 14      LDY.W $1490                 ; [$1490] = Mario star timer
$02:BFE5  F0 0C         BEQ $BFF3             ; No star: skip the speed reversal
$02:BFE7  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:BFE9  1A            INC A                       ; } Negate Y speed: A = -A
$02:BFEA  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:BFEC  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:BFEE  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:BFF0  1A            INC A                       ; } Negate X speed: A = -A
$02:BFF1  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; /
$02:BFF3  20 26 C1      JSR.W $C126           ; Face the direction of the X speed
$02:BFF6  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Apply X speed to X position
$02:BFF9  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$02:BFFC  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Interact with level objects
$02:C000  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:C001  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Restore the real Y speed
$02:C003  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:C004  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Restore the real X speed
$02:C006  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Animation timer [$1570]++
$02:C009  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C00C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Touching a wall (left/right)?
$02:C00E  F0 02         BEQ $C012             ; /
$02:C010  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Yes: X speed = 0
$02:C012  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C015  29 0C         AND.B #$0C                  ; } Touching floor or ceiling?
$02:C017  F0 02         BEQ $C01B             ; /
$02:C019  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Yes: Y speed = 0
$02:C01B  BD 4A 16      LDA.W $164A,X               ; [$164A] = in-water flag
$02:C01E  D0 04         BNE $C024             ; In water: skip
$02:C020  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:C022  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Out of water: Y speed = $10 (sink)
$02:C024  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = state
$02:C026  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run state routine

}

;;; $C02A: Pointer table: Rip Van Fish states (RipVanFishPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Index [RAM_SpriteState]: 0 = sleeping, 1 = chasing Mario.
$02:C02A  2E C0         .dw $C02E             ; State 0: asleep
$02:C02C  8A C0         .dw $C08A             ; State 1: awake, chasing Mario

$02:C02E  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Y speed = 2 (slow sink)
$02:C030  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X
$02:C032  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:C034  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Every 4th frame: move X speed towards 0
$02:C036  D0 0C         BNE $C044             ; /
$02:C038  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed
$02:C03A  F0 08         BEQ $C044             ; Zero: nothing to do
$02:C03C  10 04         BPL $C042             ; Positive: go decrement
$02:C03E  F6 B6         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Negative: X speed++
$02:C040  80 02         BRA $C044             ; Continue

$02:C042  D6 B6         DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed--
$02:C044  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C047  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C049  F0 08         BEQ $C053             ; /
$02:C04B  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Yes: Y speed = 0
$02:C04D  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:C04F  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; } Snap Y to a 16 pixel boundary
$02:C051  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:C053  22 D9 C0 02   JSL.L $C0D9           ; Maybe spawn a Zzz minor extended sprite
$02:C057  AD FD 18      LDA.W $18FD                 ; [$18FD]: set by the Whistlin Chuck code
$02:C05A  D0 16         BNE $C072             ; Non-zero: wake up
$02:C05C  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; $0F = horizontal distance to Mario, Y = side
$02:C05F  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:C061  69 30         ADC.B #$30                  ; |
$02:C063  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; } Within $30 pixels horizontally?
$02:C065  B0 14         BCS $C07B             ; /
$02:C067  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; $0E = vertical distance to Mario
$02:C06A  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:C06C  69 30         ADC.B #$30                  ; |
$02:C06E  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; } Within $30 pixels vertically?
$02:C070  B0 09         BCS $C07B             ; /
$02:C072  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Wake up: state = 1
$02:C074  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; Chase duration = $FF
$02:C076  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; [$151C] = chase timer
$02:C079  80 0F         BRA $C08A             ; Run the state 1 code now

$02:C07B  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: sleeping frame
$02:C07D  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:C080  29 30         AND.B #$30                  ; |
$02:C082  D0 01         BNE $C085             ; } Alternate animation frame 2/3 every $10 frames
$02:C084  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:C085  98            TYA                          ; A = frame
$02:C086  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set the animation frame
$02:C089  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:C08A  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:C08C  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Every other frame: chase timer--
$02:C08E  D0 05         BNE $C095             ; /
$02:C090  DE 1C 15      DEC.W $151C,X               ; [$151C]--
$02:C093  F0 35         BEQ $C0CA             ; Timer expired: go back to sleep
$02:C095  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:C097  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; } Every 8th frame: steer towards Mario
$02:C099  D0 20         BNE $C0BB             ; /
$02:C09B  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Y = side of Mario horizontally
$02:C09E  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed
$02:C0A0  D9 C8 BF      CMP.W $BFC8,Y         ; At max speed ($BFC8)?
$02:C0A3  F0 06         BEQ $C0AB             ; Yes: leave it
$02:C0A5  18            CLC                          ; Else add acceleration ($BFCA)
$02:C0A6  79 CA BF      ADC.W $BFCA,Y         ; X speed += +/-1
$02:C0A9  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store X speed
$02:C0AB  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; Y = side of Mario vertically
$02:C0AE  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed
$02:C0B0  D9 C8 BF      CMP.W $BFC8,Y         ; At max speed?
$02:C0B3  F0 06         BEQ $C0BB             ; Yes: leave it
$02:C0B5  18            CLC                          ; Else add acceleration
$02:C0B6  79 CA BF      ADC.W $BFCA,Y         ; Y speed += +/-1
$02:C0B9  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Store Y speed
$02:C0BB  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:C0BD  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; |
$02:C0C0  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:C0C2  F0 01         BEQ $C0C5             ; } Swim animation: frame 0/1 from [$1570] bit 2
$02:C0C4  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:C0C5  98            TYA                          ; A = frame
$02:C0C6  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set the animation frame
$02:C0C9  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:C0CA  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Chase over: state = 0
$02:C0CC  4C 2E C0      JMP.W $C02E           ; Back to the sleeping code

$02:C0CF  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:C0D1  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; |
$02:C0D4  F0 01         BEQ $C0D7             ; } Unused. A = 8 or 9 by direction (alternate Zzz number)
$02:C0D6  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:C0D7  80 02         BRA $C0DB             ; Skip

$02:C0D9  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; A = 6: minor extended sprite number (Zzz)
$02:C0DB  A8            TAY                          ; Y = number
$02:C0DC  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:C0DF  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } Return if off-screen
$02:C0E2  D0 41         BNE $C125            ; /
$02:C0E4  98            TYA                          ; A = number
$02:C0E5  DE 28 15      DEC.W $1528,X               ; Spawn timer [$1528]--
$02:C0E8  10 3B         BPL $C125            ; Not expired: return
$02:C0EA  48            PHA                          ; Save the number
$02:C0EB  A9 28         LDA.B #$28                  ; \
$02:C0ED  9D 28 15      STA.W $1528,X               ; / Reload spawn timer = $28
$02:C0F0  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = $0B: search 12 slots
$02:C0F2  B9 F0 17      LDA.W $17F0,Y               ; Minor extended sprite number in slot Y
$02:C0F5  F0 10         BEQ $C107             ; Free slot: use it
$02:C0F7  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:C0F8  10 F8         BPL $C0F2             ; Loop
$02:C0FA  CE 5D 18      DEC.W $185D                 ; No free slot: use round robin slot [$185D]--
$02:C0FD  10 05         BPL $C104             ; Still >= 0
$02:C0FF  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:C101  8D 5D 18      STA.W $185D                 ; / Wrap [$185D] to $0B
$02:C104  AC 5D 18      LDY.W $185D                 ; Y = slot to overwrite
$02:C107  68            PLA                          ; Restore the number
$02:C108  99 F0 17      STA.W $17F0,Y               ; Spawn it
$02:C10B  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:C10D  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C10E  69 06         ADC.B #$06                  ; } X = sprite X + 6
$02:C110  99 08 18      STA.W $1808,Y               ; /
$02:C113  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:C115  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C116  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Y = sprite Y
$02:C118  99 FC 17      STA.W $17FC,Y               ; /
$02:C11B  A9 7F         LDA.B #$7F                  ; Timer = $7F
$02:C11D  99 50 18      STA.W $1850,Y               ; Store minor extended sprite timer
$02:C120  A9 FA         LDA.B #$FA                  ; Y speed = $FA (float up)
$02:C122  99 2C 18      STA.W $182C,Y               ; Store Y speed
$02:C125  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:C126  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:C128  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; |
$02:C12A  10 01         BPL $C12D             ; |
$02:C12C  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:C12D  98            TYA                          ; } Sprite direction = 1 if X speed negative else 0
$02:C12E  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:C131  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C132..C136: Data: Diggin Chuck phase durations ;;;
{

;;; $C13A: Diggin Chuck: dig and throw rocks ;;;
{
;; Chuck state 4 (sprite 0x46 only). Cycles through 4 digging phases, timed by $C132; every 4th cycle pauses for $40 frames, otherwise throws a rock.
;; [$1534] = phase counter, [$1540] = phase timer, [$1558] = rock throw pause, [$151C] = head frame, [$1602] = body frame.
$02:C13A  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; [$1558] = pause timer
$02:C13D  F0 17         BEQ $C156             ; Zero: run the normal cycle
$02:C13F  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; Last frame of the pause?
$02:C141  D0 0D         BNE $C150             ; No: just face forward
$02:C143  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:C145  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Pause over: [$1540] = $30
$02:C148  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:C14A  9D 34 15      STA.W $1534,X               ; / Phase [$1534] = 4
$02:C14D  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; Animation index [$1570] = 0
$02:C150  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C152  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; / Head frame [$151C] = 2 (looking front)
$02:C155  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C156  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = phase timer
$02:C159  D0 26         BNE $C181             ; Still running
$02:C15B  FE 34 15      INC.W $1534,X               ; Next phase
$02:C15E  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; Phase
$02:C161  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Phase mod 4
$02:C163  9D 70 15      STA.W $1570,X               ; [$1570] = animation index
$02:C166  A8            TAY                          ; Y = index
$02:C167  B9 32 C1      LDA.W $C132,Y         ; Duration for this phase
$02:C16A  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Start phase timer
$02:C16D  C0 01         CPY.B #$01                  ; Phase 1 (the throwing phase)?
$02:C16F  D0 10         BNE $C181             ; No: skip
$02:C171  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:C174  29 0C         AND.B #$0C                  ; } Every 4th cycle: long pause
$02:C176  D0 06         BNE $C17E             ; /
$02:C178  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:C17A  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; / [$1558] = $40
$02:C17D  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C17E  20 9A C1      JSR.W $C19A           ; Otherwise throw a rock
$02:C181  BC 70 15      LDY.W $1570,X               ; Y = animation index
$02:C184  B9 36 C1      LDA.W $C136,Y         ; Body frame for this phase
$02:C187  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set the body frame
$02:C18A  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = direction
$02:C18D  B9 F3 C1      LDA.W $C1F3,Y         ; Head frame by direction
$02:C190  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Set the head frame
$02:C193  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C19A: Spawn Diggin Chuck rock ;;;
{
;; Spawns sprite 0x48 (Diggin Chuck rock) in front of the Chuck, thrown up and forward.
;; Returns: nothing; returns without effect if there is no free sprite slot.
;; Called by: $02:C17E (Diggin Chuck: dig and throw rocks)
$02:C19A  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot (Y)
$02:C19E  30 52         BMI $C1F2            ; None: return
$02:C1A0  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \

$02:C1B1  85 00         STA $00                     ; |

$02:C1B6  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:C1B8  DA            PHX                          ; Save Chuck index
$02:C1B9  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite
$02:C1BA  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise sprite tables
$02:C1BE  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; X = direction
$02:C1C0  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:C1C2  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C1C3  7D 94 C1      ADC.W $C194,X         ; } Rock X low = Chuck X + offset
$02:C1C6  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; /
$02:C1C9  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:C1CB  7D 96 C1      ADC.W $C196,X         ; } Rock X high
$02:C1CE  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; /
$02:C1D1  BD 98 C1      LDA.W $C198,X         ; Rock X speed by direction
$02:C1D4  99 B6 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y    ; Store X speed
$02:C1D7  FA            PLX                          ; Restore Chuck index
$02:C1D8  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:C1DA  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C1DB  69 0A         ADC.B #$0A                  ; |
$02:C1DD  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; |
$02:C1E0  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:C1E3  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Rock Y = Chuck Y + $0A (16-bit)
$02:C1E5  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; /
$02:C1E8  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:C1EA  99 AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y    ; / Y speed = $C0 (thrown up)
$02:C1ED  A9 2C         LDA.B #$2C                  ; \
$02:C1EF  99 40 15      STA.W $1540,Y               ; / Timer [$1540] = $2C
$02:C1F2  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

{

;;; $C1F5: Chuck main routine (ChucksMain) ;;;
{
;; Shared by all Chuck sprites (0x46, 0x91-0x95, 0x97-0x99). Sets the data bank to $02, runs the main code and arms the [$163E] timer when [$187B] changes from 0 to non-zero.
;; [$187B] appears to be the charging flag (Chargin Chuck sets it when it starts running at Mario); [$163E] is probably a charge-start timer.
;; Called by: $01:8806 (Diggin' Chuck (DigginChuck)), $01:886A (Chargin' Chuck and variants (Chucks))
$02:C1F5  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:C1F6  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:C1F7  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = $02
$02:C1F8  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; Remember [$187B] before the update
$02:C1FB  48            PHA                          ; On the stack
$02:C1FC  20 2C C2      JSR.W $C22C           ; Run the Chuck code
$02:C1FF  68            PLA                          ; A = old [$187B]
$02:C200  D0 0F         BNE $C211             ; Was non-zero: done
$02:C202  DD 7B 18      CMP.W $187B,X               ; Still zero?
$02:C205  F0 0A         BEQ $C211             ; Yes: done
$02:C207  BD 3E 16      LDA.W $163E,X               ; [$163E] timer
$02:C20A  D0 05         BNE $C211             ; Already running: done
$02:C20C  A9 28         LDA.B #$28                  ; \
$02:C20E  9D 3E 16      STA.W $163E,X               ; / [$163E] = $28
$02:C211  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:C212  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $C213..C213: Data: dying Chuck head frames ;;;
{
$02:C213                .db $01,$02,$03,$02         ; Head frames 1,2,3,2 (wobble)

}

;;; $C217: Chuck not alive: animate and draw ;;;
{
;; Used when the status is not 8 (stunned, killed by star, etc.): cycles the head frame with [RAM_FrameCounterB] and draws.
$02:C217  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C219  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C21A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C21B  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = ([$14] >> 2) & 3
$02:C21D  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C21E  B9 13 C2      LDA.W $C213,Y         ; Head frame
$02:C221  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Set head frame
$02:C224  20 1A C8      JSR.W $C81A           ; Draw the Chuck
$02:C227  60            RTS                          ; Return


}
