;;; $C22C: Chuck: physics and state dispatch ;;;
{
;; Main per-frame code for a living Chuck: pose overrides, drawing, Mario/sprite interaction, wall and block collisions (a charging Chuck shatters turn blocks),
;; gravity with water and air limits, then runs the Chuck state routine through ChuckPtrs.
;; If the status is not 8 it jumps to the dying code at $02C217.
;; Called by: $02:C1FC (Chuck main routine (ChucksMain))
$02:C22C  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; Sprite status
$02:C22F  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; 8 = normal?
$02:C231  D0 E4         BNE $C217             ; No: dying code
$02:C233  BD AC 15      LDA.W $15AC,X               ; [$15AC] = head turn / look timer
$02:C236  F0 05         BEQ $C23D             ; Zero: skip
$02:C238  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:C23A  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Body frame = 5
$02:C23D  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C240  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C242  D0 0F         BNE $C253             ; /
$02:C244  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed
$02:C246  10 0B         BPL $C253             ; Falling: skip
$02:C248  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State
$02:C24A  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; State >= 5: skip
$02:C24C  B0 05         BCS $C253
$02:C24E  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:C250  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Rising in the air: body frame = 6 (jump)
$02:C253  20 1A C8      JSR.W $C81A           ; Draw the Chuck
$02:C256  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:C258  F0 01         BEQ $C25B             ; No: continue
$02:C25A  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C25B  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:C25E  20 9D C7      JSR.W $C79D           ; Mario contact (stomp / hurt / fireball)
$02:C261  22 32 80 01   JSL.L SprSprInteract        ; Sprite-sprite interaction
$02:C265  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Object interaction
$02:C269  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C26C  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; } Hit a ceiling?
$02:C26E  F0 04         BEQ $C274             ; /
$02:C270  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:C272  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $10 (bump down)
$02:C274  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C277  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Touching a wall?
$02:C279  F0 79         BEQ $C2F4             ; /
$02:C27B  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:C27E  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } Off-screen?
$02:C281  D0 61         BNE $C2E4             ; /
$02:C283  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; [$187B] = charging flag
$02:C286  F0 5C         BEQ $C2E4             ; Not charging: no block breaking
$02:C288  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:C28A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:C28B  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:C28D  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C28E  69 14         ADC.B #$14                  ; |
$02:C290  C9 1C         CMP.B #$1C                  ; } Skip if the Chuck is near the left edge of the screen
$02:C292  90 50         BCC $C2E4             ; /
$02:C294  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C297  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; } Skip if the object contact flag $40 is set
$02:C299  D0 49         BNE $C2E4             ; /
$02:C29B  AD A7 18      LDA.W $18A7                 ; [$18A7] = tile number touched
$02:C29E  C9 2E         CMP.B #$2E                  ; $2E (turn block)?
$02:C2A0  F0 04         BEQ $C2A6             ; Yes: break it
$02:C2A2  C9 1E         CMP.B #$1E                  ; $1E?
$02:C2A4  D0 3E         BNE $C2E4             ; Neither: no breaking
$02:C2A6  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C2A9  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on the ground: skip breaking
$02:C2AB  F0 4A         BEQ $C2F7             ; /
$02:C2AD  A5 9B         LDA RAM_BlockXHi            ; \
$02:C2AF  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:C2B0  A5 9A         LDA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:C2B2  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:C2B3  A5 99         LDA RAM_BlockYHi            ; |
$02:C2B5  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:C2B6  A5 98         LDA RAM_BlockYLo            ; } Save block X/Y position
$02:C2B8  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:C2B9  22 63 86 02   JSL.L ShatterBlock          ; Shatter the block
$02:C2BD  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C2BF  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = $02 (empty)
$02:C2C1  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Place the tile
$02:C2C5  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:C2C6  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:C2C7  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:C2C9  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:C2CB  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:C2CC  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Block Y = saved Y - $10 (block above)
$02:C2CE  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:C2D0  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:C2D1  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:C2D3  68            PLA                          ; } Restore block X
$02:C2D4  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:C2D6  22 63 86 02   JSL.L ShatterBlock          ; Shatter the block above
$02:C2DA  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C2DC  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = $02 (empty)
$02:C2DE  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Place the tile
$02:C2E2  80 10         BRA $C2F4             ; Move on

$02:C2E4  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C2E7  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Blocked by a wall: on the ground?
$02:C2E9  F0 0C         BEQ $C2F7             ; /
$02:C2EB  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:C2ED  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Jump over it: Y speed = $C0
$02:C2EF  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Move up
$02:C2F2  80 0D         BRA $C301             ; Skip the X update

$02:C2F4  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Apply X speed to X position
$02:C2F7  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C2FA  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C2FC  F0 03         BEQ $C301             ; /
$02:C2FE  20 79 C5      JSR.W $C579           ; Stop: clear X and Y speed (state code sets X speed each frame)
$02:C301  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$02:C304  BC 4A 16      LDY.W $164A,X               ; [$164A] = in water
$02:C307  C0 01         CPY.B #$01                  ; Carry = in water (>= 1)
$02:C309  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0 (air)
$02:C30B  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed
$02:C30D  90 0B         BCC $C31A             ; Not in water: skip
$02:C30F  C8            INY                          ; Y = 1 (water)
$02:C310  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; Y speed negative?
$02:C312  10 06         BPL $C31A             ; No: skip
$02:C314  C9 E0         CMP.B #$E0                  ; Limit upward speed to $E0 in water
$02:C316  B0 02         BCS $C31A             ; Already above: ok
$02:C318  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; Cap at $E0
$02:C31A  18            CLC                          ; Gravity: Y speed += $C22A[Y]
$02:C31B  79 2A C2      ADC.W $C22A,Y         ; Add gravity
$02:C31E  30 08         BMI $C328             ; Still negative: store
$02:C320  D9 28 C2      CMP.W $C228,Y         ; Compare with max fall speed
$02:C323  90 03         BCC $C328             ; Below max: store
$02:C325  B9 28 C2      LDA.W $C228,Y         ; Cap at the max fall speed
$02:C328  A8            TAY                          ; Y = new speed (set N)
$02:C329  30 09         BMI $C334             ; Negative: store
$02:C32B  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State
$02:C32D  C0 07         CPY.B #$07                  ; State 7?
$02:C32F  D0 03         BNE $C334             ; No: store
$02:C331  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:C332  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; / State 7: extra gravity +3
$02:C334  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Store Y speed
$02:C336  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = state
$02:C338  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run the Chuck state routine

}

;;; $C33C: Pointer table: Chuck states (ChuckPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Indexed by [RAM_SpriteState]. Names are inferred from the code and are tentative.
;; Followed by the code of state 0B: body frame 3, and when in water with Mario within $30 pixels vertically switches to state 0C; then faces Mario.
$02:C33C  3B C6         .dw $C63B             ; 00: idle, watch for Mario (Chargin Chuck)
$02:C33E  A7 C6         .dw $C6A7             ; 01: run left/right, charging when [$187B] is set
$02:C340  26 C7         .dw $C726             ; 02: short pause before charging
$02:C342  4A C7         .dw $C74A             ; 03: intro pose when a Diggin Chuck changes into a Chargin Chuck
$02:C344  3A C1         .dw $C13A             ; 04: Diggin Chuck (dig, throw rocks)
$02:C346  82 C5         .dw $C582             ; 05: Splittin Chuck: wait, then spawn two clones
$02:C348  3C C5         .dw $C53C             ; 06: jumping / landing
$02:C34A  64 C5         .dw $C564             ; 07: land and stand still
$02:C34C  E3 C4         .dw $C4E3             ; 08: jumping hops (Bouncin Chuck, probably)
$02:C34E  BD C4         .dw $C4BD             ; 09: Clappin Chuck
$02:C350  CB C3         .dw $C3CB             ; 0A: Pitchin Chuck (throws baseballs)
$02:C352  56 C3         .dw $C356             ; 0B: stand and face Mario
$02:C354  7B C3         .dw $C37B             ; 0C: Whistlin Chuck

$02:C356  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; Body frame = 3
$02:C358  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set it
$02:C35B  BD 4A 16      LDA.W $164A,X               ; [$164A] = in water
$02:C35E  F0 10         BEQ $C370             ; Zero: just face Mario
$02:C360  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; $0F = distance to Mario
$02:C363  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; A = $0F
$02:C365  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:C366  69 30         ADC.B #$30                  ; A = distance + $30
$02:C368  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; Within $30?
$02:C36A  B0 04         BCS $C370             ; No: skip
$02:C36C  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:C36E  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = $0C
$02:C370  4C 56 C5      JMP.W $C556           ; Face Mario ($C556)


}

;;; $C373..C373: Data: Whistlin Chuck head frames ;;;
{
$02:C373                .db $05,$05,$05,$02,$02,$06,$06,$06 ; Head frames for the whistle animation

}

;;; $C37B: Chuck state 0C: Whistlin Chuck ;;;
{
;; Plays sound $1E every $40 frames, animates body and head, and sets [$18FD] = 9 (which wakes Rip Van Fish) and, when bit 4 of sprite X is set, sprite generator number [RAM_GeneratorNum] = 9.
$02:C37B  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C37D  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:C37F  D0 05         BNE $C386             ; |
$02:C381  A9 1E         LDA.B #$1E                  ; } Every 64 frames: whistle sound ($1E)
$02:C383  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; /
$02:C386  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: body frame
$02:C388  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; [$14] & $30
$02:C38A  29 30         AND.B #$30                  ; Zero: frame 3
$02:C38C  F0 02         BEQ $C390             ; Branch
$02:C38E  A0 06         LDY.B #$06                  ; Otherwise frame 6
$02:C390  98            TYA                          ; A = frame
$02:C391  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set body frame
$02:C394  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C396  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C397  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C398  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; } Y = ([$14] >> 2) & 7
$02:C39A  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C39B  B9 73 C3      LDA.W $C373,Y         ; Head frame
$02:C39E  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Set head frame
$02:C3A1  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:C3A3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C3A4  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C3A5  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C3A6  4A            LSR                          ; } Carry = bit 4 of sprite X position
$02:C3A7  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:C3A8  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; A = 9 (carry unchanged)
$02:C3AA  90 03         BCC $C3AF             ; Carry clear: skip generator
$02:C3AC  8D B9 18      STA.W RAM_GeneratorNum      ; Set sprite generator = 9
$02:C3AF  8D FD 18      STA.W $18FD                 ; [$18FD] = 9
$02:C3B2  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C3B3..C3C3: Data: Pitchin Chuck tables ;;;
{
$02:C3B3                .db $7F,$BF,$FF,$DF         ; Throw timer reload by [$187B]

$02:C3B7                .db $18,$19,$14,$14         ; Body frames for the throw wind-up

$02:C3BB                .db $18,$18,$18,$18,$17,$17,$17,$17 ; Body frames for the post-throw phase (16 entries)
$02:C3C3                .db $17,$17,$16,$15,$15,$16,$16,$16 ; continued

}

;;; $C3CB: Chuck state 0A: Pitchin Chuck ;;;
{
;; Two modes selected by [$1534]. Mode 0: if Mario is above ($0E in $D0..$FF) the Chuck jumps ([$1540] = $3E, [$1534] = 1); otherwise winds up and throws baseballs
;; with $C466. Mode 1: ascent and descent animation, throwing at the top of the jump. Timers: [$1540] animation/throw, [$1558] throw cooldown.
$02:C3CB  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; Mode
$02:C3CE  D0 6A         BNE $C43A             ; Non-zero: jump mode
$02:C3D0  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; $0E = vertical distance to Mario
$02:C3D3  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; A = $0E
$02:C3D5  10 10         BPL $C3E7             ; Positive (Mario below): skip
$02:C3D7  C9 D0         CMP.B #$D0                  ; Too far above: skip
$02:C3D9  B0 0C         BCS $C3E7             ; Skip
$02:C3DB  A9 C8         LDA.B #$C8                  ; \
$02:C3DD  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Mario above: jump, Y speed = $C8
$02:C3DF  A9 3E         LDA.B #$3E                  ; \
$02:C3E1  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $3E
$02:C3E4  FE 34 15      INC.W $1534,X               ; Mode = 1
$02:C3E7  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:C3E9  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; } Every 8th frame: lengthen [$1540]
$02:C3EB  D0 08         BNE $C3F5             ; /
$02:C3ED  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]
$02:C3F0  F0 03         BEQ $C3F5             ; Zero: skip
$02:C3F2  FE 40 15      INC.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]++
$02:C3F5  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C3F7  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; } Every 64 frames: turn to face Mario
$02:C3F9  D0 03         BNE $C3FE             ; /
$02:C3FB  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario
$02:C3FE  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]
$02:C401  D0 09         BNE $C40C             ; Running: continue
$02:C403  BC 7B 18      LDY.W $187B,X               ; Y = [$187B]
$02:C406  B9 B3 C3      LDA.W $C3B3,Y         ; Reload timer from table
$02:C409  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Store timer
$02:C40C  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]
$02:C40F  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; >= $40?
$02:C411  B0 06         BCS $C419             ; Yes: wind-up
$02:C413  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:C415  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Idle: body frame 0
$02:C418  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C419  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:C41A  E9 40         SBC.B #$40                  ; |
$02:C41C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C41D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C41E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C41F  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:C421  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:C422  B9 B7 C3      LDA.W $C3B7,Y         ; } Body frame = $C3B7[(([$1540] - $40) >> 3) & 3]
$02:C425  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; /
$02:C428  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]
$02:C42B  29 1F         AND.B #$1F                  ; Low 5 bits
$02:C42D  C9 06         CMP.B #$06                  ; Equal to 6?
$02:C42F  D0 08         BNE $C439            ; No: return
$02:C431  20 66 C4      JSR.W $C466           ; Throw a baseball
$02:C434  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:C436  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; / Throw cooldown [$1558] = 8
$02:C439  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C43A  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] (jump mode)
$02:C43D  F0 1D         BEQ $C45C             ; Zero: end jump mode
$02:C43F  48            PHA                          ; Save timer
$02:C440  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; $20 <= timer < $30?
$02:C442  90 06         BCC $C44A             ; No
$02:C444  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; Compare
$02:C446  B0 02         BCS $C44A             ; No
$02:C448  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Hover: Y speed = 0
$02:C44A  4A            LSR                          ; Index = timer >> 2
$02:C44B  4A            LSR                          ; Index
$02:C44C  A8            TAY                          ; Y = index
$02:C44D  B9 BB C3      LDA.W $C3BB,Y         ; Body frame from table
$02:C450  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set body frame
$02:C453  68            PLA                          ; Restore timer
$02:C454  C9 26         CMP.B #$26                  ; Timer = $26?
$02:C456  D0 03         BNE $C45B            ; No: return
$02:C458  20 66 C4      JSR.W $C466           ; Throw a baseball
$02:C45B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C45C  9E 34 15      STZ.W $1534,X               ; Mode = 0
$02:C45F  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C460: Data: baseball spawn offsets (BaseballTileDispX) ;;;
{
$02:C460                .db $10,$F8                 ; Baseball X offset low: +$10 / -$08

$02:C462                .db $00,$FF                 ; Baseball X offset high: $00 / $FF

}

;;; $C464: Spawn baseball extended sprite (BaseballSpeed) ;;;
{
;; Spawns extended sprite 0x0D (baseball) beside the Pitchin Chuck, thrown in its facing direction. BaseballSpeed: +$18 / -$18.
;; Returns: nothing; returns early if [$1558] is non-zero, the Chuck is off-screen vertically, or no free extended sprite slot.
$02:C464                .db $18,$E8                 ; Baseball X speed: +$18 / -$18

$02:C466  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; \
$02:C469  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } Return if cooldown running or off-screen
$02:C46C  D0 CB         BNE $C439            ; /
$02:C46E  A0 07         LDY.B #$07                  ; Y = 7: search 8 extended sprite slots
$02:C470  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; Extended sprite number
$02:C473  F0 04         BEQ $C479             ; Free: use it
$02:C475  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:C476  10 F8         BPL $C470             ; Loop
$02:C478  60            RTS                          ; No free slot: return

$02:C479  A9 0D         LDA.B #$0D                  ; \
$02:C47B  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; / Extended sprite = $0D (baseball)
$02:C47E  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:C480  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:C482  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } $00/$01 = Chuck X position
$02:C485  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:C487  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:C489  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C48A  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:C48C  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; |
$02:C48F  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:C492  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Baseball Y = Chuck Y
$02:C494  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; /
$02:C497  DA            PHX                          ; Save Chuck index
$02:C498  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:C49B  AA            TAX                          ; / X = Chuck direction
$02:C49C  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:C49E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C49F  7D 60 C4      ADC.W BaseballTileDispX,X   ; |
$02:C4A2  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; |
$02:C4A5  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:C4A7  7D 62 C4      ADC.W $C462,X         ; } Baseball X = Chuck X + offset
$02:C4AA  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; /
$02:C4AD  BD 64 C4      LDA.W BaseballSpeed,X       ; \
$02:C4B0  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / Baseball X speed by direction
$02:C4B3  FA            PLX                          ; Restore Chuck index
$02:C4B4  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C4B5..C4B5: Data: Clappin Chuck frames ;;;
{
$02:C4B5                .db $00,$00,$11,$11,$11,$11,$00,$00 ; Body frames while clapping, by (counter >> 2)

}

;;; $C4BD: Chuck states 09, 08, 06, 07 and helpers ;;;
{
;; Counter = (8 * X + [$13]) & $7F, so each Chuck is out of phase. At 0 it faces Mario and calls $CBB3 (probably the clap effect); below $20 it plays $C4B5 body frames.
;; $02C4BD state 09 (Clappin Chuck): counter = (8 * X + [$13]) & $7F so each Chuck is out of phase. At 0 it faces Mario and calls $CBB3 (probably the clap effect); below $20 it plays $C4B5 frames.
;; $02C4E3 state 08 (hopping): hops towards Mario with sounds $19/$08. $02C53C state 06: land, stop, then state 07. $02C556: face Mario, set head frame. $02C564 state 07: wait, then state 05. $02C579: clear X and Y speed.
$02:C4BD  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X
$02:C4C0  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:C4C1  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:C4C2  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:C4C3  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:C4C4  65 13         ADC RAM_FrameCounter        ; } A = (X * 8 + [$13]) & $7F
$02:C4C6  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; /
$02:C4C8  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; Zero?
$02:C4CA  D0 09         BNE $C4D5             ; No: skip
$02:C4CC  48            PHA                          ; Save counter
$02:C4CD  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario
$02:C4D0  22 B3 CB 03   JSL.L $CBB3           ; Clap effect (probably)
$02:C4D4  68            PLA                          ; Restore counter
$02:C4D5  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; >= $20?
$02:C4D7  B0 09         BCS $C4E2            ; Yes: done
$02:C4D9  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:C4DA  4A            LSR                          ; } Index = counter >> 2
$02:C4DB  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C4DC  B9 B5 C4      LDA.W $C4B5,Y         ; Frame from table
$02:C4DF  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set frame
$02:C4E2  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C4E3  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario
$02:C4E6  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; A = 6: jumping frame
$02:C4E8  B4 AA         LDY RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y = Y speed
$02:C4EA  C0 F0         CPY.B #$F0                  ; Rising fast (< $F0)?
$02:C4EC  30 16         BMI $C504             ; Yes: use frame 6
$02:C4EE  BC 0E 16      LDY.W $160E,X               ; [$160E] = jump flag
$02:C4F1  F0 11         BEQ $C504             ; Zero: frame 6
$02:C4F3  BD E2 1F      LDA.W $1FE2,X               ; [$1FE2] = sound cooldown
$02:C4F6  D0 0A         BNE $C502             ; Running: skip sound
$02:C4F8  A9 19         LDA.B #$19                  ; \
$02:C4FA  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound $19
$02:C4FD  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:C4FF  9D E2 1F      STA.W $1FE2,X               ; / Cooldown [$1FE2] = $20
$02:C502  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; A = 7: falling frame
$02:C504  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set body frame
$02:C507  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C50A  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C50C  F0 2D         BEQ $C53B            ; /
$02:C50E  9E 0E 16      STZ.W $160E,X               ; Clear jump flag
$02:C511  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:C513  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Landed: body frame 4
$02:C516  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = hop delay
$02:C519  D0 20         BNE $C53B            ; Running: return
$02:C51B  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:C51D  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Hop delay = $20
$02:C520  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:C522  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $F0 (small hop)
$02:C524  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; $0E = vertical distance to Mario
$02:C527  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; A = $0E
$02:C529  10 10         BPL $C53B            ; Mario below: return
$02:C52B  C9 D0         CMP.B #$D0                  ; Too far above: return
$02:C52D  B0 0C         BCS $C53B            ; Return
$02:C52F  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:C531  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Mario above: high jump, Y speed = $C0
$02:C533  FE 0E 16      INC.W $160E,X               ; Set jump flag
$02:C536  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:C538  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound 8
$02:C53B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C53C  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:C53E  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Body frame = 6
$02:C541  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C544  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C546  F0 0D         BEQ $C555            ; /
$02:C548  20 79 C5      JSR.W $C579           ; Stop moving
$02:C54B  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario
$02:C54E  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:C550  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = 8
$02:C553  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:C555  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C556  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; $0F / Y = side of Mario
$02:C559  98            TYA                          ; A = side
$02:C55A  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction = side
$02:C55D  B9 39 C6      LDA.W $C639,Y         ; Head frame for that direction
$02:C560  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Set head frame
$02:C563  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C564  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C566  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Body frame = 3
$02:C569  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540]
$02:C56C  D0 0B         BNE $C579             ; Running: stop moving
$02:C56E  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C571  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } On the ground?
$02:C573  F0 08         BEQ $C57D            ; /
$02:C575  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:C577  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / Done waiting: state = 5
$02:C579  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed = 0
$02:C57B  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = 0
$02:C57D  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C57E..C580: Data: Splittin Chuck clone speeds ;;;
{
$02:C57E                .db $10,$F0                 ; Clone X speed: +$10 / -$10

$02:C580                .db $20,$E0                 ; Jump X speed: +$20 / -$20

}

;;; $C582: Chuck state 5: split or hop at Mario ;;;
{
;; State 5 handler. Faces Mario. Timer [$1540] = 0: if Mario is within $50 pixels horizontally start a $40 frame countdown, else hop every 64 frames.
;; Countdown reaches 1: Bouncin' Chuck ($93) jumps toward Mario (state 6); any other Chuck splits: spawns two Chargin' Chucks ($91) that fly apart.
;; Also holds $C628 (starts the head turn timer [$15AC] = 8) as a tail.
$02:C582  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario: [dir] = side Mario is on, head pose = looking that way
$02:C585  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = state timer [$1540]
$02:C588  F0 78         BEQ $C602             ; Timer = 0: go wait for Mario to come close
$02:C58A  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; Timer = 1: time to act, otherwise keep shaking
$02:C58C  D0 6E         BNE $C5FC             ; Timer >= 2: just show the pose 9 animation
$02:C58E  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:C590  C9 93         CMP.B #$93                  ; } Sprite $93 (Bouncin' Chuck)? If not, go split
$02:C592  D0 13         BNE $C5A7             ; /
$02:C594  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Y = side Mario is on (SubHorizPos)
$02:C597  B9 80 C5      LDA.W $C580,Y         ; Bouncin' Chuck: X speed = $20 or $E0 by direction
$02:C59A  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store as sprite X speed
$02:C59C  A9 B0         LDA.B #$B0                  ; \
$02:C59E  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $B0 (jump up)
$02:C5A0  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:C5A2  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = 6 (in the air, landing handler)
$02:C5A4  4C 36 C5      JMP.W $C536           ; Play jump sound and return ($C536)

$02:C5A7  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0 (look around)
$02:C5A9  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:C5AB  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $50
$02:C5AE  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:C5B0  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect $10
$02:C5B3  9C 5E 18      STZ.W $185E                 ; Clone index [$185E] = 0 (clone to the right)
$02:C5B6  20 BC C5      JSR.W $C5BC           ; Spawn clone 0
$02:C5B9  EE 5E 18      INC.W $185E                 ; Clone index = 1 (clone to the left), fall into spawn code again
$02:C5BC  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot (Y = slot, N = none)
$02:C5C0  30 3A         BMI $C5FC             ; No free slot: skip to the pose
$02:C5C2  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:C5C4  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Clone status = 8 (normal)
$02:C5C7  A9 91         LDA.B #$91                  ; \
$02:C5C9  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Clone sprite number = $91 (Chargin' Chuck)
$02:C5CC  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:C5CE  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; / Clone X position low = this Chuck's
$02:C5D1  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:C5D4  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; / Clone X position high = this Chuck's
$02:C5D7  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:C5D9  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; / Clone Y position low = this Chuck's
$02:C5DC  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:C5DF  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; / Clone Y position high = this Chuck's
$02:C5E2  DA            PHX                          ; Save this Chuck's index
$02:C5E3  BB            TYX                          ; X = clone slot
$02:C5E4  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialize the clone's sprite tables
$02:C5E8  AE 5E 18      LDX.W $185E                 ; X = clone index [$185E]
$02:C5EB  BD 7E C5      LDA.W $C57E,X         ; \
$02:C5EE  99 B6 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedX,Y    ; / Clone X speed = $10 or $F0 (flies apart)
$02:C5F1  FA            PLX                          ; Restore this Chuck's index
$02:C5F2  A9 C8         LDA.B #$C8                  ; \
$02:C5F4  99 AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y    ; / Clone Y speed = $C8 (hops up)
$02:C5F7  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:C5F9  99 40 15      STA.W $1540,Y               ; / Clone timer = $50
$02:C5FC  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:C5FE  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Pose = 9 (crouching/splitting)
$02:C601  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C602  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Timer 0: face Mario (Y = side Mario is on)
$02:C605  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:C606  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Sprite direction = that side
$02:C609  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:C60B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C60C  69 50         ADC.B #$50                  ; } Is Mario within $50 pixels horizontally? ([$0F] + $50 < $A0)
$02:C60E  C9 A0         CMP.B #$A0                  ; /
$02:C610  B0 06         BCS $C618             ; No: go and hop around
$02:C612  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:C614  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Yes: start the $40 frame countdown before acting
$02:C617  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C618  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C61A  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Pose = 3 (standing)
$02:C61D  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:C61F  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; } Every 64 frames...
$02:C621  D0 04         BNE $C627            ; /
$02:C623  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:C625  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / ...hop: Y speed = $E0
$02:C627  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C628  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; Start head turn timer
$02:C62A  9D AC 15      STA.W $15AC,X               ; Turn timer [$15AC] = 8 (pose 5 is shown while non-zero)
$02:C62D  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C62E..C636: Table: head pose by look-around step ;;;
{
$02:C62E                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$02,$03,$04 ; Head pose by look-around step [$1594] = 0..$A: 0,0,0,0,1,2,3,4
$02:C636                .db $04,$04,$04             ; Steps $8-$A: 4,4,4 (head fully turned)

}

;;; $C639..C639: Table: head pose by direction ;;;
{
$02:C639                .db $00,$04                 ; Head pose for direction: 0 = right, 4 = left

}

;;; $C63B: Chuck state 0: look around for Mario ;;;
{
;; State 0 handler. Every 16 timer frames checks whether Mario is within $28 pixels vertically; if so faces him, sets [$187B] and enters state 2.
;; Falls into $C668 when no Mario seen, which animates the head scan and turns the Chuck around when the timer ends.
$02:C63B  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C63D  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Pose = 3 (standing)
$02:C640  9E 7B 18      STZ.W $187B,X               ; [$187B] = 0 (not charging)
$02:C643  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:C646  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } Every 16 frames of the timer, check for Mario
$02:C648  D0 1E         BNE $C668             ; /
$02:C64A  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; Vertical distance to Mario into [$0E]
$02:C64D  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:C64F  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C650  69 28         ADC.B #$28                  ; |
$02:C652  C9 50         CMP.B #$50                  ; } Mario within $28 pixels vertically? If not, keep looking around
$02:C654  B0 12         BCS $C668             ; /
$02:C656  20 56 C5      JSR.W $C556           ; Face Mario
$02:C659  FE 7B 18      INC.W $187B,X               ; [$187B]++ (has seen Mario, will charge)
$02:C65C  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; State = 2 (pause before charging)
$02:C65E  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Store state
$02:C660  A9 18         LDA.B #$18                  ; \
$02:C662  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $18
$02:C665  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C666..C666: Table: head scan step delta ;;;
{
$02:C666                .db $01,$FF                 ; Look-around step delta: +1, -1

}

;;; $C668: Chuck head scan and turn around ;;;
{
;; Timer 0: flips direction and enters state 2 (pause). Otherwise every 4th frame steps head pose index [$1594] up and down 0..$0A and sets head pose [$151C].
$02:C668  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = 0?
$02:C66B  D0 0A         BNE $C677             ; No: go animate the head
$02:C66D  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:C670  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Yes: turn around (flip direction)
$02:C672  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:C675  80 E5         BRA $C65C             ; Then pause (state 2)

$02:C677  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C679  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Only advance the head scan every 4th frame
$02:C67B  D0 14         BNE $C691             ; /
$02:C67D  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:C680  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Y = scan direction bit [$1534] & 1
$02:C682  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C683  BD 94 15      LDA.W $1594,X               ; \
$02:C686  18            CLC                          ; } Step [$1594] += +1 or -1
$02:C687  79 66 C6      ADC.W $C666,Y         ; /
$02:C68A  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:C68C  B0 0D         BCS $C69B             ; / Went past 0..$A? Reverse the scan direction
$02:C68E  9D 94 15      STA.W $1594,X               ; Store the new scan step
$02:C691  BC 94 15      LDY.W $1594,X               ; Y = scan step
$02:C694  B9 2E C6      LDA.W $C62E,Y         ; Head pose = table by step
$02:C697  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Store head pose [$151C]
$02:C69A  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C69B  FE 34 15      INC.W $1534,X               ; Reverse scan direction: [$1534]++
$02:C69E  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C69F..C6A3: Tables: Chuck walk speeds and poses ;;;
{
$02:C69F                .db $10,$F0,$18,$E8         ; X speeds: $10 / $F0 walk (right/left), $18 / $E8 charge

$02:C6A3                .db $12,$13,$12,$13         ; Walking/charging poses, alternate $12 and $13

}

;;; $C6A7: Chuck state 1: walk and charge ;;;
{
;; State 1 handler. Walks or charges at Mario. If Mario is within $30 pixels vertically and the Chuck faces him, sets timer and charge flag [$187B] = $20.
;; Timer 0: back to state 0 with a random $40-$7F timer. Charging uses faster speed ($18/$E8), plays a footstep sound every 8 frames, and animates poses $12/$13.
;; Quirk: the first lines are dead code, and $C6B5 (play sound $24) is unreachable.
$02:C6A7  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C6AA  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Dead check: is Chuck on the ground? (result unused)
$02:C6AC  F0 0C         BEQ $C6BA             ; /
$02:C6AE  BD 3E 16      LDA.W $163E,X               ; \
$02:C6B1  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; } Dead: compare [$163E] with 1 (result unused), always continue
$02:C6B3  80 05         BRA $C6BA             ; /

$02:C6B5  A9 24         LDA.B #$24                  ; \
$02:C6B7  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Unused: play sound effect $24
$02:C6BA  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; Vertical distance to Mario into [$0E]
$02:C6BD  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:C6BF  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:C6C0  69 30         ADC.B #$30                  ; |
$02:C6C2  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; } Mario within $30 pixels vertically?
$02:C6C4  B0 11         BCS $C6D7             ; /
$02:C6C6  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Y = side Mario is on
$02:C6C9  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:C6CA  DD 7C 15      CMP.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; } Is Chuck already facing Mario? If not, no charge
$02:C6CD  D0 08         BNE $C6D7             ; /
$02:C6CF  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:C6D1  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $20 (charge time)
$02:C6D4  9D 7B 18      STA.W $187B,X               ; [$187B] = $20 (charging)
$02:C6D7  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:C6DA  D0 10         BNE $C6EC             ; / Timer 0: go on, else keep walking
$02:C6DC  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0 (look around)
$02:C6DE  20 28 C6      JSR.W $C628           ; Start head turn timer
$02:C6E1  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:C6E5  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:C6E7  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; } Timer = random $40-$7F
$02:C6E9  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; /
$02:C6EC  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = direction
$02:C6EF  B9 39 C6      LDA.W $C639,Y         ; \
$02:C6F2  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; / Head pose = table by direction
$02:C6F5  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:C6F8  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on ground: skip speed changes
$02:C6FA  F0 17         BEQ $C713             ; /
$02:C6FC  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; \
$02:C6FF  F0 0D         BEQ $C70E             ; / Walking (not charging)? Use slow speeds
$02:C701  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C703  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; } Charging: every 8 frames...
$02:C705  D0 05         BNE $C70C             ; /
$02:C707  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:C709  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / ...play footstep sound effect 1
$02:C70C  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:C70D  C8            INY                          ; / Y += 2: pick the fast charge speeds
$02:C70E  B9 9F C6      LDA.W $C69F,Y         ; \
$02:C711  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = table by direction/charge
$02:C713  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; A = frame counter
$02:C715  BC 7B 18      LDY.W $187B,X               ; \
$02:C718  D0 01         BNE $C71B             ; / Y = charging flag
$02:C71A  4A            LSR                          ; Walking: extra shift, so animation is slower
$02:C71B  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:C71C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / Frame index 0-3
$02:C71E  A8            TAY                          ; \
$02:C71F  B9 A3 C6      LDA.W $C6A3,Y         ; / Pose = $12 or $13 by frame
$02:C722  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store pose
$02:C725  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C726  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C728  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Pose = 3 (standing)
$02:C72B  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = 0?
$02:C72E  D0 0C         BNE $C73C            ; No: keep waiting
$02:C730  20 28 C6      JSR.W $C628           ; Start head turn timer
$02:C733  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:C735  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = 1 (walk/charge)
$02:C737  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:C739  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $40

;;; $C74A: Chuck state 3: hurt after stomp ;;;
{
;; Plays a 6-step hurt animation ([$1570] = step, pose from table, step time in [$1540]).
;; When it ends: Whistlin' Chuck ($94) goes to state $C; Diggin' Chuck ($46) becomes Chargin' Chuck ($91); others go to state 2 with timer $30, charge flag set, facing Mario.
$02:C74A  BC 70 15      LDY.W $1570,X               ; Y = animation step [$1570]
$02:C74D  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = 0?
$02:C750  D0 0E         BNE $C760             ; No: just show the pose
$02:C752  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:C755  C8            INY                          ; / Next step: [$1570]++, Y++
$02:C756  C0 07         CPY.B #$07                  ; \
$02:C758  F0 1D         BEQ $C777             ; / Step 7 reached: hurt animation is over
$02:C75A  B9 43 C7      LDA.W $C743,Y         ; \
$02:C75D  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = step duration
$02:C760  B9 3D C7      LDA.W $C73D,Y         ; \
$02:C763  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Pose = hurt pose by step
$02:C766  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Head pose 2 (front)
$02:C768  C0 05         CPY.B #$05                  ; \
$02:C76A  D0 07         BNE $C773             ; / Step 5: use a blinking head pose
$02:C76C  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:C76E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C76F  EA            NOP                          ; |
$02:C770  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; } Head pose 1 or 3 by frame counter
$02:C772  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:C773  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Store head pose
$02:C776  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C777  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:C779  C9 94         CMP.B #$94                  ; } Whistlin' Chuck ($94)? Go back to its own state
$02:C77B  F0 17         BEQ $C794             ; /
$02:C77D  C9 46         CMP.B #$46                  ; \
$02:C77F  D0 04         BNE $C785             ; / Diggin' Chuck ($46)?
$02:C781  A9 91         LDA.B #$91                  ; \
$02:C783  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Yes: it becomes a Chargin' Chuck ($91)
$02:C785  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:C787  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $30
$02:C78A  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C78C  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = 2 (pause, then charge)
$02:C78E  FE 7B 18      INC.W $187B,X               ; [$187B]++ (angry, will charge)
$02:C791  4C 56 C5      JMP.W $C556           ; Face Mario and return

$02:C794  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:C796  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / Whistlin' Chuck: state = $C
$02:C798  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $C79D: Chuck: interact with Mario ;;;
{
;; Skipped while contact cooldown [$1564] is non-zero. Touching with star power kills the Chuck (status 2, points).
;; Stomp (Mario well above): cooldown 5, bounce Mario, count stomps in [$1528]; 3rd stomp kills it, otherwise enters hurt state 3 and pushes Mario away.
;; Side contact: hurts Mario unless riding Yoshi.
;; Called by: $02:C25E (Chuck: physics and state dispatch)
$02:C79D  BD 64 15      LDA.W $1564,X               ; Contact cooldown [$1564] non-zero: no interaction
$02:C7A0  D0 6D         BNE $C80F            ; Return
$02:C7A2  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Check contact with Mario (carry set = touching)
$02:C7A6  90 67         BCC $C80F            ; Not touching: return
$02:C7A8  AD 90 14      LDA.W $1490                 ; \
$02:C7AB  F0 17         BEQ $C7C4             ; / Mario has star power? If not, go on
$02:C7AD  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:C7AF  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Death Y speed = $D0 (pops up)
$02:C7B1  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed = 0
$02:C7B3  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C7B5  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Status = 2 (killed)
$02:C7B8  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C7BA  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect 3
$02:C7BD  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C7BF  22 E5 AC 02   JSL.L GivePoints            ; / Give points (index 3)
$02:C7C3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C7C4  20 0C D5      JSR.W $D50C           ; Vertical distance to Mario into [$0E]
$02:C7C7  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \
$02:C7C9  C9 EC         CMP.B #$EC                  ; } Mario not high enough above Chuck? Then hurt Mario
$02:C7CB  10 43         BPL $C810             ; /
$02:C7CD  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:C7CF  9D 64 15      STA.W $1564,X               ; / Contact cooldown = 5
$02:C7D2  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C7D4  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play sound effect 2 (stomp)
$02:C7D7  22 99 AB 01   JSL.L DisplayContactGfx     ; Show contact star
$02:C7DB  22 33 AA 01   JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed       ; Bounce Mario up
$02:C7DF  9E 3E 16      STZ.W $163E,X               ; Clear [$163E]
$02:C7E2  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:C7E4  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; } Already hurt (state 3)? Do not count the stomp
$02:C7E6  F0 27         BEQ $C80F            ; /
$02:C7E8  FE 28 15      INC.W $1528,X               ; Stomp count [$1528]++
$02:C7EB  BD 28 15      LDA.W $1528,X               ; \
$02:C7EE  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; } Stomped 3 times? If not, go to the hurt state
$02:C7F0  90 04         BCC $C7F6             ; /
$02:C7F2  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = 0
$02:C7F4  80 BB         BRA $C7B1             ; Kill the Chuck (as with star)

$02:C7F6  A9 28         LDA.B #$28                  ; \
$02:C7F8  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $28
$02:C7FB  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C7FD  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = 3 (hurt)
$02:C7FF  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:C801  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = 3
$02:C804  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; Hurt animation step [$1570] = 0
$02:C807  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Y = side Mario is on
$02:C80A  B9 9B C7      LDA.W $C79B,Y         ; \
$02:C80D  85 7B         STA RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; / Push Mario away: X speed = $20 or $E0
$02:C80F  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C810  AD 7A 18      LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; Mario riding Yoshi?
$02:C813  D0 04         BNE $C819            ; Yes: no damage
$02:C815  22 B7 F5 00   JSL.L HurtMario             ; Hurt Mario
$02:C819  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:C81A  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; GetDrawInfo: $00/$01 = screen X/Y
$02:C81D  20 8C C8      JSR.W $C88C           ; Draw head
$02:C820  20 27 CA      JSR.W $CA27           ; Draw body (two tiles)
$02:C823  20 9D CA      JSR.W $CA9D           ; Draw arms or extra tiles by pose
$02:C826  20 A1 CB      JSR.W $CBA1           ; Draw Diggin' Chuck shovel
$02:C829  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Y = $FF: tile sizes already set
$02:C82B  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:C82D  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; / 5 tiles; finish OAM and return


}

;;; $C87E: Chuck graphics: head tiles and routine (ChuckHeadTiles) ;;;
{
;; Chuck GFX routine at $C81A: GetDrawInfo2, then head, body, arms/extra tiles and shovel; finishes with 5 tiles, sizes already set.
;; Head ($C88C): pose [$1602] chooses offset and OAM slot, head pose [$151C] chooses tile ($06,$0A,$0E,$0A,$06,$4B,$4B) and X-flip.
;; Pose 9 (splitting): head raised by ([$1540]-$20)>>5 and 1 pixel X shake.
;; Tile and flip tables for the head are at the start of this section.
$02:C87E                .db $06,$0A,$0E,$0A,$06,$4B,$4B ; Head tile by head pose [$151C]: $06,$0A,$0E,$0A,$06,$4B,$4B

$02:C885                .db $40,$40,$00,$00,$00,$00,$40 ; Head X-flip by head pose: $40 for poses 0, 1 and 6

$02:C88C  64 07         STZ $07                     ; [$07] = 0 (no vertical shift)
$02:C88E  BC 02 16      LDY.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:C891  84 04         STY $04                     ; / Y = pose [$1602], copy to [$04]
$02:C893  C0 09         CPY.B #$09                  ; \
$02:C895  18            CLC                          ; } Pose 9 (splitting)? If not, no shake
$02:C896  D0 13         BNE $C8AB             ; /
$02:C898  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:C89B  38            SEC                          ; } A = timer - $20
$02:C89C  E9 20         SBC.B #$20                  ; /
$02:C89E  90 0B         BCC $C8AB             ; Timer below $20: no shake
$02:C8A0  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:C8A1  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:C8A2  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C8A3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C8A4  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C8A5  4A            LSR                          ; } [$07] = A >> 5: head raised as the timer runs down
$02:C8A6  85 07         STA $07                     ; /
$02:C8A8  68            PLA                          ; Get A back
$02:C8A9  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:C8AA  4A            LSR                          ; / A >> 2, carry = X shake bit
$02:C8AB  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:C8AD  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } X position += carry (1 pixel shake)
$02:C8AF  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:C8B1  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:C8B4  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = head pose
$02:C8B6  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:C8B9  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = direction
$02:C8BB  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:C8BE  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } [$08] = palette | priority [$64]
$02:C8C0  85 08         STA $08                     ; /
$02:C8C2  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:C8C5  85 05         STA $05                     ; / [$05] = sprite OAM index
$02:C8C7  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:C8C8  79 64 C8      ADC.W $C864,Y         ; } Y = OAM slot for the head, by pose
$02:C8CB  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C8CC  A6 04         LDX $04                     ; \
$02:C8CE  BD 30 C8      LDA.W $C830,X         ; / A = head X offset for this pose
$02:C8D1  A6 03         LDX $03                     ; \
$02:C8D3  D0 03         BNE $C8D8             ; |
$02:C8D5  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; } Facing right: negate the offset
$02:C8D7  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:C8D8  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:C8D9  65 00         ADC $00                     ; } OAM X = sprite X + offset
$02:C8DB  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:C8DE  A6 04         LDX $04                     ; \
$02:C8E0  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:C8E2  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite Y + head Y offset
$02:C8E3  7D 4A C8      ADC.W $C84A,X         ; /
$02:C8E6  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:C8E7  E5 07         SBC $07                     ; } OAM Y = A - [$07]
$02:C8E9  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:C8EC  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; \
$02:C8EE  BD 85 C8      LDA.W $C885,X         ; } Properties = head flip | [$08]
$02:C8F1  05 08         ORA $08                     ; /
$02:C8F3  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Store OAM properties
$02:C8F6  BD 7E C8      LDA.W ChuckHeadTiles,X      ; \
$02:C8F9  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = head tile by head pose
$02:C8FC  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:C8FD  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:C8FE  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4 (size table index)
$02:C8FF  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:C900  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:C902  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Tile size = 2 (16x16)
$02:C905  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:C908  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:C9FB                .db $00,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02,$02 ; Body tile 1 size, poses $08-$0F
$02:CA03                .db $02,$00,$02,$02,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Body tile 1 size, poses $10-$17
$02:CA0B                .db $00,$00                 ; Body tile 1 size, poses $18-$19

$02:CA0D                .db $00,$00,$00,$04,$04,$04,$0C,$0C ; Body OAM slot offset by pose $00-$07
$02:CA15                .db $00,$08,$00,$00,$04,$04,$04,$04 ; Body OAM slot offset, poses $08-$0F

$02:CA49  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \

$02:CA4C  7D 3D C9      ADC.W $C93D,X         ; /
$02:CA4F  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; Store tile 2 X
$02:CA52  A6 04         LDX $04                     ; X = pose
$02:CA54  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CA56  18            CLC                          ; } A = Y + tile 1 Y offset
$02:CA57  7D 71 C9      ADC.W $C971,X         ; /
$02:CA5A  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store tile 1 Y
$02:CA5D  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CA5F  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; / Tile 2 Y = sprite Y
$02:CA62  BD 8B C9      LDA.W ChuckBody1,X          ; \
$02:CA65  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile 1 = body tile 1 by pose
$02:CA68  BD A5 C9      LDA.W ChuckBody2,X          ; \
$02:CA6B  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; / Tile 2 = body tile 2 by pose
$02:CA6E  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:CA70  05 06         ORA $06                     ; } A = palette | flip, saved for tile 2
$02:CA72  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:CA73  5D BF C9      EOR.W $C9BF,X         ; \
$02:CA76  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Tile 1 properties = A EOR flip bits (may read past the table)
$02:CA79  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:CA7A  5D D9 C9      EOR.W $C9D9,X         ; } Tile 2 properties = A EOR flip bits (may read past the table)
$02:CA7D  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; /
$02:CA80  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CA81  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CA82  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:CA83  A8            TAY                          ; /

;;; $CA97: Chuck arm tiles for poses 6-7 (ClappinChuckTiles) ;;;
{
;; Raised hands tiles ($0C and $44). Routine $CA9D draws extra tiles by pose: poses 6-7 two hand tiles (second X-flipped), $12-$13 the tile pair at $CAFC, $14+ the held tile at $CB53.
$02:CA97                .db $0C,$44                 ; Raised hands tile: $0C, $44

$02:CA99                .db $F8,$F0                 ; Raised hands Y offset: $F8, $F0

$02:CA9B                .db $00,$02                 ; Raised hands tile size: 0 (8x8), 2 (16x16)

$02:CA9D  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:CA9F  C9 14         CMP.B #$14                  ; / Pose $14 or higher?
$02:CAA1  90 03         BCC $CAA6             ; No: check the other poses
$02:CAA3  4C 53 CB      JMP.W $CB53           ; Yes: draw the held tile ($CB53)

$02:CAA6  C9 12         CMP.B #$12                  ; \
$02:CAA8  F0 52         BEQ $CAFC             ; / Pose $12: draw the tile pair
$02:CAAA  C9 13         CMP.B #$13                  ; \
$02:CAAC  F0 4E         BEQ $CAFC             ; / Pose $13: draw the tile pair
$02:CAAE  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:CAAF  E9 06         SBC.B #$06                  ; / A = pose - 6
$02:CAB1  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; \
$02:CAB3  B0 44         BCS $CAF9            ; / Not pose 6 or 7: nothing more to draw
$02:CAB5  AA            TAX                          ; X = 0 or 1
$02:CAB6  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; Y = OAM index of the first slot
$02:CAB8  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CABA  18            CLC                          ; } A = X + tile 1 X offset
$02:CABB  7D 93 CA      ADC.W $CA93,X         ; /
$02:CABE  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store tile 1 X
$02:CAC1  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CAC3  18            CLC                          ; } A = X + tile 2 X offset
$02:CAC4  7D 95 CA      ADC.W $CA95,X         ; /
$02:CAC7  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; Store tile 2 X
$02:CACA  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CACC  18            CLC                          ; } A = Y + Y offset
$02:CACD  7D 99 CA      ADC.W $CA99,X         ; /
$02:CAD0  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store tile 1 Y
$02:CAD3  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Tile 2 Y = same
$02:CAD6  BD 97 CA      LDA.W ClappinChuckTiles,X   ; \
$02:CAD9  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile 1 = raised hand tile
$02:CADC  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Tile 2 = same tile
$02:CADF  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:CAE1  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Tile 1 properties = [$08]
$02:CAE4  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:CAE6  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Tile 2 properties = [$08] X-flipped
$02:CAE9  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CAEA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CAEB  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:CAEC  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:CAED  BD 9B CA      LDA.W $CA9B,X         ; \
$02:CAF0  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Tile 1 size by pose
$02:CAF3  99 61 04      STA.W $0461,Y               ; Tile 2 size = same
$02:CAF6  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:CAF9  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $CAFA: Chuck extra tile pair (poses $12, $13) (ChuckGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Draws two 8x8 tiles ($1C, $1D) side by side, 8 pixels above sprite Y, for the run poses $12 and $13. Properties by direction at the start.
$02:CAFA                .db $47,$07                 ; Properties by direction: $47 (right), $07 (left)

$02:CAFC  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; Y = OAM index of the first slot
$02:CAFE  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:CB01  DA            PHX                          ; } X = direction (A saved on stack)
$02:CB02  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CB03  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:CB04  0A            ASL                          ; } A = direction * 8
$02:CB05  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:CB06  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:CB07  49 08         EOR.B #$08                  ; |
$02:CB09  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CB0A  65 00         ADC $00                     ; } Tile 1 X = sprite X + ((direction * 8) EOR 8)
$02:CB0C  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:CB0F  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:CB10  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CB11  65 00         ADC $00                     ; } Tile 2 X = sprite X + direction * 8
$02:CB13  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; /
$02:CB16  A9 1C         LDA.B #$1C                  ; \
$02:CB18  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile 1 = $1C
$02:CB1B  1A            INC A                       ; \
$02:CB1C  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; / Tile 2 = $1D
$02:CB1F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CB21  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:CB22  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; } Tile 1 Y = sprite Y - 8
$02:CB24  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:CB27  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Tile 2 Y = same
$02:CB2A  BD FA CA      LDA.W ChuckGfxProp,X        ; \
$02:CB2D  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Tile 1 properties = by direction | priority
$02:CB2F  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:CB32  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; Tile 2 properties = same
$02:CB35  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CB36  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CB37  4A            LSR                          ; } X = OAM index / 4
$02:CB38  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CB39  9E 60 04      STZ.W OAM_TileSize,X        ; Tile 1 size = 8x8
$02:CB3C  9E 61 04      STZ.W $0461,X               ; Tile 2 size = 8x8
$02:CB3F  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:CB40  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $CB53: Chuck held tile (poses $14-$19) ;;;
{
;; Draws one 8x8 tile ($AD) beside the Chuck for poses $14-$19, if the Y offset for the pose is not 0.
;; The table is addressed as CODE_02CB2D+pose (X offsets) and CODE_02CB39+pose (Y offsets), which land on $CB41 for pose $14.
;; Called by: $02:CAA3 (Chuck arm tiles for poses 6-7 (ClappinChuckTiles))
$02:CB53  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:CB54  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = pose
$02:CB56  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:CB59  D0 03         BNE $CB5E             ; / Facing left? Use the first half of the table
$02:CB5B  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CB5C  69 06         ADC.B #$06                  ; / Facing right: index + 6
$02:CB5E  AA            TAX                          ; X = X offset table index
$02:CB5F  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:CB61  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CB62  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Y = OAM index + 8 (third slot)
$02:CB64  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:CB65  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CB67  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite X + X offset
$02:CB68  7D 2D CB      ADC.W $CB2D,X         ; /
$02:CB6B  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store tile X
$02:CB6E  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; \
$02:CB70  BD 39 CB      LDA.W $CB39,X         ; / A = Y offset by pose
$02:CB73  F0 19         BEQ $CB8E             ; 0: no tile for this pose
$02:CB75  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CB76  65 01         ADC $01                     ; } Store tile Y = sprite Y + offset
$02:CB78  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:CB7B  A9 AD         LDA.B #$AD                  ; \
$02:CB7D  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = $AD
$02:CB80  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:CB82  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Properties = $09 | priority
$02:CB84  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:CB87  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CB88  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CB89  4A            LSR                          ; } X = OAM index / 4
$02:CB8A  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CB8B  9E 60 04      STZ.W OAM_TileSize,X        ; Tile size = 8x8
$02:CB8E  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:CB8F  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $CB9E: Diggin' Chuck shovel graphics (DigChuckTileSize) ;;;
{
;; Tile sizes table, then $CBA1: for sprite $46 only, draws a shovel tile in the 4th OAM slot. Pose 5 uses shovel index 1; poses $0E+ use pose - $0E; other poses draw nothing.
$02:CB9E                .db $00,$02,$02             ; Shovel tile sizes: 0, 2, 2

$02:CBA1  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:CBA3  C9 46         CMP.B #$46                  ; / Sprite $46 (Diggin' Chuck)?
$02:CBA5  D0 54         BNE $CBFB            ; No: nothing to draw
$02:CBA7  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:CBAA  C9 05         CMP.B #$05                  ; / Pose 5?
$02:CBAC  D0 04         BNE $CBB2             ; Other poses: go on
$02:CBAE  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:CBB0  80 07         BRA $CBB9             ; / Pose 5: shovel index 1

$02:CBB2  C9 0E         CMP.B #$0E                  ; \
$02:CBB4  90 45         BCC $CBFB            ; / Poses below $0E: nothing to draw
$02:CBB6  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:CBB7  E9 0E         SBC.B #$0E                  ; / Shovel index = pose - $0E
$02:CBB9  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = shovel index
$02:CBBB  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:CBBE  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CBBF  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; } Y = OAM index + $0C (fourth slot)
$02:CBC1  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:CBC2  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:CBC3  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:CBC5  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:CBC6  1D 7C 15      ORA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; } X = shovel index * 2 + direction
$02:CBC9  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CBCA  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CBCC  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite X + X offset
$02:CBCD  7D 90 CB      ADC.W DigChuckTileDispX,X   ; /
$02:CBD0  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store tile X
$02:CBD3  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:CBD4  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } X = direction bit
$02:CBD6  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CBD7  BD 96 CB      LDA.W DigChuckTileProp,X    ; \
$02:CBDA  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Properties = by direction | priority
$02:CBDC  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:CBDF  A6 02         LDX $02                     ; X = shovel index
$02:CBE1  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CBE3  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite Y + Y offset
$02:CBE4  7D 98 CB      ADC.W DigChuckTileDispY,X   ; /
$02:CBE7  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store tile Y
$02:CBEA  BD 9B CB      LDA.W DigChuckTiles,X       ; \
$02:CBED  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = shovel tile
$02:CBF0  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CBF1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CBF2  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4
$02:CBF3  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:CBF4  BD 9E CB      LDA.W DigChuckTileSize,X    ; \
$02:CBF7  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Tile size by index
$02:CBFA  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:CBFB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:CBFC  60            RTS                          ; Return (unused)

$02:CBFD  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

}

;;; $CBFE: Unused. Winged cage main (WingedCageMain) ;;;
{
;; Main routine of an unused sprite: a flying cage that keeps Mario inside a $90 x $60 box.
;; Draws the wings, sets BG3 scroll from the cage position, moves the cage by [$17BD]/[$17BC], moves Mario along when [$18B5] is set, then clamps Mario to the cage walls, ceiling and floor.
;; Standing on the floor sets [$1471] and [$18B5]. Returns early while a Mario animation is playing.
;; Called by: $01:887F (Unused. Winged cage (WingedCage))
$02:CBFE  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:CC00  D0 03         BNE $CC05             ; / If sprites are not locked...
$02:CC02  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; ...increment the cage frame counter [$1570]
$02:CC05  20 B9 CC      JSR.W $CCB9           ; Draw the cage wings
$02:CC08  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:CC09  22 32 FF 00   JSL.L $FF32           ; Set BG3 scroll [$22]/[$24] from the cage position ($FF32)
$02:CC0D  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:CC0E  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:CC10  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite X low + [$17BD] (cage X movement)
$02:CC11  6D BD 17      ADC.W $17BD                 ; /
$02:CC14  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Store X low
$02:CC16  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:CC19  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } X high += carry
$02:CC1B  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; /
$02:CC1E  A5 71         LDA RAM_MarioAnimation      ; \
$02:CC20  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; } Return if a Mario animation is playing
$02:CC22  B0 D9         BCS $CBFD            ; /
$02:CC24  AD B5 18      LDA.W $18B5                 ; \
$02:CC27  F0 04         BEQ $CC2D             ; / Mario inside the cage? ([$18B5])
$02:CC29  22 07 FF 00   JSL.L $FF07           ; Yes: move Mario by the cage movement ($FF07)
$02:CC2D  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0 (sign extension high byte)
$02:CC2F  AD BC 17      LDA.W $17BC                 ; \
$02:CC32  10 01         BPL $CC35             ; / A = [$17BC] (cage Y movement)
$02:CC34  88            DEY                          ; Negative: Y = $FF
$02:CC35  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CC36  75 D8         ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; } Sprite Y low += [$17BC]
$02:CC38  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:CC3A  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CC3B  7D D4 14      ADC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Sprite Y high += sign + carry
$02:CC3E  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:CC41  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:CC43  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:CC45  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } [$00] = sprite X (16 bit)
$02:CC48  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:CC4A  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:CC4C  85 02         STA $02                     ; |
$02:CC4E  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } [$02] = sprite Y (16 bit)
$02:CC51  85 03         STA $03                     ; /
$02:CC53  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A is 16 bit
$02:CC55  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = cage X
$02:CC57  A4 7B         LDY RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; \
$02:CC59  88            DEY                          ; } Mario moving right (speed >= 1)? Go to right wall
$02:CC5A  10 10         BPL $CC6C             ; /
$02:CC5C  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CC5D  69 00 00      ADC.W #$0000                ; } Left wall: cage X + 0 vs Mario X
$02:CC60  C5 94         CMP RAM_MarioXPos           ; /
$02:CC62  90 1B         BCC $CC7F             ; Mario inside: skip
$02:CC64  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; Push Mario to the left wall
$02:CC66  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:CC68  84 7B         STY RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; / Mario X speed = 0
$02:CC6A  80 13         BRA $CC7F             ; Continue with the vertical check

$02:CC6C  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CC6D  69 90 00      ADC.W #$0090                ; } Right wall: cage X + $90 vs Mario X
$02:CC70  C5 94         CMP RAM_MarioXPos           ; /
$02:CC72  B0 0B         BCS $CC7F             ; Mario inside: skip
$02:CC74  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CC76  69 91 00      ADC.W #$0091                ; } Mario X = cage X + $91
$02:CC79  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; /
$02:CC7B  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:CC7D  84 7B         STY RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; / Mario X speed = 0
$02:CC7F  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; A = cage Y
$02:CC81  A4 7D         LDY RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; \
$02:CC83  10 0E         BPL $CC93             ; / Mario moving down or still? Go to the floor
$02:CC85  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CC86  69 20 00      ADC.W #$0020                ; } Ceiling: cage Y + $20 vs Mario Y
$02:CC89  C5 96         CMP RAM_MarioYPos           ; /
$02:CC8B  90 21         BCC $CCAE             ; Below the ceiling: done
$02:CC8D  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:CC8F  84 7D         STY RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; / Hit the ceiling: Mario Y speed = 0
$02:CC91  80 1B         BRA $CCAE             ; Done

$02:CC93  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CC94  69 60 00      ADC.W #$0060                ; } Floor: cage Y + $60 vs Mario Y
$02:CC97  C5 96         CMP RAM_MarioYPos           ; /
$02:CC99  B0 13         BCS $CCAE             ; Above the floor: done
$02:CC9B  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:CC9D  69 61 00      ADC.W #$0061                ; } Mario Y = cage Y + $61 (stand on the floor)
$02:CCA0  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; /
$02:CCA2  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:CCA4  84 7D         STY RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; / Mario Y speed = 0
$02:CCA6  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; \
$02:CCA8  8C 71 14      STY.W $1471                 ; / [$1471] = 1 (Mario standing on a sprite)
$02:CCAB  8C B5 18      STY.W $18B5                 ; [$18B5] = 1 (Mario in the cage)
$02:CCAE  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A is 8 bit
$02:CCB0  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}
