;;; $CCB5: Unused. Draw four wing tile columns (CageWingTileDispY) ;;;
{
;; Unreferenced (reached only from unreachable code at $02CC05). Draws 4 columns of two 8x8 tiles at X offsets $00/$30/$60/$90 from the sprite,
;; alternating tile numbers every 8 frames of [$1570]. The first row of this section is the Y offset table ($F8,$00,$F8,$00).
;; $02CD2D (end of section): long-call wrapper for the Palace Switch routine at $02CD59; called from bank 1.
$02:CCB5                .db $F8,$00,$F8,$00         ; Y offsets per column (4 columns): $F8, $00, $F8, $00

$02:CCB9  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; [$08] = 3: column counter, 4 columns of two tiles
$02:CCBB  85 08         STA $08
$02:CCBD  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:CCBF  38            SEC                          ; }
$02:CCC0  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / [$00] = sprite X position on screen
$02:CCC2  85 00         STA $00
$02:CCC4  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:CCC6  38            SEC                          ; }
$02:CCC7  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / [$01] = sprite Y position on screen
$02:CCC9  85 01         STA $01
$02:CCCB  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = sprite OAM index
$02:CCCE  84 02         STY $02                     ; [$02] = OAM index of the current column
$02:CCD0  A4 02         LDY $02                     ; Y = OAM index of the current column
$02:CCD2  A6 08         LDX $08                     ; X = column number (3..0)
$02:CCD4  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CCD6  18            CLC                          ; }
$02:CCD7  7D B1 CC      ADC.W CageWingTileDispX,X   ; / A = screen X + column X offset (CageWingTileDispX)
$02:CCDA  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Upper tile X position
$02:CCDD  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; Lower tile X position (same as the upper tile)
$02:CCE0  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CCE2  18            CLC                          ; }
$02:CCE3  7D B5 CC      ADC.W CageWingTileDispY,X   ; / A = screen Y + Y offset of this column (CageWingTileDispY)
$02:CCE6  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Upper tile Y position
$02:CCE9  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CCEA  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; / Lower tile is 8 pixels below the upper one
$02:CCEC  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Lower tile Y position
$02:CCEF  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:CCF2  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:CCF5  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CCF6  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CCF7  4A            LSR                          ; } A = [$1570] / 8 (animation frame counter) EOR column, bit 0 picks the wing frame
$02:CCF8  45 08         EOR $08                     ; /
$02:CCFA  4A            LSR                          ; Carry = wing frame bit
$02:CCFB  A9 C6         LDA.B #$C6                  ; Upper tile = $C6 for one frame...
$02:CCFD  90 02         BCC $CD01
$02:CCFF  A9 81         LDA.B #$81                  ; ...or $81 for the other
$02:CD01  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Upper tile number
$02:CD04  A9 D6         LDA.B #$D6                  ; Lower tile = $D6 for one frame...
$02:CD06  90 02         BCC $CD0A
$02:CD08  A9 D7         LDA.B #$D7                  ; ...or $D7 for the other
$02:CD0A  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Lower tile number
$02:CD0D  A9 70         LDA.B #$70                  ; Properties: palette 8, priority 3 ($70)
$02:CD0F  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Upper tile properties
$02:CD12  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; Lower tile properties
$02:CD15  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:CD16  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:CD17  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM index / 4: index into the OAM size table
$02:CD18  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:CD19  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0: 8x8 tiles
$02:CD1B  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Upper tile size = 8x8
$02:CD1E  99 61 04      STA.W $0461,Y               ; Lower tile size = 8x8
$02:CD21  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:CD23  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CD24  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } [$02] += 8: OAM index of the next column
$02:CD26  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:CD28  C6 08         DEC $08                     ; Next column
$02:CD2A  10 A4         BPL $CCD0             ; Loop for all 4 columns
$02:CD2C  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:CD2D  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:CD2E  4B            PHK                          ; }
$02:CD2F  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank ($02), old bank saved
$02:CD30  20 59 CD      JSR.W $CD59           ; Run the Palace Switch routine
$02:CD33  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:CD34  6B            RTL                          ; Return long (JSL from the Palace Switch sprite in bank 1)


}

;;; $CD35..CD55: Table: Palace Switch tile layout ;;;
{
;; Per-tile X offset, Y offset, tile number, properties for the 8 tiles, then the palette bits per switch color ([$191E]).
$02:CD35                .db $00,$08,$10,$18,$00,$08,$10,$18 ; X offsets of the 8 switch tiles
$02:CD3D                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$08,$08,$08,$08 ; Y offsets of the 8 switch tiles
$02:CD45                .db $00,$01,$01,$00,$10,$11,$11,$10 ; Tile numbers of the 8 switch tiles
$02:CD4D                .db $31,$31,$71,$71,$31,$31,$71,$71 ; Properties of the 8 switch tiles (palette 8; $40 = X flip, $30 = priority 3)
$02:CD55                .db $0A,$04,$06,$08         ; Palette bits ORed into the first 4 tiles, one per switch color ([$191E])

}

;;; $CD59: Palace Switch: generate block and draw ;;;
{
;; Main routine of the Palace Switch sprite (called via $CD2D). When timer [$1540] equals $5E it generates block $1B above the switch.
;; Then runs the invisible block routine (so Mario can stand on it) and draws 8 tiles; the first four get the switch color palette from [$191E].
;; Called by: $02:CD30 (Unused. Draw four wing tile columns (CageWingTileDispY))
$02:CD59  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = [$1540] (press animation timer)
$02:CD5C  C9 5E         CMP.B #$5E                  ; Timer = $5E?
$02:CD5E  D0 1F         BNE $CD7F             ; No: skip generating the block
$02:CD60  A9 1B         LDA.B #$1B                  ; \
$02:CD62  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = $1B
$02:CD64  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:CD66  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:CD68  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; |
$02:CD6B  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; } Block X position = sprite X position
$02:CD6D  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:CD6F  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:CD70  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:CD72  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; } Block Y position = sprite Y position - $10
$02:CD74  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:CD77  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:CD79  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:CD7B  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the block (GenerateTile)
$02:CD7F  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Run the invisible solid block routine so Mario can stand on the switch
$02:CD83  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position of the sprite
$02:CD86  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:CD87  AE 1E 19      LDX.W $191E                 ; X = [$191E] (switch color)
$02:CD8A  BD 55 CD      LDA.W $CD55,X         ; A = palette bits for this color
$02:CD8D  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = palette bits
$02:CD8F  A2 07         LDX.B #$07                  ; X = 7: 8 tiles
$02:CD91  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CD93  18            CLC                          ; }
$02:CD94  7D 35 CD      ADC.W $CD35,X         ; / A = screen X + X offset of tile X
$02:CD97  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Tile X position
$02:CD9A  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:CD9C  18            CLC                          ; }
$02:CD9D  7D 3D CD      ADC.W $CD3D,X         ; / A = screen Y + Y offset of tile X
$02:CDA0  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Tile Y position
$02:CDA3  BD 45 CD      LDA.W $CD45,X         ; A = tile number
$02:CDA6  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Tile number
$02:CDA9  BD 4D CD      LDA.W $CD4D,X         ; A = tile properties
$02:CDAC  E0 04         CPX.B #$04                  ; Tile index < 4?
$02:CDAE  B0 02         BCS $CDB2             ; No: keep the table properties
$02:CDB0  05 02         ORA $02                     ; Yes: add the switch color palette bits
$02:CDB2  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Tile properties
$02:CDB5  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:CDB6  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:CDB7  C8            INY                          ; } OAM index += 4
$02:CDB8  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:CDB9  CA            DEX                          ; Next tile
$02:CDBA  10 D5         BPL $CD91             ; Loop for all 8 tiles
$02:CDBC  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:CDBD  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$02:CDBF  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; A = 7: 8 tiles drawn
$02:CDC1  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM ($B7A7)

$02:CDC4  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $CDC5..CDC5: Unused data ;;;
{
$02:CDC5                .db $00,$07,$F9,$00,$01,$FF ; Unreferenced data

}

;;; $CDCB: Wall springboard main (PeaBouncerMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite main routine for the wall springboard (sprites $6B/$6C, called from bank 1). Draws it, then (if sprites are not locked)
;; runs the A-button bounce window ([$1534]) and the state machine in [$1528]: 0 idle, 1 compressing, 2 springing back and oscillating.
;; [$C2] = signed compression amount, [$151C] = target amplitude.
;; Called by: $01:884D (Spring board on wall (Pea Bouncer) (PeaBouncer))
$02:CDCB  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Erase the sprite if it is off screen
$02:CDCE  20 E0 CE      JSR.W $CEE0           ; Draw the sprite
$02:CDD1  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:CDD3  D0 29         BNE $CDFE            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:CDD5  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; A = [$1534] (timer: window in which A gives a higher bounce)
$02:CDD8  F0 17         BEQ $CDF1             ; Timer = 0: skip
$02:CDDA  DE 34 15      DEC.W $1534,X               ; Count the timer down
$02:CDDD  24 15         BIT RAM_ControllerA         ; \
$02:CDDF  10 10         BPL $CDF1             ; / A button (new press) not held: skip
$02:CDE1  9E 34 15      STZ.W $1534,X               ; Clear the timer
$02:CDE4  BC 1C 15      LDY.W $151C,X               ; Y = [$151C] (compression strength)
$02:CDE7  B9 FF CD      LDA.W $CDFF,Y         ; A = bounce speed from table
$02:CDEA  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = bounce speed (extra high jump)
$02:CDEC  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:CDEE  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $08 (spring)
$02:CDF1  BD 28 15      LDA.W $1528,X               ; A = [$1528] (state)
$02:CDF4  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run the state routine

}

;;; $CDF8: Pointer table: wall springboard states (PeaBouncerPtrs) ;;;
{
$02:CDF8  FE CD         .dw $CDFE            ; 0 - Idle
$02:CDFA  0F CE         .dw $CE0F             ; 1 - Compress under Mario
$02:CDFC  3A CE         .dw $CE3A             ; 2 - Spring back and oscillate

$02:CDFE  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $CDFF..CE07: Table: wall springboard bounce speeds ;;;
{
;; First row: Mario Y speed for a boosted bounce (A pressed in time), indexed by [$151C]. Second row: normal bounce speed, indexed by [$C2].
$02:CDFF                .db $B6,$B4,$B0,$A8,$A0,$98,$90,$88 ; Mario Y speed for a high bounce, indexed by [$151C]
$02:CE07                .db $00,$00,$E8,$E0,$D0,$C8,$C0,$B8 ; Mario Y speed for a normal bounce, indexed by [$C2] (compression)

}

;;; $CE0F: Wall springboard state routines ;;;
{
;; $02CE0F: state 1 (compress): [$C2] counts up to [$151C], then holds 8 frames and switches to state 2.
;; $02CE3A: state 2: oscillates [$C2] between +/-[$151C] in steps of 4, reducing the amplitude every 4 frames until it reaches 0 (back to state 0).
;; $02CE8C: unreachable wrapper for the graphics routine.
$02:CE0F  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = [$1540] (hold timer)
$02:CE12  F0 0C         BEQ $CE20             ; Timer = 0: go compress
$02:CE14  3A            DEC A                       ; Count down
$02:CE15  D0 08         BNE $CE1F            ; Not about to end: return
$02:CE17  FE 28 15      INC.W $1528,X               ; State = 2 (spring back)
$02:CE1A  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:CE1C  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction = 1 (start by extending)
$02:CE1F  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE20  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = [$C2] (compression, signed)
$02:CE22  30 05         BMI $CE29             ; Negative: keep compressing
$02:CE24  DD 1C 15      CMP.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:CE27  B0 06         BCS $CE2F             ; / Reached the target [$151C]: go to $02CE2F
$02:CE29  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CE2A  69 01         ADC.B #$01                  ; |
$02:CE2C  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; } [$C2] += 1
$02:CE2E  6B            RTL                          ; / Return

$02:CE2F  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:CE32  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / [$C2] = [$151C]: fully compressed
$02:CE34  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:CE36  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Hold timer [$1540] = 8 frames
$02:CE39  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE3A  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; [$1570]++ (frame counter)
$02:CE3D  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; A = [$1570]
$02:CE40  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; Every 4th frame...
$02:CE42  D0 05         BNE $CE49             ; (other frames skip)
$02:CE44  DE 1C 15      DEC.W $151C,X               ; ...[$151C]-- (damp the oscillation)
$02:CE47  F0 3D         BEQ $CE86             ; Amplitude 0: stop at $02CE86
$02:CE49  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:CE4C  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:CE4E  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:CE4F  85 00         STA $00                     ; } [$00] = -[$151C]: negative amplitude
$02:CE51  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:CE54  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Direction bit 0 set? Then going negative
$02:CE56  D0 18         BNE $CE70             ; Set: go to $02CE70
$02:CE58  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:CE5A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:CE5B  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:CE5D  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; } [$C2] += 4 (moving toward positive amplitude)
$02:CE5F  30 05         BMI $CE66            ; Still negative: return
$02:CE61  DD 1C 15      CMP.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:CE64  B0 01         BCS $CE67             ; / Reached [$151C]: turn around at $02CE67
$02:CE66  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE67  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:CE6A  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / [$C2] = [$151C]
$02:CE6C  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction++ (now going negative)
$02:CE6F  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE70  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:CE72  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:CE73  E9 04         SBC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:CE75  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; } [$C2] -= 4 (moving toward negative amplitude)
$02:CE77  10 04         BPL $CE7D            ; Still positive: return
$02:CE79  C5 00         CMP $00                     ; \
$02:CE7B  90 01         BCC $CE7E             ; / Not yet past -[$151C]: return
$02:CE7D  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE7E  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:CE80  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / [$C2] = -[$151C]
$02:CE82  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction++ (now going positive)
$02:CE85  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE86  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; [$C2] = 0: spring is straight again
$02:CE88  9E 28 15      STZ.W $1528,X               ; State = 0 (idle)
$02:CE8B  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:CE8C  20 E0 CE      JSR.W $CEE0           ; Unused. Wrapper for the graphics routine
$02:CE8F  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $CE90..CEB0: Table: wall springboard piece X offsets ;;;
{
$02:CE90                .db $00,$08,$10,$18,$20,$00,$08,$10 ; X offsets of the 5 coil pieces, indexed by amplitude * 5 + piece
$02:CE98                .db $18,$20,$00,$08,$10,$18,$20,$00
$02:CEA0                .db $08,$10,$18,$1F,$00,$08,$10,$17
$02:CEA8                .db $1E,$00,$08,$0F,$16,$1D,$00,$07
$02:CEB0                .db $0F,$16,$1C,$00,$07,$0E,$15,$1B
}

;;; $CEB8..CED8: Table: wall springboard piece Y offsets ;;;
{
$02:CEB8                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$01 ; Y offsets of the 5 coil pieces, same indexing
$02:CEC0                .db $01,$02,$00,$00,$01,$02,$04,$00
$02:CEC8                .db $01,$02,$04,$06,$00,$01,$03,$06
$02:CED0                .db $08,$00,$02,$04,$08,$0A,$00,$02
$02:CED8                .db $05,$07,$0C,$00,$02,$05,$09,$0E

}

;;; $CEE0: Wall springboard: draw and Mario contact ;;;
{
;; $02CEE0: draws 5 coil pieces (tile $3D). Offsets come from the two tables indexed by |[$C2]| * 5 + piece; mirrored for the other wall and for negative compression.
;; $02CF52: per-piece contact check. If Mario is falling onto the piece, he is placed on top of it, X speed is cleared and the spring starts compressing,
;; or (if already compressed and [$1540] = 1) the bounce speed is applied and the [$1534] boost window opens.
;; Called by: $02:CDCE (Wall springboard main (PeaBouncerMain)), $02:CE8C (Wall springboard state routines)
$02:CEE0  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position of the sprite
$02:CEE3  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:CEE5  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = 4: piece counter, 5 pieces
$02:CEE7  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:CEE9  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:CEEA  E9 6B         SBC.B #$6B                  ; |
$02:CEEC  85 05         STA $05                     ; } [$05] = sprite number - $6B (bit 0 = which wall: mirrors the X offsets)
$02:CEEE  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:CEF0  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = [$C2] (compression, signed)
$02:CEF2  10 03         BPL $CEF7             ; Positive: keep
$02:CEF4  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:CEF6  1A            INC A                       ; / A = |[$C2]|
$02:CEF7  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = |[$C2]|
$02:CEF9  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = sprite OAM index
$02:CEFC  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; A = |[$C2]|
$02:CEFE  0A            ASL                          ; \
$02:CEFF  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:CF00  65 04         ADC $04                     ; |
$02:CF02  65 02         ADC $02                     ; } X = |[$C2]| * 5 + piece number
$02:CF04  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:CF05  A5 05         LDA $05                     ; \
$02:CF07  4A            LSR                          ; / Carry = bit 0 of the sprite number offset
$02:CF08  BD 90 CE      LDA.W $CE90,X         ; A = X offset of this piece
$02:CF0B  90 03         BCC $CF10             ; \
$02:CF0D  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; / Bit 0 set: negate the X offset (mirror)
$02:CF0F  1A            INC A
$02:CF10  85 08         STA $08                     ; [$08] = X offset
$02:CF12  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CF13  65 00         ADC $00                     ; / A = screen X + X offset
$02:CF15  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Piece X position
$02:CF18  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:CF1A  0A            ASL                          ; / Carry = sign of [$C2]
$02:CF1B  BD B8 CE      LDA.W $CEB8,X         ; A = Y offset of this piece
$02:CF1E  90 03         BCC $CF23             ; \
$02:CF20  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; / Negative compression: negate the Y offset
$02:CF22  1A            INC A
$02:CF23  85 09         STA $09                     ; [$09] = Y offset
$02:CF25  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:CF26  65 01         ADC $01                     ; / A = screen Y + Y offset
$02:CF28  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Piece Y position
$02:CF2B  A9 3D         LDA.B #$3D                  ; \
$02:CF2D  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = $3D (spring coil)
$02:CF30  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:CF32  09 0A         ORA.B #$0A                  ; |
$02:CF34  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Properties = [$64] (priority) with palette 5
$02:CF37  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:CF3A  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM index
$02:CF3B  20 52 CF      JSR.W $CF52           ; Check whether Mario stands on this piece
$02:CF3E  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:CF3F  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:CF40  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:CF41  C8            INY                          ; } OAM index += 4
$02:CF42  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:CF43  C6 02         DEC $02                     ; Next piece
$02:CF45  30 03         BMI $CF4A             ; All 5 done: go finish
$02:CF47  4C FC CE      JMP.W $CEFC           ; Loop for the next piece

$02:CF4A  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$02:CF4C  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; A = 4: 5 tiles drawn

{

;; Parameters: X = sprite index; [$03] set by the entry point.
;; Called by: $02:B6A3 (Pokey main routine entry (PokeyMainRt)), $02:B6B7 (Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)), $02:B8A0 (Torpedo Ted main (long wrapper) (TorpedoTedMain)), $02:BFD5 (Rip Van Fish main routine (RipVanFishMain)), $02:C25B (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:CDCB (Wall springboard main (PeaBouncerMain)), $02:D595 (Banzai Bill main), $02:D927 (Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4)), $02:DCC5 (Sumo Bro: main wrapper and state dispatch (SumoBrotherMain)), $02:DFA1 (Volcano Lotus main (VolcanoLotusMain)), $02:E126 (Jumping Piranha Plant main (JumpingPiranhaMain)), $02:E34A (Gas Bubble movement) ...
$02:D025  64 03         STZ $03                     ; [$03] = 0

$02:D02C  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:D02E  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Vertical level?
$02:D030  D0 5F         BNE VerticalLevelBnk2       ; Yes: go to the vertical check
$02:D032  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:D034  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; / [$03] = 4?
$02:D036  F0 15         BEQ $D04D             ; Yes: skip the bottom-of-level check
$02:D038  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:D03A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D03B  69 50         ADC.B #$50                  ; |
$02:D03D  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:D040  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:D042  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; } Sprite Y + $50 as a 16-bit value: >= $200 means below the bottom of the level
$02:D044  10 34         BPL OffScrEraseSprBnk2      ; / Erase the sprite
$02:D046  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; \
$02:D049  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / "Process offscreen" bit of [$167A] set?
$02:D04B  D0 43         BNE $D090            ; Yes: return
$02:D04D  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:D04F  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:D051  05 03         ORA $03                     ; } [$01] = [$13] bit 0 | [$03]: alternates the limit used each frame
$02:D053  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:D055  A8            TAY                          ; Y = table index
$02:D056  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:D058  18            CLC                          ; / A = screen X low + limit low
$02:D059  79 07 D0      ADC.W $D007,Y
$02:D05C  26 00         ROL $00                     ; Rotate carry into [$00]
$02:D05E  D5 E4         CMP RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Compare with sprite X low
$02:D060  08            PHP                          ; Save the result
$02:D061  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; A = screen X high
$02:D063  46 00         LSR $00                     ; Restore carry
$02:D065  79 0F D0      ADC.W $D00F,Y         ; Add high byte limit
$02:D068  28            PLP                          ; Restore the comparison result
$02:D069  FD E0 14      SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Subtract sprite X high
$02:D06C  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = signed distance
$02:D06E  46 01         LSR $01                     ; Test bit 0 of [$01]
$02:D070  90 04         BCC $D076             ; Clear: keep
$02:D072  49 80         EOR.B #$80                  ; Flip the sign (check the other edge)
$02:D074  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = result
$02:D076  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = result
$02:D078  10 16         BPL $D090            ; Positive: on screen, return
}

;;; $D07A: Erase sprite, allow level reload (OffScrEraseSprBnk2) ;;;
{
;; If the sprite status is 8 or more and it came from the level data, clears its load status so it can respawn; then erases it.
;; Called by: $02:D41E (Layer 3 smash: states and Mario collision (Layer3SmashPtrs))
$02:D07A  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; A = sprite status
$02:D07D  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:D07F  90 0C         BCC OffScrKillSprBnk2       ; / Status < 8: erase permanently
$02:D081  BC 1A 16      LDY.W RAM_SprIndexInLvl,X   ; \
$02:D084  C0 FF         CPY.B #$FF                  ; / Sprite not tied to the level data ($FF): erase
$02:D086  F0 05         BEQ OffScrKillSprBnk2       ; /
$02:D088  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:D08A  99 38 19      STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y   ; / Allow the level loader to respawn it
}

;;; $D08D: Erase sprite permanently (OffScrKillSprBnk2) ;;;
{
$02:D08D  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Erase the sprite
$02:D090  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $D091: Off-screen check for vertical levels (VerticalLevelBnk2) ;;;
{
;; Same test as the horizontal version but on Y position, run only every other frame; erases the sprite when too far off screen.
$02:D091  BD 7A 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker167A,X     ; \
$02:D094  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / "Process offscreen" bit set: return
$02:D096  D0 F8         BNE $D090            ; /
$02:D098  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:D09A  4A            LSR                          ; / Return every other frame
$02:D09B  B0 F3         BCS $D090            ; /
$02:D09D  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; \
$02:D09F  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = [$13] bit 1
$02:D0A1  A8            TAY                          ; Y = table index
$02:D0A2  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:D0A4  18            CLC                          ; / A = screen Y low + limit low
$02:D0A5  79 03 D0      ADC.W $D003,Y
$02:D0A8  26 00         ROL $00                     ; Rotate carry into [$00]
$02:D0AA  D5 D8         CMP RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Compare with sprite Y low
$02:D0AC  08            PHP                          ; Save the result
$02:D0AD  AD 1D 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi    ; A = screen Y high
$02:D0B0  46 00         LSR $00                     ; Restore carry
$02:D0B2  79 05 D0      ADC.W $D005,Y         ; Add high byte limit
$02:D0B5  28            PLP                          ; Restore the comparison result
$02:D0B6  FD D4 14      SBC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Subtract sprite Y high
$02:D0B9  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = signed distance
$02:D0BB  A4 01         LDY $01                     ; Y = [$01]
$02:D0BD  F0 04         BEQ $D0C3             ; Zero: keep
$02:D0BF  49 80         EOR.B #$80                  ; Flip the sign (check the other edge)
$02:D0C1  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = result
$02:D0C3  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = result
$02:D0C5  10 C9         BPL $D090            ; Positive: on screen, return
$02:D0C7  30 B1         BMI OffScrEraseSprBnk2      ; Off screen: erase the sprite
}

$02:D19D  BF 9C BA 00   LDA.L $BA9C,X         ; A = Map16 pointer high
$02:D1A1  A4 0F         LDY $0F                     ; Y = [$0F]
$02:D1A3  F0 04         BEQ $D1A9             ; Layer 1: keep
$02:D1A5  BF AC BA 00   LDA.L $BAAC,X         ; Layer 2 table
$02:D1A9  65 02         ADC $02                     ; \
$02:D1AB  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = pointer high
$02:D1AD  A9 7E         LDA.B #$7E                  ; \
$02:D1AF  85 07         STA $07                     ; / [$07] = $7E: Map16 low byte bank
$02:D1B1  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:D1B4  A7 05         LDA [$05]                   ; A = Map16 tile number low byte
$02:D1B6  8D 93 16      STA.W $1693                 ; [$1693] = tile number (low byte)
$02:D1B9  E6 07         INC $07                     ; [$07] = $7F: Map16 high byte bank
$02:D1BB  A7 05         LDA [$05]                   ; A = tile number high byte
$02:D1BD  D0 31         BNE $D1F0            ; Non-zero: return
$02:D1BF  AD 93 16      LDA.W $1693                 ; A = tile number low byte
$02:D1C2  C9 45         CMP.B #$45                  ; \
$02:D1C4  90 2A         BCC $D1F0            ; / Below $45: not a berry, return
$02:D1C6  C9 48         CMP.B #$48                  ; \
$02:D1C8  B0 26         BCS $D1F0            ; / $48 or above: not a berry, return
$02:D1CA  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D1CB  E9 44         SBC.B #$44                  ; / A = berry type 1-3 (tile $45-$47 minus $44)
$02:D1CD  8D D6 18      STA.W $18D6                 ; [$18D6] = berry type being eaten
$02:D1D0  9C A3 14      STZ.W $14A3                 ; [$14A3] = 0

$02:D1DC  A9 22         LDA.B #$22                  ; \

$02:D1E1  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \

$02:D1E4  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; |

$02:D1E8  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; } Mario Y position = (Mario Y + 8) rounded down to a 16 pixel boundary
$02:D1EA  A5 97         LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; |
$02:D1EC  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:D1EE  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; /

{

;;; all.log 02D210..02D287
;;;
;;; Sprite numbers for RAM_SpriteNum:
;;;   $7D P-balloon
;;;   $87 Lakitu cloud
;;;
;;; New labels (not in original all.log):
;;; $D214 => ControlSprCarried
;;; $D21A => CscSlowSpeedX
;;; $D228 => CscGoLeftOrRight
;;; $D238 => CscGoRight
;;; $D241 => CscUnderLimitX
;;; $D247 => CscDecideY
;;; $D25F => CscNotLakituCloud
;;; $D26F => CscHandleY

;; Tables for horizontal movement of the P-balloon or the Lakitu
;; cloud, indexed by Y = 1 (going right) or Y = 2 (going left).
;;
;; ControlSprCarried requires that data bank register = $02
;; because the code uses the 16-bit address of these tables.
;;
;; $D20F,Y = delta for horizontal movement
;; $D20F,1 = +1 to move right
;; $D20F,2 = -1 to move left
;;
;; $D211,Y = horizontal speed limit
;; $D211,1 = +16 when moving right
;; $D211,2 = -16 when moving left
;;
;;; $D20F:   6B            RTL                       ; Return 
}

;;; $D210..D211: Table: balloon/cloud speed deltas and limits ;;;
{
$02:D210                .db $01                     ; Speed change per update: +1
$02:D211                .db $FF,$10,$F0             ; Speed change -1, speed limits +16 and -16

;;; JSL subroutine
;;; precondition that data bank = $02
;;; takes X = index of this (P-balloon or Lakitu cloud) sprite in the common sprite tables in RAM
;;; preserves X
;;;
;;; React to the Control Pad while Mario carries the P-balloon sprite or rides the Lakitu-cloud
;;; sprite. This allows the player to control the P-balloon or the Lakitu cloud.
;;;
;;; This routine increments or decrements the speed of the sprite. The game calls this routine only
;;; when the frame counter is a multiple of four (with the P-balloon, I am not sure with the Lakitu
;;; cloud), so the effect is to increment or decrement the speed for every four frames until the
;;; speed reaches the target speed or the speed limit. If the sprite is over the speed limit (for
;;; example when Mario runs right and grabs a P-balloon), then the sprite gradually slows.
;;;
;;; The routine first considers the horizontal X_speed, then the vertical Y_speed. Finally, the
;;; routine sets the speed of Mario to match the speed of the sprite.
;;;
}

;;; $D214: Control P-balloon / Lakitu cloud with D-pad (ControlSprCarried) ;;;
{
;; Called every few frames. Changes the sprite's X and Y speed from the Control Pad, then copies them to Mario.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index; data bank must be $02.
;; Called by: $01:9FCF (P-balloon: control and position (BalloonActive)), $01:E848 (Lakitu's cloud logic (NoCloudGfx))
$02:D214  A5 15         LDA RAM_ControllerA         ; \
$02:D216  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / A = Control Pad left/right bits
$02:D218  D0 0E         BNE CscGoLeftOrRight        ; Pressing left or right: go to $02D228
;;; Fall through if player not pressing left or right.
;;; Come here if sprite is over horizontal speed limit.
}

;;; $D21A: Move X speed toward zero (CscSlowSpeedX) ;;;
{
$02:D21A  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; A = sprite X speed
$02:D21C  F0 08         BEQ $D226             ; Zero: skip
$02:D21E  10 04         BPL $D224             ; Positive: go decrement
$02:D220  F6 B6         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:D222  F6 B6         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Negative: X speed += 2...
$02:D224  D6 B6         DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; ...then X speed -= 1 (net +1 or -1 toward zero)
$02:D226  80 1F         BRA CscDecideY              ; Go to the vertical speed

}

;;; $D228: Handle left or right pressed (CscGoLeftOrRight) ;;;
{
$02:D228  A8            TAY                          ; Y = Control Pad bits (1 = right, 2 = left)
$02:D229  C0 01         CPY.B #$01                  ; \
$02:D22B  D0 0B         BNE CscGoLeft               ; / Not pressing right: go to $02D238
;; Here Y = 1
$02:D22D  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:D22F  D9 11 D2      CMP.W $D211,Y         ; / Compare X speed with the limit
$02:D232  F0 13         BEQ CscDecideY              ; At the limit: skip
$02:D234  10 E4         BPL CscSlowSpeedX           ; Over the limit: slow down
$02:D236  80 09         BRA CscUnderLimitX          ; Under the limit: speed up

;; Here Y = 2
;; (Y = 3 is impossible from the SNES controller)
}

;;; $D238: Handle left pressed: compare with limit (CscGoRight) ;;;
{
$02:D238  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:D23A  D9 11 D2      CMP.W $D211,Y         ; / Compare X speed with the left limit
$02:D23D  F0 08         BEQ CscDecideY              ; At the limit: skip
$02:D23F  30 D9         BMI CscSlowSpeedX           ; Over the limit: slow down
;; Fall through if >

;; Here Y = 1 (pressing right) or Y = 2 (pressing left)
;; Here A = X_speed
}

;;; $D241: Add speed delta for the direction (CscUnderLimitX) ;;;
{
$02:D241  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D242  79 0F D2      ADC.W $D20F,Y        ; / X speed += delta for the direction
$02:D245  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store the new X speed
;; Fall through to CscDecideY

;; Now consider the vertical speed. Positive speed goes down.
;; First set the Y register to the target speed.
;;
;;                    Down            Neutral         Up
;; Lakitu cloud       Y = +16         Y = 0           Y = -16
;; P-balloon          Y = +8          Y = -8          Y = -16
;;
;; The Lakitu cloud goes up and down as well as it goes left and
;; right, but the P-balloon goes down more slowly. The P-balloon
;; also floats up if the player releases the Control Pad.
;;
}

;;; $D247: Choose target Y speed (CscDecideY) ;;;
{
;; Lakitu cloud: -16 / 0 / +16 for up / neutral / down. P-balloon: -16 up, -8 neutral, +8 down.
$02:D247  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: target Y speed
$02:D249  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:D24B  C9 87         CMP.B #$87                  ; / Lakitu cloud (sprite $87)?
$02:D24D  D0 10         BNE CscNotLakituCloud       ; No: go to the P-balloon code
$02:D24F  A5 15         LDA RAM_ControllerA         ; \
$02:D251  29 0C         AND.B #$0C                  ; / A = Control Pad up/down bits
$02:D253  F0 1A         BEQ CscHandleY              ; Neither: target Y speed 0
$02:D255  A0 10         LDY.B #$10                  ; Y = +16 (down)
$02:D257  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; \
$02:D259  F0 14         BEQ CscHandleY              ; / Down pressed: keep
$02:D25B  A0 F0         LDY.B #$F0                  ; Y = -16 (up)
$02:D25D  80 10         BRA CscHandleY              ; Go set the Y speed

}

;;; $D25F: P-balloon target Y speed (CscNotLakituCloud) ;;;
{
$02:D25F  A0 F8         LDY.B #$F8                  ; Y = -8: P-balloon floats up by default
$02:D261  A5 15         LDA RAM_ControllerA         ; \
$02:D263  29 0C         AND.B #$0C                  ; / A = Control Pad up/down bits
$02:D265  F0 08         BEQ $D26F             ; Neither: keep -8
$02:D267  A0 F0         LDY.B #$F0                  ; Y = -16 (up)
$02:D269  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; \
$02:D26B  D0 02         BNE $D26F             ; / Up pressed: keep
$02:D26D  A0 08         LDY.B #$08                  ; Y = +8 (down)
;; Player pressing down. Fall through

}

;;; $D26F: Move Y speed toward target, copy to Mario (CscHandleY) ;;;
{
$02:D26F  84 00         STY $00                     ; [$00] = target Y speed
$02:D271  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D273  C5 00         CMP $00                     ; / Compare Y speed with the target
$02:D275  F0 08         BEQ $D27F             ; Equal: done
$02:D277  10 04         BPL $D27D             ; Above target: decrement
$02:D279  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D27B  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Below target: Y speed += 2...
$02:D27D  D6 AA         DEC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; ...then Y speed -= 1 (net +1 or -1 toward the target)
$02:D27F  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:D281  85 7B         STA RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; / Mario X speed = sprite X speed
$02:D283  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D285  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; / Mario Y speed = sprite Y speed
$02:D287  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $D288: Update X position without gravity (UpdateXPosNoGrvty) ;;;
{
;; Adds $0C to X so UpdateYPosNoGrvty uses the X speed table, then restores X from [$15E9].
;; Called by: $02:B6D7 (Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)), $02:B8D2 (Torpedo Ted flight movement (TorpedoAccel)), $02:BBA1 (Dolphin main routine (DolphinMain)), $02:BD80 (Urchin states and wall-following movement (UrchinPtrs?)), $02:BE45 (Urchin states and wall-following movement (UrchinPtrs?)), $02:BFF6 (Rip Van Fish main routine (RipVanFishMain)), $02:C2F4 (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:D59C (Banzai Bill main), $02:D92A (Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4)), $02:DBDA (Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform (PutHammerBroOnPlat)), $02:E297 (Directional Coins main (DirectionCoinsMain)), $02:E327 (Gas Bubble movement) ...
$02:D288  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:D289  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D28A  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; } X += $0C: use X speed instead of Y speed tables
$02:D28C  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:D28D  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update position (UpdateYPosNoGrvty)
$02:D290  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:D293  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $D294: Update sprite Y position, no gravity (UpdateYPosNoGrvty) ;;;
{
;; Adds the sprite's Y speed to its Y position: speed/16 whole pixels plus a 4-bit fraction kept in [$14EC+X] (the speed is 1/16 px per frame).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
;; Returns: [$1491] = amount the sprite moved (whole pixels).
;; Also contains an unused routine at $02D2C7 and the 'aim at Mario' routine at $02D2FB (sets [$00] = Y speed, [$01] = X speed pointing at Mario,
;; for a given speed in A, with the longer distance getting the full speed). Nothing calls $02D2FB except the unused code.
;; Called by: $02:B69C (Pokey main routine entry (PokeyMainRt)), $02:B6DA (Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)), $02:B8B0 (Torpedo Ted main (long wrapper) (TorpedoTedMain)), $02:B8D5 (Torpedo Ted flight movement (TorpedoAccel)), $02:BB9E (Dolphin main routine (DolphinMain)), $02:BD83 (Urchin states and wall-following movement (UrchinPtrs?)), $02:BE48 (Urchin states and wall-following movement (UrchinPtrs?)), $02:BFF9 (Rip Van Fish main routine (RipVanFishMain)), $02:C2EF (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:C301 (Chuck: physics and state dispatch), $02:D28D (Update X position without gravity (UpdateXPosNoGrvty)), $02:D44E (Layer 3 smash: states and Mario collision (Layer3SmashPtrs)) ...
$02:D294  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D296  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:D297  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:D298  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:D299  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:D29A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D29B  7D EC 14      ADC.W $14EC,X               ; } Y fraction [$14EC+X] += speed * 16 (carry kept)
$02:D29E  9D EC 14      STA.W $14EC,X               ; /
$02:D2A1  08            PHP                          ; \
$02:D2A2  08            PHP                          ; / Save the fraction carry (twice)
$02:D2A3  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: high byte of the movement
$02:D2A5  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D2A7  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:D2A8  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:D2A9  4A            LSR                          ; } A = sprite Y speed / 16 (whole pixels per frame)
$02:D2AA  4A            LSR                          ; /
$02:D2AB  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:D2AD  90 03         BCC $D2B2             ; |
$02:D2AF  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; } If speed was negative: A |= $F0, Y = $FF (sign extend)
$02:D2B1  88            DEY                          ; /
$02:D2B2  28            PLP                          ; Restore the fraction carry
$02:D2B3  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:D2B4  75 D8         ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:D2B6  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:D2B8  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:D2B9  7D D4 14      ADC.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Sprite Y position (16-bit) += A (sign extended) + carry
$02:D2BC  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:D2BF  68            PLA                          ; A = amount moved (low byte)
$02:D2C0  28            PLP                          ; Restore the fraction carry again
$02:D2C1  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; A += carry
$02:D2C3  8D 91 14      STA.W $1491                 ; [$1491] = amount the sprite moved vertically this frame
$02:D2C6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D2C7  85 00         STA $00                     ; Unused: [$00] = speed (A); Y = sprite to aim from
$02:D2C9  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:D2CB  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:D2CC  A5 95         LDA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; |
$02:D2CE  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:D2CF  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; |
$02:D2D1  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:D2D2  A5 97         LDA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; } Save Mario's 16-bit X and Y position
$02:D2D4  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:D2D5  B9 E4 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; \
$02:D2D8  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; |
$02:D2DA  B9 E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; |
$02:D2DD  85 95         STA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; |
$02:D2DF  B9 D8 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; |
$02:D2E2  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; |
$02:D2E4  B9 D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; } Mario's position = position of sprite Y
$02:D2E7  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; /
$02:D2E9  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = speed
$02:D2EB  20 FB D2      JSR.W $D2FB           ; Aim at Mario ($D2FB) from that position
$02:D2EE  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:D2EF  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; |
$02:D2F1  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:D2F2  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; |
$02:D2F4  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:D2F5  85 95         STA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; |
$02:D2F7  68            PLA                          ; } Restore Mario's position
$02:D2F8  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; /
$02:D2FA  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D2FB  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = speed (travelled along the longer axis)

$02:D302  84 02         STY $02                     ; [$02] = vertical sign (1 = Mario above the sprite)
$02:D304  A5 0E         LDA $0E                     ; \

$02:D308  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:D30A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D30B  69 01         ADC.B #$01                  ; } [$0C] = |[$0E]| (vertical distance)
$02:D30D  85 0C         STA $0C                     ; /
$02:D30F  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; [$0F] = Mario X - sprite X; Y = 1 if negative
$02:D312  84 03         STY $03                     ; [$03] = horizontal sign (1 = Mario left of the sprite)
$02:D314  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:D316  10 05         BPL $D31D             ; |
$02:D318  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:D31A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D31B  69 01         ADC.B #$01                  ; } [$0D] = |[$0F]| (horizontal distance)
$02:D31D  85 0D         STA $0D                     ; /
$02:D31F  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: distances not swapped
$02:D321  A5 0D         LDA $0D                     ; A = horizontal distance
$02:D323  C5 0C         CMP $0C                     ; Horizontal >= vertical?
$02:D325  B0 09         BCS $D330             ; Yes: keep the order

$02:D328  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:D329  A5 0C         LDA $0C                     ; |
$02:D32B  85 0D         STA $0D                     ; |
$02:D32D  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:D32E  85 0C         STA $0C                     ; } Swap [$0C] and [$0D] so that [$0D] is the longer
$02:D330  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0
$02:D332  85 0B         STA $0B                     ; [$0B] = 0 (remainder)
$02:D334  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = 0 (result)
$02:D336  A6 01         LDX $01                     ; X = speed: loop counter
$02:D338  A5 0B         LDA $0B                     ; A = remainder
$02:D33A  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D33B  65 0C         ADC $0C                     ; / remainder += short distance

$02:D34D  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \

$02:D350  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; |
$02:D352  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:D354  68            PLA                          ; } Swap [$00] and [$01]
$02:D355  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:D357  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = Y speed
$02:D359  A4 02         LDY $02                     ; Y = vertical sign
$02:D35B  F0 07         BEQ $D364             ; Mario below: keep it positive
$02:D35D  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \

$02:D36A  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \

$02:D36D  69 01         ADC.B #$01                  ; /

$02:D371  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y

;;; $D378: Get sprite draw info (bank 2) (GetDrawInfo2) ;;;
{
;; Bank 2 copy of GetDrawInfo. Sets the horizontal/vertical offscreen flags and [$15C4,X] (1 = more than $40 px offscreen horizontally),
;; then returns the sprite's position on screen.
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
;; Returns: Y = OAM index of the sprite, [$00] = X on screen, [$01] = Y on screen.
;; Quirk: if the sprite is far offscreen horizontally it pops its own return address and returns to the caller's caller (skips drawing).
;; Called by: $02:8092 (Bob-omb explosion: timer and clipping (ExplodeBombSubRt)), $02:B726 (Pokey: behaviour and drawing (PokeyAlive)), $02:B8F7 (Torpedo Ted graphics (TorpedoGfxRt)), $02:BC1D (Table: dolphin tile 3, then draw dolphin (DolphinTiles3)), $02:BEB5 (Hothead tables and graphics (HotheadTiles)), $02:BF75 (Urchin graphics (UrchinTiles)), $02:C81A (Chuck: interact with Mario), $02:CD83 (Palace Switch: generate block and draw), $02:CEE0 (Wall springboard: draw and Mario contact), $02:D5E4 (Draw Banzai Bill (4x4 tiles) (BanzaiBillTiles)), $02:D813 (Draw ball of ball and chain), $02:D848 (Draw wood platform; signed division helper (WoodPlatformTiles)) ...
$02:D378  9E 6C 18      STZ.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; Clear vertical offscreen flags
$02:D37B  9E A0 15      STZ.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; Clear horizontal offscreen flag
$02:D37E  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = sprite X low
$02:D380  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; Compare with screen X low (carry)
$02:D382  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; A = sprite X high
$02:D385  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; Minus screen X high with borrow
$02:D387  F0 03         BEQ $D38C             ; Same 256 px page as the screen: on screen horizontally
$02:D389  FE A0 15      INC.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; Else horizontal offscreen flag = 1
$02:D38C  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; A = sprite X high
$02:D38F  EB            XBA                          ; Into the high byte of A
$02:D390  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = sprite X low (16-bit sprite X)
$02:D392  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:D394  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D395  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:D397  18            CLC                          ; } A = sprite X - screen X + $40
$02:D398  69 40 00      ADC.W #$0040                ; /
$02:D39B  C9 80 01      CMP.W #$0180                ; Within $0000-$017F, i.e. at most $40 px offscreen?
$02:D39E  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:D3A0  2A            ROL                          ; \
$02:D3A1  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } [$15C4+X] = 1 if farther offscreen than that, else 0
$02:D3A3  9D C4 15      STA.W $15C4,X               ; /
$02:D3A6  D0 3F         BNE $D3E7             ; Far offscreen: return to the caller's caller ($D3E7)
$02:D3A8  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0
$02:D3AA  BD 62 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1662,X     ; A = sprite tweaker [$1662]
$02:D3AD  29 20         AND.B #$20                  ; Bit 5 = tall sprite
$02:D3AF  F0 01         BEQ $D3B2             ; Clear: only test the $0C offset
$02:D3B1  C8            INY                          ; Y = 1: test the $1C offset as well
$02:D3B2  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A = sprite Y low
$02:D3B4  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D3B5  79 74 D3      ADC.W $D374,Y         ; / A += vertical offset [DATA_02D374+Y]
$02:D3B8  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:D3B9  C5 1C         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; Compare with screen Y low
$02:D3BB  26 00         ROL $00                     ; Save the borrow in [$00]
$02:D3BD  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:D3BE  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; A = sprite Y high
$02:D3C1  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; + carry
$02:D3C3  46 00         LSR $00                     ; Restore the borrow
$02:D3C5  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; Minus screen Y high
$02:D3C7  F0 09         BEQ $D3D2             ; Zero: on screen vertically for this offset
$02:D3C9  BD 6C 18      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; A = vertical offscreen flags
$02:D3CC  19 76 D3      ORA.W $D376,Y         ; Set the bit for this offset
$02:D3CF  9D 6C 18      STA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; Store back
$02:D3D2  88            DEY                          ; Next offset
$02:D3D3  10 DD         BPL $D3B2             ; Loop for Y = 1, 0
$02:D3D5  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index of this sprite
$02:D3D8  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = sprite X low
$02:D3DA  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D3DB  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } [$00] = sprite X on screen
$02:D3DD  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:D3DF  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A = sprite Y low
$02:D3E1  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D3E2  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } [$01] = sprite Y on screen
$02:D3E4  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:D3E6  60            RTS                          ; Return: Y = OAM index, [$00]/[$01] = screen position

$02:D3E7  68            PLA                          ; Discard return address of this routine
$02:D3E8  68            PLA                          ; Discard return address of the caller
$02:D3E9  60            RTS                          ; Return to the caller's caller (sprite far offscreen)

}

;;; $D3EA: Layer 3 smash: main (Layer3SmashMain) ;;;
{

;; and runs the state routine.

$02:D3EA  22 61 FF 00   JSL.L $FF61           ; Set layer 3 scroll from sprite position ($FF61)

$02:D406  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; /

$02:D40B  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run the state routine

;;; $D40F: Layer 3 smash: states and Mario collision (Layer3SmashPtrs) ;;;
{
;; State pointers: 0 wait ([$1540]) then pick a random X in $FF80-$FFBF and Y = 0; 1 slide down at speed 4 until the timer ends;
;; 2 fall with gravity (+7, max $40) until Y >= $A0, then snap to the floor, shake the ground ([$1887] = $50), sound $09, timer $30;
;; 3 rest; 4 rise at speed $E0 until Y = 0, then back to state 0 with a $A0 frame timer.
;; $02D49C: collision with Mario. Mario below the smasher's bottom and within the central $80 px: hurt if on the ground, otherwise
;; his Y speed is set to the smasher's. In the $08 px margins at either side Mario is pushed sideways (X speed +8 or $F8).
$02:D40F  19 D4         .dw $D419             ; State 0 - wait, then start a smash
$02:D411  45 D4         .dw $D445             ; State 1 - slide down slowly (warning)
$02:D413  55 D4         .dw $D455             ; State 2 - fall with gravity
$02:D415  81 D4         .dw $D481             ; State 3 - rest on the ground
$02:D417  89 D4         .dw $D489             ; State 4 - rise back up

$02:D419  AD BF 18      LDA.W $18BF                 ; A = [$18BF]
$02:D41C  F0 04         BEQ $D422             ; Zero: continue
$02:D41E  20 7A D0      JSR.W OffScrEraseSprBnk2    ; Non-zero: erase the sprite once offscreen
$02:D421  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D422  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; Wait for the timer
$02:D425  D0 1D         BNE $D444            ; Still running: return
$02:D427  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:D429  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; A = $80
$02:D42B  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = $80 frames
$02:D42E  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; Random number
$02:D432  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; \
$02:D434  09 80         ORA.B #$80                  ; / A = $80 + random 0-$3F
$02:D436  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; Sprite X low = A
$02:D438  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; A = $FF
$02:D43A  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Sprite X high = $FF
$02:D43D  74 D8         STZ RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Sprite Y low = 0
$02:D43F  9E D4 14      STZ.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Sprite Y high = 0
$02:D442  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Sprite Y speed = 0
$02:D444  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D445  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = timer
$02:D448  F0 08         BEQ $D452             ; Zero: go to the next state
$02:D44A  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; A = 4
$02:D44C  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Sprite Y speed = 4 (slow descent)
$02:D44E  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Move the sprite
$02:D451  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D452  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:D454  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D455  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Move the sprite
$02:D458  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; A = Y speed
$02:D45A  30 04         BMI $D460             ; Negative: accelerate
$02:D45C  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; Reached max speed $40?
$02:D45E  B0 05         BCS $D465             ; Yes: do not accelerate
$02:D460  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D461  69 07         ADC.B #$07                  ; } Y speed += 7 (gravity, max $40)
$02:D463  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:D465  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A = sprite Y low
$02:D467  C9 A0         CMP.B #$A0                  ; Reached the floor at $A0?
$02:D469  90 15         BCC $D480            ; No: return
$02:D46B  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; Snap to a multiple of $10
$02:D46D  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; Store Y
$02:D46F  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:D471  8D 87 18      STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer    ; / Ground shake timer = $50
$02:D474  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:D476  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Sound effect $09 (to $1DFC)
$02:D479  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; A = $30
$02:D47B  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = $30 frames of rest
$02:D47E  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:D480  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D481  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = timer
$02:D484  D0 02         BNE $D488            ; Still running: return
$02:D486  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:D488  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D489  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; A = $E0
$02:D48B  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = $E0 (rise)
$02:D48D  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Move the sprite
$02:D490  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A = sprite Y low
$02:D492  D0 07         BNE $D49B            ; Not back at the top: return
$02:D494  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0
$02:D496  A9 A0         LDA.B #$A0                  ; A = $A0
$02:D498  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Timer = $A0 frames until the next smash
$02:D49B  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D49C  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0: extra height
$02:D49E  A4 19         LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp        ; Y = Mario power-up
$02:D4A0  F0 06         BEQ $D4A8             ; Small: skip
$02:D4A2  A4 73         LDY RAM_IsDucking           ; Y = ducking flag
$02:D4A4  D0 02         BNE $D4A8             ; Ducking: skip
$02:D4A6  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; A = $10: big Mario is taller
$02:D4A8  18            CLC                          ; Clear carry
$02:D4A9  75 D8         ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A += sprite Y low (bottom of the smasher)
$02:D4AB  C5 80         CMP $80                     ; Compared with Mario's Y position on screen [$80]
$02:D4AD  90 40         BCC $D4EF             ; Mario is below that point: not touching, return
$02:D4AF  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = sprite X low
$02:D4B1  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = sprite X low
$02:D4B3  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; A = sprite X high
$02:D4B6  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = sprite X high
$02:D4B8  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:D4BA  A5 7E         LDA $7E                     ; A = Mario X position on screen [$7E]
$02:D4BC  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D4BD  65 00         ADC $00                     ; / A += sprite X
$02:D4BF  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D4C0  E9 30 00      SBC.W #$0030                ; / A -= $30
$02:D4C3  C9 90 00      CMP.W #$0090                ; Within $90 px of the smasher?
$02:D4C6  B0 27         BCS $D4EF             ; No: return
$02:D4C8  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D4C9  E9 08 00      SBC.W #$0008                ; / A -= 8
$02:D4CC  C9 80 00      CMP.W #$0080                ; Within the central $80 px (the crushing area)?
$02:D4CF  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:D4D1  B0 12         BCS $D4E5             ; No: side margin, push Mario sideways
$02:D4D3  A5 72         LDA RAM_IsFlying            ; A = Mario in-air flag
$02:D4D5  D0 05         BNE $D4DC             ; In the air: push him down instead
$02:D4D7  22 B7 F5 00   JSL.L HurtMario             ; Mario is on the ground: hurt him
$02:D4DB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D4DC  64 7D         STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = 0
$02:D4DE  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; A = sprite Y speed
$02:D4E0  30 02         BMI $D4E4            ; Rising: leave Mario's speed at 0
$02:D4E2  85 7D         STA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; Mario Y speed = sprite Y speed (pushed down)
$02:D4E4  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D4E5  08            PHP                          ; Save flags of the range test
$02:D4E6  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; A = 8
$02:D4E8  28            PLP                          ; Restore flags
$02:D4E9  10 02         BPL $D4ED             ; Mario was right of the left edge: push right
$02:D4EB  A9 F8         LDA.B #$F8                  ; A = $F8: push left
$02:D4ED  85 7B         STA RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; Mario X speed = +/-8
$02:D4EF  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:D4F1  60            RTS                          ; Return


}
