;;; $D5B4..D5BC: Data: Banzai Bill tile Y offsets ;;;
{
$02:D5B4                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$10,$10,$10,$10 ; Tile Y offsets, rows 1 and 2: $00 x4, $10 x4
$02:D5BC                .db $20,$20,$20,$20,$30,$30,$30,$30 ; Tile Y offsets, rows 3 and 4: $20 x4, $30 x4
}

;;; $D5C4: Draw Banzai Bill (4x4 tiles) (BanzaiBillTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers and properties, then the draw routine at $02D5E4: 16 tiles of 16x16 in a 4x4 block ($40 px square), last row Y-flipped.
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
$02:D5C4                .db $80,$82,$84,$86,$A0,$88,$CE,$EE ; Banzai Bill tile numbers, rows 1 and 2
$02:D5CC                .db $C0,$C2,$CE,$EE,$8E,$AE,$84,$86 ; Banzai Bill tile numbers, rows 3 and 4
$02:D5D4                .db $33,$33,$33,$33,$33,$33,$33,$33 ; Banzai Bill tile properties, rows 1 and 2 ($33)
$02:D5DC                .db $33,$33,$33,$33,$33,$33,$B3,$B3 ; Banzai Bill tile properties, rows 3 and 4 (last row $B3 = Y flip)

$02:D5E4  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info (GetDrawInfo2)
$02:D5E7  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D5E8  A2 0F         LDX.B #$0F                  ; X = 15: 16 tiles in a 4x4 block
$02:D5EA  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = sprite X on screen
$02:D5EC  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D5ED  7D A4 D5      ADC.W $D5A4,X         ; / + tile X offset
$02:D5F0  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; OAM X
$02:D5F3  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = sprite Y on screen
$02:D5F5  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D5F6  7D B4 D5      ADC.W $D5B4,X         ; / + tile Y offset
$02:D5F9  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; OAM Y
$02:D5FC  BD C4 D5      LDA.W BanzaiBillTiles,X     ; A = tile number
$02:D5FF  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile
$02:D602  BD D4 D5      LDA.W $D5D4,X         ; A = tile properties
$02:D605  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM properties
$02:D608  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:D609  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:D60A  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:D60B  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:D60C  CA            DEX                          ; Next tile
$02:D60D  10 DB         BPL $D5EA             ; Loop for all 16 tiles
$02:D60F  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:D610  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:D612  A9 0F         LDA.B #$0F                  ; A = 15: 16 tiles
$02:D614  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write and return

}

;;; $D617: Banzai Bill, ball and chain, chained platform (Banzai+Rotating) ;;;
{
;; Entry for sprites $9E (ball and chain), $9F (Banzai Bill) and $A3 (grey platform on chain); sets the data bank first.
;; Rotating sprites ($02D62A): angle [$151C+X]:[$1602+X] (9-bit) changes by +/-2 per frame; direction = bit 4 of the sprite's X position.
;; Offset from the pivot = radius [$187B+X] * sin/cos (table CircleCoords, rounded using the hardware multiplier). The sprite is moved there,
;; [$1528+X] gets the X distance moved this frame (for carrying Mario), then interaction and drawing run and the sprite goes back to the pivot.
;; Ball and chain: MarioSprInteract and a 4-tile ball. Platform: solid block via InvisBlkMainRt and a wooden platform. Both draw 2 chain links
;; at 32 px and 16 px from the pivot along the line to the ball. $02D870: A = A * 32 / radius (signed), using the hardware divider.
;; Notes: NOPs at $02D800 are timing delays after hardware multiply/divide; they also serve as the ball tile number ($EA).
;; Called by: $01:8793 (Banzai Bill, ball and chain, grey platform (BanzaiBnCGrayPlat))
$02:D617  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:D618  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank (restored at D628)
$02:D619  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:D61A  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; A = sprite number
$02:D61C  C9 9F         CMP.B #$9F                  ; Banzai Bill ($9F)?
$02:D61E  D0 05         BNE $D625             ; No: ball and chain or chained platform
$02:D620  20 87 D5      JSR.W $D587           ; Banzai Bill main ($D587)
$02:D623  80 03         BRA $D628             ; Go restore the data bank

$02:D625  20 2A D6      JSR.W $D62A           ; Rotating sprite main ($D62A)
$02:D628  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:D629  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:D62A  20 17 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen3Bnk2     ; Erase when far offscreen
$02:D62D  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; A = sprites-locked flag
$02:D62F  D0 22         BNE $D653             ; Locked: do not turn
$02:D631  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = sprite X low
$02:D633  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: clockwise
$02:D635  29 10         AND.B #$10                  ; Bit 4 of the X position chooses the direction
$02:D637  D0 02         BNE $D63B             ; Set: keep +2
$02:D639  A0 FE         LDY.B #$FE                  ; Y = $FE: counterclockwise
$02:D63B  98            TYA                          ; A = angle step (+2 or -2)
$02:D63C  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: high byte
$02:D63E  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; Test the sign
$02:D640  10 01         BPL $D643             ; Positive: keep Y = 0
$02:D642  88            DEY                          ; Y = $FF: sign extend
$02:D643  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D644  7D 02 16      ADC.W $1602,X               ; } Angle low [$1602+X] += step
$02:D647  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; /
$02:D64A  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:D64B  7D 1C 15      ADC.W $151C,X               ; |
$02:D64E  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Angle high [$151C+X] += carry, kept to bit 0 (9-bit angle 0-$1FF)
$02:D650  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; /
$02:D653  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; A = angle high
$02:D656  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = angle high
$02:D658  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; A = angle low
$02:D65B  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = angle low
$02:D65D  C2 30         REP #$30                    ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$02:D65F  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = angle
$02:D661  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D662  69 80 00      ADC.W #$0080                ; |
$02:D665  29 FF 01      AND.W #$01FF                ; } [$02] = (angle + $80) & $1FF (90 degrees ahead)
$02:D668  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:D66A  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = angle
$02:D66C  29 FF 00      AND.W #$00FF                ; \
$02:D66F  0A            ASL                          ; } X = (angle & $FF) * 2: index into the sine table
$02:D670  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:D671  BF DB F7 07   LDA.L CircleCoords,X        ; A = CircleCoords[X]: sine of the angle ($0100 = 1.0)
$02:D675  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = sine
$02:D677  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; A = angle + $80
$02:D679  29 FF 00      AND.W #$00FF                ; \
$02:D67C  0A            ASL                          ; } X = (angle & $FF) * 2
$02:D67D  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:D67E  BF DB F7 07   LDA.L CircleCoords,X        ; A = cosine of the angle
$02:D682  85 06         STA $06                     ; [$06] = cosine
$02:D684  E2 30         SEP #$30                    ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$02:D686  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:D689  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; A = sine low byte
$02:D68B  8D 02 42      STA.W $4202                 ; Multiplicand A = sine
$02:D68E  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; A = [$187B+X] (radius of the circle)
$02:D691  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; Y = sine high byte ($01 only when the sine is exactly 1.0)
$02:D693  D0 0E         BNE $D6A3             ; Y != 0: use the radius as is
$02:D695  8D 03 42      STA.W $4203                 ; Multiplier B = radius (starts the multiplication)
$02:D698  20 00 D8      JSR.W $D800           ; Wait for the multiplier (NOPs)
$02:D69B  0E 16 42      ASL.W $4216                 ; Carry = bit 7 of the low byte (for rounding)
$02:D69E  AD 17 42      LDA.W $4217                 ; A = high byte of sine * radius
$02:D6A1  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Round: A = sine * radius / 256
$02:D6A3  46 01         LSR $01                     ; Angle bit 8 into carry (second half of the circle)
$02:D6A5  90 03         BCC $D6AA             ; Clear: positive
$02:D6A7  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:D6A9  1A            INC A                       ; / Negate A
$02:D6AA  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = X offset from the pivot
$02:D6AC  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; A = cosine
$02:D6AE  8D 02 42      STA.W $4202                 ; Multiplicand A = cosine
$02:D6B1  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; A = radius
$02:D6B4  A4 07         LDY $07                     ; Y = cosine high byte
$02:D6B6  D0 0E         BNE $D6C6             ; Y != 0: use the radius as is
$02:D6B8  8D 03 42      STA.W $4203                 ; Multiplier B = radius
$02:D6BB  20 00 D8      JSR.W $D800           ; Wait for the multiplier (NOPs)
$02:D6BE  0E 16 42      ASL.W $4216                 ; Carry = bit 7 of the low byte (for rounding)
$02:D6C1  AD 17 42      LDA.W $4217                 ; A = high byte of cosine * radius
$02:D6C4  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; Round: A = cosine * radius / 256
$02:D6C6  46 03         LSR $03                     ; Sign bit of (angle + $80) into carry
$02:D6C8  90 03         BCC $D6CD             ; Clear: positive
$02:D6CA  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:D6CC  1A            INC A                       ; / Negate A
$02:D6CD  85 06         STA $06                     ; [$06] = Y offset from the pivot
$02:D6CF  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:D6D1  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:D6D2  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } Save sprite X (16-bit)
$02:D6D5  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:D6D6  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:D6D8  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:D6D9  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Save sprite Y (16-bit)
$02:D6DC  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:D6DD  BC 86 0F      LDY.W $0F86,X               ; Y = [$0F86+X] (value not used here)
$02:D6E0  64 00         STZ $00                     ; [$00] = 0: high byte of X offset
$02:D6E2  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; A = X offset
$02:D6E4  10 02         BPL $D6E8             ; Positive: keep 0
$02:D6E6  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; [$00] = $FF: sign extend
$02:D6E8  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D6E9  75 E4         ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; } Sprite X low += X offset
$02:D6EB  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; /
$02:D6ED  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:D6EE  48            PHA                          ; Save new X low
$02:D6EF  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D6F0  FD 34 15      SBC.W $1534,X               ; } [$1528+X] = X movement since last frame (carries Mario)
$02:D6F3  9D 28 15      STA.W $1528,X               ; /
$02:D6F6  68            PLA                          ; A = new X low
$02:D6F7  9D 34 15      STA.W $1534,X               ; [$1534+X] = this frame's X low
$02:D6FA  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:D6FB  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; A = sprite X high
$02:D6FE  65 00         ADC $00                     ; + sign extension
$02:D700  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; Store sprite X high
$02:D703  64 01         STZ $01                     ; [$01] = 0: high byte of Y offset
$02:D705  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; A = Y offset
$02:D707  10 02         BPL $D70B             ; Positive: keep 0
$02:D709  C6 01         DEC $01                     ; [$01] = $FF: sign extend
$02:D70B  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D70C  75 D8         ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; } Sprite Y low += Y offset
$02:D70E  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:D710  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; A = sprite Y high
$02:D713  65 01         ADC $01                     ; + sign extension
$02:D715  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; Store sprite Y high
$02:D718  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; A = sprite number
$02:D71A  C9 9E         CMP.B #$9E                  ; Ball and chain ($9E)?
$02:D71C  F0 32         BEQ $D750             ; Yes: go to the ball code at $02D750
$02:D71E  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Grey platform: act as a solid block (InvisBlkMainRt)
$02:D722  90 19         BCC $D73D             ; Carry clear: Mario is not on it
$02:D724  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3
$02:D726  9D 0E 16      STA.W $160E,X               ; [$160E+X] = 3: Mario is on the platform
$02:D729  8D 71 14      STA.W $1471                 ; [$1471] = 3 (standing on a moving platform)
$02:D72C  AD 7A 18      LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; A = on-Yoshi flag
$02:D72F  D0 1A         BNE $D74B             ; On Yoshi: skip
$02:D731  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:D732  22 BD E2 00   JSL.L $E2BD           ; Call $E2BD (probably refreshes Mario's pose)
$02:D736  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:D737  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; A = $FF
$02:D739  85 78         STA $78                     ; [$78] = $FF
$02:D73B  80 0E         BRA $D74B             ; Go draw the platform

$02:D73D  BD 0E 16      LDA.W $160E,X               ; A = Mario-on-platform flag
$02:D740  F0 09         BEQ $D74B             ; Not set: go draw
$02:D742  9E 0E 16      STZ.W $160E,X               ; Clear the flag
$02:D745  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:D746  22 BD E2 00   JSL.L $E2BD           ; Call $E2BD (probably refreshes Mario's pose)
$02:D74A  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:D74B  20 48 D8      JSR.W $D848           ; Draw the platform ($D848)
$02:D74E  80 07         BRA $D757             ; Skip the ball code

$02:D750  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Ball: hurt Mario on contact (MarioSprInteract)
$02:D754  20 13 D8      JSR.W $D813           ; Draw the ball ($D813)
$02:D757  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:D758  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:D75B  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:D75C  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:D75E  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:D75F  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; |
$02:D762  68            PLA                          ; } Restore the sprite's position to the pivot (Y high, Y low, X high, X low)
$02:D763  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; /
$02:D765  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = ball screen X ([$00] from the draw routine)
$02:D767  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D768  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / + screen X: ball world X low
$02:D76A  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D76B  F5 E4         SBC RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; / minus pivot X low: signed X distance to the ball
$02:D76D  20 70 D8      JSR.W $D870           ; Scale to 32 px: A = A * 32 / radius ($D870)
$02:D770  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D771  75 E4         ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; |
$02:D773  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:D774  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; } [$00] = pivot X + A - screen X (first chain link, X on screen)
$02:D776  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:D778  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = ball screen Y ([$01] from the draw routine)
$02:D77A  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D77B  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / + screen Y: ball world Y low
$02:D77D  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D77E  F5 D8         SBC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / minus pivot Y low: signed Y distance to the ball
$02:D780  20 70 D8      JSR.W $D870           ; Scale to 32 px: A = A * 32 / radius
$02:D783  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D784  75 D8         ADC RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:D786  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:D787  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; } [$01] = pivot Y + A - screen Y (first chain link, Y on screen)
$02:D789  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:D78B  BD C4 15      LDA.W $15C4,X               ; A = offscreen flag [$15C4+X]
$02:D78E  D0 76         BNE $D806            ; Far offscreen: skip the chain links
$02:D790  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; A = OAM index of this sprite
$02:D793  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D794  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; / + $10: links go after the 4 ball/platform tiles
$02:D796  A8            TAY                          ; Y = OAM index for the links
$02:D797  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D798  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; A = pivot X low
$02:D79A  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; [$0A] = pivot X low
$02:D79C  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; A = pivot Y low
$02:D79E  85 0B         STA $0B                     ; [$0B] = pivot Y low
$02:D7A0  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; A = sprite number
$02:D7A2  AA            TAX                          ; X = sprite number
$02:D7A3  A9 E8         LDA.B #$E8                  ; A = $E8: chain link tile of the ball and chain
$02:D7A5  E0 9E         CPX.B #$9E                  ; Ball and chain?
$02:D7A7  F0 02         BEQ $D7AB             ; Yes: keep $E8
$02:D7A9  A9 A2         LDA.B #$A2                  ; A = $A2: chain link tile of the grey platform
$02:D7AB  85 08         STA $08                     ; [$08] = link tile
$02:D7AD  A2 01         LDX.B #$01                  ; X = 1: two chain links
$02:D7AF  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = link X on screen
$02:D7B1  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; OAM X
$02:D7B4  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = link Y on screen
$02:D7B6  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; OAM Y
$02:D7B9  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; A = link tile
$02:D7BB  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile
$02:D7BE  A9 33         LDA.B #$33                  ; A = $33: priority 3, palette 9, 2nd tile page
$02:D7C0  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM properties
$02:D7C3  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = link X on screen
$02:D7C5  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D7C6  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:D7C8  38            SEC                          ; } + screen X - pivot X: X distance from the pivot
$02:D7C9  E5 0A         SBC $0A                     ; /
$02:D7CB  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = distance
$02:D7CD  0A            ASL                          ; Carry = sign
$02:D7CE  66 00         ROR $00                     ; [$00] = distance / 2 (arithmetic shift)
$02:D7D0  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = half distance
$02:D7D2  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D7D3  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:D7D5  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D7D6  65 0A         ADC $0A                     ; |
$02:D7D8  85 00         STA $00                     ; } [$00] = pivot X + half distance - screen X (second link)
$02:D7DA  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = link Y on screen
$02:D7DC  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D7DD  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:D7DF  38            SEC                          ; } + screen Y - pivot Y: Y distance from the pivot
$02:D7E0  E5 0B         SBC $0B                     ; /
$02:D7E2  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = distance
$02:D7E4  0A            ASL                          ; Carry = sign
$02:D7E5  66 01         ROR $01                     ; [$01] = distance / 2 (arithmetic shift)
$02:D7E7  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = half distance
$02:D7E9  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:D7EA  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:D7EC  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D7ED  65 0B         ADC $0B                     ; } [$01] = pivot Y + half distance - screen Y (second link)
$02:D7EF  85 01         STA $01                     ; /
$02:D7F1  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:D7F2  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:D7F3  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:D7F4  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:D7F5  CA            DEX                          ; Next link
$02:D7F6  10 B7         BPL $D7AF             ; Loop for both links
$02:D7F8  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:D7F9  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:D7FB  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; A = 5: 6 tiles (ball/platform 4 + 2 links)
$02:D7FD  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write and return

$02:D800  EA            NOP                          ; NOPs: delay for the multiplier and divider; $EA is also read as the ball tile
$02:D801  EA            NOP 
$02:D802  EA            NOP 
$02:D803  EA            NOP 
$02:D804  EA            NOP 
$02:D805  EA            NOP 
$02:D806  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $D807..D80F: Data: ball and chain tile layout ;;;
{
;; X offsets, Y offsets and properties for the four 16x16 ball tiles.
$02:D807                .db $F8,$08,$F8,$08         ; Ball tile X offsets: -8, +8, -8, +8

$02:D80B                .db $F8,$F8,$08,$08         ; Ball tile Y offsets: -8, -8, +8, +8

$02:D80F                .db $33,$73,$B3,$F3         ; Ball tile properties: $33, $73 (X flip), $B3 (Y flip), $F3 (both)

}

;;; $D813: Draw ball of ball and chain ;;;
{
;; Draws a 32x32 ball from four copies of tile $EA with different flips (tile read from the NOPs at $02D800).
;; Parameters: X: sprite index.
;; Called by: $02:D754 (Banzai Bill, ball and chain, chained platform (Banzai+Rotating))
$02:D813  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info (GetDrawInfo2)
$02:D816  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D817  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: four 16x16 tiles make the ball
$02:D819  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = sprite X on screen
$02:D81B  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D81C  7D 07 D8      ADC.W $D807,X         ; / + tile X offset
$02:D81F  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; OAM X
$02:D822  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; A = sprite Y on screen
$02:D824  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:D825  7D 0B D8      ADC.W $D80B,X         ; / + tile Y offset
$02:D828  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; OAM Y
$02:D82B  BD 00 D8      LDA.W $D800,X         ; A = $EA (read from the NOPs at $02D800): ball tile
$02:D82E  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile
$02:D831  BD 0F D8      LDA.W $D80F,X         ; A = tile properties (flips)
$02:D834  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM properties
$02:D837  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:D838  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:D839  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:D83A  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:D83B  CA            DEX                          ; Next tile
$02:D83C  10 DB         BPL $D819             ; Loop for all 4 tiles
$02:D83E  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:D83F  60            RTS                          ; Return (OAM size is finished by the caller)


}

{
$02:D840                .db $00,$F0,$00,$10         ; Platform tile X offsets: chain tile in the middle, then -16, 0, +16

}

;;; $D844: Draw wood platform; signed division helper (WoodPlatformTiles) ;;;
{
;; $02D848: draws a 4-tile wooden platform (shared by sprites that look like one) at the sprite's screen position, palette 1.
;; $02D870: signed division helper. Parameters: A = signed value, X = sprite index. Returns: A = high byte of (|A| * 256 / ([$187B,X] / 2)) * 16 with the sign of A; [$0E] = low byte.
$02:D844                .db $A2,$60,$61,$62         ; $00 - 4 tile numbers, one per platform segment (indexed like $D840)

$02:D848  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite OAM index and screen position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$02:D84B  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D84C  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: four tiles
$02:D84E  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:D850  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D851  7D 40 D8      ADC.W $D840,X         ; } OAM X = screen X + [DATA_02D840+X] (segment X offset)
$02:D854  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:D857  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:D859  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = screen Y
$02:D85C  BD 44 D8      LDA.W WoodPlatformTiles,X   ; \
$02:D85F  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = [WoodPlatformTiles+X]
$02:D862  A9 33         LDA.B #$33                  ; \
$02:D864  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = $33 (palette 1, priority 3)
$02:D867  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:D868  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:D869  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:D86A  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:D86B  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:D86C  10 E0         BPL $D84E             ; / Loop for all 4 tiles
$02:D86E  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:D86F  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D870  08            PHP                          ; Save sign of A
$02:D871  10 03         BPL $D876             ; \
$02:D873  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; } A = |A|
$02:D875  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:D876  8D 05 42      STA.W $4205                 ; \
$02:D879  9C 04 42      STZ.W $4204                 ; / Dividend = |A| * 256
$02:D87C  BD 7B 18      LDA.W $187B,X               ; \
$02:D87F  4A            LSR                          ; } Divisor = [$187B+X] / 2
$02:D880  8D 06 42      STA.W $4206                 ; /
$02:D883  20 00 D8      JSR.W $D800           ; Wait for the SNES divider to finish
$02:D886  AD 14 42      LDA.W $4214                 ; \
$02:D889  85 0E         STA $0E                     ; / $0E = quotient low byte
$02:D88B  AD 15 42      LDA.W $4215                 ; A = quotient high byte
$02:D88E  06 0E         ASL $0E                     ; \
$02:D890  2A            ROL                          ; |
$02:D891  06 0E         ASL $0E                     ; |
$02:D893  2A            ROL                          ; |
$02:D894  06 0E         ASL $0E                     ; |
$02:D896  2A            ROL                          ; |
$02:D897  06 0E         ASL $0E                     ; } A:$0E = quotient * 16 (shift left 4 times)
$02:D899  2A            ROL                          ; /
$02:D89A  28            PLP                          ; Restore sign flag from the original A
$02:D89B  10 03         BPL $D8A0            ; \
$02:D89D  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; } If A was negative, negate the result
$02:D89F  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:D8A0  60            RTS                          ; Return: A = signed ([A] * 256 / ([$187B,X] / 2)) * 16, high byte


}

{

;;; $D8B9: Bubble sprite: logic and contents release (BubbleSprGfxProp4) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $9D: a floating bubble containing Goomba, Bob-omb, sprite $15 or a Mushroom ([RAM_SpriteState] = 0-3).
;; Draws the contents plus the bubble, drifts sideways with a bobbing Y speed, pops on touching Mario or a wall, then turns into the contained sprite.
;; [$1534] is the bubble's pop timer: the contents spawn when it reaches 1.
$02:D8B9                .db $0C,$F4                 ; Bubble Y speed limit: +$0C, -$0C

$02:D8BB  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:D8BE  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D8BF  69 14         ADC.B #$14                  ; } OAM index += $14: contained sprite is drawn after the 5 bubble tiles
$02:D8C1  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:D8C4  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the contained sprite as one 16x16 tile (GenericSprGfxRt2)
$02:D8C8  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D8C9  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = contained sprite type [RAM_SpriteState] (0-3)
$02:D8CB  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index of the contained sprite tile
$02:D8CE  AA            TAX                          ; Use the contained type as table index
$02:D8CF  BD A9 D8      LDA.W BubbleSprGfxProp1,X   ; \
$02:D8D2  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } OAM properties = [BubbleSprGfxProp1+type] | [$64]
$02:D8D4  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:D8D7  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:D8D9  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:D8DA  0A            ASL                          ; } Carry = bit 5 of the frame counter (alternates every 32 frames)
$02:D8DB  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:D8DC  BD A1 D8      LDA.W BubbleSprTiles1,X     ; A = tile, animation frame 1
$02:D8DF  90 03         BCC $D8E4             ; Carry clear: use frame 1
$02:D8E1  BD A5 D8      LDA.W BubbleSprTiles2,X     ; Carry set: tile, animation frame 2
$02:D8E4  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store the contained sprite's tile
$02:D8E7  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:D8E8  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; A = [$1534] (bubble life timer, counts down after the bubble pops)
$02:D8EB  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; \
$02:D8ED  B0 04         BCS $D8F3             ; / If >= $60, always draw the bubble
$02:D8EF  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; \
$02:D8F1  F0 03         BEQ $D8F6             ; / Otherwise draw it only every other 2 frames (blink) while the timer is short
$02:D8F3  20 D6 D9      JSR.W $D9D6           ; Draw the bubble (5 tiles)
$02:D8F6  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; A = sprite status
$02:D8F9  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; \
$02:D8FB  D0 07         BNE $D904             ; / Status 2 (killed)? If not, go on
$02:D8FD  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:D8FF  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Unused: set the sprite status to normal (8)
$02:D902  80 67         BRA $D96B             ; Unused: continue at $D96B

$02:D904  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:D906  D0 6F         BNE $D977            ; Yes: return
$02:D908  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:D90A  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Run the timer only on even frames
$02:D90C  D0 0F         BNE $D91D             ; Odd frame: skip the timer
$02:D90E  DE 34 15      DEC.W $1534,X               ; Timer [$1534]--
$02:D911  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; A = new timer value
$02:D914  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; \
$02:D916  D0 05         BNE $D91D             ; / Timer = 4: play the pop sound
$02:D918  A9 19         LDA.B #$19                  ; \
$02:D91A  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $19
$02:D91D  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; A = [$1534]
$02:D920  3A            DEC A                       ; A = timer - 1
$02:D921  F0 55         BEQ $D978             ; Timer = 1: release the contained sprite
$02:D923  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; \
$02:D925  90 50         BCC $D977            ; / Timer < 8: popping animation, return
$02:D927  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:D92A  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:D92D  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:D930  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Object interaction (sets [$1588])
$02:D934  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = sprite direction
$02:D937  B9 B5 D8      LDA.W BubbleSprGfxProp2,Y   ; \
$02:D93A  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Sprite X speed = [BubbleSprGfxProp2+dir] (+8 or -8)
$02:D93C  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:D93E  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Adjust Y speed only on even frames
$02:D940  D0 16         BNE $D958             ; /
$02:D942  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:D945  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Y = bit 0 of [$151C] (up/down phase)
$02:D947  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:D948  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:D94A  18            CLC                          ; } Y speed += [BubbleSprGfxProp3+Y] (+1 or -1)
$02:D94B  79 B7 D8      ADC.W BubbleSprGfxProp3,Y   ; /
$02:D94E  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Store the new Y speed
$02:D950  D9 B9 D8      CMP.W BubbleSprGfxProp4,Y   ; \
$02:D953  D0 03         BNE $D958             ; / Reached the limit [BubbleSprGfxProp4+Y]?
$02:D955  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; Yes: flip the phase
$02:D958  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; A = object contact flags
$02:D95B  D0 0E         BNE $D96B             ; Touching a wall or floor: pop the bubble
$02:D95D  22 32 80 01   JSL.L SprSprInteract        ; Sprite-sprite interaction
$02:D961  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Mario-sprite interaction
$02:D965  90 39         BCC $D9A0            ; No contact with Mario: return
$02:D967  64 7D         STZ RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; \
$02:D969  64 7B         STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; / Mario touched the bubble: clear Mario's Y and X speed
$02:D96B  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; A = [$1534]
$02:D96E  C9 07         CMP.B #$07                  ; \
$02:D970  90 05         BCC $D977            ; / Timer < 7 (already popping): return
$02:D972  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:D974  9D 34 15      STA.W $1534,X               ; / Start popping: [$1534] = 6
$02:D977  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:D978  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = contained sprite type
$02:D97A  B9 A1 D9      LDA.W BubbleSprites,Y       ; A = sprite number to release [BubbleSprites+Y]
$02:D97D  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Turn the bubble into that sprite
$02:D97F  48            PHA                          ; Save the sprite number
$02:D980  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Reset all sprite tables for the new sprite
$02:D984  7A            PLY                          ; Y = sprite number
$02:D985  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; Default interaction-disabled timer $20
$02:D987  C0 74         CPY.B #$74                  ; \
$02:D989  D0 02         BNE $D98D             ; / Mushroom ($74)?
$02:D98B  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; Mushroom: timer $04
$02:D98D  9D 4C 15      STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; Disable interaction with other sprites for that many frames
$02:D990  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; A = sprite number
$02:D992  C9 0D         CMP.B #$0D                  ; \
$02:D994  D0 03         BNE $D999             ; / Bob-omb ($0D)?
$02:D996  DE 40 15      DEC.W $1540,X               ; Bob-omb: [$1540]-- (probably shortens its fuse)
$02:D999  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Determine the side Mario is on (sets Y = 0/1)
$02:D99C  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:D99D  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Sprite direction = face Mario
$02:D9A0  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $D9CD: Draw bubble graphics (BubbleSize) ;;;
{
;; Draws the 5 bubble tiles (4 corners and a center) with a 3-phase wobble animation, or the burst tiles $64/$66 when [$1534] < 6.
;; Tables BubbleSize ($02D9CD) and $D9D2 (animation offsets $00,$05,$0A,$05) precede the code at $02D9D6.
$02:D9CD                .db $02,$02,$02,$02,$00     ; Bubble tile sizes: 16x16 for the corners, 8x8 center

$02:D9D2                .db $00,$05,$0A,$05         ; Offset into the offset tables for each animation phase

$02:D9D6  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite OAM index and screen position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$02:D9D9  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:D9DB  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:D9DC  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:D9DD  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:D9DE  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = ([$14] >> 3) & 3: animation phase
$02:D9E0  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:D9E1  B9 D2 D9      LDA.W $D9D2,Y         ; \
$02:D9E4  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = [DATA_02D9D2+Y]: offset into the tile position tables
$02:D9E6  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:D9E9  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:D9EA  E9 14         SBC.B #$14                  ; } OAM index -= $14: back to the bubble's own slots
$02:D9EC  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:D9EF  A8            TAY                          ; Y = OAM index
$02:D9F0  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:D9F1  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:D9F4  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 = bubble state [$1534]
$02:D9F6  A2 04         LDX.B #$04                  ; X = 4: five tiles
$02:D9F8  DA            PHX                          ; Save tile index
$02:D9F9  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:D9FA  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:D9FB  65 02         ADC $02                     ; } X = tile index + animation offset
$02:D9FD  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:D9FE  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = screen X
$02:DA00  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:DA01  7D A5 D9      ADC.W BubbleTileDispX,X     ; } OAM X = screen X + [BubbleTileDispX+X]
$02:DA04  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:DA07  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:DA09  18            CLC                          ; } OAM Y = screen Y + [BubbleTileDispY+X]
$02:DA0A  7D B4 D9      ADC.W BubbleTileDispY,X     ; /
$02:DA0D  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store OAM Y
$02:DA10  FA            PLX                          ; X = tile index
$02:DA11  BD C3 D9      LDA.W BubbleTiles,X         ; A = tile number
$02:DA14  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store OAM tile
$02:DA17  BD C8 D9      LDA.W BubbleGfxProp,X       ; \
$02:DA1A  05 64         ORA $64                     ; / OAM properties = [BubbleGfxProp+X] | [$64]
$02:DA1C  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Store OAM properties
$02:DA1F  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:DA21  C9 06         CMP.B #$06                  ; / Timer >= 6: normal bubble
$02:DA23  B0 12         BCS $DA37             ; Timer >= 6: keep this tile
$02:DA25  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; Carry = timer >= 3
$02:DA27  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:DA29  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Popping: tile properties = 2 | [$64]
$02:DA2B  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:DA2E  A9 64         LDA.B #$64                  ; A = tile $64 (big burst)
$02:DA30  B0 02         BCS $DA34             ; Timer >= 3: use $64
$02:DA32  A9 66         LDA.B #$66                  ; Timer < 3: use $66 (small burst)
$02:DA34  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store OAM tile
$02:DA37  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:DA38  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:DA39  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DA3A  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM slot index / 4
$02:DA3B  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DA3C  BD CD D9      LDA.W BubbleSize,X          ; A = [BubbleSize+X]
$02:DA3F  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Store OAM size bit
$02:DA42  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:DA43  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:DA44  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:DA45  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:DA46  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:DA47  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:DA48  10 AE         BPL $D9F8             ; / Loop for the 5 tiles
$02:DA4A  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:DA4B  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Y = $FF: sizes already set
$02:DA4D  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; A = 4: five tiles drawn
$02:DA4F  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM (off-screen checks) and return

}

;;; $DA52: Hammer Bro: main wrapper (HammerBrotherMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $9B. Sets the data bank and calls the Hammer Bro code.
;; Called by: $01:879D (Hammer Brother (HammerBrother))
$02:DA52  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:DA53  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:DA54  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank
$02:DA55  20 5A DA      JSR.W $DA5A           ; Run the Hammer Bro code
$02:DA58  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:DA59  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:DA5A  9E 7C 15      STZ.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction = 0 (facing right) by default
$02:DA5D  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; A = sprite status
$02:DA60  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; \
$02:DA62  D0 0A         BNE $DA6E             ; / Status 2 (killed)? If not, run the normal code
$02:DA64  4C FD DA      JMP.W HammerBroGfx          ; Killed: just draw


}

;;; $DA67: Hammer Bro behaviour and hammer throw (HammerFreq) ;;;
{
;; Turns around periodically, and throws a hammer when [$1570] & HammerFreq is 0 (more often on submaps other than the main map).
;; Hammers are extended sprite $04, thrown upward at Y speed $D0 and X speed +/-$10.
$02:DA67                .db $1F,$0F,$0F,$0F,$0F,$0F,$0F ; Throw interval mask: $1F on the main map, $0F on other submaps

$02:DA6E  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:DA70  D0 76         BNE $DAE8            ; Yes: return
$02:DA72  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Sprite-to-Mario interaction
$02:DA76  20 1F D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:DA79  AC B3 0D      LDY.W $0DB3                 ; Y = current player's offset
$02:DA7C  B9 11 1F      LDA.W $1F11,Y               ; A = submap number of the player [$1F11]
$02:DA7F  A8            TAY                          ; Y = submap number
$02:DA80  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:DA82  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:DA84  F0 03         BEQ $DA89             ; } Increment [$1570] 3 out of every 4 frames
$02:DA86  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; /
$02:DA89  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DA8C  0A            ASL                          ; / A = [$1570] * 2
$02:DA8D  C0 00         CPY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:DA8F  F0 01         BEQ $DA92             ; / On the main map (Y = 0) keep *2, else *4
$02:DA91  0A            ASL                          ; A = [$1570] * 4 (other submaps)
$02:DA92  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; Keep only bit 6: horizontal flip flag
$02:DA94  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Sprite direction = $40 or $00 (turns around periodically)
$02:DA97  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DA9A  39 67 DA      AND.W HammerFreq,Y          ; / Throw only when [$1570] & [HammerFreq+Y] = 0...
$02:DA9D  1D A0 15      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; ...and the sprite is on screen horizontally...
$02:DAA0  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; ...and vertically...
$02:DAA3  1D 40 15      ORA.W $1540,X               ; ...and no hammer was thrown in the last 3 frames
$02:DAA6  D0 40         BNE $DAE8            ; Not time to throw: return
$02:DAA8  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:DAAA  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Set the minimum time between throws: [$1540] = 3
$02:DAAD  A0 10         LDY.B #$10                  ; \
$02:DAAF  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; |
$02:DAB2  D0 02         BNE $DAB6             ; |
$02:DAB4  A0 F0         LDY.B #$F0                  ; } $00 = hammer X speed: +$10 facing left/flipped, -$10 otherwise
$02:DAB6  84 00         STY $00                     ; /
$02:DAB8  A0 07         LDY.B #$07                  ; Y = 7: search extended sprite slots 7..0
$02:DABA  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; \
$02:DABD  F0 04         BEQ GenerateHammer          ; / Free slot (type 0)? Then generate the hammer
$02:DABF  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:DAC0  10 F8         BPL $DABA             ; / Next slot
$02:DAC2  60            RTS                          ; Return: no free slot

}

;;; $DAC3: Generate hammer extended sprite (GenerateHammer) ;;;
{
;; Parameters: Y = free extended sprite slot, [$00] = hammer X speed.
$02:DAC3  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:DAC5  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; / Extended sprite type = $04 (Hammer)
$02:DAC8  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:DACA  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; / Hammer X position = sprite X position
$02:DACD  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:DAD0  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; / }
$02:DAD3  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:DAD5  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; / Hammer Y position = sprite Y position
$02:DAD8  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:DADB  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; / }
$02:DADE  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:DAE0  99 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y     ; / Hammer Y speed = $D0 (thrown upward)
$02:DAE3  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:DAE5  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / Hammer X speed = [$00]
$02:DAE8  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

}

}

{
$02:DAF9                .db $00,$00,$02,$02         ; Tile sizes: two 8x8 (arm and head parts), two 16x16

}

;;; $DAFD: Draw Hammer Bro (HammerBroGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 4 tiles; flipped horizontally per the direction flag, using a second tile set when facing left.
;; Called by: $02:DA64 (Hammer Bro: main wrapper (HammerBrotherMain)), $02:DB9A (Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform (PutHammerBroOnPlat))
$02:DAFD  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite OAM index and screen position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$02:DB00  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:DB03  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = sprite direction flag ($00 or $40)
$02:DB05  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:DB06  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: four tiles
$02:DB08  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:DB0A  18            CLC                          ; } OAM X = screen X + [HammerBroDispX+X]
$02:DB0B  7D E9 DA      ADC.W HammerBroDispX,X      ; /
$02:DB0E  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store OAM X
$02:DB11  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:DB13  18            CLC                          ; } OAM Y = screen Y + [HammerBroDispY+X]
$02:DB14  7D ED DA      ADC.W HammerBroDispY,X      ; /
$02:DB17  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store OAM Y
$02:DB1A  DA            PHX                          ; Save tile index
$02:DB1B  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:DB1D  48            PHA                          ; / Save direction flag
$02:DB1E  09 37         ORA.B #$37                  ; \
$02:DB20  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = direction flag | $37
$02:DB23  68            PLA                          ; Restore direction flag
$02:DB24  F0 04         BEQ $DB2A             ; Facing right: use the first set of tiles
$02:DB26  E8            INX                          ; \
$02:DB27  E8            INX                          ; |
$02:DB28  E8            INX                          ; } Facing left: X += 4 (second set of tiles)
$02:DB29  E8            INX                          ; /
$02:DB2A  BD F1 DA      LDA.W HammerBroTiles,X      ; A = [HammerBroTiles+X]
$02:DB2D  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store OAM tile
$02:DB30  FA            PLX                          ; X = tile index
$02:DB31  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:DB32  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:DB33  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DB34  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM slot index / 4
$02:DB35  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DB36  BD F9 DA      LDA.W HammerBroTileSize,X   ; A = [HammerBroTileSize+X]
$02:DB39  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Store OAM size bit
$02:DB3C  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:DB3D  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:DB3E  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:DB3F  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:DB40  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:DB41  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:DB42  10 C4         BPL $DB08             ; / Loop for the 4 tiles
$02:DB44  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:DB45  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Y = $FF: sizes already set
$02:DB47  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: four tiles drawn
$02:DB49  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM and return

}

;;; $DB4C: Hammer Bro platform: main wrapper (FlyingPlatformMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $9C. Sets the data bank and calls the platform code.
;; Called by: $01:87A2 (Hammer Brother flying blocks (FlyingPlatform))
$02:DB4C  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:DB4D  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:DB4E  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank
$02:DB4F  20 5C DB      JSR.W $DB5C           ; Run the platform code
$02:DB52  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:DB53  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $DB54..DB5A: Table: platform acceleration and speed limits ;;;
{
$02:DB54                .db $01,$FF                 ; Platform X acceleration: +1, -1

$02:DB56                .db $20,$E0                 ; Platform X speed limit: +$20, -$20

$02:DB58                .db $02,$FE                 ; Platform Y acceleration: +2, -2

$02:DB5A                .db $20,$E0                 ; Platform Y speed limit: +$20, -$20

}

;;; $DB5C: Hammer Bro platform: logic ;;;
{
;; Draws the platform, finds a Hammer Bro (sprite $9B) in sprite slots 0-9 and carries it on the platform ($1594 = its slot, $FF if none).
;; Floats in a Lissajous-like path: X/Y speed accelerate toward +/-$20 and flip on reaching the limit.
;; Acts as a solid block (InvisBlkMainRt). When Mario lands on it ([$1558] non-zero) the Hammer Bro is probably knocked off.
;; Called by: $02:DB4F (Hammer Bro platform: main wrapper (FlyingPlatformMain))
$02:DB5C  20 3F DC      JSR.W FlyingPlatformGfx     ; Draw the platform (FlyingPlatformGfx)
$02:DB5F  A9 FF         LDA.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:DB61  9D 94 15      STA.W $1594,X               ; / $1594 = $FF: no Hammer Bro on the platform
$02:DB64  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Y = 9: check sprite slots 9..0 for a Hammer Bro
$02:DB66  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:DB69  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Sprite status = normal (8)?
$02:DB6B  D0 07         BNE $DB74             ; /
$02:DB6D  B9 9E 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; \
$02:DB70  C9 9B         CMP.B #$9B                  ; } Sprite number $9B (Hammer Bro)? Then put it on the platform
$02:DB72  F0 05         BEQ PutHammerBroOnPlat      ; /
$02:DB74  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:DB75  10 EF         BPL $DB66             ; / Next slot
$02:DB77  80 25         BRA $DB9E             ; No Hammer Bro found: skip to the movement code

}

;;; $DB79: Place Hammer Bro on platform and move platform (PutHammerBroOnPlat) ;;;
{
;; Puts the Hammer Bro 16 pixels above the platform and draws it, then runs the platform movement, solid-block and Mario-landing code (see previous section).
$02:DB79  98            TYA                          ; A = slot of the Hammer Bro
$02:DB7A  9D 94 15      STA.W $1594,X               ; $1594 = slot of the Hammer Bro on the platform
$02:DB7D  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:DB7F  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; / Hammer Bro X position = platform X position
$02:DB82  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:DB85  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; / }
$02:DB88  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:DB8A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:DB8B  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; } Hammer Bro Y position = platform Y position - $10
$02:DB8D  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; /
$02:DB90  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:DB93  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } }
$02:DB95  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; /
$02:DB98  DA            PHX                          ; Save platform index
$02:DB99  BB            TYX                          ; X = Hammer Bro index
$02:DB9A  20 FD DA      JSR.W HammerBroGfx          ; Draw the Hammer Bro
$02:DB9D  FA            PLX                          ; Restore platform index
$02:DB9E  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:DBA0  D0 6C         BNE $DC0E            ; Yes: return
$02:DBA2  20 1F D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen1Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:DBA5  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:DBA7  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Adjust speeds only on even frames
$02:DBA9  D0 2C         BNE $DBD7             ; /
$02:DBAB  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:DBAE  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Y = bit 0 of [$1534] (X acceleration phase)
$02:DBB0  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DBB1  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:DBB3  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:DBB4  79 54 DB      ADC.W $DB54,Y         ; } X speed += [DATA_02DB54+Y]
$02:DBB7  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; /
$02:DBB9  D9 56 DB      CMP.W $DB56,Y         ; X speed at the limit [DATA_02DB56+Y]?
$02:DBBC  D0 03         BNE $DBC1             ; Not yet: skip
$02:DBBE  FE 34 15      INC.W $1534,X               ; Yes: flip the X phase
$02:DBC1  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:DBC4  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Y = bit 0 of [$151C] (Y acceleration phase)
$02:DBC6  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DBC7  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:DBC9  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:DBCA  79 58 DB      ADC.W $DB58,Y         ; } Y speed += [DATA_02DB58+Y]
$02:DBCD  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:DBCF  D9 5A DB      CMP.W $DB5A,Y         ; Y speed at the limit [DATA_02DB5A+Y]?
$02:DBD2  D0 03         BNE $DBD7             ; Not yet: skip
$02:DBD4  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; Yes: flip the Y phase
$02:DBD7  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:DBDA  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:DBDD  9D 28 15      STA.W $1528,X               ; [$1528] = X movement (probably lets Mario ride along)
$02:DBE0  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Act as a solid block for Mario
$02:DBE4  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; A = [$1558] (Mario on platform timer, probably set by InvisBlkMainRt)
$02:DBE7  F0 25         BEQ $DC0E            ; Zero: return
$02:DBE9  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:DBEB  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / Platform state = 1 (left side dips)
$02:DBED  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Determine Mario's side ($0F = relative X)
$02:DBF0  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:DBF2  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } [$0F] >= 8?
$02:DBF4  30 02         BMI $DBF8             ; /
$02:DBF6  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Mario on the right half: state = 2
$02:DBF8  BC 94 15      LDY.W $1594,X               ; Y = Hammer Bro slot
$02:DBFB  30 11         BMI $DC0E            ; None: return
$02:DBFD  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:DBFF  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Hammer Bro status = 2 (killed)
$02:DC02  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:DC04  99 AA 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteSpeedY,Y    ; / Hammer Bro Y speed = $C0 (knocked upward)
$02:DC07  DA            PHX                          ; Save platform index
$02:DC08  BB            TYX                          ; X = Hammer Bro index
$02:DC09  22 6F AB 01   JSL.L $AB6F           ; Spawn the kill effect for the Hammer Bro ($AB6F), probably score
$02:DC0D  FA            PLX                          ; Restore platform index
$02:DC0E  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $DC3F: Draw Hammer Bro platform (FlyingPlatformGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 4 tiles with 2 animation sets; the tile on the side Mario stands on dips by $DC37[[$1558] / 2] pixels.
;; Called by: $02:DB5C (Hammer Bro platform: logic)
$02:DC3F  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite OAM index and screen position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$02:DC42  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:DC44  85 07         STA $07                     ; / $07 = platform state (which end dips)
$02:DC46  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; \
$02:DC49  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = [$1558] / 2
$02:DC4A  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DC4B  B9 37 DC      LDA.W $DC37,Y         ; \
$02:DC4E  85 05         STA $05                     ; / $05 = dip amount [DATA_02DC37+Y]
$02:DC50  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:DC53  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:DC54  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:DC56  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DC57  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } $02 = animation set offset: 0 or 4, from [$14] bit 3
$02:DC59  85 02         STA $02                     ; /
$02:DC5B  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; \
$02:DC5D  86 06         STX $06                     ; / X = 3: four tiles, [$06] = tile counter
$02:DC5F  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:DC60  05 02         ORA $02                     ; } X = tile counter | animation set offset
$02:DC62  AA            TAX                          ; /
$02:DC63  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:DC65  18            CLC                          ; } OAM X = screen X + [DATA_02DC0F+X]
$02:DC66  7D 0F DC      ADC.W $DC0F,X         ; /
$02:DC69  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store OAM X
$02:DC6C  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:DC6E  18            CLC                          ; } OAM Y = screen Y + [DATA_02DC17+X]
$02:DC6F  7D 17 DC      ADC.W $DC17,X         ; /
$02:DC72  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store OAM Y
$02:DC75  DA            PHX                          ; Save table index
$02:DC76  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; X = tile counter
$02:DC78  E0 02         CPX.B #$02                  ; \
$02:DC7A  B0 0E         BCS $DC8A             ; / Tile counter >= 2: no dip for those tiles
$02:DC7C  E8            INX                          ; \
$02:DC7D  E4 07         CPX $07                     ; / X = tile counter + 1, compared with the state in [$07]
$02:DC7F  D0 09         BNE $DC8A             ; Not the dipped end: skip
$02:DC81  B9 01 03      LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; \
$02:DC84  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:DC85  E5 05         SBC $05                     ; } OAM Y -= dip amount [$05]
$02:DC87  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:DC8A  FA            PLX                          ; Restore table index
$02:DC8B  BD 1F DC      LDA.W HmrBroPlatTiles,X     ; \
$02:DC8E  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = [HmrBroPlatTiles+X]
$02:DC91  BD 27 DC      LDA.W $DC27,X         ; \
$02:DC94  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM properties = [DATA_02DC27+X]
$02:DC97  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:DC98  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:DC99  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DC9A  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM slot index / 4
$02:DC9B  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DC9C  BD 2F DC      LDA.W $DC2F,X         ; A = [DATA_02DC2F+X]
$02:DC9F  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Store OAM size bit
$02:DCA2  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:DCA3  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:DCA4  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:DCA5  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:DCA6  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:DCA7  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; X = tile counter
$02:DCA9  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:DCAA  10 B1         BPL $DC5D             ; / Loop for the 4 tiles
$02:DCAC  4C 44 DB      JMP.W $DB44           ; Finish OAM via the Hammer Bro draw tail ($DB44)

}

;;; $DCAF: Sumo Bro: main wrapper and state dispatch (SumoBrotherMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite $9A. Draws, then runs interaction/physics and dispatches [RAM_SpriteState]: 0 and 1 = short pauses that step the animation frame, 2 = walk, 3 = stomp.
;; Called by: $01:87B1 (Sumo Brother (SumoBrother)), $01:87C5 (Unused. Sumo Brother wrapper (Unused0187C5))
$02:DCAF  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:DCB0  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:DCB1  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank
$02:DCB2  20 B7 DC      JSR.W $DCB7           ; Run the Sumo Bro code
$02:DCB5  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:DCB6  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:DCB7  20 3E DE      JSR.W SumoBroGfx            ; Draw the Sumo Bro
$02:DCBA  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Sprites locked?
$02:DCBC  D0 2B         BNE $DCE9            ; Yes: return
$02:DCBE  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:DCC1  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; / Sprite status
$02:DCC3  D0 24         BNE $DCE9            ; Not normal (8): return
$02:DCC5  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:DCC8  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Sprite-to-Mario interaction
$02:DCCC  22 2A 80 01   JSL.L UpdateSpritePos       ; Update sprite position with gravity
$02:DCD0  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:DCD3  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / On the ground?
$02:DCD5  F0 04         BEQ $DCDB             ; Not on ground: skip
$02:DCD7  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Landed: Y speed = 0
$02:DCD9  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Landed: X speed = 0
$02:DCDB  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = Sumo Bro state [RAM_SpriteState]
$02:DCDD  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run the state routine

}

;;; $DCE1: Pointer table: Sumo Bro states (SumoBroPtrs) ;;;
{
$02:DCE1  EA DC         .dw $DCEA             ; State 0: pause before stomp
$02:DCE3  FF DC         .dw $DCFF             ; State 1: pause, advance animation
$02:DCE5  0E DD         .dw $DD0E             ; State 2: walk
$02:DCE7  4B DD         .dw $DD4B             ; State 3: stomp and spawn lightning

$02:DCE9  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DCEA  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Animation frame $1602 = 1
$02:DCEC  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:DCEF  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; / A = [$1540] timer
$02:DCF2  D0 0A         BNE $DCFE            ; Timer running: return
$02:DCF4  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Frame = 0
$02:DCF7  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3
$02:DCF9  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = 3
$02:DCFC  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
$02:DCFE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DCFF  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; A = timer [$1540]
$02:DD02  D0 07         BNE $DD0B            ; Timer running: return
$02:DD04  FE 02 16      INC.W $1602,X               ; Next animation frame
$02:DD07  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3
$02:DD09  80 EE         BRA $DCF9             ; Set timer and advance state

$02:DD0B  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $DD0C..DD0C: Table: Sumo Bro X speed by direction ;;;
{
$02:DD0C                .db $20,$E0                 ; Sumo Bro X speed by direction: +$20, -$20

}

;;; $DD0E: Sumo Bro walk and stomp states ;;;
{
;; Walk state: moves at X speed +/-$20, pausing every other step; after 3 steps it starts the stomp state (timer $70).
;; Stomp state: at timer $2E shakes the ground ([$1887] = $30), plays sound $09 and spawns lightning; then turns around.
$02:DD0E  BD 58 15      LDA.W $1558,X               ; A = [$1558] (walk pause timer)
$02:DD11  D0 32         BNE $DD45             ; Paused: show the standing frame
$02:DD13  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = sprite direction
$02:DD16  B9 0C DD      LDA.W $DD0C,Y         ; \
$02:DD19  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = [DATA_02DD0C+Y]
$02:DD1B  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:DD1E  D0 24         BNE $DD44            ; / Timer [$1540] running: return
$02:DD20  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Walk counter [$1570]++
$02:DD23  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DD26  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Every other step...
$02:DD28  D0 05         BNE $DD2F             ; \
$02:DD2A  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; / ...pause for $20 frames
$02:DD2C  9D 58 15      STA.W $1558,X               ; Set the walk pause timer [$1558]
$02:DD2F  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DD32  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; / Third step...
$02:DD34  D0 07         BNE $DD3D             ; Not the third: wait and restart
$02:DD36  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; Reset the walk counter
$02:DD39  A9 70         LDA.B #$70                  ; A = $70: stomp wind-up timer
$02:DD3B  80 BC         BRA $DCF9             ; Set the timer and advance to the stomp state

$02:DD3D  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3
$02:DD3F  20 F9 DC      JSR.W $DCF9           ; Set timer and advance the state
$02:DD42  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0
$02:DD44  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DD45  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; Frame 1 (standing)
$02:DD47  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set the frame
$02:DD4A  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DD4B  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: base frame
$02:DD4D  BC 40 15      LDY.W $1540,X               ; Y = stomp timer [$1540]
$02:DD50  F0 2F         BEQ $DD81             ; Timer expired: turn around
$02:DD52  C0 2E         CPY.B #$2E                  ; \
$02:DD54  D0 19         BNE $DD6F             ; / Timer = $2E (moment of the stomp)?
$02:DD56  48            PHA                          ; Save frame
$02:DD57  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:DD5A  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } On screen?
$02:DD5D  D0 0F         BNE $DD6E             ; /
$02:DD5F  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:DD61  8D 87 18      STA.W RAM_ShakeGrndTimer    ; / Ground shake timer = $30
$02:DD64  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:DD66  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $09 (ground stomp)
$02:DD69  5A            PHY                          ; Save timer
$02:DD6A  20 8F DD      JSR.W GenSumoLightning      ; Spawn the lightning sprite
$02:DD6D  7A            PLY                          ; Restore timer
$02:DD6E  68            PLA                          ; Restore frame
$02:DD6F  C0 30         CPY.B #$30                  ; \
$02:DD71  90 0A         BCC $DD7D             ; / Timer < $30: frame 3
$02:DD73  C0 50         CPY.B #$50                  ; \
$02:DD75  B0 06         BCS $DD7D             ; / Timer >= $50: frame 3
$02:DD77  1A            INC A                       ; Frame 4
$02:DD78  C0 44         CPY.B #$44                  ; \
$02:DD7A  B0 01         BCS $DD7D             ; / Timer >= $44: frame 4
$02:DD7C  1A            INC A                       ; Frame 5 for timer in $30-$43
$02:DD7D  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Set the animation frame
$02:DD80  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DD81  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:DD84  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Flip the sprite direction
$02:DD86  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:DD89  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; A = $40: timer for the next pause
$02:DD8B  20 3F DD      JSR.W $DD3F           ; Set timer, advance state, state = 0
$02:DD8E  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $DD8F: Spawn Sumo Bro lightning (GenSumoLightning) ;;;
{
;; Spawns sprite $2B at the Sumo Bro's X + 4, same Y.
;; Called by: $02:DD6A (Sumo Bro walk and stomp states)
$02:DD8F  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:DD93  30 30         BMI $DDC5            ; No free slot: return
$02:DD95  A9 2B         LDA.B #$2B                  ; \
$02:DD97  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $2B (lightning)
$02:DD9A  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:DD9C  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)
$02:DD9F  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:DDA1  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } Lightning X position = Sumo Bro X position + 4
$02:DDA3  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; /
$02:DDA6  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:DDA9  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } }
$02:DDAB  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; /
$02:DDAE  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:DDB0  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; / Lightning Y position = Sumo Bro Y position
$02:DDB3  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:DDB6  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; / }
$02:DDB9  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:DDBA  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite
$02:DDBB  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Reset the sprite's tables
$02:DDBF  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:DDC1  9D E2 1F      STA.W $1FE2,X               ; / [$1FE2] = $10: probably frames before it may interact with the ground
$02:DDC4  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:DDC5  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

{
$02:DDC6                .db $FF,$07,$FC,$04,$FF,$07,$FC,$04 ; Tile X offsets: frames 0-5, 8 entries each (facing left set), then mirrored set at +$18
$02:DDCE                .db $FF,$FF,$FC,$04,$FF,$FF,$FC,$04 ; }
$02:DDD6                .db $02,$02,$F4,$04,$02,$02,$F4,$04 ; }
$02:DDDE                .db $09,$01,$04,$FC,$09,$01,$04,$FC ; }
$02:DDE6                .db $01,$01,$04,$FC,$01,$01,$04,$FC ; }
$02:DDEE                .db $FF,$FF,$0C,$FC,$FF,$FF,$0C,$FC ; }
}

;;; $DDF6: Table: Sumo Bro tile Y offsets (SumoBrosDispY) ;;;
{
$02:DDF6                .db $F8,$F8,$00,$00,$F8,$F8,$00,$00 ; Tile Y offsets: frames 0-5, 4 tiles each
$02:DDFE                .db $F8,$F0,$00,$00,$F8,$F8,$00,$00 ; }
$02:DE06                .db $F8,$F8,$01,$00,$F8,$F8,$FF,$00 ; }

;;; $DE0E: Table: Sumo Bro tile numbers (SumoBrosTiles) ;;;
{
$02:DE0E                .db $98,$99,$A7,$A8,$98,$99,$AA,$AB ; Tile numbers: frames 0-5, 4 tiles each

$02:DE1E                .db $80,$80,$C1,$C3,$80,$80,$C1,$C3 ; }

{
