;;; $DE3E: Draw Sumo Bro (SumoBroGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 4 tiles for animation frame [$1602]; mirrored X offsets are used when the flip flag is set.
;; Called by: $02:DCB7 (Sumo Bro: main wrapper and state dispatch (SumoBrotherMain))
$02:DE3E  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get sprite OAM index and screen position ($00 = X, $01 = Y)
$02:DE41  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:DE44  4A            LSR                          ; / A = sprite direction
$02:DE45  6A            ROR                          ; \
$02:DE46  6A            ROR                          ; |
$02:DE47  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; } $02 = $40 if facing right-flipped, else 0 (inverted direction flip)
$02:DE49  49 40         EOR.B #$40                  ; /
$02:DE4B  85 02         STA $02                     ; Store the flip flag
$02:DE4D  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:DE50  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:DE53  0A            ASL                          ; } X = animation frame [$1602] * 4
$02:DE54  0A            ASL                          ; /
$02:DE55  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:DE56  AA            TAX                          ; X = frame * 4 (table index)
$02:DE57  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:DE59  85 05         STA $05                     ; / $05 = 3: four tiles
$02:DE5B  DA            PHX                          ; Save table index
$02:DE5C  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; Flipped?
$02:DE5E  F0 05         BEQ $DE65             ; No: skip
$02:DE60  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:DE61  18            CLC                          ; } Flipped: use the mirrored X offsets at +$18
$02:DE62  69 18         ADC.B #$18                  ; /
$02:DE64  AA            TAX 
$02:DE65  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:DE67  18            CLC                          ; } OAM X = screen X + [SumoBrosDispX+X]
$02:DE68  7D C6 DD      ADC.W SumoBrosDispX,X       ; /
$02:DE6B  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store OAM X
$02:DE6E  FA            PLX                          ; Restore table index
$02:DE6F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:DE71  18            CLC                          ; } OAM Y = screen Y + [SumoBrosDispY+X]
$02:DE72  7D F6 DD      ADC.W SumoBrosDispY,X       ; /
$02:DE75  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store OAM Y
$02:DE78  BD 0E DE      LDA.W SumoBrosTiles,X       ; A = [SumoBrosTiles+X]
$02:DE7B  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store OAM tile
$02:DE7E  C9 66         CMP.B #$66                  ; \
$02:DE80  38            SEC                          ; } Tile $66 (the stomping foot)? Carry clear for it
$02:DE81  D0 01         BNE $DE84             ; /
$02:DE83  18            CLC                          ; Unused: carry clear when the tile is $66
$02:DE84  A9 34         LDA.B #$34                  ; \
$02:DE86  65 02         ADC $02                     ; } OAM properties = $34 + flip flag + carry
$02:DE88  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:DE8B  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:DE8C  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:DE8D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DE8E  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = OAM slot index / 4
$02:DE8F  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:DE90  BD 26 DE      LDA.W SumoBrosTileSize,X    ; A = [SumoBrosTileSize+X]
$02:DE93  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; Store OAM size bit
$02:DE96  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:DE97  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:DE98  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:DE99  C8            INY                          ; } Y += 4: next OAM slot
$02:DE9A  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:DE9B  E8            INX                          ; Next table index
$02:DE9C  C6 05         DEC $05                     ; \
$02:DE9E  10 BB         BPL $DE5B             ; / Loop for the 4 tiles
$02:DEA0  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:DEA1  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Y = $FF: sizes already set
$02:DEA3  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: four tiles drawn
$02:DEA5  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM and return

}

;;; $DEA8: Sumo Bro lightning main (SumosLightningMain) ;;;
{
;; Falls, then on landing starts a flame timer and spawns a row of ground flames. Draws itself with a flickering X/Y flip.
;; Sprite uses [$1540] as the flame timer and [$1570] as the flame offset index.
;; Called by: $01:87B6 (Sumo Brother's lightning (SumosLightning))
$02:DEA8  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:DEA9  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
$02:DEAA  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:DEAB  20 B0 DE      JSR.W $DEB0           ; Run the sprite code
$02:DEAE  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:DEAF  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:DEB0  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = flame timer; non-zero: lightning has landed, run the flame phase
$02:DEB3  D0 47         BNE $DEFC             ; Flame phase: branch
$02:DEB5  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:DEB7  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Falling speed Y = $30
$02:DEB9  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:DEBC  BD E2 1F      LDA.W $1FE2,X               ; [$1FE2] = non-zero: skip the ground check
$02:DEBF  D0 29         BNE $DEEA             ; Skip landing logic
$02:DEC1  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Handle interaction with blocks and the ground
$02:DEC5  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:DEC8  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on the ground yet: just draw
$02:DECA  F0 1E         BEQ $DEEA             ; /
$02:DECC  A9 17         LDA.B #$17                  ; \
$02:DECE  8D FC 1D      STA.W $1DFC                 ; / Play sound effect $17 (lightning hits the ground)
$02:DED1  A9 22         LDA.B #$22                  ; \
$02:DED3  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Flame timer [$1540] = $22
$02:DED6  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:DED9  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } Offscreen: skip the ground effect
$02:DEDC  D0 0C         BNE $DEEA             ; /
$02:DEDE  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:DEE0  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; / Block X = sprite X (low)
$02:DEE2  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:DEE4  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; / Block Y = sprite Y (low)
$02:DEE6  22 44 8A 02   JSL.L $8A44           ; Spawn the ground impact effect at that position (exact effect not checked)
$02:DEEA  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:DEEC  22 42 80 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt0      ; / Draw with GenericSprGfxRt0, 1 tile
$02:DEF0  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = sprite OAM index
$02:DEF3  B9 07 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; \
$02:DEF6  49 C0         EOR.B #$C0                  ; } Flip the tile's X and Y flip bits (flickers the bolt)
$02:DEF8  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; /
$02:DEFB  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DEFC  85 02         STA $02                     ; $02 = flame timer
$02:DEFE  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; Timer = 1 (last frame)?
$02:DF00  D0 03         BNE $DF05             ; No
$02:DF02  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; Timer was 1: erase the sprite
$02:DF05  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; Low nibble of timer
$02:DF07  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; Is it 1 (every 16 frames)?
$02:DF09  D0 16         BNE $DF21            ; No: nothing to spawn
$02:DF0B  8D B8 18      STA.W $18B8                 ; $18B8 = 1 (flag set while the flames burn)
$02:DF0E  20 2C DF      JSR.W $DF2C           ; Spawn a pair of flames at the sprite ($DF2C)
$02:DF11  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Next flame offset index [$1570]++
$02:DF14  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DF17  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; } If [$1570] = 1, done
$02:DF19  F0 06         BEQ $DF21            ; /
$02:DF1B  20 2C DF      JSR.W $DF2C           ; Spawn another flame pair at the next offset
$02:DF1E  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; [$1570]++
$02:DF21  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $DF22..DF27: Table: Sumo Bro flame X offsets ;;;
{
;; Low byte then high byte of X offsets for the five flames (-4,+12,-20,+28,-36).
$02:DF22                .db $FC,$0C,$EC,$1C,$DC     ; X offsets (low) of the flames: -4, +12, -20, +28, -36

$02:DF27                .db $FF,$00,$FF,$00,$FF     ; X offsets (high): sign extension of the table above

}

;;; $DF2C: Spawn Sumo Bro flame ;;;
{
;; Finds a free slot in the 10-entry Sumo Bro flame tables ([$1892]-[$1E3E]) or recycles one round-robin ([$191D]).
;; Sets position from the sprite plus the offset indexed by [$1570], and starts the flame (timer [$1892] = 6).
;; Called by: $02:DF0E (Sumo Bro lightning main (SumosLightningMain)), $02:DF1B (Sumo Bro lightning main (SumosLightningMain))
$02:DF2C  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:DF2E  85 00         STA $00                     ; / $00 = sprite X (low)
$02:DF30  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:DF33  85 01         STA $01                     ; / $01 = sprite X (high)
$02:DF35  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Y = 9: search 10 Sumo Bro flame slots
$02:DF37  B9 92 18      LDA.W $1892,Y               ; \
$02:DF3A  F0 10         BEQ $DF4C             ; / Free slot ([$1892,Y] = 0): use it
$02:DF3C  88            DEY                          ; Next slot
$02:DF3D  10 F8         BPL $DF37             ; Loop
$02:DF3F  CE 1D 19      DEC.W $191D                 ; \
$02:DF42  10 05         BPL $DF49             ; / No free slot: step the round-robin index [$191D] down
$02:DF44  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; Wrap around to 9
$02:DF46  8D 1D 19      STA.W $191D                 ; Store index
$02:DF49  AC 1D 19      LDY.W $191D                 ; Y = slot to overwrite
$02:DF4C  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:DF4D  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:DF50  AA            TAX                          ; / X = flame offset index [$1570]
$02:DF51  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:DF53  18            CLC                          ; } Flame X (low) = sprite X + $DF22[X]
$02:DF54  7D 22 DF      ADC.W $DF22,X         ; /
$02:DF57  99 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,Y               ; Store at [$1E16,Y]
$02:DF5A  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:DF5C  7D 27 DF      ADC.W $DF27,X         ; / Flame X (high) = sprite X high + $DF27[X]
$02:DF5F  99 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,Y               ; Store at [$1E3E,Y]
$02:DF62  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:DF63  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:DF65  38            SEC                          ; } Flame Y (low) = sprite Y - $10
$02:DF66  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; /
$02:DF68  99 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,Y               ; Store at [$1E02,Y]
$02:DF6B  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:DF6E  38            SEC                          ; } Flame Y (high) = sprite Y high - borrow
$02:DF6F  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; /
$02:DF71  99 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,Y               ; Store at [$1E2A,Y]
$02:DF74  A9 7F         LDA.B #$7F                  ; \
$02:DF76  99 4A 0F      STA.W $0F4A,Y               ; / [$0F4A,Y] = $7F (flame animation/timer start)
$02:DF79  B9 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,Y               ; \
$02:DF7C  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:DF7E  B9 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,Y               ; } Compare flame X with the left screen edge (16-bit)
$02:DF81  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; /
$02:DF83  D0 05         BNE $DF8A            ; Flame is right of the screen edge
$02:DF85  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:DF87  99 92 18      STA.W $1892,Y               ; / Flame timer [$1892,Y] = 6 (activates the flame)
$02:DF8A  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $DF8B: Volcano Lotus main (VolcanoLotusMain) ;;;
{
;; Wrapper: sets the data bank, then draws, moves with gravity and runs the state routine.
;; Called by: $01:87AC (Volcano Lotus (VolcanoLotus))
$02:DF8B  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:DF8C  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
$02:DF8D  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:DF8E  20 93 DF      JSR.W $DF93           ; Run the sprite code
$02:DF91  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:DF92  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:DF93  20 0B E0      JSR.W VolcanoLotusGfx       ; Draw the Volcano Lotus
$02:DF96  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:DF98  D0 2E         BNE $DFC8            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:DF9A  9E 1C 15      STZ.W $151C,X               ; [$151C] = 0 (pollen/flame animation flag)
$02:DF9D  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Interact with Mario
$02:DFA1  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far offscreen
$02:DFA4  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:DFA7  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:DFA9  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; } Apply gravity: Y speed += 1 up to $40
$02:DFAB  10 02         BPL $DFAF             ; /
$02:DFAD  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed++
$02:DFAF  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Handle interaction with blocks and the ground
$02:DFB3  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:DFB6  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on the ground: skip
$02:DFB8  F0 02         BEQ $DFBC             ; /
$02:DFBA  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = 0
$02:DFBC  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = sprite state
$02:DFBE  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run state routine (VolcanoLotusPtrs)

}

;;; $DFC2: Volcano Lotus states (VolcanoLotusPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table indexed by [$C2]: state 0 pulsing, 1 flickering, 2 shoots fire then restarts.
$02:DFC2  C9 DF         .dw $DFC9             ; State 0: idle, pulsing
$02:DFC4  DF DF         .dw $DFDF             ; State 1: charging, blinking
$02:DFC6  EF DF         .dw $DFEF             ; State 2: shooting fire

$02:DFC8  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DFC9  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:DFCC  D0 08         BNE $DFD6             ; / Timer [$1540] = 0: start the next phase
$02:DFCE  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; Timer = $40
$02:DFD0  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Store timer
$02:DFD3  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++
$02:DFD5  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DFD6  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:DFD7  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:DFD8  4A            LSR                          ; } Animation frame = bit 3 of the timer (toggles every 8 frames)
$02:DFD9  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; /
$02:DFDB  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store in [$1602]
$02:DFDE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DFDF  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:DFE2  D0 04         BNE $DFE8             ; / Timer = 0: restart with $40 (branch to DFD0)
$02:DFE4  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; Timer = $40
$02:DFE6  80 E8         BRA $DFD0             ; Go set timer and next state

$02:DFE8  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:DFE9  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / [$151C] = bit 1 of timer (flicker the flame palette flag)
$02:DFEB  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; Store [$151C]
$02:DFEE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:DFEF  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:DFF2  D0 07         BNE $DFFB             ; / Timer = 0: restart cycle
$02:DFF4  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; Timer = $80
$02:DFF6  20 D0 DF      JSR.W $DFD0           ; Set the timer and advance state
$02:DFF9  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0 (loops back to idle)
$02:DFFB  C9 38         CMP.B #$38                  ; Timer = $38?
$02:DFFD  D0 03         BNE $E002             ; No
$02:DFFF  20 79 E0      JSR.W $E079           ; Shoot the fire balls ($E079)

$02:E002  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; Frame = 2 (open)
$02:E004  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store in [$1602]
$02:E007  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $E008: Table: Volcano Lotus top tiles (VolcanoLotusTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile numbers for animation frames 0-2.
$02:E008                .db $8E,$9E,$E2             ; Tile numbers for animation frames 0-2 (frame 2 = $E2 open)

}

;;; $E00B: Draw Volcano Lotus (VolcanoLotusGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws the mushroom-scale stalk, then four more tiles: the flower body ($CE) and a two-tile top that depends on the frame in [$1602] and the palette flag [$151C].
;; Called by: $02:DF93 (Volcano Lotus main (VolcanoLotusMain))
$02:E00B  20 7E E5      JSR.W MushroomScaleGfx      ; Draw the mushroom-scale base (stalk)
$02:E00E  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:E011  A9 CE         LDA.B #$CE                  ; \
$02:E013  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; } Tile 1 and 2 = $CE (lotus body)
$02:E016  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; /
$02:E019  B9 03 03      LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; \
$02:E01C  29 30         AND.B #$30                  ; } Properties: keep priority bits, palette 5, bit 3
$02:E01E  09 0B         ORA.B #$0B                  ; /
$02:E020  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Store properties for tile 1
$02:E023  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:E025  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Tile 2 = same with X flip
$02:E028  B9 00 03      LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; \
$02:E02B  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E02C  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Tile 3 X = tile 1 X + 8
$02:E02E  99 08 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3DispX,Y      ; /
$02:E031  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E032  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Tile 4 X = tile 3 X + 8
$02:E034  99 0C 03      STA.W OAM_Tile4DispX,Y      ; /
$02:E037  B9 01 03      LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; \
$02:E03A  99 09 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3DispY,Y      ; / Tile 3 Y = tile 1 Y
$02:E03D  99 0D 03      STA.W OAM_Tile4DispY,Y      ; Tile 4 Y = tile 1 Y
$02:E040  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:E041  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:E044  AA            TAX                          ; / X = animation frame
$02:E045  BD 08 E0      LDA.W VolcanoLotusTiles,X   ; Top tile number from VolcanoLotusTiles
$02:E048  99 0A 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3,Y           ; Store as tile 3
$02:E04B  1A            INC A                       ; \
$02:E04C  99 0E 03      STA.W OAM_Tile4,Y           ; / Tile 4 = tile 3 + 1
$02:E04F  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:E050  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:E053  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; / [$151C] < 1?
$02:E055  A9 39         LDA.B #$39                  ; Palette/properties $39 (normal)
$02:E057  90 02         BCC $E05B             ; Use it if [$151C] = 0
$02:E059  A9 35         LDA.B #$35                  ; Otherwise $35 (flashing palette)
$02:E05B  99 0B 03      STA.W OAM_Tile3Prop,Y       ; \
$02:E05E  99 0F 03      STA.W OAM_Tile4Prop,Y       ; / Set properties for tiles 3 and 4
$02:E061  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:E064  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E065  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Advance OAM index by 8 (2 tiles used)
$02:E067  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:E06A  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:E06C  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; / Y = 0 (8x8 tile size), A = 1 (two tiles)
$02:E06E  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish: set OAM size and finish via $B7A7


}

;;; $E079: Spawn Volcano Lotus fire balls ;;;

$02:E07F  D0 43         BNE $E0C4            ; /

$02:E090  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \

$02:E095  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E097  18            CLC                          ; } X position = sprite X + 4
$02:E098  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; /
$02:E09A  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; Store X low
$02:E09D  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:E0A0  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; / X high with carry
$02:E0A2  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; Store X high
$02:E0A5  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E0A7  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; / Y low = sprite Y low
$02:E0AA  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E0AD  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; / Y high = sprite Y high
$02:E0B0  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:E0B1  A6 00         LDX $00                     ; X = fire ball number
$02:E0B3  BD 71 E0      LDA.W $E071,X         ; \
$02:E0B6  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / X speed from $E071
$02:E0B9  BD 75 E0      LDA.W $E075,X         ; \
$02:E0BC  99 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y     ; / Y speed from $E075
$02:E0BF  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:E0C0  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; \
$02:E0C2  10 C1         BPL $E085             ; / Next fire ball

}

;;; $E0C5: Jumping Piranha Plant main (JumpingPiranhaMain) ;;;
{
;; Draws the head and stem, then runs three states: wait for Mario to be far enough, jump up, then fall; the fire-spitting variety ($50) shoots fireballs at the apex.
;; Called by: $01:87BB (Jumping Piranha Plant (JumpingPiranha))
$02:E0C5  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E0C6  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
$02:E0C7  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E0C8  20 CD E0      JSR.W $E0CD           ; Run the sprite code
$02:E0CB  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:E0CC  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E0CD  22 8B F7 07   JSL.L LoadSpriteTables      ; Load sprite tables (position, offscreen info)
$02:E0D1  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:E0D3  48            PHA                          ; / Save [$64] (sprite priority)
$02:E0D4  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:E0D6  85 64         STA $64                     ; / [$64] = $10: sprite is in front of layers
$02:E0D8  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E0DB  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; |
$02:E0DD  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:E0DE  4A            LSR                          ; } Head frame = ([$1570] bit 3 >> 2) XOR 2
$02:E0DF  49 02         EOR.B #$02                  ; /
$02:E0E1  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store in [$1602]
$02:E0E4  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the head
$02:E0E8  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:E0EB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E0EC  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; } OAM index += 4 (head used one tile)
$02:E0EE  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:E0F1  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:E0F4  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:E0F6  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:E0F7  4A            LSR                          ; } Stem frame = 1 + ([$151C] bit 2 >> 2)
$02:E0F8  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:E0F9  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store in [$1602]
$02:E0FC  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E0FE  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E0FF  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E100  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Y position += 8 temporarily (low)
$02:E102  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:E104  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E107  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E108  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Same for high byte
$02:E10A  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:E10D  A9 0A         LDA.B #$0A                  ; \
$02:E10F  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; / Palette = $0A
$02:E112  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:E114  22 42 80 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt0      ; / Draw the stem, 1 tile
$02:E118  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E119  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; / Restore Y high
$02:E11C  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E11D  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Restore Y low
$02:E11F  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E120  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Restore [$64]
$02:E122  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E124  D0 32         BNE $E158            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:E126  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far offscreen
$02:E129  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Interact with Mario
$02:E12D  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:E130  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = sprite state
$02:E132  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run state routine (JumpingPiranhaPtrs)

}

;;; $E136: Jumping Piranha Plant states (JumpingPiranhaPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table indexed by [$C2], followed by the state routines and the fireball spawner ($E1C0).
$02:E136  3C E1         .dw $E13C             ; State 0: waiting below pipe
$02:E138  59 E1         .dw $E159             ; State 1: jumping up
$02:E13A  77 E1         .dw $E177             ; State 2: falling / spitting fire

$02:E13C  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = 0
$02:E13E  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \

$02:E149  69 1B         ADC.B #$1B                  ; /
$02:E14B  C9 37         CMP.B #$37                  ; \
$02:E14D  90 09         BCC $E158            ; / Return if Mario is too close (|distance| < $1B)
$02:E14F  A9 C0         LDA.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:E151  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $C0 (jump upward)
$02:E153  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++
$02:E155  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Frame = 0

$02:E15F  B0 05         BCS $E166             ; / Or if Y speed < $40
$02:E161  18            CLC                          ; \

$02:E164  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:E166  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; [$1570]++ (animation counter)

$02:E16B  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; / Compare Y speed with -$10
$02:E16D  30 07         BMI $E176            ; Still rising quickly: return
$02:E16F  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:E171  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $50 (hang time at apex)

$02:E177  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; [$151C]++ (stem animation counter)

$02:E182  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \

$02:E186  D0 09         BNE $E191             ; /
$02:E188  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \

$02:E18C  10 03         BPL $E191             ; /
$02:E18E  1A            INC A                       ; \
$02:E18F  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed++
$02:E191  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Handle block/ground interaction
$02:E195  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:E198  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on the ground: return
$02:E19A  F0 DA         BEQ $E176            ; /
$02:E19C  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0
$02:E19E  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:E1A0  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $40
$02:E1A3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E1A4  B4 9E         LDY RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; Y = sprite number
$02:E1A6  C0 50         CPY.B #$50                  ; Fire-spitting variety ($50)?
$02:E1A8  D0 4D         BNE $E1F7             ; No: just animate
$02:E1AA  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; [$1570] = 0
$02:E1AD  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; Timer = $40?
$02:E1AF  D0 46         BNE $E1F7             ; No
$02:E1B1  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:E1B4  1D 6C 18      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenVert,X   ; } Skip if offscreen
$02:E1B7  D0 3E         BNE $E1F7             ; /
$02:E1B9  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:E1BB  20 C0 E1      JSR.W $E1C0           ; / Fire ball X speed = $10 (to the right)
$02:E1BE  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \

$02:E1C7  F0 04         BEQ $E1CD             ; |
$02:E1C9  88            DEY                          ; } Search slots Y = 7..0
$02:E1CA  10 F8         BPL $E1C4             ; /
$02:E1CC  60            RTS                          ; Return if no free slots

$02:E1CD  A9 0B         LDA.B #$0B                  ; \
$02:E1CF  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; / Extended sprite = Piranha fireball ($0B)
$02:E1D2  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E1D4  18            CLC                          ; } X position = sprite X + 4
$02:E1D5  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; /
$02:E1D7  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; Store X low
$02:E1DA  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:E1DD  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; / X high with carry
$02:E1DF  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; Store X high
$02:E1E2  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E1E4  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; / Y low = sprite Y low
$02:E1E7  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E1EA  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; / Y high = sprite Y high
$02:E1ED  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:E1EF  99 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y     ; / Fireball Y speed = $D0 (upward)
$02:E1F2  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E1F4  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / Fireball X speed = [$00]
$02:E1F7  80 86         BRA $E17F             ; Continue with the common animation code


}

;;; $E1F9..E209: Table: Directional Coin movement ;;;
{
;; Speeds by direction (X then Y) and D-pad direction mapping tables.
$02:E1F9                .db $00,$00,$F0,$10         ; X speed by direction state: 0 up, 1 down, 2 left ($F0), 3 right ($10)

$02:E1FD                .db $F0,$10,$00,$00         ; Y speed by direction state: 0 up ($F0), 1 down ($10), 2 left, 3 right

$02:E201                .db $00,$03,$02,$00,$01,$03,$02,$00 ; Indexed by D-pad bits: gives direction state (0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right), 0 = none/ambiguous
$02:E209                .db $00,$03,$02,$00,$00,$00,$00,$00 ; Same table, second half (D-pad bits $08-$0F)
}

;;; $E211..E211: Table: opposite direction ;;;
{
;; $01,$00,$03,$02: direction index of the opposite direction.
$02:E211                .db $01,$00,$03,$02         ; Opposite direction: up<->down, left<->right

}

;;; $E215: Directional Coins main (DirectionCoinsMain) ;;;
{
;; Moves a coin along tiles following the D-pad, turning only at tile corners and leaving Map16 coin blocks behind. Times out via [$190C] and then restores the level music.
;; Called by: $01:87CA (Directional coins (DirectionalCoins))
$02:E215  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E216  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
$02:E217  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E218  20 1D E2      JSR.W $E21D           ; Run the sprite code
$02:E21B  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:E21C  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E21D  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:E21F  48            PHA                          ; / Save [$64]
$02:E220  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E223  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; } Timer < $30: normal priority
$02:E225  90 04         BCC $E22B             ; /
$02:E227  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:E229  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Else [$64] = $10 (draw in front)
$02:E22B  A5 1C         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; \
$02:E22D  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E22E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E22F  69 01         ADC.B #$01                  ; } Screen Y boundary += 1 temporarily (low)
$02:E231  85 1C         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; /
$02:E233  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:E235  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E236  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Same for high byte
$02:E238  85 1D         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; /
$02:E23A  AD AD 14      LDA.W RAM_BluePowTimer      ; \
$02:E23D  D0 06         BNE $E245             ; / Blue P-switch timer 0?
$02:E23F  22 41 C6 01   JSL.L CoinSprGfx            ; Draw as a coin
$02:E243  80 14         BRA $E259             ; Skip other drawing

$02:E245  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw as a generic sprite (turned into a block)
$02:E249  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:E24C  A9 2E         LDA.B #$2E                  ; \
$02:E24E  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = $2E (P-switch silver coin tile)
$02:E251  B9 03 03      LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; \
$02:E254  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; } Clear the top two property bits (no flip)
$02:E256  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:E259  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E25A  85 1D         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; / Restore screen Y high
$02:E25C  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E25D  85 1C         STA RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / Restore screen Y low
$02:E25F  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E260  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Restore [$64]
$02:E262  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E264  D0 78         BNE $E2DE             ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$02:E266  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:E268  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / Every 4th frame
$02:E26A  D0 1C         BNE $E288             ; Skip timer
$02:E26C  CE 0C 19      DEC.W $190C                 ; \
$02:E26F  D0 17         BNE $E288             ; / Decrement [$190C] (directional coin lifetime)
$02:E271  9C 0C 19      STZ.W $190C                 ; \
$02:E274  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; / Time ran out: erase the sprite
$02:E277  AD AD 14      LDA.W RAM_BluePowTimer      ; \
$02:E27A  0D AE 14      ORA.W RAM_SilverPowTimer    ; } Return if a P-switch is still active
$02:E27D  D0 08         BNE $E287            ; /
$02:E27F  AD DA 0D      LDA.W $0DDA                 ; \
$02:E282  30 03         BMI $E287            ; / [$0DDA] = original music; return if bit 7 (none)
$02:E284  8D FB 1D      STA.W $1DFB                 ; Restore level music
$02:E287  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E288  B4 C2         LDY RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Y = state (direction)
$02:E28A  B9 F9 E1      LDA.W $E1F9,Y         ; \
$02:E28D  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed from $E1F9
$02:E28F  B9 FD E1      LDA.W $E1FD,Y         ; \
$02:E292  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed from $E1FD
$02:E294  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:E297  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:E29A  A5 15         LDA RAM_ControllerA         ; \
$02:E29C  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } Read D-pad; none pressed: skip
$02:E29E  F0 10         BEQ $E2B0             ; /
$02:E2A0  A8            TAY                          ; Y = D-pad bits
$02:E2A1  B9 01 E2      LDA.W $E201,Y         ; \
$02:E2A4  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = direction for those bits
$02:E2A5  B9 11 E2      LDA.W $E211,Y         ; \
$02:E2A8  D5 C2         CMP RAM_SpriteState,X       ; } Ignore the request if it is the reverse of the current direction
$02:E2AA  F0 04         BEQ $E2B0             ; /
$02:E2AC  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E2AD  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; / Remember the wanted direction in [$151C]
$02:E2B0  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E2B2  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } $00 = Y position within tile
$02:E2B4  85 00         STA $00                     ; /
$02:E2B6  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E2B8  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } OR with X position within tile
$02:E2BA  05 00         ORA $00                     ; /
$02:E2BC  D0 20         BNE $E2DE             ; Not at a tile corner: no turning
$02:E2BE  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:E2C1  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / Take the stored direction as the new state
$02:E2C3  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E2C5  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:E2C7  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } Block X = sprite X
$02:E2CA  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:E2CC  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E2CE  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:E2D0  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Block Y = sprite Y
$02:E2D3  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:E2D5  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:E2D7  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = coin ($06)
$02:E2D9  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the coin block
$02:E2DD  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E2DE  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Handle block interaction
$02:E2E2  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:E2E4  D0 0D         BNE $E2F3             ; / X speed non-zero: horizontal movement
$02:E2E6  AD D7 18      LDA.W $18D7                 ; \
$02:E2E9  D0 14         BNE $E2FF             ; / Vertical movement: if [$18D7] set, go finish
$02:E2EB  AD 5F 18      LDA.W $185F                 ; \
$02:E2EE  C9 25         CMP.B #$25                  ; } Is the tile above Map16 $25 (a coin trail)? If not, end
$02:E2F0  D0 0D         BNE $E2FF             ; /
$02:E2F2  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E2F3  AD 62 18      LDA.W $1862                 ; \
$02:E2F6  D0 07         BNE $E2FF             ; / Horizontal: tile side check
$02:E2F8  AD 60 18      LDA.W $1860                 ; \
$02:E2FB  C9 25         CMP.B #$25                  ; } Is the tile map16 $25? Return if so
$02:E2FD  F0 03         BEQ $E302            ; /
$02:E2FF  20 71 E2      JSR.W $E271           ; Time out the sprite ($E271)
$02:E302  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $E303: Gas Bubble main (GasBubbleMain) ;;;
{
;; Wrapper: sets the data bank and runs the main routine.
;; Called by: $01:87C0 (Large green gas bubble (GasBubble))
$02:E303  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E304  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
