$02:E306  20 11 E3      JSR.W $E311           ; Run the sprite code
$02:E309  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:E30A  6B            RTL                          ; Return


}

;;; $E30B..E30F: Table: Gas Bubble movement ;;;
{
;; X speeds by direction, Y acceleration and Y speed limits.
$02:E30B                .db $10,$F0                 ; X speeds by direction: $10, $F0

$02:E30D                .db $01,$FF                 ; Y acceleration: +1, -1

$02:E30F                .db $10,$F0                 ; Y speed limits: $10, $F0

}

;;; $E311: Gas Bubble movement ;;;
{
;; Moves horizontally at a fixed speed and bobs vertically (Y speed oscillates between limits every 4 frames). Hurts Mario on contact.
;; Called by: $02:E306 (Gas Bubble main (GasBubbleMain))
$02:E311  20 AA E3      JSR.W GasBubbleGfx          ; Draw the gas bubble
$02:E314  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E316  D0 39         BNE $E351            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:E318  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:E31B  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Return if not status 8 (normal)
$02:E31D  D0 32         BNE $E351            ; /
$02:E31F  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = direction
$02:E322  B9 0B E3      LDA.W $E30B,Y         ; X speed from table
$02:E325  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store X speed
$02:E327  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:E32A  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:E32C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Every fourth frame
$02:E32E  D0 14         BNE $E344             ; /
$02:E330  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E332  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Y = state bit 0
$02:E334  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:E335  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:E337  18            CLC                          ; } Y speed += $E30D[Y]
$02:E338  79 0D E3      ADC.W $E30D,Y         ; /
$02:E33B  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Store Y speed
$02:E33D  D9 0F E3      CMP.W $E30F,Y         ; \
$02:E340  D0 02         BNE $E344             ; / Hit the limit? If not skip
$02:E342  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Flip direction of acceleration (state++)
$02:E344  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:E347  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; [$1570]++ (animation counter)
$02:E34A  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far offscreen
$02:E34D  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Interact with Mario
$02:E351  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $E352..E35A: Table: Gas Bubble tile X offsets ;;;
{
;; 16 tiles in a 4x4 layout.
$02:E352                .db $00,$10,$20,$30,$00,$10,$20,$30 ; X offsets of the 16 tiles, columns 0-3 repeated
$02:E35A                .db $00,$10,$20,$30,$00,$10,$20,$30
}

;;; $E362..E36A: Table: Gas Bubble tile Y offsets ;;;
{
;; 16 tiles in a 4x4 layout.
$02:E362                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$10,$10,$10,$10 ; Y offsets of the 16 tiles, rows 0-3
$02:E36A                .db $20,$20,$20,$20,$30,$30,$30,$30
}

;;; $E372..E37A: Table: Gas Bubble tile numbers ;;;
{
;; 16 tile numbers.
$02:E372                .db $80,$82,$84,$86,$A0,$A2,$A4,$A6 ; Tile numbers
$02:E37A                .db $A0,$A2,$A4,$A6,$80,$82,$84,$86
}

;;; $E382..E38A: Table: Gas Bubble tile properties ;;;
{
;; $3B for the top half, $BB (Y flipped) for the bottom.
$02:E382                .db $3B,$3B,$3B,$3B,$3B,$3B,$3B,$3B ; Tile properties: $3B normal, $BB Y flipped
$02:E38A                .db $BB,$BB,$BB,$BB,$BB,$BB,$BB,$BB
}

;;; $E392..E39A: Table: Gas Bubble wobble flags ;;;
{
;; Bit 1: subtract wobble in X; bit 0: subtract in Y.
$02:E392                .db $00,$00,$02,$02,$00,$00,$02,$02 ; Wobble direction bits per tile (bit 1 = X, bit 0 = Y)
$02:E39A                .db $01,$01,$03,$03,$01,$01,$03,$03
}

;;; $E3A2..E3A6: Table: Gas Bubble wobble offsets ;;;
{
;; X offsets then Y offsets by animation frame.
$02:E3A2                .db $00,$01,$02,$01         ; Wobble offsets X: 0,1,2,1

$02:E3A6                .db $02,$01,$00,$01         ; Wobble offsets Y: 2,1,0,1

}

;;; $E3AA: Draw Gas Bubble (GasBubbleGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws 16 8x8 tiles in a 4x4 grid, with a wobble that moves tiles in or out (X and Y) depending on animation frame and per-tile flags.
;; Called by: $02:E311 (Gas Bubble movement)
$02:E3AA  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info (screen X in $00, Y in $01)
$02:E3AD  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E3B0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:E3B1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:E3B2  4A            LSR                          ; } Y = animation frame from [$1570] bits 3-4
$02:E3B3  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; /
$02:E3B5  A8            TAY                          ; Index
$02:E3B6  B9 A2 E3      LDA.W $E3A2,Y         ; \
$02:E3B9  85 02         STA $02                     ; / $02 = wobble X offset
$02:E3BB  B9 A6 E3      LDA.W $E3A6,Y         ; \
$02:E3BE  85 03         STA $03                     ; / $03 = wobble Y offset
$02:E3C0  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:E3C3  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:E3C4  A2 0F         LDX.B #$0F                  ; X = 15: loop over 16 tiles
$02:E3C6  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E3C8  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E3C9  7D 52 E3      ADC.W $E352,X         ; } Tile X = screen X + column offset
$02:E3CC  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:E3CD  BD 92 E3      LDA.W $E392,X         ; \
$02:E3D0  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; } Bit 1 of wobble set: subtract
$02:E3D2  D0 06         BNE $E3DA             ; /
$02:E3D4  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E3D5  18            CLC                          ; } Add wobble offset
$02:E3D6  65 02         ADC $02                     ; /
$02:E3D8  80 04         BRA $E3DE             ; Skip

$02:E3DA  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E3DB  38            SEC                          ; } Subtract wobble offset
$02:E3DC  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; /
$02:E3DE  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store tile X
$02:E3E1  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E3E3  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E3E4  7D 62 E3      ADC.W $E362,X         ; } Tile Y = screen Y + row offset
$02:E3E7  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:E3E8  BD 92 E3      LDA.W $E392,X         ; \
$02:E3EB  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Bit 0 of wobble set: subtract
$02:E3ED  D0 06         BNE $E3F5             ; /
$02:E3EF  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E3F0  18            CLC                          ; } Add wobble offset
$02:E3F1  65 03         ADC $03                     ; /
$02:E3F3  80 04         BRA $E3F9             ; Skip

$02:E3F5  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E3F6  38            SEC                          ; } Subtract wobble offset
$02:E3F7  E5 03         SBC $03                     ; /
$02:E3F9  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store tile Y
$02:E3FC  BD 72 E3      LDA.W $E372,X         ; \
$02:E3FF  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile number
$02:E402  BD 82 E3      LDA.W $E382,X         ; \
$02:E405  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Tile properties
$02:E408  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:E409  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:E40A  C8            INY                          ; } Next OAM slot (Y += 4)
$02:E40B  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:E40C  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:E40D  10 B7         BPL $E3C6             ; / Loop for all 16 tiles
$02:E40F  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:E410  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; \
$02:E412  A9 0F         LDA.B #$0F                  ; / Y = 2 (16x16 tiles), A = 15 (16 tiles)
$02:E414  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish: set OAM size and finish via $B7A7

}

;;; $E417: Exploding Block main (ExplodingBlkMain) ;;;
{
;; Shakes sideways. When Mario comes within range, turns into the sprite whose number is stored in [$C2] and shatters the block into pieces.
;; Called by: $01:87CF (Exploding block (ExplodingBlock))
$02:E417  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E418  4B            PHK                          ; } Set data bank = program bank (02)
$02:E419  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E41A  20 1F E4      JSR.W $E41F           ; Run the sprite code
$02:E41D  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:E41E  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E41F  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw as a generic sprite
$02:E423  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E425  D0 3B         BNE $E462            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:E427  80 04         BRA $E42D             ; Skip over the unused code

$02:E429  22 CF C0 02   JSL.L $C0CF           ; Unused. Call to $C0CF (unreachable)
$02:E42D  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: no shake
$02:E42F  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; [$1570]++
$02:E432  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E435  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; } Bit 6 of counter: shake phase
$02:E437  F0 0B         BEQ $E444             ; /
$02:E439  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; Y = 4
$02:E43B  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E43E  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Every 4th frame ...
$02:E440  F0 02         BEQ $E444             ; /
$02:E442  A0 FC         LDY.B #$FC                  ; Y = -4
$02:E444  94 B6         STY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store as X speed (shaking)
$02:E446  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:E449  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Interact with Mario
$02:E44D  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Get horizontal distance to Mario
$02:E450  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:E452  18            CLC                          ; } [$0F] + $60
$02:E453  69 60         ADC.B #$60                  ; /
$02:E455  C9 C0         CMP.B #$C0                  ; \
$02:E457  B0 09         BCS $E462            ; / Return if Mario is out of range ($C0)
$02:E459  BC A0 15      LDY.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; \
$02:E45C  D0 04         BNE $E462            ; / Return if offscreen horizontally
$02:E45E  22 63 E4 02   JSL.L $E463           ; Explode: turn into the sprite stored in [$C2]
$02:E462  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E463  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E465  95 9E         STA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; / Sprite number = stored value in sprite state
$02:E467  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the new sprite tables
$02:E46B  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:E46D  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $D0 (up)
$02:E46F  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Get direction to Mario
$02:E472  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E473  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Facing = direction
$02:E476  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E478  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; / Block X low = sprite X low
$02:E47A  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:E47D  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; / Block X high
$02:E47F  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E481  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; / Block Y low
$02:E483  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E486  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; / Block Y high
$02:E488  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E489  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; |
$02:E48B  48            PHA                          ; } Set data bank to 02
$02:E48C  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E48D  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:E48F  22 63 86 02   JSL.L ShatterBlock          ; / Shatter the block (explosion pieces)
$02:E493  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:E494  6B            RTL                          ; Return

}

;;; $E495: Mushroom scale platforms main (ScalePlatformMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite main for the pair of mushroom platforms on the scale: the sprite is one platform and keeps its partner's position in [$1534]/[$151C] (Y lo/hi),
;; [state] (X lo) and [$1602] (X hi). Runs $E524 for the partner (position temporarily swapped in) and then for itself.
;; Whichever platform carries something sinks 8 while the other rises; if neither does, they drift toward the same height. Preserves the sprite's OAM index.
;; Called by: $01:87D4 (Scale platforms (ScalePlatforms))
$02:E495  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Save sprite's OAM index (the code below shifts it for the second platform)
$02:E498  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:E499  8B            PHB                          ; |
$02:E49A  4B            PHK                          ; } Push saved index; data bank = program bank ($02)
$02:E49B  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E49C  20 A5 E4      JSR.W $E4A5           ; Run the scale platform routine
$02:E49F  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E4A0  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E4A1  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; / Restore OAM index (so the sprite's OAM slot is unchanged for next frame)
$02:E4A4  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E4A5  20 1B D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen2Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen (SubOffscreen type 2)
$02:E4A8  9C 5E 18      STZ.W $185E                 ; [$185E] = 0: count of platforms Mario/sprites are standing on
$02:E4AB  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E4AD  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E4AE  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; |
$02:E4B1  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E4B2  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; |
$02:E4B4  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E4B5  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Save this platform's X and Y position (lo/hi) on the stack
$02:E4B8  48            PHA                          ; /
$02:E4B9  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:E4BC  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; / Y position hi = [$151C] (partner platform Y hi)
$02:E4BF  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:E4C2  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Y position lo = [$1534] (partner platform Y lo)
$02:E4C4  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E4C6  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; / X position lo = [state] (partner platform X lo)
$02:E4C8  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:E4CB  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; / X position hi = [$1602] (partner platform X hi)
$02:E4CE  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: tile table index for the partner platform
$02:E4D0  20 24 E5      JSR.W $E524           ; Process the partner platform (generate tile, draw, solid interaction)
$02:E4D3  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E4D4  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; / Restore Y position hi
$02:E4D7  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E4D8  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Restore Y position lo
$02:E4DA  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E4DB  9D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; / Restore X position hi
$02:E4DE  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E4DF  95 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; / Restore X position lo
$02:E4E1  90 08         BCC $E4EB             ; Carry clear: nothing on the partner platform, skip
$02:E4E3  EE 5E 18      INC.W $185E                 ; One platform is loaded: [$185E]++
$02:E4E6  A9 F8         LDA.B #$F8                  ; A = $F8 (Y speed -8)
$02:E4E8  20 59 E5      JSR.W $E559           ; Move this sprite up 8 and adjust the partner's stored Y the other way
$02:E4EB  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:E4EE  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E4EF  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } OAM index += 8 (second platform uses the next two OAM tiles)
$02:E4F1  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:E4F4  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: tile table index for this platform
$02:E4F6  20 24 E5      JSR.W $E524           ; Process this platform
$02:E4F9  90 08         BCC $E503             ; Carry clear: nothing on this platform, skip
$02:E4FB  EE 5E 18      INC.W $185E                 ; Platform loaded: [$185E]++
$02:E4FE  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; A = $08 (Y speed +8)
$02:E500  20 59 E5      JSR.W $E559           ; Move this sprite down 8 and adjust the partner's stored Y the other way
$02:E503  AD 5E 18      LDA.W $185E                 ; \
$02:E506  D0 17         BNE $E51F            ; / If either platform is loaded, skip the re-centering below
$02:E508  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: re-centering speed
$02:E50A  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E50C  DD 34 15      CMP.W $1534,X               ; / Compare this platform's Y lo with partner's [$1534]
$02:E50F  F0 0E         BEQ $E51F            ; Equal: already level, return
$02:E511  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E514  FD 1C 15      SBC.W $151C,X               ; / Subtract the Y hi difference (carry from the CMP)
$02:E517  30 02         BMI $E51B             ; This platform is higher (negative difference): keep speed +2
$02:E519  A0 FE         LDY.B #$FE                  ; Otherwise speed -2
$02:E51B  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E51C  20 59 E5      JSR.W $E559           ; / Slowly move toward the partner's height (speed in A)
$02:E51F  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $E520: Scale platform tile generation and balance (MushrmScaleTiles) ;;;
{
;; $02E524: when on a 16 pixel row boundary and moving, generates a block under the platform (MushrmScaleTiles), draws it and runs solid-block interaction. Carry returns from InvisBlkMainRt (probably set when something stands on it).
;; $02E559: moves the platform vertically by A, and moves the partner's stored Y the opposite way (by -[$1491]).
;; Parameters: Y: table index (0 self, 2 partner); A: Y speed ($02E559).
$02:E520                .db $02,$07,$07,$02         ; Tile numbers to generate: [down self, up self, down partner, up partner] ($02 / $07)

$02:E524  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E526  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; / Y position lo & $0F: only act when exactly on a 16 pixel boundary
$02:E528  D0 24         BNE $E54E             ; Not aligned: skip tile generation
$02:E52A  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:E52C  F0 20         BEQ $E54E             ; / Y speed = 0: nothing to do
$02:E52E  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:E530  10 01         BPL $E533             ; Moving down: keep index
$02:E532  C8            INY                          ; Moving up: use the next table entry
$02:E533  B9 20 E5      LDA.W MushrmScaleTiles,Y    ; Tile number = MushrmScaleTiles[Y]
$02:E536  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; Block to generate = that tile
$02:E538  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E53A  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:E53C  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } Block X position = sprite X position
$02:E53F  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:E541  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E543  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:E545  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Block Y position = sprite Y position
$02:E548  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:E54A  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the tile at the platform position
$02:E54E  20 7E E5      JSR.W MushroomScaleGfx      ; Draw the mushroom platform
$02:E551  9E 28 15      STZ.W $1528,X               ; Clear [$1528] (Mario-on-sprite carry flag, probably)
$02:E554  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Solid block interaction (invisible solid block code); carry set if Mario stands on it
$02:E558  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E559  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; Y = [RAM_SpritesLocked]
$02:E55B  D0 20         BNE $E57D            ; Sprites locked: return
$02:E55D  48            PHA                          ; Save new Y speed
$02:E55E  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position by current speed (no gravity)
$02:E561  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E562  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = saved value
$02:E564  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: sign extension byte
$02:E566  AD 91 14      LDA.W $1491                 ; \
$02:E569  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; } A = -[$1491] (two's complement)
$02:E56B  1A            INC A                       ; /
$02:E56C  10 01         BPL $E56F             ; Non-negative: sign extension stays 0
$02:E56E  88            DEY                          ; Negative: sign extension = $FF
$02:E56F  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E570  7D 34 15      ADC.W $1534,X               ; } Partner Y lo ([$1534]) += A
$02:E573  9D 34 15      STA.W $1534,X               ; /
$02:E576  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E577  7D 1C 15      ADC.W $151C,X               ; } Partner Y hi ([$151C]) += sign extension (partner moves opposite to this platform)
$02:E57A  9D 1C 15      STA.W $151C,X               ; /
$02:E57D  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $E57E: Draw mushroom scale platform (MushroomScaleGfx) ;;;
{
;; Draws a two-tile wide mushroom top (tile $80, right half X flipped) centered on the sprite.
;; Called by: $02:E00B (Draw Volcano Lotus (VolcanoLotusGfx)), $02:E54E (Scale platform tile generation and balance (MushrmScaleTiles))
$02:E57E  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position ([$00] X, [$01] Y)
$02:E581  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E583  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:E584  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; } Left tile X = X - 8
$02:E586  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:E589  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E58A  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; } Right tile X = left tile X + 16
$02:E58C  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; /
$02:E58F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E591  3A            DEC A                       ; } Tile Y = Y - 1
$02:E592  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:E595  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Right tile Y = same
$02:E598  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; A = $80: mushroom platform top tile
$02:E59A  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Left tile number
$02:E59D  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Right tile number (flipped below)
$02:E5A0  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:E5A3  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Left tile properties = sprite palette | priority [$64]
$02:E5A5  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:E5A8  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:E5AA  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Right tile properties = same | X flip
$02:E5AD  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1: two tiles
$02:E5AF  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:E5B1  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write

}

;;; $E5B4: Moving ledge (hole) sprite main (MovingLedgeMain) ;;;
{
;; Horizontally oscillating ledge, speed +/-$10, direction flipping every $80 frames of [$1570]. Draws four tiles, tests contact with the other sprites ($E5F7, results in [$15DC,Y] and [$185C]) and Mario.
;; Called by: $01:8893 (Moving ledge hole in ghost house (MovingLedge))
$02:E5B4  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E5B5  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank
$02:E5B6  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E5B7  20 BC E5      JSR.W $E5BC           ; Run moving ledge routine
$02:E5BA  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E5BB  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E5BC  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:E5BF  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E5C1  D0 14         BNE $E5D7             ; / Sprites locked: skip movement
$02:E5C3  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Frame timer [$1570]++
$02:E5C6  A0 10         LDY.B #$10                  ; Y = $10: speed right
$02:E5C8  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E5CB  29 80         AND.B #$80                  ; } Bit 7 of timer clear: keep $10
$02:E5CD  D0 02         BNE $E5D1             ; /
$02:E5CF  A0 F0         LDY.B #$F0                  ; Bit 7 set: Y = $F0 (speed left); direction flips every $80 frames
$02:E5D1  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E5D2  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = Y
$02:E5D4  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:E5D7  20 37 E6      JSR.W $E637           ; Draw the hole/ledge
$02:E5DA  20 F7 E5      JSR.W $E5F7           ; Check contact with other sprites
$02:E5DD  AD 5C 18      LDA.W $185C                 ; \
$02:E5E0  F0 06         BEQ $E5E8             ; / [$185C] = 0: no one is using this ledge, interact with Mario
$02:E5E2  3A            DEC A                       ; \
$02:E5E3  CD E9 15      CMP.W $15E9                 ; } Another sprite index owns the contact? If not this sprite, return
$02:E5E6  D0 0E         BNE $E5F6            ; /
$02:E5E8  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Interact with Mario (carry set if touching)
$02:E5EC  9C 5C 18      STZ.W $185C                 ; Clear [$185C]
$02:E5EF  90 05         BCC $E5F6            ; Not touching: return
$02:E5F1  E8            INX                          ; \
$02:E5F2  8E 5C 18      STX.W $185C                 ; } [$185C] = this sprite index + 1 (claims the contact)
$02:E5F5  CA            DEX                          ; /
$02:E5F6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E5F7  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = $0B: sprite slot to check, counting down
$02:E5F9  CC E9 15      CPY.W $15E9                 ; \
$02:E5FC  F0 35         BEQ $E633             ; / Skip this sprite itself
$02:E5FE  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E5FF  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:E601  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Only test a given slot on every fourth frame (offset by slot)
$02:E603  D0 2E         BNE $E633             ; /
$02:E605  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:E608  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Skip sprites with status < 8 (not alive/normal)
$02:E60A  90 27         BCC $E633             ; /
$02:E60C  B9 DC 15      LDA.W $15DC,Y               ; \
$02:E60F  F0 06         BEQ $E617             ; / [$15DC,Y] = 0: not already in contact with a ledge
$02:E611  3A            DEC A                       ; \
$02:E612  CD E9 15      CMP.W $15E9                 ; } Else only retest if it is in contact with this ledge
$02:E615  D0 1C         BNE $E633             ; /
$02:E617  BB            TYX                          ; \
$02:E618  22 E5 B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB    ; / Clipping box for the other sprite (slot Y)
$02:E61C  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = this sprite; get its clipping box
$02:E61F  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Clipping box for this ledge
$02:E623  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Check for contact
$02:E627  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:E629  99 DC 15      STA.W $15DC,Y               ; / [$15DC,Y] = 0 (no contact)
$02:E62C  90 05         BCC $E633             ; No contact: next sprite
$02:E62E  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:E62F  1A            INC A                       ; } [$15DC,Y] = this sprite index + 1 (contact)
$02:E630  99 DC 15      STA.W $15DC,Y               ; /
$02:E633  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:E634  10 C3         BPL $E5F9             ; / Next slot, loop for Y = $0B..0
$02:E636  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E637  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position
$02:E63A  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:E63B  A2 03         LDX.B #$03                  ; X = 3: four tiles
$02:E63D  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E63F  18            CLC                          ; } Tile X = X + $E666[X]
$02:E640  7D 66 E6      ADC.W $E666,X         ; /
$02:E643  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store tile X
$02:E646  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E648  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Tile Y = sprite Y
$02:E64B  BD 6A E6      LDA.W MovingHoleTiles,X     ; \
$02:E64E  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile number from MovingHoleTiles[X]
$02:E651  BD 6E E6      LDA.W $E66E,X         ; \
$02:E654  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Tile properties from $E66E[X]
$02:E657  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:E658  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:E659  C8            INY                          ; } Next OAM slot (4 bytes)
$02:E65A  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:E65B  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:E65C  10 DF         BPL $E63D             ; / Next tile
$02:E65E  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:E65F  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: four tiles
$02:E661  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:E663  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write


}

;;; $E666..E666: Table: moving ledge tile X offsets ;;;
{
$02:E666                .db $00,$08,$18,$20         ; Tile X offsets: 0, 8, $18, $20

}

;;; $E66A: Moving ledge tables; Lakitu fishing line graphics (MovingHoleTiles) ;;;
{
;; $02E66A/$02E66E: tile and property tables for the moving ledge. $02E672 (from the Lakitu routine when [$151C] is set, probably the Fishin' Lakitu): draws the pole, a bait and an 8 tile line below it; touching the bait with Mario clears [$151C] and gives a score sprite (probably 1UP).
$02:E66A                .db $EB,$EA,$EA,$EB         ; Tile numbers: $EB, $EA, $EA, $EB

$02:E66E                .db $71,$31,$31,$31         ; Tile properties: $71 then $31 for the rest

$02:E672  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E673  4B            PHK                          ; } Long-call wrapper: data bank = program bank (Fishin' Lakitu line)
$02:E674  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E675  20 7A E6      JSR.W $E67A           ; Draw the fishing line
$02:E678  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E679  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E67A  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position
$02:E67D  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E67E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E67F  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } Sprite OAM index += 8 (the pole and bait use the slots after Lakitu's)
$02:E681  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; /
$02:E684  A8            TAY                          ; Y = OAM index
$02:E685  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E687  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:E688  E9 0D         SBC.B #$0D                  ; } Pole X = X - $0D
$02:E68A  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; /
$02:E68D  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:E68E  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; } Line and bait X = pole X - 8, saved in [$185E]
$02:E690  8D 5E 18      STA.W $185E                 ; /
$02:E693  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; Bait X
$02:E696  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E698  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E699  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; } Pole Y = Y + 2
$02:E69B  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:E69E  8D B6 18      STA.W $18B6                 ; Save line start Y in [$18B6]
$02:E6A1  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E6A2  69 40         ADC.B #$40                  ; } Bait Y = pole Y + $40
$02:E6A4  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; /
$02:E6A7  A9 AA         LDA.B #$AA                  ; \
$02:E6A9  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Pole tile = $AA
$02:E6AC  A9 24         LDA.B #$24                  ; \
$02:E6AE  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; / Bait tile = $24
$02:E6B1  A9 35         LDA.B #$35                  ; \
$02:E6B3  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Pole properties
$02:E6B6  A9 3A         LDA.B #$3A                  ; \
$02:E6B8  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Bait properties
$02:E6BB  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1: two tiles
$02:E6BD  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:E6BF  20 A7 B7      JSR.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write
$02:E6C2  BD A0 15      LDA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; Sprite is off-screen horizontally
$02:E6C5  D0 24         BNE $E6EB             ; Off-screen: skip the catch test
$02:E6C7  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:E6CA  A5 7E         LDA $7E                     ; \
$02:E6CC  38            SEC                          ; } A = Mario screen X [$7E] - bait X
$02:E6CD  F9 04 03      SBC.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; /
$02:E6D0  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E6D1  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; } Within +/- $0C in X?
$02:E6D3  C9 18         CMP.B #$18                  ; /
$02:E6D5  B0 14         BCS $E6EB             ; No: skip
$02:E6D7  A5 80         LDA $80                     ; \
$02:E6D9  38            SEC                          ; } A = Mario screen Y [$80] - bait Y
$02:E6DA  F9 05 03      SBC.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; /
$02:E6DD  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E6DE  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; } Within +/- $0C in Y?
$02:E6E0  C9 18         CMP.B #$18                  ; /
$02:E6E2  B0 07         BCS $E6EB             ; No: skip
$02:E6E4  9E 1C 15      STZ.W $151C,X               ; [$151C] = 0: bait is gone
$02:E6E7  22 88 F3 00   JSL.L $F388           ; Give Mario a score sprite (probably 1UP)
$02:E6EB  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:E6EC  A9 38         LDA.B #$38                  ; \
$02:E6EE  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; / OAM index = $38
$02:E6F1  A8            TAY                          ; Y = OAM index
$02:E6F2  A2 07         LDX.B #$07                  ; X = 7: eight line tiles
$02:E6F4  AD 5E 18      LDA.W $185E                 ; \
$02:E6F7  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / Line tile X = [$185E]
$02:E6FA  AD B6 18      LDA.W $18B6                 ; \
$02:E6FD  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Line tile Y = [$18B6]
$02:E700  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E701  69 08         ADC.B #$08                  ; } [$18B6] += 8 (next tile down)
$02:E703  8D B6 18      STA.W $18B6                 ; /
$02:E706  A9 89         LDA.B #$89                  ; \
$02:E708  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = $89 (fishing line)
$02:E70B  A9 35         LDA.B #$35                  ; \
$02:E70D  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Properties = $35
$02:E710  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:E711  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:E712  C8            INY                          ; } Next OAM slot
$02:E713  C8            INY                          ; /
$02:E714  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:E715  10 DD         BPL $E6F4             ; / Next line tile, X = 7..0
$02:E717  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:E718  A9 07         LDA.B #$07                  ; A = 7: eight tiles
$02:E71A  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: 8x8 tiles
$02:E71C  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write

}

;;; $E71F: Jumping fish sprite main (SwimJumpFishMain) ;;;
{
;; Draws, locks, despawns, does Mario interaction and animation, then runs one of two states: swim back and forth, or jump out of the water.
;; Called by: $01:880B (Swimming/jumping fish (SwimJumpFish))
$02:E71F  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E720  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank
$02:E721  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E722  20 27 E7      JSR.W $E727           ; Run fish routine
$02:E725  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E726  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E727  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the sprite
$02:E72B  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E72D  D0 1C         BNE $E74B            ; / Sprites locked: return
$02:E72F  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:E732  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Mario and sprite interaction
$02:E736  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Process water/block interaction (probably)
$02:E73A  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; \
$02:E73C  20 3D EB      JSR.W $EB3D           ; / Animation frame: Y = 0 base, [$1602] = Y + ([$14] bit 2)
$02:E73F  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E741  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; } Run state 0 or 1 (state bit 0)
$02:E743  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; /

}

;;; $E747: Pointer table: jumping fish states (FishPtrs) ;;;
{
$02:E747  4E E7         .dw $E74E             ; State 0: swim back and forth
$02:E749  88 E7         .dw $E788             ; State 1: jump out of the water

$02:E74B  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $E74C..E74C: Table: jumping fish X speeds ;;;
{
$02:E74C                .db $14,$EC                 ; X speeds by direction: +$14 (right), -$14 (left)

}

;;; $E74E: Jumping fish state routines ;;;
{
;; $02E74E, state 0: swims back and forth, flipping direction at the end of each leg (timers $40/$20), after four legs sets Y speed $A0 and goes to state 1.
;; $02E788, state 1: jump arc with gravity +2 until timer ends; then snaps to a 16 pixel row, returns to state 0 with a $20 frame timer.
$02:E74E  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:E751  B9 4C E7      LDA.W $E74C,Y         ; / X speed from direction table
$02:E754  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store X speed
$02:E756  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:E759  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E75C  D0 1D         BNE $E77B            ; / Return while the swim timer [$1540] runs
$02:E75E  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E761  BC 70 15      LDY.W $1570,X               ; / Swim leg counter [$1570]++
$02:E764  C0 04         CPY.B #$04                  ; \
$02:E766  F0 14         BEQ $E77C             ; / 4th leg: go to the jump
$02:E768  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:E76B  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; } Flip direction
$02:E76D  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; /
$02:E770  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:E772  C0 03         CPY.B #$03                  ; / Next leg lasts $20 frames after leg 3, otherwise $40
$02:E774  F0 02         BEQ $E778             ; \
$02:E776  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; } Set timer [$1540]
$02:E778  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; /
$02:E77B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E77C  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++ (jump)
$02:E77E  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; \
$02:E780  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $80
$02:E783  A9 A0         LDA.B #$A0                  ; \
$02:E785  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $A0 (-$60, upward)
$02:E787  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E788  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; Timer [$1540] = 0: finished the jump
$02:E78B  F0 17         BEQ $E7A4             ; Go to landing
$02:E78D  C9 70         CMP.B #$70                  ; \
$02:E78F  B0 12         BCS $E7A3            ; / Timer >= $70: hold still at start, return
$02:E791  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed = 0
$02:E793  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:E796  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:E798  30 04         BMI $E79E             ; / Y speed negative: add gravity
$02:E79A  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; \
$02:E79C  B0 05         BCS $E7A3            ; / Positive but >= $30: no more gravity (terminal speed)
$02:E79E  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E79F  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; } Y speed += 2
$02:E7A1  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; /
$02:E7A3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E7A4  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E7A6  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; } Snap Y position to a 16 pixel boundary
$02:E7A8  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:E7AA  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++ (back to swimming)
$02:E7AC  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; Swim leg counter = 0
$02:E7AF  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:E7B1  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / Timer = $20
$02:E7B4  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $E7B5: Digging Chuck's rock main (ChucksRockMain) ;;;
{
;; Draws and updates the rock thrown by a Digging Chuck. Bounces off walls and ceiling, bounces up from the floor ($E0 or $D0 depending on fall speed) and rolls along slopes. While its timer [$1540] is under 8 it is active; with the timer running it is drawn with priority bits $10.
;; Called by: $01:8810 (Diggin' Chuck's rock (DigginChucksRock))
$02:E7B5  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E7B6  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank (Digging Chuck's rock)
$02:E7B7  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E7B8  20 BD E7      JSR.W $E7BD           ; Run rock routine
$02:E7BB  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E7BC  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E7BD  A5 64         LDA $64                     ; \
$02:E7BF  48            PHA                          ; / Save tile priority bits [$64]
$02:E7C0  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E7C3  F0 04         BEQ $E7C9             ; / Timer [$1540] = 0: draw normally
$02:E7C5  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:E7C7  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Timer running (rock is breaking): [$64] = $10 (draw behind layers)
$02:E7C9  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the rock
$02:E7CD  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E7CE  85 64         STA $64                     ; / Restore [$64]
$02:E7D0  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E7D2  D0 58         BNE $E82C            ; / Sprites locked: return
$02:E7D4  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E7D7  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; } Timer >= 8: return (rock waits for its release)
$02:E7D9  B0 51         BCS $E82C            ; /
$02:E7DB  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0
$02:E7DD  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:E7DF  4A            LSR                          ; / A = frame counter / 2
$02:E7E0  20 3D EB      JSR.W $EB3D           ; Animation frame ([$1602]) from timer
$02:E7E3  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:E7E6  22 2A 80 01   JSL.L UpdateSpritePos       ; Update position with gravity and block interaction
$02:E7EA  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E7ED  D0 39         BNE $E828             ; / Timer non-zero: skip the bounce logic
$02:E7EF  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:E7F2  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Not touching a wall (bits 0-1): skip
$02:E7F4  F0 07         BEQ $E7FD             ; /
$02:E7F6  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:E7F8  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:E7FA  1A            INC A                       ; } Hit a wall: negate X speed
$02:E7FB  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; /
$02:E7FD  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:E800  29 08         AND.B #$08                  ; } Not touching ceiling (bit 3): skip
$02:E802  F0 04         BEQ $E808             ; /
$02:E804  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:E806  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Hit ceiling: Y speed = $10 (downward)
$02:E808  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:E80B  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; } Not on ground (bit 2): skip
$02:E80D  F0 19         BEQ $E828             ; /
$02:E80F  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:E811  C9 38         CMP.B #$38                  ; / Y speed >= $38 (falling fast)?
$02:E813  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; Select bounce speed: carry from the CMP above ($38 threshold)
$02:E815  90 02         BCC $E819             ; Carry set (speed < $38): bounce speed -$20
$02:E817  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; Fast fall: bounce speed -$30
$02:E819  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = bounce
$02:E81B  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; A = 8: rolling speed
$02:E81D  BC B8 15      LDY.W $15B8,X               ; \
$02:E820  F0 06         BEQ $E828             ; / [$15B8] = slope type: flat, no rolling push
$02:E822  10 02         BPL $E826             ; \
$02:E824  A9 F8         LDA.B #$F8                  ; / Slope down-left: speed -8
$02:E826  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed = +/- 8 along the slope
$02:E828  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Mario and sprite interaction
$02:E82C  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

$02:E82D  8B            PHB                          ; \

;;; $E835..E839: Table: growing pipe Y speeds and durations ;;;
{
;; $E835: Y speed per phase. $E839: phase duration in frames.
$02:E835                .db $00,$F0,$00,$10         ; Y speed per phase: wait, up -$10, wait, down +$10

$02:E839                .db $20,$40,$20,$40         ; Duration per phase: $20, $40, $20, $40 frames

}

;;; $E83D: Table: growing pipe left tiles (GrowingPipeTiles1) ;;;
{
$02:E83D                .db $00,$14,$00,$02         ; Left half Map16 tile per phase ($14 while rising, $02 empty while sinking)

}

;;; $E841: Growing pipe logic and right tile table (GrowingPipeTiles2) ;;;
{
;; $02E841: right tile table. $02E845: setup (while [$1534] is non-negative, clears one row of tiles per frame and counts down by $10), then the cycle: wait, rise, wait, sink, only while Mario is within range, generating Map16 tiles for the pipe body as it moves.
$02:E841                .db $00,$15,$00,$02         ; Right half Map16 tile per phase ($15 while rising, $02 empty while sinking)

$02:E845  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:E848  30 28         BMI $E872             ; / [$1534] bit 7 set: normal operation (setup finished)
$02:E84A  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E84C  48            PHA                          ; / Save Y lo
$02:E84D  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:E84E  FD 34 15      SBC.W $1534,X               ; } Y = Y - [$1534]
$02:E851  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; /
$02:E853  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:E856  48            PHA                          ; |
$02:E857  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; } Same for Y hi
$02:E859  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; /
$02:E85C  A0 03         LDY.B #$03                  ; Y = 3: generate empty tiles
$02:E85E  20 BA E8      JSR.W GrowingPipeGfx        ; Generate the pipe tiles at this position
$02:E861  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E862  9D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; / Restore Y hi
$02:E865  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:E866  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Restore Y lo
$02:E868  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:E86B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:E86C  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; } [$1534] -= $10 (next row up)
$02:E86E  9D 34 15      STA.W $1534,X               ; /
$02:E871  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E872  20 02 E9      JSR.W $E902           ; Draw the pipe top
$02:E875  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:E878  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E87A  1D A0 15      ORA.W RAM_OffscreenHorz,X   ; } Sprites locked or off-screen: only do interaction
$02:E87D  D0 36         BNE $E8B5             ; /
$02:E87F  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Mario X distance from the pipe in [$0F]
$02:E882  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:E884  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E885  69 50         ADC.B #$50                  ; |
$02:E887  C9 A0         CMP.B #$A0                  ; } Mario within range ([$0F] + $50 < $A0)? If not, only do interaction
$02:E889  B0 2A         BCS $E8B5             ; /
$02:E88B  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E88D  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; } Y = phase (state & 3)
$02:E88F  A8            TAY                          ; /
$02:E890  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:E893  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; / Phase timer [$1570]++
$02:E896  D9 39 E8      CMP.W $E839,Y         ; \
$02:E899  D0 07         BNE $E8A2             ; / Not yet the phase duration: keep moving
$02:E89B  9E 70 15      STZ.W $1570,X               ; Timer = 0
$02:E89E  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next phase
$02:E8A0  80 13         BRA $E8B5             ; Skip movement this frame

$02:E8A2  B9 35 E8      LDA.W $E835,Y         ; \
$02:E8A5  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed from the phase table
$02:E8A7  F0 09         BEQ $E8B2             ; Speed 0 (waiting): skip
$02:E8A9  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E8AB  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; } Only on a 16 pixel boundary:
$02:E8AD  D0 03         BNE $E8B2             ; /
$02:E8AF  20 BA E8      JSR.W GrowingPipeGfx        ; Generate/erase pipe tiles
$02:E8B2  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:E8B5  22 4F B4 01   JSL.L InvisBlkMainRt        ; Solid block interaction
$02:E8B9  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $E8BA: Generate growing pipe tiles and draw top (GrowingPipeGfx) ;;;
{
;; $02E8BA: generates two Map16 tiles (left, right at X+$10) at the sprite position using phase table index Y.
;; $02E902: draws the pipe opening as two tiles ($A4, $A6).
;; Called by: $02:E85E (Growing pipe logic and right tile table (GrowingPipeTiles2)), $02:E8AF (Growing pipe logic and right tile table (GrowingPipeTiles2))
$02:E8BA  B9 3D E8      LDA.W GrowingPipeTiles1,Y   ; \
$02:E8BD  8D 5E 18      STA.W $185E                 ; / Left tile = GrowingPipeTiles1[Y], saved in [$185E]
$02:E8C0  B9 41 E8      LDA.W GrowingPipeTiles2,Y   ; \
$02:E8C3  8D B6 18      STA.W $18B6                 ; / Right tile = GrowingPipeTiles2[Y], saved in [$18B6]
$02:E8C6  AD 5E 18      LDA.W $185E                 ; \
$02:E8C9  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = left tile
$02:E8CB  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E8CD  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:E8CF  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; } Block X = sprite X
$02:E8D2  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:E8D4  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E8D6  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:E8D8  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Block Y = sprite Y
$02:E8DB  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:E8DD  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the left tile
$02:E8E1  AD B6 18      LDA.W $18B6                 ; \
$02:E8E4  85 9C         STA RAM_BlockBlock          ; / Block to generate = right tile
$02:E8E6  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:E8E8  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E8E9  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:E8EB  85 9A         STA RAM_BlockXLo            ; |
$02:E8ED  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; |
$02:E8F0  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; } Block X = sprite X + $10
$02:E8F2  85 9B         STA RAM_BlockXHi            ; /
$02:E8F4  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:E8F6  85 98         STA RAM_BlockYLo            ; |
$02:E8F8  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; } Block Y = sprite Y
$02:E8FB  85 99         STA RAM_BlockYHi            ; /
$02:E8FD  22 B0 BE 00   JSL.L GenerateTile          ; Generate the right tile
$02:E901  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E902  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index and screen position
$02:E905  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E907  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / Left tile X = X
$02:E90A  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E90B  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; } Right tile X = X + 16
$02:E90D  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; /
$02:E910  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E912  3A            DEC A                       ; } Tile Y = Y - 1
$02:E913  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; /
$02:E916  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Right tile Y = same
$02:E919  A9 A4         LDA.B #$A4                  ; \
$02:E91B  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Left tile = $A4 (pipe opening)
$02:E91E  A9 A6         LDA.B #$A6                  ; \
$02:E920  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; / Right tile = $A6 (pipe opening)
$02:E923  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:E926  05 64         ORA $64                     ; } Left properties = palette | [$64]
$02:E928  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; /
$02:E92B  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; Right properties = same
$02:E92E  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; A = 1: two tiles
$02:E930  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: 16x16 tiles
$02:E932  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write

}

;;; $E935: Pipe Lakitu main (PipeLakituMain) ;;;
{
;; Draws, and when status is 2 (killed) shows frame 2 only. Otherwise runs the state machine in PipeLakituPtrs.
;; Called by: $01:8801 (Pipe-dwelling Lakitu (PipeLakitu))
$02:E935  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:E936  4B            PHK                          ; } Data bank = program bank (Pipe Lakitu)
$02:E937  AB            PLB                          ; /
$02:E938  20 3D E9      JSR.W $E93D           ; Run Pipe Lakitu routine
$02:E93B  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:E93C  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:E93D  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:E940  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)?
$02:E942  D0 08         BNE $E94C             ; No: normal path
$02:E944  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:E946  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Killed: animation frame $1602 = 2
$02:E949  4C EC E9      JMP.W $E9EC           ; Just draw

$02:E94C  20 EC E9      JSR.W $E9EC           ; Draw
$02:E94F  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:E951  D0 32         BNE $E985            ; / Sprites locked: return
$02:E953  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Animation frame = 0
$02:E956  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:E959  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Mario and sprite interaction
$02:E95D  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:E95F  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; / Run the current state

}

;;; $E963: Pipe Lakitu state routines (PipeLakituPtrs) ;;;
{
;; State 0: waits until Mario is away from the pipe. 1: rises, faces Mario. 2: rises further. 3: throws a sprite (spawns $14, or $21 coin with Silver POW). 4: sinks back and returns to state 0. Timer in [$1540].
$02:E963  6D E9         .dw $E96D             ; State 0: wait in pipe
$02:E965  86 E9         .dw $E986             ; State 1: rise out of pipe
$02:E967  B4 E9         .dw $E9B4             ; State 2: keep rising
$02:E969  BD E9         .dw $E9BD             ; State 3: throw an item
$02:E96B  D5 E9         .dw $E9D5             ; State 4: sink back

$02:E96D  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E970  D0 13         BNE $E985            ; / Timer [$1540] running: return
$02:E972  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Mario X distance in [$0F]
$02:E975  A5 0F         LDA $0F                     ; \
$02:E977  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:E978  69 13         ADC.B #$13                  ; |
$02:E97A  C9 36         CMP.B #$36                  ; } Mario within +/- $13 of the pipe? If so stay hidden
$02:E97C  90 07         BCC $E985            ; /
$02:E97E  A9 90         LDA.B #$90                  ; A = $90: timer
$02:E980  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; Set timer [$1540] = A
$02:E983  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State++
$02:E985  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E986  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E989  D0 0B         BNE $E996             ; / Timer non-zero: keep rising
$02:E98B  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Face Mario
$02:E98E  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E98F  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction = Mario side
$02:E992  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; A = $0C: timer
$02:E994  80 EA         BRA $E980             ; Set timer, state++

$02:E996  C9 7C         CMP.B #$7C                  ; \
$02:E998  90 08         BCC $E9A2             ; / Timer < $7C: go to turning
$02:E99A  A9 F8         LDA.B #$F8                  ; A = $F8
$02:E99C  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed = A
$02:E99E  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:E9A1  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E9A2  C9 50         CMP.B #$50                  ; \
$02:E9A4  B0 0D         BCS $E9B3            ; / Timer >= $50: return
$02:E9A6  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0
$02:E9A8  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:E9AA  29 20         AND.B #$20                  ; } Frame counter bit 5 set?
$02:E9AC  F0 01         BEQ $E9AF             ; /
$02:E9AE  C8            INY                          ; Y = 1
$02:E9AF  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:E9B0  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction toggles every $20 frames (looks around)
$02:E9B3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E9B4  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E9B7  D0 E1         BNE $E99A             ; / Timer non-zero: rise (speed -8)
$02:E9B9  A9 80         LDA.B #$80                  ; \
$02:E9BB  80 C3         BRA $E980             ; / Timer = $80, state++

$02:E9BD  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E9C0  D0 04         BNE $E9C6             ; / Timer non-zero: go on
$02:E9C2  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:E9C4  80 BA         BRA $E980             ; / Timer = $20, state++

$02:E9C6  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; \
$02:E9C8  D0 05         BNE $E9CF             ; / Timer = $40?
$02:E9CA  22 19 EA 01   JSL.L $EA19           ; Throw the item (spawns sprite $14, or $21 coin if Silver POW is active)
$02:E9CE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E9CF  B0 03         BCS $E9D4            ; Timer > $40: return
$02:E9D1  FE 02 16      INC.W $1602,X               ; Timer < $40: animation frame++ (throwing pose)
$02:E9D4  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E9D5  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:E9D8  D0 08         BNE $E9E2             ; / Timer non-zero: sink
$02:E9DA  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; \
$02:E9DC  20 80 E9      JSR.W $E980           ; / Timer = $50, state++
$02:E9DF  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0
$02:E9E1  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:E9E2  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:E9E4  80 B6         BRA $E99C             ; / Y speed = +8, update Y position (sink into pipe)


}

;;; $E9E6: Table: Pipe Lakitu tiles (probably) (PipeLakitu1) ;;;
{
$02:E9E6                .db $EC,$A8,$CE             ; Tile numbers: $EC, $A8, $CE (probably Pipe Lakitu graphics)

}

;;; $E9E9: Pipe Lakitu tiles, Baby Yoshi helpers (PipeLakitu2) ;;;
{
;; Lower-half tile table for the Pipe Lakitu, the tail of its draw routine, and three Baby Yoshi helpers called from bank 01.
;; $02E9EC: draws the two-tile Pipe Lakitu. $02EA25: Baby Yoshi draw tail, sets the dynamic tile source in $0D8B/$0D95 (probably).
;; $02EA4E: Baby Yoshi scans the other sprites to find one to put in its mouth ([$160E]). Interpretation of the tweaker tests is a guess.
$02:E9E9                .db $EE,$EE,$EE             ; Lower-half tile per frame: $EE, $EE, $EE

$02:E9EC  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info: Y = OAM index, [$00] = screen X, [$01] = screen Y (GetDrawInfo2)
$02:E9EF  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:E9F1  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / Top tile X = sprite screen X
$02:E9F4  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; Bottom tile X = same
$02:E9F7  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:E9F9  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Top tile Y = sprite screen Y
$02:E9FC  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:E9FD  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:E9FF  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; / Bottom tile Y = screen Y + $10
$02:EA02  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:EA03  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:EA06  AA            TAX                          ; / X = animation frame [$1602]
$02:EA07  BD E6 E9      LDA.W PipeLakitu1,X         ; Top tile from PipeLakitu1[frame]
$02:EA0A  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store top tile
$02:EA0D  BD E9 E9      LDA.W PipeLakitu2,X         ; Bottom tile from PipeLakitu2[frame]
$02:EA10  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Store bottom tile
$02:EA13  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:EA14  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:EA17  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:EA18  6A            ROR                          ; |
$02:EA19  4A            LSR                          ; /  A = direction bit shifted into the X-flip bit ($40)
$02:EA1A  49 5B         EOR.B #$5B                  ; Add priority/palette bits ($5B EOR)
$02:EA1C  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Store properties for top tile
$02:EA1F  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; Same properties for bottom tile
$02:EA22  4C 2E E9      JMP.W $E92E           ; Finish: set the two tile sizes and exit ($E92E)

$02:EA25  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Baby Yoshi draw tail: Y = OAM index of the sprite
$02:EA28  B9 02 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; \
$02:EA2B  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = tile number the earlier draw code picked (baby Yoshi frame)
$02:EA2D  64 01         STZ $01                     ; [$01] = 0 (16-bit index)
$02:EA2F  A9 06         LDA.B #$06                  ; \
$02:EA31  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile = $06 (the real graphics are DMAed in dynamically, probably)
$02:EA34  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:EA36  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:EA38  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EA39  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EA3A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EA3B  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EA3C  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EA3D  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EA3E  69 00 85      ADC.W #$8500                ; / A = [$00] * 32 + $8500: offset of this frame's tile data
$02:EA41  8D 8B 0D      STA.W $0D8B                 ; Dynamic graphics source, first row = A (probably used by NMI DMA)
$02:EA44  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EA45  69 00 02      ADC.W #$0200                ; / A += $0200: second tile row
$02:EA48  8D 95 0D      STA.W $0D95                 ; Dynamic graphics source, second row = A
$02:EA4B  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:EA4D  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:EA4E  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Baby Yoshi: look for a sprite to pick up, Y = sprite slot $0B down to 0
$02:EA50  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:EA51  DD 0E 16      CMP.W $160E,X               ; |
$02:EA54  F0 30         BEQ $EA86             ; / Skip if this slot is the one already in Yoshi's mouth ([$160E])
$02:EA56  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:EA58  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:EA59  B0 2B         BCS $EA86             ; / Skip when ([slot] EOR [$13]) is odd: each slot is tested every other frame
$02:EA5B  CC E9 15      CPY.W $15E9                 ; \
$02:EA5E  F0 26         BEQ $EA86             ; / Skip Yoshi himself (current sprite [$15E9])
$02:EA60  8C 95 16      STY.W $1695                 ; Remember the candidate slot in [$1695]
$02:EA63  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:EA66  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |
$02:EA68  90 1C         BCC $EA86             ; / Skip if that sprite's status is below 8 (not alive and normal)
$02:EA6A  B9 9E 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; \
$02:EA6D  C9 70         CMP.B #$70                  ; |
$02:EA6F  F0 15         BEQ $EA86             ; / Skip sprite $70
$02:EA71  C9 0E         CMP.B #$0E                  ; \
$02:EA73  F0 11         BEQ $EA86             ; / Skip sprite $0E
$02:EA75  C9 1D         CMP.B #$1D                  ; \
$02:EA77  90 0A         BCC $EA83             ; / Sprites below $1D need no further tweaker check
$02:EA79  B9 86 16      LDA.W RAM_Tweaker1686,Y     ; \
$02:EA7C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:EA7E  0D E8 18      ORA.W $18E8                 ; |
$02:EA81  D0 03         BNE $EA86             ; / Skip if tweaker [$1686] bits 0-1 or [$18E8] are set (probably inedible sprites)
$02:EA83  20 8A EA      JSR.W $EA8A           ; Test contact between Yoshi and the candidate
$02:EA86  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:EA87  10 C7         BPL $EA50             ; / Next slot, loop for slots $0B..0
$02:EA89  6B            RTL                          ; Return

$02:EA8A  DA            PHX                          ; Test contact of Baby Yoshi with sprite Y; start of grab
$02:EA8B  BB            TYX                          ; \
$02:EA8C  22 E5 B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingB    ; |
$02:EA90  FA            PLX                          ; / Clipping box B = candidate sprite, then restore X
$02:EA91  22 9F B6 03   JSL.L GetSpriteClippingA    ; Clipping box A = Baby Yoshi
$02:EA95  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Check for contact; carry set if they overlap
$02:EA99  90 32         BCC $EACD            ; No contact: return
$02:EA9B  BD 3E 16      LDA.W $163E,X               ; \
$02:EA9E  F0 09         BEQ $EAA9             ; / Hold timer [$163E] zero: go grab
$02:EAA0  22 23 C0 03   JSL.L $C023           ; Already holding something: other handling ($C023, probably swallow)
$02:EAA4  AD E8 18      LDA.W $18E8                 ; \
$02:EAA7  D0 25         BNE $EACE             ; / If [$18E8] is set: clear the hold timer and leave ($EACE)
$02:EAA9  A9 37         LDA.B #$37                  ; \
$02:EAAB  9D 3E 16      STA.W $163E,X               ; / Hold timer [$163E] = $37
$02:EAAE  AC 95 16      LDY.W $1695                 ; \
$02:EAB1  99 32 16      STA.W RAM_SprBehindScrn,Y   ; / Candidate's "behind scenery" flag = $37
$02:EAB4  AD 95 16      LDA.W $1695                 ; \
$02:EAB7  9D 0E 16      STA.W $160E,X               ; / Sprite in mouth [$160E] = candidate slot
$02:EABA  9E 7C 15      STZ.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction = 0
$02:EABD  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EABF  D9 E4 00      CMP.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; |
$02:EAC2  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; |
$02:EAC5  F9 E0 14      SBC.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; |
$02:EAC8  90 03         BCC $EACD            ; / Carry if Yoshi's X < candidate X: leave direction 0
$02:EACA  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Yoshi is to the right of it: direction = 1
$02:EACD  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EACE  9E 3E 16      STZ.W $163E,X               ; Clear the hold timer
$02:EAD1  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $EAD2: Warp hole sprite and Feather spawn (WarpBlocksMain) ;;;
{
;; $02EAD2: main routine of sprite $8E (invisible warp hole block): when Mario touches it his X speed is zeroed and he is centred on it.
;; $02EAF2: spawns a Feather ($77) at the current sprite with Y speed $D0; called from the bank 01 sprite kill code for sprites $72 and up.
;; Called by: $01:87E8 (Invisible warp hole blocks (WarpBlocks))
$02:EAD2  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:EAD3  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:EAD4  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:EAD5  20 DA EA      JSR.W $EADA           ; Run the warp hole code
$02:EAD8  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:EAD9  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:EADA  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Test contact between Mario and this sprite
$02:EADE  90 10         BCC $EAF0            ; No contact: return
$02:EAE0  64 7B         STZ RAM_MarioSpeedX         ; Mario X speed = 0
$02:EAE2  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EAE4  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EAE5  69 0A         ADC.B #$0A                  ; |
$02:EAE7  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; / Mario X position = sprite X + $0A (low byte)
$02:EAE9  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:EAEC  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:EAEE  85 95         STA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; / Mario X position high byte with carry
$02:EAF0  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EAF1  60            RTS                          ; Unreferenced RTS

$02:EAF2  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:EAF6  30 2E         BMI $EB26            ; No free slot: return
$02:EAF8  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:EAFA  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Status = 8 (normal)
$02:EAFD  A9 77         LDA.B #$77                  ; \
$02:EAFF  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $77 (Feather)
$02:EB02  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EB04  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; / New sprite X low = this sprite's X low
$02:EB07  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:EB0A  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; / New sprite X high
$02:EB0D  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EB0F  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; / New sprite Y low = this sprite's Y low
$02:EB12  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:EB15  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; / New sprite Y high
$02:EB18  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite slot
$02:EB19  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the new sprite's tables
$02:EB1D  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:EB1F  9D 4C 15      STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; / Disable-interaction timer = $30
$02:EB22  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:EB24  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $D0 (shoots upward)
$02:EB26  6B            RTL                          ; Return

}

;;; $EB27: Super Koopa main wrapper (SuperKoopaMain) ;;;
{
;; Long entry for the red, yellow and feather Super Koopa ($71-$73): sets the data bank and runs the routine at $02EB31.
;; Called by: $01:87F2 (Red Super Koopa (RedSuperKoopa)), $01:87F7 (Yellow Super Koopa (YellowSuperKoopa)), $01:87FC (Feather Super Koopa (FeatherSuperKoopa))
$02:EB27  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:EB28  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:EB29  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:EB2A  20 31 EB      JSR.W $EB31           ; Run the Super Koopa code
$02:EB2D  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:EB2E  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $EB2F..EB2F: Table: Super Koopa flight X speed ;;;
{
;; Indexed by direction: $18 (right), $E8 (left).
$02:EB2F                .db $18,$E8                 ; Flight X speed by direction: $18 right, $E8 left

}

;;; $EB31: Super Koopa behaviour ;;;
{
;; Draws the sprite, then handles the killed tumble (status 2), movement and interaction. The feather Super Koopa ($73) runs a three state machine instead of flying straight.
;; Called by: $02:EB2A (Super Koopa main wrapper (SuperKoopaMain))
$02:EB31  20 DE EC      JSR.W $ECDE           ; Draw the Super Koopa
$02:EB34  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:EB37  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; / Status = 2 (killed, falling)?
$02:EB39  D0 0E         BNE $EB49             ; No: go act normally
$02:EB3B  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; Y = 4: first tumbling frame
$02:EB3D  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:EB3F  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / Alternate with frame 5 every 4 frames
$02:EB41  F0 01         BEQ $EB44             ; Branch if bit clear
$02:EB43  C8            INY                          ; Frame 5
$02:EB44  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:EB45  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Animation frame [$1602] = Y
$02:EB48  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EB49  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:EB4B  D0 2F         BNE $EB7C            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:EB4D  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:EB50  22 3A 80 01   JSL.L SprSpr+MarioSprRts    ; Mario and sprite interaction (MarioSprRts)
$02:EB54  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:EB57  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:EB5A  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:EB5C  C9 73         CMP.B #$73                  ; |
$02:EB5E  F0 1D         BEQ $EB7D             ; / Sprite $73 (feather Super Koopa) uses its own state machine
$02:EB60  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:EB63  B9 2F EB      LDA.W $EB2F,Y         ; |
$02:EB66  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = +-$18 by direction
$02:EB68  20 F8 EB      JSR.W $EBF8           ; Set the flying animation frame (2 or 3)
$02:EB6B  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:EB6D  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:EB6F  D0 0B         BNE $EB7C            ; / Only every other frame
$02:EB71  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:EB73  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:EB75  30 05         BMI $EB7C            ; / Skip when Y speed is below $F0
$02:EB77  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EB78  69 FF         ADC.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:EB7A  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed -= 1 (levels out the swoop)
$02:EB7C  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EB7D  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Feather Super Koopa: run the routine for [state]
$02:EB7F  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr

}

;;; $EB83: Feather Super Koopa state machine (SuperKoopaPtrs) ;;;
{
;; Pointers: state 0 = swoop and accelerate, 1 = rise, 2 = fly at constant speed. Followed by target X speed and acceleration tables.
;; Quirk: [$01] = [$13] AND $00 is always 0, so the speed is raised every frame.
$02:EB83  8D EB         .dw $EB8D             ; State 0: swoop in and accelerate
$02:EB85  D1 EB         .dw $EBD1             ; State 1: rise, Y speed increasing
$02:EB87  E7 EB         .dw $EBE7             ; State 2: fly straight at constant speed

$02:EB89                .db $18,$E8                 ; Target X speed by direction: $18, $E8

$02:EB8B                .db $01,$FF                 ; X acceleration by direction: +1, -1

$02:EB8D  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:EB8F  29 00         AND.B #$00                  ; |
$02:EB91  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = [$13] AND $00 = 0 (so acceleration happens every frame)
$02:EB93  64 00         STZ $00                     ; [$00] = 0: not accelerating yet
$02:EB95  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = direction
$02:EB98  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:EB9A  D9 89 EB      CMP.W $EB89,Y         ; / Already at target X speed?
$02:EB9D  F0 0C         BEQ $EBAB             ; Yes: skip the acceleration
$02:EB9F  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EBA0  79 8B EB      ADC.W $EB8B,Y         ; / A = X speed + acceleration
$02:EBA3  A4 01         LDY $01                     ; \
$02:EBA5  D0 02         BNE $EBA9             ; / Only store if [$01] = 0
$02:EBA7  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; Store the new X speed
$02:EBA9  E6 00         INC $00                     ; [$00]++: marks that acceleration happened
$02:EBAB  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:EBAE  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; / Count frames in [$151C]
$02:EBB1  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; \
$02:EBB3  F0 15         BEQ $EBCA             ; / After $30 frames go to the next state
$02:EBB5  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: base animation frame
$02:EBB7  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:EBB9  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / Alternate frame every 4 frames
$02:EBBB  F0 01         BEQ $EBBE             ; Branch if bit clear
$02:EBBD  C8            INY                          ; Frame 1
$02:EBBE  98            TYA                          ; A = frame
$02:EBBF  A4 00         LDY $00                     ; \
$02:EBC1  D0 03         BNE $EBC6             ; / If not accelerating ([$00] = 0), use frames 6/7
$02:EBC3  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EBC4  69 06         ADC.B #$06                  ; / Add 6
$02:EBC6  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store animation frame [$1602]
$02:EBC9  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EBCA  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Next state
