$02:EBCC  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:EBCE  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $D0 (up)
$02:EBD0  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EBD1  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:EBD3  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EBD4  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; |
$02:EBD6  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed += 2
$02:EBD8  C9 14         CMP.B #$14                  ; \
$02:EBDA  30 02         BMI $EBDE             ; / Still below $14: stay in this state
$02:EBDC  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Reached $14: next state
$02:EBDE  64 00         STZ $00                     ; [$00] = 0
$02:EBE0  20 B5 EB      JSR.W $EBB5           ; Pick animation frame (6/7)
$02:EBE3  FE 02 16      INC.W $1602,X               ; Frame + 1: shifts to frames 7/8
$02:EBE6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EBE7  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:EBEA  B9 89 EB      LDA.W $EB89,Y         ; |
$02:EBED  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = ±$18 by direction
$02:EBEF  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:EBF1  F0 05         BEQ $EBF8             ; / Y speed is zero: just animate
$02:EBF3  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EBF4  69 FF         ADC.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:EBF6  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed -= 1
$02:EBF8  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; Y = 2: base flight frame
$02:EBFA  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:EBFC  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / Alternate frame every 4 frames
$02:EBFE  F0 01         BEQ $EC01             ; Branch if bit clear
$02:EC00  C8            INY                          ; Frame 3
$02:EC01  98            TYA                          ; A = frame
$02:EC02  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; Store animation frame [$1602]
$02:EC05  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $EC06..EC46: Table: Super Koopa tile X offsets ;;;
{
;; 9 frames x 4 tiles = 36 bytes, then 36 more for the mirrored direction (index + $24).
$02:EC06                .db $08,$08,$10,$00,$08,$08,$10,$00 ; Tile X offsets: 9 frames x 4 tiles (first 36 normal; next 36 mirrored for the other direction)
$02:EC0E                .db $08,$10,$10,$00,$08,$10,$10,$00
$02:EC16                .db $09,$09,$00,$00,$09,$09,$00,$00
$02:EC1E                .db $08,$10,$00,$00,$08,$10,$00,$00
$02:EC26                .db $08,$10,$00,$00,$00,$00,$F8,$00
$02:EC2E                .db $00,$00,$F8,$00,$00,$F8,$F8,$00
$02:EC36                .db $00,$F8,$F8,$00,$FF,$FF,$00,$00
$02:EC3E                .db $FF,$FF,$00,$00,$00,$F8,$00,$00
$02:EC46                .db $00,$F8,$00,$00,$00,$F8,$00,$00
}

;;; $EC4E..EC6E: Table: Super Koopa tile Y offsets ;;;
{
;; 9 frames x 4 tiles.
$02:EC4E                .db $00,$08,$08,$00,$00,$08,$08,$00 ; Tile Y offsets: 9 frames x 4 tiles
$02:EC56                .db $03,$03,$08,$00,$03,$03,$08,$00
$02:EC5E                .db $FF,$07,$00,$00,$FF,$07,$00,$00
$02:EC66                .db $FD,$FD,$00,$00,$FD,$FD,$00,$00
$02:EC6E                .db $FD,$FD,$00,$00

}

;;; $EC72: Super Koopa tiles, properties, sizes and draw (SuperKoopaTiles) ;;;
{
;; Tile number table (9 frames x 4), tile property table (bit 1 marks the cape tile), OAM size table, and the draw routine at $02ECDE.
;; Draw: four tiles per frame, mirrored X offsets and X flip when the direction bit is clear, cape palette chosen by sprite number ($71 red, others yellow) or flashing if [$1534] is set.
$02:EC72                .db $C8,$D8,$D0,$E0,$C9,$D9,$C0,$E2 ; Tile numbers: 9 frames x 4 tiles
$02:EC7A                .db $E4,$E5,$F2,$E0,$F4,$F5,$F2,$E0
$02:EC82                .db $DA,$CA,$E0,$CF,$DB,$CB,$E0,$CF
$02:EC8A                .db $E4,$E5,$E0,$CF,$F4,$F5,$E2,$CF
$02:EC92                .db $E4,$E5,$E2,$CF

$02:EC96                .db $03,$03,$03,$00,$03,$03,$03,$00 ; Tile properties: 9 frames x 4 tiles (bit 1 = cape tile, whose palette is set at run time)
$02:EC9E                .db $03,$03,$01,$01,$03,$03,$01,$01
$02:ECA6                .db $83,$83,$80,$00,$83,$83,$80,$00
$02:ECAE                .db $03,$03,$00,$01,$03,$03,$00,$01
$02:ECB6                .db $03,$03,$00,$01

$02:ECBA                .db $00,$00,$00,$02,$00,$00,$00,$02 ; OAM size bits: 9 frames x 4 tiles (00 = 8x8, 02 = 16x16)
$02:ECC2                .db $00,$00,$00,$02,$00,$00,$00,$02
$02:ECCA                .db $00,$00,$02,$00,$00,$00,$02,$00
$02:ECD2                .db $00,$00,$02,$00,$00,$00,$02,$00
$02:ECDA                .db $00,$00,$02,$00

$02:ECDE  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info: Y = OAM index, [$00]/[$01] = screen X/Y
$02:ECE1  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:ECE4  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = direction
$02:ECE6  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:ECE9  29 0E         AND.B #$0E                  ; |
$02:ECEB  85 05         STA $05                     ; / [$05] = sprite palette bits ($0E mask)
$02:ECED  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:ECF0  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:ECF1  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:ECF2  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = frame * 4: first tile index of this frame
$02:ECF4  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:ECF5  64 04         STZ $04                     ; [$04] = 0: tile counter
$02:ECF7  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:ECF9  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:ECFA  65 04         ADC $04                     ; |
$02:ECFC  AA            TAX                          ; / X = frame * 4 + tile counter
$02:ECFD  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:ECFF  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:ED00  7D 4E EC      ADC.W $EC4E,X         ; |
$02:ED03  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = screen Y + Y offset
$02:ED06  BD 72 EC      LDA.W SuperKoopaTiles,X     ; \
$02:ED09  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / OAM tile from SuperKoopaTiles
$02:ED0C  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:ED0D  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:ED0E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:ED0F  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:ED10  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4 (index into the size table)
$02:ED11  BD BA EC      LDA.W $ECBA,X         ; \
$02:ED14  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / OAM size bit from the table
$02:ED17  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:ED18  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:ED1A  4A            LSR                          ; / Carry = direction bit 0, set when the sprite faces one way
$02:ED1B  BD 96 EC      LDA.W $EC96,X         ; A = tile properties
$02:ED1E  29 02         AND.B #$02                  ; \
$02:ED20  F0 2B         BEQ $ED4D             ; / Not a cape tile: go use palette bits of the sprite
$02:ED22  08            PHP                          ; Save flags (carry)
$02:ED23  DA            PHX                          ; Save table index
$02:ED24  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:ED27  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:ED2A  F0 0F         BEQ $ED3B             ; / [$1534] set: use a flashing palette
$02:ED2C  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:ED2E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:ED2F  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / A = frame counter bit 3
$02:ED31  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:ED32  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:ED33  B9 39 ED      LDA.W $ED39,Y         ; |
$02:ED36  7A            PLY                          ; / A = $ED39[bit]: alternating palette value
$02:ED37  80 0B         BRA $ED44             ; Go on


}

;;; $ED39..ED39: Table: Super Koopa flashing cape palettes ;;;
{
;; $10, $0A, alternated every 2 frames.
$02:ED39                .db $10,$0A                 ; Flashing cape palettes: $10, $0A

}

;;; $ED3B: Super Koopa cape palette and OAM finish ;;;
{
;; Continuation of the draw routine: picks the cape colour, builds the OAM property byte, stores X, and loops over the four tiles.
$02:ED3B  B5 9E         LDA RAM_SpriteNum,X         ; \
$02:ED3D  C9 72         CMP.B #$72                  ; |
$02:ED3F  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; |
$02:ED41  90 01         BCC $ED44             ; /  Cape color: $08 for sprite $71 (red), 4 for $72 and up
$02:ED43  4A            LSR                          ; Yellow/feather: A = 4
$02:ED44  FA            PLX                          ; Restore table index
$02:ED45  28            PLP                          ; Restore flags
$02:ED46  1D 96 EC      ORA.W $EC96,X         ; \
$02:ED49  29 FD         AND.B #$FD                  ; / Add base properties, clear the cape marker bit 1
$02:ED4B  80 05         BRA $ED52             ; Go on

$02:ED4D  BD 96 EC      LDA.W $EC96,X         ; \
$02:ED50  05 05         ORA $05                     ; / Properties = table | sprite palette bits
$02:ED52  05 64         ORA $64                     ; Add priority bits [$64]
$02:ED54  B0 09         BCS $ED5F             ; Carry set: no X flip, keep as is
$02:ED56  48            PHA                          ; \
$02:ED57  8A            TXA                          ; |
$02:ED58  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:ED59  69 24         ADC.B #$24                  ; |
$02:ED5B  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:ED5C  68            PLA                          ; |
$02:ED5D  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; / Facing the other way: use the mirrored offsets (index + $24) and X-flip
$02:ED5F  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Store OAM properties
$02:ED62  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:ED64  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:ED65  7D 06 EC      ADC.W $EC06,X         ; |
$02:ED68  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = screen X + X offset
$02:ED6B  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:ED6C  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:ED6D  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:ED6E  C8            INY                          ; / Next OAM slot
$02:ED6F  E6 04         INC $04                     ; [$04]++
$02:ED71  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:ED73  C9 04         CMP.B #$04                  ; |
$02:ED75  D0 80         BNE $ECF7             ; / Loop for 4 tiles
$02:ED77  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:ED78  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Y = $FF: sizes already set
$02:ED7A  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; A = 3: four tiles
$02:ED7C  4C A7 B7      JMP.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM ($B7A7)


}

;;; $ED7F..ED7F: Table: floating skull X offsets ;;;
{
;; $10, $20, $30: positions of the three skulls spawned next to the first.
$02:ED7F                .db $10,$20,$30             ; X offsets of the extra skulls: $10, $20, $30

}

;;; $ED82: Floating skull raft init (FloatingSkullInit) ;;;
{
;; Resets the shared raft speed [$18BC], sets the state and spawns three more floating skulls ($61) to the right (+$10, +$20, +$30), forming a four-skull raft.
;; Called by: $01:87D9 (Init: floating skull (InitFloatingSkull))
$02:ED82  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:ED83  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:ED84  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:ED85  20 8A ED      JSR.W $ED8A           ; Run the init
$02:ED88  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:ED89  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:ED8A  9C BC 18      STZ.W $18BC                 ; Raft speed [$18BC] = 0
$02:ED8D  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Sprite state++
$02:ED8F  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:ED91  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = 2: three skulls to spawn
$02:ED93  22 E4 A9 02   JSL.L FindFreeSprSlot       ; Find a free sprite slot
$02:ED97  30 32         BMI $EDCB             ; None: skip this skull
$02:ED99  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:ED9B  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Status = 8 (normal)
$02:ED9E  A9 61         LDA.B #$61                  ; \
$02:EDA0  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $61 (floating skull)
$02:EDA3  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EDA5  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; / Y low = this sprite's
$02:EDA8  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:EDAB  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; / Y high = this sprite's
$02:EDAE  A6 00         LDX $00                     ; \
$02:EDB0  BD 7F ED      LDA.W $ED7F,X         ; / A = X offset for skull [$00]
$02:EDB3  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = this sprite
$02:EDB6  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EDB7  75 E4         ADC RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; |
$02:EDB9  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; / New X low = this X + offset
$02:EDBC  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:EDBF  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:EDC1  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; / New X high with carry
$02:EDC4  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:EDC5  BB            TYX                          ; |
$02:EDC6  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; |
$02:EDCA  FA            PLX                          ; / Initialise the new sprite's tables
$02:EDCB  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; \
$02:EDCD  10 C4         BPL $ED93             ; / Next skull
$02:EDCF  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $EDD0: Floating skull raft main (FloatingSkullMain) ;;;
{
;; Draws the skull (tile alternates $E0/$E2), applies the shared raft speed [$18BC], and carries Mario when he lands on it, which sets the speed to $0C.
;; When one skull dies all the others are erased. [$00] (contact flags of other skulls) is computed but not used in this routine.
;; Called by: $01:87DE (Floating skull (FloatingSkulls))
$02:EDD0  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:EDD1  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:EDD2  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:EDD3  20 D8 ED      JSR.W $EDD8           ; Run the skull raft code
$02:EDD6  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:EDD7  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:EDD8  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:EDDA  F0 1A         BEQ $EDF6             ; / State 0: only draw
$02:EDDC  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when off-screen
$02:EDDF  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:EDE2  D0 12         BNE $EDF6             ; / Status is non-zero: still alive, go draw
$02:EDE4  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Dead: Y = 9, scan slots 9..0
$02:EDE6  B9 9E 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; \
$02:EDE9  C9 61         CMP.B #$61                  ; |
$02:EDEB  D0 05         BNE $EDF2             ; / Is it another floating skull ($61)?
$02:EDED  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:EDEF  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Erase it too (status 0)
$02:EDF2  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:EDF3  10 F1         BPL $EDE6             ; / Next slot
$02:EDF5  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EDF6  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the sprite (generic 16x16 graphics)
$02:EDFA  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:EDFD  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:EDFF  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:EE00  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:EE01  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:EE02  4A            LSR                          ; / Carry = frame counter bit 3
$02:EE03  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:EE05  90 02         BCC $EE09             ; / Tile $E0 normally
$02:EE07  A9 E2         LDA.B #$E2                  ; Tile $E2 on the other half of the cycle
$02:EE09  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Store tile
$02:EE0C  B9 01 03      LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; \
$02:EE0F  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:EE11  B0 06         BCS $EE19             ; / Skip if Y is off-screen ($F0 or more)
$02:EE13  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EE14  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:EE16  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Move the skull down 3 pixels
$02:EE19  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:EE1B  D0 D8         BNE $EDF5            ; / Return if sprites are locked
$02:EE1D  64 00         STZ $00                     ; [$00] = 0
$02:EE1F  A0 09         LDY.B #$09                  ; Y = 9
$02:EE21  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:EE24  F0 10         BEQ $EE36             ; / Skip empty slots
$02:EE26  B9 9E 00      LDA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; \
$02:EE29  C9 61         CMP.B #$61                  ; |
$02:EE2B  D0 09         BNE $EE36             ; / Only floating skulls ($61)
$02:EE2D  B9 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,Y    ; \
$02:EE30  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; |
$02:EE32  F0 02         BEQ $EE36             ; / Skip when it touches nothing
$02:EE34  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = its contact flags
$02:EE36  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:EE37  10 E8         BPL $EE21             ; / Next slot
$02:EE39  AD BC 18      LDA.W $18BC                 ; \
$02:EE3C  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = shared raft speed [$18BC]
$02:EE3E  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:EE40  C9 20         CMP.B #$20                  ; |
$02:EE42  30 04         BMI $EE48             ; |
$02:EE44  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; |
$02:EE46  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Limit Y speed to $20
$02:EE48  22 2A 80 01   JSL.L UpdateSpritePos       ; Update position
$02:EE4C  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:EE4F  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; / Touching the ground?
$02:EE51  F0 04         BEQ $EE57             ; No: skip
$02:EE53  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:EE55  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $10 (keeps the skull pushed down slightly)
$02:EE57  22 DC A7 01   JSL.L MarioSprInteract      ; Mario and sprite interaction
$02:EE5B  90 4B         BCC $EEA8            ; No contact: return
$02:EE5D  A5 7D         LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; \
$02:EE5F  30 47         BMI $EEA8            ; / Return if Mario is moving upward
$02:EE61  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:EE63  8D BC 18      STA.W $18BC                 ; / Raft speed [$18BC] = $0C (starts to move when stepped on)
$02:EE66  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:EE69  AA            TAX                          ; / X = OAM index
$02:EE6A  FE 01 03      INC.W OAM_DispY,X           ; OAM Y + 1: skull sinks slightly
$02:EE6D  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:EE70  A9 01         LDA.B #$01
$02:EE72  8D 71 14      STA.W $1471                 ; / [$1471] = 1: Mario is standing on a platform
$02:EE75  64 72         STZ RAM_IsFlying            ; Mario not flying
$02:EE77  A9 1C         LDA.B #$1C                  ; \
$02:EE79  AC 7A 18      LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; |
$02:EE7C  F0 02         BEQ $EE80             ; |
$02:EE7E  A9 2C         LDA.B #$2C                  ; / A = $1C, or $2C while riding Yoshi: Mario height above sprite
$02:EE80  85 01         STA $01                     ; [$01] = height
$02:EE82  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EE84  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:EE85  E5 01         SBC $01                     ; |
$02:EE87  85 96         STA RAM_MarioYPos           ; / Mario Y low = sprite Y - height
$02:EE89  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:EE8C  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:EE8E  85 97         STA RAM_MarioYPosHi         ; / Mario Y high
$02:EE90  A5 77         LDA RAM_MarioObjStatus      ; \
$02:EE92  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:EE94  D0 12         BNE $EEA8            ; / Skip if Mario touches a wall on his right
$02:EE96  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: sign extension byte
$02:EE98  AD 91 14      LDA.W $1491                 ; \
$02:EE9B  10 01         BPL $EE9E             ; / A = [$1491], the platform's X movement
$02:EE9D  88            DEY                          ; Negative: Y = $FF
$02:EE9E  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EE9F  65 94         ADC RAM_MarioXPos           ; |
$02:EEA1  85 94         STA RAM_MarioXPos           ; |
$02:EEA3  98            TYA                          ; |
$02:EEA4  65 95         ADC RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; |
$02:EEA6  85 95         STA RAM_MarioXPosHi         ; / Mario X += platform movement (16 bit)
$02:EEA8  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $EEA9: Coin game cloud wrapper (CoinCloudMain) ;;;
{
;; Long entry for sprite $6A: sets the data bank and runs $EEB5.
;; Called by: $01:8833 (Coin game cloud (CoinCloud))
$02:EEA9  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:EEAA  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:EEAB  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:EEAC  20 B5 EE      JSR.W $EEB5           ; Run the coin cloud code
$02:EEAF  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:EEB0  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $EEB1..EEB3: Table: coin cloud Y acceleration and limit ;;;
{
;; $02EEB1: acceleration +1/-1. $02EEB3: maximum Y speed $10/$F0.
$02:EEB1                .db $01,$FF                 ; Y acceleration by index: +1, -1

$02:EEB3                .db $10,$F0                 ; Max Y speed by index: $10, $F0

}

;;; $EEB5: Coin game cloud behaviour ;;;
{
;; Every $80 frames drops a cloud game coin (extended sprite $0A) or, once [$18E3] reaches $0A, a 1-Up ($78); up to $0B times.
;; The cloud bobs around Y = $0110, moves right at speed 8, and flies away when finished. Draws the cloud plus a second tile.
;; Called by: $02:EEAC (Coin game cloud wrapper (CoinCloudMain))
$02:EEB5  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:EEB7  D0 05         BNE $EEBE             ; |
$02:EEB9  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; |
$02:EEBB  9C E3 18      STZ.W $18E3                 ; / First frame: state = 1, coin counter [$18E3] = 0
$02:EEBE  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:EEC0  D0 5A         BNE $EF1C             ; / Sprites locked: only draw
$02:EEC2  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:EEC4  29 7F         AND.B #$7F                  ; / Every $80 frames...
$02:EEC6  D0 0D         BNE $EED5             ; No: skip
$02:EEC8  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:EECB  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; / ...if spawn count [$1570] is below $0B
$02:EECD  B0 06         BCS $EED5             ; No: skip
$02:EECF  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Spawn count++
$02:EED2  20 67 EF      JSR.W $EF67           ; Spawn a coin or 1-Up
$02:EED5  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:EED7  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; / Move vertically only every other frame
$02:EED9  D0 37         BNE $EF12             ; Odd frame: skip
$02:EEDB  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EEDD  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:EEDF  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; |
$02:EEE2  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$00] = sprite Y position (16 bit)
$02:EEE4  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:EEE6  85 02         STA $02                     ; |
$02:EEE8  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; |
$02:EEEA  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$02] = $0110
$02:EEEC  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:EEEE  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:EEF0  C5 02         CMP $02                     ; / Compare Y with $0110
$02:EEF2  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:EEF4  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: below target, speed down
$02:EEF6  90 01         BCC $EEF9             ; Carry clear: keep 0
$02:EEF8  C8            INY                          ; Y = 1: speed up
$02:EEF9  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:EEFC  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; / All coins spawned?
$02:EEFE  90 05         BCC $EF05             ; No: skip
$02:EF00  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Yes: despawn when off-screen
$02:EF03  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; And always fly up (Y = 1)
$02:EF05  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:EF07  D9 B3 EE      CMP.W $EEB3,Y         ; / At maximum Y speed?
$02:EF0A  F0 06         BEQ $EF12             ; Yes: skip
$02:EF0C  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EF0D  79 B1 EE      ADC.W $EEB1,Y         ; |
$02:EF10  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed += acceleration
$02:EF12  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:EF15  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:EF17  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = 8
$02:EF19  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:EF1C  BD EA 15      LDA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; \
$02:EF1F  48            PHA                          ; / Save OAM index
$02:EF20  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:EF21  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:EF23  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; / OAM index += 4: next slot
$02:EF26  22 B2 90 01   JSL.L GenericSprGfxRt2      ; Draw the cloud there
$02:EF2A  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = new OAM index
$02:EF2D  A9 60         LDA.B #$60                  ; \
$02:EF2F  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile $60
$02:EF32  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:EF34  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EF35  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EF36  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:EF37  29 C0         AND.B #$C0                  ; |
$02:EF39  09 30         ORA.B #$30                  ; |
$02:EF3B  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Properties: flip bits cycle with the frame counter, priority $30
$02:EF3E  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:EF3F  9D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; / Restore OAM index
$02:EF42  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get draw info
$02:EF45  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:EF47  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EF48  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; / X + 4
$02:EF4A  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Store X
$02:EF4D  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:EF4F  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EF50  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; / Y + 4
$02:EF52  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Store Y
$02:EF55  A9 4D         LDA.B #$4D                  ; \
$02:EF57  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile $4D
$02:EF5A  A9 39         LDA.B #$39                  ; \
$02:EF5C  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Properties $39
$02:EF5F  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: 8x8 size
$02:EF61  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; A = 0: one tile
$02:EF63  20 A7 B7      JSR.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM ($B7A7)
$02:EF66  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EF67  AD E3 18      LDA.W $18E3                 ; \
$02:EF6A  C9 0A         CMP.B #$0A                  ; |
$02:EF6C  90 3C         BCC $EFAA             ; / Coin counter [$18E3] below $0A: spawn a coin
$02:EF6E  A0 0B         LDY.B #$0B                  ; Y = $0B: free slots $0B and $0A only
$02:EF70  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; \
$02:EF73  F0 06         BEQ $EF7B             ; / Free slot found?
$02:EF75  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:EF76  C0 09         CPY.B #$09                  ; |
$02:EF78  D0 F6         BNE $EF70             ; / Next slot, give up below $0A
$02:EF7A  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EF7B  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:EF7D  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Status = 8 (normal)
$02:EF80  A9 78         LDA.B #$78                  ; \
$02:EF82  99 9E 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteNum,Y       ; / Sprite number = $78 (1-Up)
$02:EF85  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EF87  99 E4 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteXLo,Y       ; / Copy X low
$02:EF8A  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:EF8D  99 E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,Y       ; / Copy X high
$02:EF90  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EF92  99 D8 00      STA.W RAM_SpriteYLo,Y       ; / Copy Y low
$02:EF95  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:EF98  99 D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,Y       ; / Copy Y high
$02:EF9B  DA            PHX                          ; Save cloud index
$02:EF9C  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite
$02:EF9D  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise its tables
$02:EFA1  A9 E0         LDA.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:EFA3  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $E0 (up)
$02:EFA5  FE 7C 15      INC.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Direction = 1
$02:EFA8  FA            PLX                          ; Restore cloud index
$02:EFA9  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:EFAA  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:EFAD  C9 0B         CMP.B #$0B                  ; / All spawn slots used? Return
$02:EFAF  B0 0A         BCS $EFBB            ; Yes
$02:EFB1  A0 07         LDY.B #$07                  ; \
$02:EFB3  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; |
$02:EFB6  F0 04         BEQ $EFBC             ; |
$02:EFB8  88            DEY                          ; |
$02:EFB9  10 F8         BPL $EFB3             ; / Find a free extended sprite slot (Y = 7..0)
$02:EFBB  60            RTS                          ; Return if none

$02:EFBC  A9 0A         LDA.B #$0A                  ; \
$02:EFBE  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; / Extended sprite = $0A (cloud game coin)
$02:EFC1  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EFC3  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:EFC4  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; / X low = cloud X + 4
$02:EFC6  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; Store
$02:EFC9  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:EFCC  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:EFCE  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; / X high with carry
$02:EFD1  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:EFD3  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; / Y low = cloud Y
$02:EFD6  BD D4 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteYHi,X       ; \
$02:EFD9  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; / Y high
$02:EFDC  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:EFDE  99 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y     ; / Y speed = $D0 (tossed up)
$02:EFE1  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:EFE3  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / X speed = 0
$02:EFE6  99 65 17      STA.W $1765,Y               ; Clear $1765 too
$02:EFE9  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $EFEA..EFEE: Table: Wiggler buffer offsets ;;;
{
;; $02EFEA: low bytes $00,$80,$00,$80; $02EFEE: high bytes $00,$00,$01,$01. Offset of the position history per sprite slot AND 3.
$02:EFEA                .db $00,$80,$00,$80         ; Low byte of buffer offset per sprite slot AND 3: $00, $80, $00, $80

$02:EFEE                .db $00,$00,$01,$01         ; High byte of buffer offset: $00, $00, $01, $01

}

;;; $EFF2: Wiggler init (WigglerInit) ;;;
{
;; Fills the Wiggler's 64-entry position history (X, Y pairs at $7F:9A7B + (slot AND 3) * $80) with its spawn position and faces Mario.
;; Called by: $01:8829 (Init: Wiggler (InitWiggler))
$02:EFF2  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:EFF3  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:EFF4  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:EFF5  20 11 F0      JSR.W $F011           ; Point [$D5] at this Wiggler's position buffer
$02:EFF8  A0 7E         LDY.B #$7E                  ; Y = $7E: last entry
$02:EFFA  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:EFFC  97 D5         STA [$D5],Y                 ; / Buffer X = sprite X low
$02:EFFE  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F000  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F001  97 D5         STA [$D5],Y                 ; / Buffer Y = sprite Y low
$02:F003  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:F004  88            DEY                          ; |
$02:F005  88            DEY                          ; / Y -= 3: previous entry (index only)
$02:F006  10 F2         BPL $EFFA             ; Loop for all 64 entries
$02:F008  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Face Mario (sets Y = direction)
$02:F00B  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F00C  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Direction = Y
$02:F00F  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:F010  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:F011  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F012  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / A = slot AND 3
$02:F014  A8            TAY                          ; Y = A
$02:F015  A9 7B         LDA.B #$7B                  ; \
$02:F017  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F018  79 EA EF      ADC.W $EFEA,Y         ; |
$02:F01B  85 D5         STA $D5                     ; / [$D5] = $7B + low offset
$02:F01D  A9 9A         LDA.B #$9A                  ; \
$02:F01F  79 EE EF      ADC.W $EFEE,Y         ; |
$02:F022  85 D6         STA $D6                     ; / [$D6] = $9A + high offset with carry
$02:F024  A9 7F         LDA.B #$7F                  ; \
$02:F026  85 D7         STA $D7                     ; / [$D7] = $7F: buffer at $7F:9A7B + n * $80 (n = slot AND 3)
$02:F028  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $F029: Wiggler main wrapper (WigglerMain) ;;;
{
;; Long entry: sets the data bank and runs WigglerMainRt.
;; Called by: $01:882E (Wiggler (Wiggler))
$02:F029  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:F02A  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:F02B  AB            PLB                          ; /  Set data bank to program bank
$02:F02C  20 35 F0      JSR.W WigglerMainRt         ; Run the Wiggler code
$02:F02F  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:F030  6B            RTL                          ; Return long


}

;;; $F031: Table: Wiggler X speeds (WigglerSpeed) ;;;
{
;; $08,$F8 normal; $10,$F0 angry.
$02:F031                .db $08,$F8,$10,$F0         ; Wiggler X speeds: $08, $F8 (normal), $10, $F0 (angry)

}

;;; $F035: Wiggler main routine (WigglerMainRt) ;;;
{
;; Wiggler (sprite 86). Each Wiggler keeps a history of its last 63 (X,Y) positions in a buffer in bank $7F; the five segments are drawn from
;; points along that history, which makes the body follow the head. Behaviour: walks left/right, turns at walls, and when stomped by Mario
;; flashes for $40 frames, becomes angry (faster, red) and releases a flower. Interaction and drawing are in WigglerTiles below.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index. Uses [$D5]-[$D7] as a pointer to the position buffer.
;; Called by: $02:F02C (Wiggler main wrapper (WigglerMain))
$02:F035  20 11 F0      JSR.W $F011           ; Set [$D5] = pointer to this Wiggler's position buffer
$02:F038  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:F03A  F0 03         BEQ $F03F             ; / Sprites locked? Go to the draw code
$02:F03C  4C D8 F0      JMP.W $F0D8           ; Locked: skip logic and draw

$02:F03F  22 32 80 01   JSL.L SprSprInteract        ; Sprite-sprite interaction
$02:F043  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:F046  F0 19         BEQ $F061             ; / [$1540] (angry transition timer) = 0: normal movement
$02:F048  C9 01         CMP.B #$01                  ; \
$02:F04A  D0 04         BNE $F050             ; / Last frame of the timer?
$02:F04C  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; Yes: palette bits = $08
$02:F04E  80 02         BRA $F052             ; Skip the flicker

$02:F050  29 0E         AND.B #$0E                  ; Otherwise palette bits = [$1540] AND $0E (cycles colours)
$02:F052  85 00         STA $00                     ; Save the palette bits
$02:F054  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:F057  29 F1         AND.B #$F1                  ; |
$02:F059  05 00         ORA $00                     ; |
$02:F05B  9D F6 15      STA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; / Sprite palette = ([pal] AND $F1) OR [$00]
$02:F05E  4C D8 F0      JMP.W $F0D8           ; Flashing: skip movement and draw

$02:F061  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position (no gravity)
$02:F064  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position (no gravity)
$02:F067  20 25 D0      JSR.W SubOffscreen0Bnk2     ; Despawn when far off-screen
$02:F06A  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Animation counter [$1570]++
$02:F06D  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:F070  F0 14         BEQ $F086             ; / Angry flag [$151C] = 0: skip the angry code
$02:F072  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Angry: animation counter runs twice as fast
$02:F075  FE 34 15      INC.W $1534,X               ; \
$02:F078  BD 34 15      LDA.W $1534,X               ; |
$02:F07B  29 3F         AND.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:F07D  D0 07         BNE $F086             ; / [$1534]++; continue unless it is a multiple of $40
$02:F07F  20 FA D4      JSR.W $D4FA           ; Get the direction toward Mario in Y
$02:F082  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F083  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Face Mario every 64 frames
$02:F086  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; Y = [direction]
$02:F089  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:F08C  F0 02         BEQ $F090             ; / Angry? then add 2 to use the fast speeds
$02:F08E  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:F08F  C8            INY                          ; / Y += 2
$02:F090  B9 31 F0      LDA.W WigglerSpeed,Y        ; \
$02:F093  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = WigglerSpeed[Y]: +8, -8 or +$10, -$10
$02:F095  F6 AA         INC RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Y speed++ (gravity)
$02:F097  22 38 91 01   JSL.L $9138           ; Sprite-block interaction (sets [RAM_SprObjStatus])
$02:F09B  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:F09E  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F0A0  D0 0C         BNE $F0AE             ; / Touching a wall (status bits 0-1)? Turn around
$02:F0A2  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:F0A5  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:F0A7  F0 05         BEQ $F0AE             ; / Not on the ground? Skip
$02:F0A9  20 D1 FF      JSR.W $FFD1           ; On the ground: Y speed = 0 (or $18 on slope)
$02:F0AC  80 15         BRA $F0C3             ; Skip the turn

$02:F0AE  BD AC 15      LDA.W $15AC,X               ; \
$02:F0B1  D0 10         BNE $F0C3             ; / Turn timer [$15AC] still running: do not turn again
$02:F0B3  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:F0B6  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; |
$02:F0B8  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Flip direction
$02:F0BB  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Reset the segment state counter [$1602]
$02:F0BE  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:F0C0  9D AC 15      STA.W $15AC,X               ; / Turn timer [$15AC] = 8
$02:F0C3  20 DB F0      JSR.W $F0DB           ; Store current position in the history buffer
$02:F0C6  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:F0C9  FE 02 16      INC.W $1602,X               ; / A = [$1602], then [$1602]++
$02:F0CC  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; \
$02:F0CE  D0 08         BNE $F0D8             ; / Continue only every 8th frame
$02:F0D0  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:F0D2  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F0D3  1D 7C 15      ORA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; |
$02:F0D6  95 C2         STA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; / State = ([state] << 1) OR direction (per-segment facing history)
$02:F0D8  4C 10 F1      JMP.W $F110           ; Go draw

$02:F0DB  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:F0DC  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:F0DD  C2 30         REP #$30                    ; A, X, Y 16-bit
$02:F0DF  A5 D5         LDA $D5                     ; \
$02:F0E1  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F0E2  69 7D 00      ADC.W #$007D                ; |
$02:F0E5  AA            TAX                          ; / X = [$D5] + $7D (source: end of the old buffer)
$02:F0E6  A5 D5         LDA $D5                     ; \
$02:F0E8  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F0E9  69 7F 00      ADC.W #$007F                ; |
$02:F0EC  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = [$D5] + $7F (destination: two bytes further)
$02:F0ED  A9 7D 00      LDA.W #$007D                ; Byte count - 1 = $7D
$02:F0F0  44 7F 7F      MVP $7F,$7F                 ; Shift the buffer back by one (X,Y) pair ($7E bytes in bank $7F)
$02:F0F3  E2 30         SEP #$30                    ; A, X, Y 8-bit
$02:F0F5  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:F0F6  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:F0F7  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; Y = 0: newest entry
$02:F0F9  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F0FB  97 D5         STA [$D5],Y                 ; / Buffer[0] = sprite X position
$02:F0FD  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F0FF  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F100  97 D5         STA [$D5],Y                 ; / Buffer[1] = sprite Y position
$02:F102  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F103..F108: Data: Wiggler segment history offsets and bob ;;;
{
;; $02F103: byte offsets into the position history for the 5 segments (normal). $02F108: vertical bob per animation phase.
$02:F103                .db $00,$1E,$3E,$5E,$7E     ; Segment offsets into the history ($00, $1E, $3E, $5E, $7E)

$02:F108                .db $00,$01,$02,$01         ; Segment Y bob: 0, 1, 2, 1

}

;;; $F10C: Wiggler draw, contact and flower spawn (WigglerTiles) ;;;
{
;; $02F10C: body tile animation table (4 frames). $02F110: draws the head, four body segments and the eyes or flower (6 OAM tiles), then
;; tests Mario against each segment: star kills it, a stomp bounces Mario and makes it angry, otherwise Mario is hurt.
;; $02F2D7 (end of this section) spawns the flower extended sprite when it turns angry.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index; [$D5] = position buffer pointer.
$02:F10C                .db $C4,$C6,$C8,$C6         ; Body tiles: $C4, $C6, $C8, $C6

$02:F110  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; Get OAM index into Y and set up offscreen flags
$02:F113  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:F116  85 03         STA $03                     ; / [$03] = animation counter [$1570]
$02:F118  BD F6 15      LDA.W RAM_SpritePal,X       ; \
$02:F11B  85 07         STA $07                     ; / [$07] = sprite palette
$02:F11D  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:F120  85 08         STA $08                     ; / [$08] = angry flag
$02:F122  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; \
$02:F124  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = segment facing history
$02:F126  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F127  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F128  69 04         ADC.B #$04                  ; |
$02:F12A  A8            TAY                          ; / Y += 4: OAM slot 0 is kept for the eyes/flower
$02:F12B  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; X = 0: segment counter (0 = head)
$02:F12D  DA            PHX                          ; Save segment counter
$02:F12E  86 05         STX $05                     ; [$05] = segment counter
$02:F130  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:F132  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F133  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F134  4A            LSR                          ; / A = [$03] >> 3
$02:F135  EA            NOP                          ; (NOPs: removed code)
$02:F136  EA            NOP                          ; |
$02:F137  EA            NOP                          ; |
$02:F138  EA            NOP                          ; /
$02:F139  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F13A  65 05         ADC $05                     ; |
$02:F13C  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / [$06] = ([$03]/8 + segment) AND 3: body animation phase
$02:F13E  85 06         STA $06                     ; Save phase
$02:F140  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM index
$02:F141  BC 03 F1      LDY.W $F103,X         ; Y = history offset for this segment
$02:F144  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:F146  F0 05         BEQ $F14D             ; / Angry? halve the offset (faster body)
$02:F148  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F149  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F14A  29 FE         AND.B #$FE                  ; |
$02:F14C  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = (Y >> 1) AND $FE
$02:F14D  84 09         STY $09                     ; Save the history offset in [$09]
$02:F14F  B7 D5         LDA [$D5],Y                 ; A = history X for this segment
$02:F151  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:F152  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:F153  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / Tile X = history X - screen X
$02:F155  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Write tile X
$02:F158  5A            PHY                          ; \
$02:F159  A4 09         LDY $09                     ; |
$02:F15B  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F15C  B7 D5         LDA [$D5],Y                 ; / A = history Y for this segment
$02:F15E  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:F15F  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:F160  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / A = history Y - screen Y
$02:F162  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; X = phase
$02:F164  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:F165  FD 08 F1      SBC.W $F108,X         ; / Subtract the vertical bob
$02:F168  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Write tile Y
$02:F16B  FA            PLX                          ; Restore segment counter
$02:F16C  DA            PHX                          ; Keep it on the stack
$02:F16D  A9 8C         LDA.B #$8C                  ; Head tile = $8C
$02:F16F  E0 00         CPX.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F171  F0 05         BEQ $F178             ; / Head (segment 0)? Keep $8C
$02:F173  A6 06         LDX $06                     ; \
$02:F175  BD 0C F1      LDA.W WigglerTiles,X        ; / Body tile = WigglerTiles[phase]
$02:F178  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; Write tile
$02:F17B  FA            PLX                          ; Restore segment counter
$02:F17C  A5 07         LDA $07                     ; \
$02:F17E  05 64         ORA $64                     ; / Properties = [$07] OR priority [$64]
$02:F180  46 02         LSR $02                     ; \
$02:F182  B0 02         BCS $F186             ; / Flip X according to the next bit of the facing history
$02:F184  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; Set X-flip bit
$02:F186  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Write properties
$02:F189  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM index
$02:F18A  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F18B  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F18C  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F18D  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index >> 2
$02:F18E  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:F190  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Tile size = 16x16
$02:F193  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM index
$02:F194  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:F195  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F196  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F197  C8            INY                          ; / Next OAM slot
$02:F198  E8            INX                          ; Next segment
$02:F199  E0 05         CPX.B #$05                  ; \
$02:F19B  D0 90         BNE $F12D             ; / Loop for the 5 segments
$02:F19D  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = sprite index
$02:F1A0  A5 08         LDA $08                     ; \
$02:F1A2  F0 23         BEQ $F1C7             ; / Angry? Draw eyes. Otherwise draw flower
$02:F1A4  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:F1A5  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index (slot 0)
$02:F1A8  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; A = direction
$02:F1AB  AA            TAX                          ; X = direction
$02:F1AC  B9 04 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; A = X of segment 0 (head)
$02:F1AF  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F1B0  7D D5 F2      ADC.W WigglerEyesX,X        ; / Add the eye X offset
$02:F1B3  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:F1B4  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Write eye X
$02:F1B7  B9 05 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; \
$02:F1BA  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Eye Y = head Y
$02:F1BD  A9 88         LDA.B #$88                  ; \
$02:F1BF  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Eye tile = $88
$02:F1C2  B9 07 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; A = head's property byte
$02:F1C5  80 28         BRA $F1EF             ; Go write it

$02:F1C7  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:F1C8  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index (slot 0)
$02:F1CB  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; A = direction
$02:F1CE  AA            TAX                          ; X = direction
$02:F1CF  B9 04 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; A = X of segment 0 (head)
$02:F1D2  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F1D3  7D D3 F2      ADC.W $F2D3,X         ; / Add the flower X offset ($00 or $08)
$02:F1D6  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:F1D7  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Write flower X
$02:F1DA  B9 05 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; \
$02:F1DD  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F1DE  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; / Flower Y = head Y - 8
$02:F1E0  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; Write flower Y
$02:F1E3  A9 98         LDA.B #$98                  ; \
$02:F1E5  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Flower tile = $98
$02:F1E8  B9 07 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; A = head's property byte
$02:F1EB  29 F1         AND.B #$F1                  ; \
$02:F1ED  09 0A         ORA.B #$0A                  ; / Palette 5
$02:F1EF  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; Write properties
$02:F1F2  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F1F3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F1F4  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F1F5  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index >> 2
$02:F1F6  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F1F8  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Tile size = 8x8
$02:F1FB  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; Six tiles (A = 5)
$02:F1FD  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; Size already set (Y = $FF)
$02:F1FF  20 A7 B7      JSR.W $B7A7           ; Finish OAM write
$02:F202  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F204  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = sprite X low
$02:F206  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:F209  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = sprite X high
$02:F20B  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:F20D  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:F20F  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F210  E5 94         SBC RAM_MarioXPos           ; |
$02:F212  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F213  69 50 00      ADC.W #$0050                ; / A = sprite X - Mario X + $50
$02:F216  C9 A0 00      CMP.W #$00A0                ; \
$02:F219  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; / Outside +/-$50 of Mario: no contact check
$02:F21B  B0 78         BCS $F295            ; Too far: return
$02:F21D  BD C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,X               ; \
$02:F220  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; / Sprite status = 8 (normal)?
$02:F222  D0 71         BNE $F295            ; No: return
$02:F224  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:F226  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = 4: segment counter for contact check
$02:F228  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:F22B  B9 04 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; \
$02:F22E  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F22F  E5 7E         SBC $7E                     ; |
$02:F231  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:F233  C9 18         CMP.B #$18                  ; / Segment X - Mario X + $0C < $18?
$02:F235  B0 64         BCS $F29B             ; No: next segment
$02:F237  B9 05 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; \
$02:F23A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F23B  E5 80         SBC $80                     ; |
$02:F23D  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; / Segment Y - Mario Y - $10
$02:F23F  5A            PHY                          ; Save Y
$02:F240  AC 7A 18      LDY.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; \
$02:F243  F0 02         BEQ $F247             ; / On Yoshi? Then subtract $10 more
$02:F245  E9 10         SBC.B #$10                  ; Extra $10 for Yoshi
$02:F247  7A            PLY                          ; Restore Y
$02:F248  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F249  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:F24B  C9 18         CMP.B #$18                  ; / Within $18 vertically?
$02:F24D  B0 4C         BCS $F29B             ; No: next segment
$02:F24F  AD 90 14      LDA.W $1490                 ; \
$02:F252  D0 49         BNE $F29D             ; / Mario has a star? Kill the Wiggler
$02:F254  BD 4C 15      LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; \
$02:F257  05 81         ORA $81                     ; |
$02:F259  D0 40         BNE $F29B             ; / Interaction disabled (timer or Mario flag [$81])? Next segment
$02:F25B  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:F25D  9D 4C 15      STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; / Disable interaction for 8 frames
$02:F260  AD 97 16      LDA.W $1697                 ; \
$02:F263  D0 06         BNE $F26B             ; / Stomp counter [$1697] nonzero: it is a stomp
$02:F265  A5 7D         LDA RAM_MarioSpeedY         ; \
$02:F267  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |
$02:F269  30 2B         BMI $F296             ; / Mario Y speed < 8 (not falling): Mario is hurt
$02:F26B  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:F26D  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play stomp sound
$02:F270  22 33 AA 01   JSL.L BoostMarioSpeed       ; Bounce Mario up
$02:F274  BD 1C 15      LDA.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:F277  1D D0 15      ORA.W $15D0,X               ; |
$02:F27A  D0 19         BNE $F295            ; / Already angry or being eaten by Yoshi: return
$02:F27C  22 99 AB 01   JSL.L DisplayContactGfx     ; Show contact star graphic
$02:F280  AD 97 16      LDA.W $1697                 ; \
$02:F283  EE 97 16      INC.W $1697                 ; / Stomp counter [$1697]++, A = old value
$02:F286  22 E5 AC 02   JSL.L GivePoints            ; Give points based on the stomp count
$02:F28A  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:F28C  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; / [$1540] = $40: flash timer before getting angry
$02:F28F  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; Angry flag [$151C] = 1
$02:F292  20 D7 F2      JSR.W $F2D7           ; Spawn the flower
$02:F295  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F296  22 B7 F5 00   JSL.L HurtMario             ; Hurt Mario
$02:F29A  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F29B  80 2A         BRA $F2C7             ; Next segment

$02:F29D  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:F29F  9D C8 14      STA.W $14C8,X               ; / Sprite status = 2 (killed)
$02:F2A2  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:F2A4  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $D0 (fly up)
$02:F2A6  EE D2 18      INC.W $18D2                 ; Star kill counter [$18D2]++
$02:F2A9  AD D2 18      LDA.W $18D2                 ; \
$02:F2AC  C9 09         CMP.B #$09                  ; |
$02:F2AE  90 05         BCC $F2B5             ; / Counter capped at 9
$02:F2B0  A9 09         LDA.B #$09                  ; \
$02:F2B2  8D D2 18      STA.W $18D2                 ; / [$18D2] = 9
$02:F2B5  22 E5 AC 02   JSL.L GivePoints            ; Give points for the kill streak
$02:F2B9  AC D2 18      LDY.W $18D2                 ; Y = kill streak
$02:F2BC  C0 08         CPY.B #$08                  ; \
$02:F2BE  B0 06         BCS $F2C6            ; / Streak >= 8: no sound
$02:F2C0  B9 7F D5      LDA.W $D57F,Y         ; \
$02:F2C3  8D F9 1D      STA.W $1DF9                 ; / Play the streak sound
$02:F2C6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F2C7  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:F2C8  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F2C9  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F2CA  C8            INY                          ; / Next OAM slot
$02:F2CB  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; \
$02:F2CD  30 03         BMI $F2D2            ; / Next segment while [$00] >= 0
$02:F2CF  4C 2B F2      JMP.W $F22B           ; Loop

$02:F2D2  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F2D3..F2D3: Data: Wiggler flower and eye X offsets ;;;
{
;; $02F2D3: X offset of the flower on the head by direction (0, 8). The next two bytes are the eye X offsets.
$02:F2D3                .db $00,$08                 ; Flower X offsets by direction: 0, 8

}

;;; $F2D5: Wiggler eye offsets, flower spawn (WigglerEyesX) ;;;
{
;; $02F2D5: X offset of the angry eyes by direction (4, 4). $02F2D7: finds a free extended sprite slot and spawns the Wiggler flower
;; (extended sprite $0E) at the Wiggler's position, thrown upward with X speed opposite to the Wiggler's.
$02:F2D5                .db $04,$04                 ; Eye X offsets by direction: 4, 4

$02:F2D7  A0 07         LDY.B #$07                  ; \
$02:F2D9  B9 0B 17      LDA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; |
$02:F2DC  F0 04         BEQ $F2E2             ; / Search extended sprite slots 7..0 for a free one
$02:F2DE  88            DEY                          ; \
$02:F2DF  10 F8         BPL $F2D9             ; / Next slot
$02:F2E1  60            RTS                          ; No free slot: return

$02:F2E2  A9 0E         LDA.B #$0E                  ; \
$02:F2E4  99 0B 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteNum,Y     ; / Extended sprite = $0E (Wiggler flower)
$02:F2E7  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:F2E9  99 65 17      STA.W $1765,Y               ; / [$1765] = 1
$02:F2EC  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F2EE  99 1F 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXLo,Y     ; / Flower X low = sprite X low
$02:F2F1  BD E0 14      LDA.W RAM_SpriteXHi,X       ; \
$02:F2F4  99 33 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteXHi,Y     ; / Flower X high = sprite X high
$02:F2F7  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F2F9  99 15 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYLo,Y     ; / Flower Y low = sprite Y low
$02:F2FC  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F2FE  99 29 17      STA.W RAM_ExSpriteYHi,Y     ; / Flower Y high = sprite Y low (original quirk)
$02:F301  A9 D0         LDA.B #$D0                  ; \
$02:F303  99 3D 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedY,Y     ; / Flower Y speed = $D0 (up)
$02:F306  B5 B6         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; \
$02:F308  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:F30A  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:F30B  99 47 17      STA.W RAM_ExSprSpeedX,Y     ; / Flower X speed = - sprite X speed
$02:F30E  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $F30F: Yoshi's House bird main (BirdsMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 8A. Wrapper: sets the data bank, runs the bird logic and returns long. A bird hops around on the ground and pecks.
;; State [RAM_SpriteState]: 0 = hopping, 1 = standing and pecking. Frame in [$1602] selects the tile; $15AC = turn-around timer.
;; Called by: $01:881A (Yoshi's house birds (YoshisHouseBirds))
$02:F30F  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:F310  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:F311  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = $02
$02:F312  20 17 F3      JSR.W $F317           ; Run bird logic
$02:F315  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:F316  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:F317  BD AC 15      LDA.W $15AC,X               ; \
$02:F31A  F0 05         BEQ $F321             ; / Turn timer [$15AC] running?
$02:F31C  A9 04         LDA.B #$04                  ; \
$02:F31E  9D 02 16      STA.W $1602,X               ; / Frame [$1602] = 4 (turned)
$02:F321  20 EA F3      JSR.W $F3EA           ; Draw the bird
$02:F324  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:F327  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:F32A  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:F32C  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F32D  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F32F  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed += 3 (gravity)
$02:F331  B5 C2         LDA RAM_SpriteState,X       ; A = bird state
$02:F333  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Run the state routine

}

;;; $F337: Pointer table: bird states (BirdsPtrs) ;;;
{
;; State 0: hopping ($02F342), state 1: pecking ($02F38F).
$02:F337  42 F3         .dw $F342             ; State 0: hopping
$02:F339  8F F3         .dw $F38F             ; State 1: pecking

$02:F33B  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F33C..F340: Data: bird hop counts and X speeds ;;;
{
;; $02F33C: number of hops/pecks, picked at random (2,3,5,1). $02F340: X speed by direction (+8, -8).
$02:F33C                .db $02,$03,$05,$01         ; Hop counts: 2,3,5,1

$02:F340                .db $08,$F8                 ; X speeds by direction: +8, -8

}

;;; $F342: Bird state logic ;;;
{
;; $02F342: hopping state. Walks at +/-8, and each time it lands (Y >= $E8) it snaps to the ground and jumps again (Y speed $F0).
;; Near the left/right area edge it turns around; after the hop count runs out it switches to the pecking state.
;; $02F38F: pecking state. Stops, shows frame 1 for the last 8 frames of a random timer, then goes back to hopping, sometimes
;; turning around ($02F3C1) and choosing a new hop count.
$02:F342  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:F345  B9 40 F3      LDA.W $F340,Y         ; |
$02:F348  95 B6         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / X speed = $F340[direction]
$02:F34A  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Frame 0
$02:F34D  B5 AA         LDA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:F34F  30 1F         BMI $F370            ; / Rising? Return
$02:F351  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F353  C9 E8         CMP.B #$E8                  ; |
$02:F355  90 19         BCC $F370            ; / Above the ground (Y < $E8)? Return
$02:F357  29 F8         AND.B #$F8                  ; \
$02:F359  95 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; / Snap Y to the ground (multiple of 8)
$02:F35B  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:F35D  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $F0 (hop)
$02:F35F  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F361  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F362  69 30         ADC.B #$30                  ; / X + $30
$02:F364  C9 60         CMP.B #$60                  ; \
$02:F366  90 19         BCC $F381             ; / Within $30 of the area edge? Go turn around
$02:F368  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:F36B  F0 04         BEQ $F371             ; / Hops left in [$1570]: decrement and return
$02:F36D  DE 70 15      DEC.W $1570,X               ; Hops left--
$02:F370  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F371  F6 C2         INC RAM_SpriteState,X       ; Go to the pecking state
$02:F373  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:F377  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F379  A8            TAY                          ; / Random hop count (table index)
$02:F37A  B9 3C F3      LDA.W $F33C,Y         ; \
$02:F37D  9D 70 15      STA.W $1570,X               ; / [$1570] = $F33C[random]
$02:F380  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F381  BD 4C 15      LDA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; \
$02:F384  D0 08         BNE $F38E            ; / Recently turned: return
$02:F386  20 C1 F3      JSR.W $F3C1           ; Turn around
$02:F389  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; \
$02:F38B  9D 4C 15      STA.W RAM_DisableInter,X    ; / Wait $10 frames before the next turn
$02:F38E  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F38F  74 AA         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; \
$02:F391  74 B6         STZ RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; / Speed X and Y = 0
$02:F393  9E 02 16      STZ.W $1602,X               ; Frame 0
$02:F396  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:F399  F0 08         BEQ $F3A3             ; / Peck timer [$1540] = 0: go to the next step
$02:F39B  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:F39D  B0 03         BCS $F3A2            ; / Timer >= 8: return
$02:F39F  FE 02 16      INC.W $1602,X               ; Last 8 frames: frame 1 (peck)
$02:F3A2  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F3A3  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:F3A6  F0 0F         BEQ $F3B7             ; / Pecks left [$1570] = 0: leave the pecking state
$02:F3A8  DE 70 15      DEC.W $1570,X               ; Pecks left--
$02:F3AB  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:F3AF  29 1F         AND.B #$1F                  ; |
$02:F3B1  09 0A         ORA.B #$0A                  ; / Random
$02:F3B3  9D 40 15      STA.W $1540,X               ; [$1540] = (random AND $1F) OR $0A: time to peck
$02:F3B6  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F3B7  74 C2         STZ RAM_SpriteState,X       ; State = 0 (hopping)
$02:F3B9  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:F3BD  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:F3BF  D0 0D         BNE $F3CE             ; / 50% chance to turn around
$02:F3C1  BD 7C 15      LDA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:F3C4  49 01         EOR.B #$01                  ; |
$02:F3C6  9D 7C 15      STA.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; / Flip direction
$02:F3C9  A9 0A         LDA.B #$0A                  ; \
$02:F3CB  9D AC 15      STA.W $15AC,X               ; / Turn timer [$15AC] = $0A
$02:F3CE  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; \
$02:F3D2  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; / Random number AND 3
$02:F3D4  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F3D5  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; / + 2
$02:F3D7  9D 70 15      STA.W $1570,X               ; Hop count [$1570] = 2..5
$02:F3DA  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F3DB: Table: bird tiles (BirdsTilemap) ;;;
{
;; Tile by frame [$1602]: $D2, $D3 = hop frames, $D0, $D1 = peck frames, $9B = turning.
$02:F3DB                .db $D2,$D3,$D0,$D1,$9B     ; Tiles by frame: hop, hop, peck, peck, turned

}

;;; $F3E0: Table: bird flip bits (BirdsFlip) ;;;
{
;; OAM property flip bits by direction: $71 = flipped (facing right), $31 = normal.
$02:F3E0                .db $71,$31                 ; Flip bits by direction

}

;;; $F3E2: Table: bird palettes (BirdsPal) ;;;
{
;; OAM palette bits by (sprite index AND 3), so neighbouring birds have different colours.
$02:F3E2                .db $08,$04,$06,$0A         ; Palette bits by (X AND 3)

}

;;; $F3E6: Table: bird OAM slots, bird draw (FireplaceTilemap) ;;;
{
;; $02F3E6: OAM offsets (in the $0200 low table) used by the four birds, indexed by sprite index AND 3.
;; $02F3EA: draws one bird as a single 8x8 sprite at its screen position in that fixed OAM slot, using the tile for frame [$1602].
$02:F3E6                .db $30,$34,$48,$3C         ; OAM offsets by (X AND 3)

$02:F3EA  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F3EB  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F3ED  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:F3EE  B9 E2 F3      LDA.W BirdsPal,Y            ; / A = palette bits by sprite index
$02:F3F1  BC 7C 15      LDY.W RAM_SpriteDir,X       ; \
$02:F3F4  19 E0 F3      ORA.W BirdsFlip,Y           ; / OR flip bits for direction
$02:F3F7  85 02         STA $02                     ; Save in [$02]
$02:F3F9  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F3FA  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F3FC  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:F3FD  B9 E6 F3      LDA.W FireplaceTilemap,Y    ; / A = OAM offset for this bird
$02:F400  A8            TAY                          ; Y = OAM offset
$02:F401  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F403  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F404  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / Screen X
$02:F406  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; Write X
$02:F409  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F40B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F40C  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; / Screen Y
$02:F40E  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; Write Y
$02:F411  DA            PHX                          ; Save sprite index
$02:F412  BD 02 16      LDA.W $1602,X               ; \
$02:F415  AA            TAX                          ; / X = frame [$1602]
$02:F416  BD DB F3      LDA.W BirdsTilemap,X        ; \
$02:F419  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / Write tile from BirdsTilemap
$02:F41C  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:F41D  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:F41F  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / Write properties
$02:F422  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F423  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F424  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F425  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM slot
$02:F426  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F428  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / Tile size = 8x8
$02:F42B  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

;;; $F42C: Yoshi's House chimney smoke main (SmokeMain) ;;;
{
;; Sprite 8B. Wrapper. The puff drifts up at 1/4 pixel per frame, sways left/right every $40 frames, is drawn as two mirrored puffs
;; and is removed when it reaches the top of the screen. [$1540] delays the sideways motion after spawning.
;; Called by: $01:881F (Yoshi's house chimney smoke (YoshisHouseSmoke))
$02:F42C  8B            PHB                          ; Save data bank
$02:F42D  4B            PHK                          ; \
$02:F42E  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = $02
$02:F42F  20 34 F4      JSR.W $F434           ; Run smoke logic
$02:F432  AB            PLB                          ; Restore data bank
$02:F433  6B            RTL                          ; Return long

$02:F434  FE 70 15      INC.W $1570,X               ; Age counter [$1570]++
$02:F437  A0 04         LDY.B #$04                  ; Y = 4 (drift right)
$02:F439  BD 70 15      LDA.W $1570,X               ; \
$02:F43C  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; |
$02:F43E  F0 02         BEQ $F442             ; / Bit 6 of the age clear: keep Y = 4
$02:F440  A0 FE         LDY.B #$FE                  ; Y = $FE (drift left)
$02:F442  94 B6         STY RAM_SpriteSpeedX,X      ; X speed = Y
$02:F444  A9 FC         LDA.B #$FC                  ; \
$02:F446  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; / Y speed = $FC (rise)
$02:F448  20 94 D2      JSR.W UpdateYPosNoGrvty     ; Update Y position
$02:F44B  BD 40 15      LDA.W $1540,X               ; \
$02:F44E  D0 03         BNE $F453             ; / Delay [$1540] still running: no X movement
$02:F450  20 88 D2      JSR.W UpdateXPosNoGrvty     ; Update X position
$02:F453  20 7C F4      JSR.W $F47C           ; Draw the puffs
$02:F456  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F458  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F459  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:F45B  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; / Screen Y == $F0?
$02:F45D  D0 03         BNE $F462            ; \
$02:F45F  9E C8 14      STZ.W $14C8,X               ; / Yes: remove the sprite
$02:F462  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F463..F47B: Table: smoke puff spread ;;;

$02:F463                .db $03,$04,$05,$04,$05,$06,$05,$06 ; Puff spread by age: 3-4-5-4-5-6-5-6-7-6-7-8-7-8 ...

$02:F473                .db $07,$08,$07,$08,$07,$08,$07,$08 ; (smoke spread table, continued)
$02:F47B                .db $07                     ; (last entry)

}

;;; $F47C: Draw smoke puffs ;;;
{
;; Draws two 16x16 puffs (tile $C5) spread apart horizontally by the table value, the second one X-flipped, with palette 2.
;; Parameters: X = sprite index.
;; Called by: $02:F453 (Yoshi's House chimney smoke main (SmokeMain))
$02:F47C  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:F47E  29 0F         AND.B #$0F                  ; |
$02:F480  D0 03         BNE $F485             ; / Every 16 frames...
$02:F482  FE 1C 15      INC.W $151C,X               ; ...age [$151C]++
$02:F485  BC 1C 15      LDY.W $151C,X               ; \
$02:F488  B9 63 F4      LDA.W $F463,Y         ; / A = puff spread by age
$02:F48B  85 00         STA $00                     ; Save in [$00]
$02:F48D  BC EA 15      LDY.W RAM_SprOAMIndex,X     ; Y = OAM index
$02:F490  B5 E4         LDA RAM_SpriteXLo,X         ; \
$02:F492  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F493  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; / A = screen X
$02:F495  48            PHA                          ; Save it
$02:F496  38            SEC                          ; \
$02:F497  E5 00         SBC $00                     ; |
$02:F499  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / Left puff X = screen X - spread
$02:F49C  68            PLA                          ; \
$02:F49D  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F49E  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |
$02:F4A0  99 04 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispX,Y      ; / Right puff X = screen X + spread
$02:F4A3  B5 D8         LDA RAM_SpriteYLo,X         ; \
$02:F4A5  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F4A6  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:F4A8  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Left puff Y = screen Y
$02:F4AB  99 05 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2DispY,Y      ; Right puff Y = screen Y
$02:F4AE  A9 C5         LDA.B #$C5                  ; \
$02:F4B0  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Left puff tile = $C5
$02:F4B3  99 06 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2,Y           ; Right puff tile = $C5
$02:F4B6  A9 05         LDA.B #$05                  ; \
$02:F4B8  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Left puff property = $05
$02:F4BB  09 40         ORA.B #$40                  ; \
$02:F4BD  99 07 03      STA.W OAM_Tile2Prop,Y       ; / Right puff property = $45 (X-flipped)
$02:F4C0  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F4C1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F4C2  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F4C3  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM slot
$02:F4C4  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:F4C6  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Left puff size = 16x16
$02:F4C9  99 61 04      STA.W $0461,Y               ; Right puff size = 16x16
$02:F4CC  60            RTS                          ; Return

}

$02:F522  BD E9 F4      LDA.W $F4E9,X         ; \

$02:F530  98            TYA                          ; \

$02:F532  4A            LSR                          ; |

$02:F539  99 61 04      STA.W $0461,Y               ; Bottom tile size = 8x8
$02:F53C  FA            PLX                          ; Restore sprite index
$02:F53D  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F53E  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \

$02:F54A  B9 C8 14      LDA.W $14C8,Y               ; |

$02:F54F  88            DEY                          ; \

$02:F552  60            RTS                          ; No free slot: return

$02:F553  A9 8B         LDA.B #$8B                  ; \

$02:F558  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; \
$02:F55A  99 C8 14      STA.W $14C8,Y               ; / Status = 8 (normal)
$02:F55D  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:F55E  BB            TYX                          ; X = new sprite
$02:F55F  22 D2 F7 07   JSL.L InitSpriteTables      ; Initialise the sprite tables
$02:F563  A9 BB         LDA.B #$BB                  ; \
