;;; $F5D0: Draw Ghost House exit ;;;
{
;; Draws ten 16x16 tiles at fixed screen positions, only while the screen scroll X is below $46 (start of the level).
;; Parameters: X = ten tile loop index; Y = $A0 start OAM offset.
;; Called by: $02:F598 (Ghost House exit main (GhostExitMain))
$02:F5D0  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:F5D2  C9 46         CMP.B #$46                  ; |
$02:F5D4  B0 42         BCS $F618            ; / Screen scroll X >= $46? Skip the exit (offscreen)
$02:F5D6  A2 09         LDX.B #$09                  ; X = 9: ten tiles
$02:F5D8  A0 A0         LDY.B #$A0                  ; Y = $A0: OAM offset
$02:F5DA  64 02         STZ $02                     ; [$02] = 0: X high-bit flag
$02:F5DC  BD 9E F5      LDA.W $F59E,X         ; \
$02:F5DF  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:F5E0  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:F5E2  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = tile X - scroll X (low)
$02:F5E4  BD A8 F5      LDA.W $F5A8,X         ; \
$02:F5E7  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:F5E9  F0 02         BEQ $F5ED             ; / X high - scroll X high: zero?
$02:F5EB  E6 02         INC $02                     ; No: set the OAM X high bit flag
$02:F5ED  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; A = tile X
$02:F5EF  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; Write X
$02:F5F2  BD B2 F5      LDA.W $F5B2,X         ; \
$02:F5F5  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Write Y
$02:F5F8  BD BC F5      LDA.W $F5BC,X         ; \
$02:F5FB  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Write tile
$02:F5FE  BD C6 F5      LDA.W $F5C6,X         ; \
$02:F601  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Write properties
$02:F604  5A            PHY                          ; Save OAM offset
$02:F605  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F606  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F607  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F608  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM slot
$02:F609  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:F60B  05 02         ORA $02                     ; |
$02:F60D  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / Size = 16x16, plus the X high bit
$02:F610  7A            PLY                          ; Restore OAM offset
$02:F611  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:F612  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F613  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F614  C8            INY                          ; / Next OAM slot
$02:F615  CA            DEX                          ; Next tile
$02:F616  10 C2         BPL $F5DA             ; Loop for the ten tiles
$02:F618  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:F681  D0 05         BNE $F688             ; |

$02:F688  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; \

$02:F698  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; A = $30: hold at full height
$02:F69A  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = vertical offset of the tile block (0-$30 pixels, bigger = higher)
$02:F69C  20 B8 F6      JSR.W $F6B8           ; Draw the 3x4 block of tiles
$02:F69F  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

$02:F7E7  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / Extended OAM Y = [$01] + [DATA_02F711+X]
$02:F7EA  A5 03         LDA $03                     ; \
$02:F7EC  C9 03         CMP.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F7EE  BD 19 F7      LDA.W $F719,X         ; |
$02:F7F1  90 02         BCC $F7F5             ; |
$02:F7F3  49 40         EOR.B #$40                  ; |
$02:F7F5  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / Extended property = [DATA_02F719+X], X-flipped when the frame is 3 or more
$02:F7F8  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F7F9  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F7FA  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F7FB  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4
$02:F7FC  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:F7FE  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; / OAM size bits = 02 (16x16 tile)
$02:F801  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:F802  30 03         BMI $F807            ; / Next tile, return when X < 0
$02:F804  4C 8C F7      JMP.W $F78C           ; Draw the next tile

$02:F807  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F808  8B            PHB                          ; \
$02:F809  4B            PHK                          ; |
$02:F80A  AB            PLB                          ; / Data bank = program bank ($02)
$02:F80B  20 10 F8      JSR.W $F810           ; Run all cluster sprites
$02:F80E  AB            PLB                          ; Restore the data bank
$02:F80F  6B            RTL                          ; Return long (called from the Mario enter-castle code and the sprite loop)

$02:F810  A2 13         LDX.B #$13                  ; X = 19: cluster sprite slot counter
$02:F812  8E E9 15      STX.W $15E9                 ; Remember the current slot in [$15E9]
$02:F815  BD 92 18      LDA.W $1892,X               ; A = cluster sprite number in this slot ([$1892,X])
$02:F818  F0 03         BEQ $F81D             ; 0 = empty slot: skip
$02:F81A  20 21 F8      JSR.W $F821           ; Run the cluster sprite's routine
$02:F81D  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:F81E  10 F2         BPL $F812             ; / Next slot, loop for 20 slots (X = 19..0)
$02:F820  60            RTS                          ; Return (also pointer entry 0: empty)

$02:F821  22 DF 86 00   JSL.L ExecutePtr            ; Jump to the routine for cluster sprite number [A] in Ptrs02F825

}

;;; $F825: Pointer table: cluster sprites, fading Boos (Ptrs02F825) ;;;
{
;; $02F825: 9 pointers to cluster sprite routines, indexed by the cluster sprite number in [$1892,X].
;; $02F83D: cluster sprite 7. A group of Boos that jump between two layouts ([$18BA] bit 0 selects the offsets at [$1E66]/[$1E52] or [$1E8E]/[$1E7A]),
;; while a timer [$190A] counts $FF to 0. The timer sets a fade level 0-8 in [$190B] (fade in at $FF-$E0, solid, fade out at $40-$20, hidden below $20),
;; applied as a palette transparency effect ($8239). Boos bob by 1 pixel every 8 frames and hurt Mario on contact ($FE71).
$02:F825  20 F8         .dw $F820            ; 00 - Empty slot (Return)
$02:F827  BC FD         .dw $FDBC             ; 01 - Cluster sprite at $FDBC
$02:F829  00 00         .dw $0000                   ; 02 - Unused (null pointer)
$02:F82B  C7 FB         .dw $FBC7             ; 03 - Cluster sprite at $FBC7 (shared with 08)
$02:F82D  98 FA         .dw $FA98             ; 04 - Ring of Boos on a circle ($FA98)
$02:F82F  16 FA         .dw $FA16             ; 05 - Castle candle flames ($FA16)
$02:F831  1C F9         .dw $F91C             ; 06 - Sumo Bro lightning flames ($F91C)
$02:F833  3D F8         .dw $F83D             ; 07 - Boos that fade in and out ($F83D)
$02:F835  C7 FB         .dw $FBC7             ; 08 - Cluster sprite at $FBC7 (shared with 03)

$02:F837                .db $01,$FF                 ; Y speed low byte for the bob: +1, -1

$02:F839                .db $00,$FF,$02,$0E         ; Y speed high byte: $00, $FF (the last two bytes are unused)

$02:F83D  AD 0A 19      LDA.W $190A                 ; A = [$190A] (fade timer, counts $FF down to 0)
$02:F840  8D 5E 18      STA.W $185E                 ; [$185E] = copy of the timer for this frame
$02:F843  9B            TXY                          ; Y = X: Z set if this is slot 0
$02:F844  D0 0F         BNE $F855             ; Only slot 0 updates the timer
$02:F846  CE 0A 19      DEC.W $190A                 ; Timer -= 1
$02:F849  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F84B  D0 08         BNE $F855             ; / Old timer was not 0: go on ($02F855)
$02:F84D  EE BA 18      INC.W $18BA                 ; Old timer was 0: next phase, [$18BA]++
$02:F850  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; \
$02:F852  8C 0A 19      STY.W $190A                 ; / Timer = $FF (restart the cycle)
$02:F855  C9 00         CMP.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F857  D0 45         BNE $F89E             ; / Timer not 0: skip repositioning ($02F89E)
$02:F859  AD BF 18      LDA.W $18BF                 ; \
$02:F85C  F0 07         BEQ $F865             ; / [$18BF] set: despawn the Boos
$02:F85E  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Clear this cluster sprite slot
$02:F861  9C BA 18      STZ.W $18BA                 ; Phase counter [$18BA] = 0
$02:F864  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F865  BD 66 1E      LDA.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:F868  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:F86A  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; |
$02:F86D  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$00] = [$1E66,X] (X offset), [$01] = [$1E52,X] (Y offset): set A
$02:F86F  AD BA 18      LDA.W $18BA                 ; \
$02:F872  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:F874  D0 0A         BNE $F880             ; / Phase bit 0 set: use set A ($02F880)
$02:F876  BD 8E 1E      LDA.W $1E8E,X               ; \
$02:F879  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:F87B  BD 7A 1E      LDA.W $1E7A,X               ; |
$02:F87E  85 01         STA $01                     ; / Phase bit 0 clear: [$00] = [$1E8E,X], [$01] = [$1E7A,X] (set B)
$02:F880  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:F882  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F883  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:F885  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; / Cluster X low = [$00] + [RAM_ScreenBndryXLo]
$02:F888  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; \
$02:F88A  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:F88C  9D 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,X               ; / Cluster X high = [RAM_ScreenBndryXHi] + carry
$02:F88F  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:F891  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F892  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:F894  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; / Cluster Y low = [$01] + [RAM_ScreenBndryYLo]
$02:F897  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; \
$02:F899  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:F89B  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; / Cluster Y high = [RAM_ScreenBndryYHi] + carry
$02:F89E  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F89F  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F8A0  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F8A1  65 14         ADC RAM_FrameCounterB       ; |
$02:F8A3  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = slot * 4 + [RAM_FrameCounterB] (staggers the slots)
$02:F8A5  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; \
$02:F8A7  05 9D         ORA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; |
$02:F8A9  D0 1D         BNE $F8C8             ; / Bob only every 8th frame and when sprites are not locked
$02:F8AB  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:F8AD  29 20         AND.B #$20                  ; |
$02:F8AF  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8B0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8B1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8B2  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8B3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8B4  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = bit 5 of [$00] (0 or 1)
$02:F8B5  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:F8B8  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F8B9  79 37 F8      ADC.W $F837,Y         ; |
$02:F8BC  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; / Y position low += [DATA_02F837+Y] (+1 or -1)
$02:F8BF  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; \
$02:F8C2  79 39 F8      ADC.W $F839,Y         ; |
$02:F8C5  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; / Y position high += [DATA_02F839+Y]
$02:F8C8  AC 5E 18      LDY.W $185E                 ; Y = timer copy
$02:F8CB  C0 20         CPY.B #$20                  ; \
$02:F8CD  90 2C         BCC $F8FB            ; / Timer < $20: Boos invisible, return
$02:F8CF  C0 40         CPY.B #$40                  ; \
$02:F8D1  B0 05         BCS $F8D8             ; / Timer >= $40: go to $02F8D8
$02:F8D3  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F8D4  E9 1F         SBC.B #$1F                  ; |
$02:F8D6  80 0A         BRA $F8E2             ; / Timer $20-$3F (fading out): A = timer - $20

$02:F8D8  C0 E0         CPY.B #$E0                  ; \
$02:F8DA  90 0A         BCC $F8E6             ; / Timer < $E0: fully visible, go to $02F8E6
$02:F8DC  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:F8DD  E9 E0         SBC.B #$E0                  ; |
$02:F8DF  49 1F         EOR.B #$1F                  ; |
$02:F8E1  1A            INC A                       ; / Timer >= $E0 (fading in): A = $20 - (timer - $E0)
$02:F8E2  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:F8E3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F8E4  80 05         BRA $F8EB             ; / A = A / 4 (0-8), go store it

$02:F8E6  20 B0 FB      JSR.W $FBB0           ; Visible: every 4th frame test contact with Mario ($FBB0)
$02:F8E9  A9 08         LDA.B #$08                  ; A = 8: fully opaque
$02:F8EB  8D 0B 19      STA.W $190B                 ; [$190B] = fade level 0-8, used for the palette transparency effect
$02:F8EE  E0 00         CPX.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F8F0  D0 04         BNE $F8F6             ; |
$02:F8F2  22 39 82 03   JSL.L $8239           ; / Slot 0 only: update the transparency palette ($8239)
$02:F8F6  A9 0F         LDA.B #$0F                  ; A = $0F: parameter for the Boo draw routine (stored in [$02])
$02:F8F8  20 48 FD      JSR.W $FD48           ; Draw this Boo ($FD48)
$02:F8FB  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F8FC..F8FC: Table: Sumo Bro flame Y offsets ;;;
{
$02:F8FC                .db $00,$10,$00,$10,$08,$10,$FF,$10 ; Flame tile Y offsets, 2 per animation frame ($FF = tile not drawn)
}

;;; $F904: Sumo Bro lightning flames (SumoBroFlameTiles) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table index 6. A flame left by the Sumo Bro; [$0F4A,X] is its lifetime timer (timer / 8 picks one of 4 animation frames).
;; Tables first: Y offsets, tiles and frame order. $02F91C: update (count timer down, animate, test contact, draw). $02F940: draw 2 16x16 tiles.
$02:F904                .db $DC,$EC,$CC,$EC,$CC,$DC,$00,$CC ; Flame tiles, 2 per animation frame
$02:F90C                .db $03,$03,$03,$03,$02,$01,$00,$00 ; Animation frame by flame timer / 8 (first half)
$02:F914                .db $00,$00,$00,$00,$01,$02,$03,$03 ; Animation frame by flame timer / 8 (second half)

$02:F91C  BD 4A 0F      LDA.W $0F4A,X               ; A = [$0F4A,X] (flame timer)
$02:F91F  F0 1B         BEQ $F93C             ; Timer 0: flame is over
$02:F921  A4 9D         LDY RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:F923  D0 03         BNE $F928             ; |
$02:F925  DE 4A 0F      DEC.W $0F4A,X               ; / Timer -= 1 unless sprites are locked
$02:F928  4A            LSR                          ; \
$02:F929  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F92A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:F92B  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = timer / 8
$02:F92C  B9 0C F9      LDA.W $F90C,Y         ; \
$02:F92F  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F930  8D 5E 18      STA.W $185E                 ; / [$185E] = animation frame * 2
$02:F933  20 AE F9      JSR.W $F9AE           ; Test contact with Mario ($F9AE)
$02:F936  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:F937  20 40 F9      JSR.W $F940           ; |
$02:F93A  FA            PLX                          ; / Draw the flame ($F940), keeping X
$02:F93B  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F93C  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Clear this cluster sprite slot
$02:F93F  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F940  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F941  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F942  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = slot * 2
$02:F943  B9 50 FF      LDA.W $FF50,Y         ; \
$02:F946  8D EA 15      STA.W RAM_SprOAMIndex       ; / [RAM_SprOAMIndex] = OAM index for this slot ([DATA_02FF50+Y])
$02:F949  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:F94C  85 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo           ; / Sprite 0 X low = cluster X low (temporary position for GetDrawInfo2)
$02:F94E  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; \
$02:F951  8D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi         ; / Sprite 0 X high = cluster X high
$02:F954  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:F957  85 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo           ; / Sprite 0 Y low = cluster Y low
$02:F959  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; \
$02:F95C  8D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi         ; / Sprite 0 Y high = cluster Y high
$02:F95F  A8            TAY                          ; Y = Y high (parameter of GetDrawInfo2)
$02:F960  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; X = 0: work on sprite slot 0
$02:F962  20 78 D3      JSR.W GetDrawInfo2          ; On-screen position: [$00] = X, [$01] = Y (GetDrawInfo2)
$02:F965  A2 01         LDX.B #$01                  ; X = tile counter (2 tiles)
$02:F967  DA            PHX                          ; Save the tile counter
$02:F968  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:F96A  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = [$00]
$02:F96D  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F96E  0D 5E 18      ORA.W $185E                 ; |
$02:F971  AA            TAX                          ; / X = [$185E] | tile: index into the flame tables
$02:F972  BD FC F8      LDA.W $F8FC,X         ; \
$02:F975  30 1C         BMI $F993             ; / Y offset = [DATA_02F8FC+X]; $FF skips this tile
$02:F977  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:F978  65 01         ADC $01                     ; |
$02:F97A  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = [$01] + offset
$02:F97D  BD 04 F9      LDA.W SumoBroFlameTiles,X   ; \
$02:F980  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = [SumoBroFlameTiles+X]
$02:F983  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:F985  29 04         AND.B #$04                  ; |
$02:F987  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F988  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F989  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F98A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:F98B  EA            NOP                          ; |
$02:F98C  05 64         ORA $64                     ; |
$02:F98E  09 05         ORA.B #$05                  ; |
$02:F990  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Property = X-flip every 4 frames | [$64] (priority) | $05 (palette 2, page 1)
$02:F993  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the tile counter
$02:F994  C8            INY                          ; \
$02:F995  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F996  C8            INY                          ; |
$02:F997  C8            INY                          ; / OAM index += 4
$02:F998  CA            DEX                          ; \
$02:F999  10 CC         BPL $F967             ; / Loop for 2 tiles
$02:F99B  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; \
$02:F99D  A0 02         LDY.B #$02                  ; |
$02:F99F  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; |
$02:F9A1  22 B3 B7 01   JSL.L FinishOAMWrite        ; / Finish the OAM write: 2 tiles (A = 1), 16x16 size (Y = 2) (FinishOAMWrite)
$02:F9A5  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F9A6  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Clear this cluster sprite slot (Mario has a star)
$02:F9A9  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $F9AA..F9AA: Table: flame hitbox Y offsets ;;;
{
$02:F9AA                .db $02,$0A,$12,$1A         ; Hitbox Y offsets, indexed by [$185E] (0,2,4,6): entries 4 and 6 read code bytes (probably a bug)

}

;;; $F9AE: Sumo Bro flame: contact with Mario ;;;
{
;; Every 4th frame per slot, if the flame timer is $10 or more: builds a hitbox (X + 2, width $0C, Y + table, height $14) and checks it against Mario.
;; Star: the flame disappears. On Yoshi: Mario loses Yoshi ($A473). Otherwise Mario is hurt. $02F9F5 is also used by the Boo contact check.
;; Called by: $02:F933 (Sumo Bro lightning flames (SumoBroFlameTiles))
$02:F9AE  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:F9AF  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:F9B1  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:F9B3  D0 49         BNE $F9FE            ; / Test contact only 1 frame in 4 per slot (staggered)
$02:F9B5  BD 4A 0F      LDA.W $0F4A,X               ; \
$02:F9B8  C9 10         CMP.B #$10                  ; |
$02:F9BA  90 42         BCC $F9FE            ; / Flame timer < $10 (dying out): harmless, return
$02:F9BC  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:F9BF  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F9C0  69 02         ADC.B #$02                  ; |
$02:F9C2  85 04         STA $04                     ; / [$04] = flame X low + 2 (hitbox X)
$02:F9C4  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; \
$02:F9C7  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:F9C9  85 0A         STA $0A                     ; / [$0A] = X high + carry
$02:F9CB  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; \
$02:F9CD  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = $0C (hitbox width)
$02:F9CF  AC 5E 18      LDY.W $185E                 ; Y = [$185E] (animation frame * 2)
$02:F9D2  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:F9D5  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:F9D6  79 AA F9      ADC.W $F9AA,Y         ; |
$02:F9D9  85 05         STA $05                     ; / [$05] = flame Y low + [DATA_02F9AA+Y] (hitbox Y)
$02:F9DB  A9 14         LDA.B #$14                  ; \
$02:F9DD  85 07         STA $07                     ; / [$07] = $14 (hitbox height)
$02:F9DF  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; \
$02:F9E2  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:F9E4  85 0B         STA $0B                     ; / [$0B] = Y high + carry
$02:F9E6  22 64 B6 03   JSL.L GetMarioClipping      ; Get Mario's hitbox (GetMarioClipping)
$02:F9EA  22 2B B7 03   JSL.L CheckForContact       ; Test the hitboxes for contact (CheckForContact)
$02:F9EE  90 0E         BCC $F9FE            ; No contact: return
$02:F9F0  AD 90 14      LDA.W $1490                 ; \
$02:F9F3  D0 B1         BNE $F9A6             ; / Mario has a star: clear the flame ($02F9A6)
$02:F9F5  AD 7A 18      LDA.W RAM_OnYoshi           ; \
$02:F9F8  D0 05         BNE $F9FF             ; / Mario on Yoshi: go to $02F9FF
$02:F9FA  22 B7 F5 00   JSL.L HurtMario             ; Hurt Mario (HurtMario)
$02:F9FE  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:F9FF  4C 73 A4      JMP.W $A473           ; Yoshi is hit: Mario loses Yoshi ($A473)


}

;;; $FA02..FA0A: Table: castle flame animation masks and OAM ;;;

$02:FA02                .db $03,$07,$07,$07,$0F,$07,$07,$0F ; Animation advance masks for the castle flames (random index 0-7)
$02:FA0A                .db $F0,$F4,$F8,$FC         ; OAM indices of the 4 castle flames: $F0,$F4,$F8,$FC

}

;;; $FA0E: Table: castle flame tiles (CastleFlameTiles) ;;;

;;; $FA12: Castle candle flames (CastleFlameGfxProp) ;;;
{
;; Pointer table index 5. Four flickering flames drawn at the last 4 OAM slots ($F0-$FC in the $0300 buffer), positioned by the layer 2 scroll [$1E]/[$20].
;; The animation counter [$0F4A,X] advances randomly. A tile at X >= $F0 is duplicated at OAM $03EC with X bit 8 set so it also shows at the left screen edge.
$02:FA12                .db $09,$09,$49,$49         ; Flame properties by animation frame: $09,$09,$49,$49 (second half X-flipped)

$02:FA16  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:FA18  D0 11         BNE $FA2B             ; / Sprites locked: skip the animation ($02FA2B)
$02:FA1A  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; Get a random number (GetRand)
$02:FA1E  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; \
$02:FA20  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = random 0-7
$02:FA21  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:FA23  39 02 FA      AND.W $FA02,Y         ; |
$02:FA26  D0 03         BNE $FA2B             ; / Advance the animation only when [RAM_FrameCounter] & mask = 0
$02:FA28  FE 4A 0F      INC.W $0F4A,X               ; Flame animation counter [$0F4A,X]++
$02:FA2B  BC 0A FA      LDY.W $FA0A,X         ; Y = OAM index of this flame ([DATA_02FA0A+X])
$02:FA2E  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FA31  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FA32  E5 1E         SBC $1E                     ; |
$02:FA34  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = flame X low - [$1E] (layer 2 X scroll)
$02:FA37  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FA3A  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FA3B  E5 20         SBC $20                     ; |
$02:FA3D  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = flame Y low - [$20] (layer 2 Y scroll)
$02:FA40  5A            PHY                          ; Save the OAM index
$02:FA41  DA            PHX                          ; Save the slot
$02:FA42  BD 4A 0F      LDA.W $0F4A,X               ; \
$02:FA45  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FA47  AA            TAX                          ; / X = animation frame ([$0F4A,X] & 3)
$02:FA48  BD 0E FA      LDA.W CastleFlameTiles,X    ; \
$02:FA4B  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; / Tile = [CastleFlameTiles+X]
$02:FA4E  BD 12 FA      LDA.W CastleFlameGfxProp,X  ; \
$02:FA51  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / Property = [CastleFlameGfxProp+X]
$02:FA54  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the slot
$02:FA55  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:FA56  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FA57  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FA58  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = OAM index / 4
$02:FA59  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:FA5B  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; / OAM size bits = 02 (16x16 tile)
$02:FA5E  7A            PLY                          ; Restore the OAM index
$02:FA5F  B9 00 03      LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; \
$02:FA62  C9 F0         CMP.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:FA64  90 1D         BCC $FA83            ; / OAM X < $F0: done, return
$02:FA66  B9 00 03      LDA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; \
$02:FA69  8D EC 03      STA.W $03EC                 ; |
$02:FA6C  B9 01 03      LDA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; |
$02:FA6F  8D ED 03      STA.W $03ED                 ; |
$02:FA72  B9 02 03      LDA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; |
$02:FA75  8D EE 03      STA.W $03EE                 ; |
$02:FA78  B9 03 03      LDA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; |
$02:FA7B  8D EF 03      STA.W $03EF                 ; / Copy the tile to OAM slot $03EC-$03EF (a duplicate for the screen wrap)
$02:FA7E  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; \
$02:FA80  8D 9B 04      STA.W $049B                 ; / Size bits of the copy = 3: 16x16 with X bit 8, so it shows at X - 256
$02:FA83  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $FA84..FA95: Table: Boo ring angle offsets ;;;
{
;; 16-bit angle offsets (512 = full turn) of each Boo in a ring: $0000, $0028, ..., $0168 (10 entries).
$02:FA84                .db $00                     ; Boo angle offset table: 16-bit entry k at $FA84+2k (low byte first)

$02:FA85                .db $00,$28,$00,$50,$00,$78,$00,$A0 ; High byte of entry 0, entries 1-3 ($0028,$0050,$0078), low byte of entry 4
$02:FA8D                .db $00,$C8,$00,$F0,$00,$18,$01,$40 ; High byte of entry 4, entries 5-7 ($00C8,$00F0,$0118), low byte of entry 8
$02:FA95                .db $01,$68,$01             ; High byte of entry 8 ($0140), entry 9 ($0168)

}

;;; $FA98: Ring of Boos on a circle ;;;
{
;; Pointer table index 4 (probably the circling Boo ring). Ring data in [$0FAE]-[$0FBC] indexed by ring number [$0F86,X]:
;; 9-bit angle [$0FAE]/[$0FB0], center X [$0FB2]/[$0FB4], center Y [$0FB6]/[$0FB8], despawn flag [$0FBA], level sprite index [$0FBC].
;; The angle advances by [$0F4A,X] unless sprites are locked. The ring despawns when its center is far off screen. Each Boo = center + radius $50 * sin/cos
;; (CircleCoords and the hardware multiplier). $02FBB0: every 4th frame test contact with Mario.
$02:FA98  BC 86 0F      LDY.W $0F86,X               ; Y = [$0F86,X]: ring number of this Boo
$02:FA9B  B9 BA 0F      LDA.W $0FBA,Y               ; A = [$0FBA,Y] (ring despawned flag)
$02:FA9E  F0 04         BEQ $FAA4             ; Ring still active: go on ($02FAA4)
$02:FAA0  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Ring is gone: clear this cluster slot
$02:FAA3  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FAA4  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:FAA6  D0 48         BNE $FAF0             ; / Sprites locked: skip the rotation ($02FAF0)
$02:FAA8  BD 4A 0F      LDA.W $0F4A,X               ; \
$02:FAAB  F0 43         BEQ $FAF0             ; / [$0F4A,X] (rotation speed) = 0: skip the rotation
$02:FAAD  64 00         STZ $00                     ; \
$02:FAAF  10 02         BPL $FAB3             ; |
$02:FAB1  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; / [$00] = sign extension of the signed speed
$02:FAB3  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:FAB4  79 AE 0F      ADC.W $0FAE,Y               ; |
$02:FAB7  99 AE 0F      STA.W $0FAE,Y               ; / Ring angle low [$0FAE,Y] += speed
$02:FABA  B9 B0 0F      LDA.W $0FB0,Y               ; \
$02:FABD  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |
$02:FABF  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FAC1  99 B0 0F      STA.W $0FB0,Y               ; / Ring angle high bit [$0FB0,Y] = (high + carry) & 1 (9-bit angle)
$02:FAC4  B9 B2 0F      LDA.W $0FB2,Y               ; \
$02:FAC7  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:FAC9  B9 B4 0F      LDA.W $0FB4,Y               ; |
$02:FACC  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$00] = ring center X (16-bit from [$0FB2,Y]/[$0FB4,Y])
$02:FACE  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:FAD0  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FAD2  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FAD3  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FAD5  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FAD6  69 80 00      ADC.W #$0080                ; |
$02:FAD9  C9 00 02      CMP.W #$0200                ; / Carry set if center X - screen X + $80 >= $200 (far off screen)
$02:FADC  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:FADE  90 10         BCC $FAF0             ; Still near the screen: go on ($02FAF0)
$02:FAE0  A9 01         LDA.B #$01                  ; \
$02:FAE2  99 BA 0F      STA.W $0FBA,Y               ; / [$0FBA,Y] = 1: mark the ring as despawned
$02:FAE5  DA            PHX                          ; Save X
$02:FAE6  BE BC 0F      LDX.W $0FBC,Y               ; X = [$0FBC,Y] (level sprite index that created the ring)
$02:FAE9  9E 38 19      STZ.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,X   ; Clear its load status so the level loader can create it again
$02:FAEC  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X
$02:FAED  CE BA 18      DEC.W $18BA                 ; [$18BA]-- (counter shared with $F83D)
$02:FAF0  DA            PHX                          ; Save the slot
$02:FAF1  BD 72 0F      LDA.W $0F72,X               ; \
$02:FAF4  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FAF5  AA            TAX                          ; / X = [$0F72,X] * 2: word index of this Boo in the ring
$02:FAF6  BD 84 FA      LDA.W $FA84,X         ; \
$02:FAF9  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FAFA  79 AE 0F      ADC.W $0FAE,Y               ; |
$02:FAFD  85 00         STA $00                     ; / [$00] = ring angle low + Boo angle offset low ([DATA_02FA84+X])
$02:FAFF  BD 85 FA      LDA.W $FA85,X         ; \
$02:FB02  79 B0 0F      ADC.W $0FB0,Y               ; |
$02:FB05  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FB07  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$01] = (ring angle high + offset high) & 1
$02:FB09  FA            PLX                          ; Restore the slot
$02:FB0A  C2 30         REP #$30                    ; A, X and Y 16-bit
$02:FB0C  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FB0E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FB0F  69 80 00      ADC.W #$0080                ; |
$02:FB12  29 FF 01      AND.W #$01FF                ; |
$02:FB15  85 02         STA $02                     ; / [$02] = ([$00] + $80) & $1FF: angle + 90 degrees
$02:FB17  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FB19  29 FF 00      AND.W #$00FF                ; |
$02:FB1C  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FB1D  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:FB1E  BF DB F7 07   LDA.L CircleCoords,X        ; |
$02:FB22  85 04         STA $04                     ; / [$04] = CircleCoords[angle & $FF] (sine, $0100 = full scale)
$02:FB24  A5 02         LDA $02                     ; \
$02:FB26  29 FF 00      AND.W #$00FF                ; |
$02:FB29  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FB2A  AA            TAX                          ; |
$02:FB2B  BF DB F7 07   LDA.L CircleCoords,X        ; |
$02:FB2F  85 06         STA $06                     ; / [$06] = CircleCoords[([$02]) & $FF] (cosine)
$02:FB31  E2 30         SEP #$30                    ; A, X and Y 8-bit
$02:FB33  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; \
$02:FB35  8D 02 42      STA.W $4202                 ; / Multiplicand A = sine low byte ($4202)
$02:FB38  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; A = $50: ring radius in pixels
$02:FB3A  A4 05         LDY $05                     ; \
$02:FB3C  D0 0F         BNE $FB4D             ; / Sine high byte non-zero (full scale): use $50 unchanged ($02FB4D)
$02:FB3E  8D 03 42      STA.W $4203                 ; Multiplier B = $50: start the multiplication ($4203)
$02:FB41  EA            NOP                          ; Wait for the multiplication (4 NOPs)
$02:FB42  EA            NOP 
$02:FB43  EA            NOP 
$02:FB44  EA            NOP 
$02:FB45  0E 16 42      ASL.W $4216                 ; \
$02:FB48  AD 17 42      LDA.W $4217                 ; |
$02:FB4B  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; / A = product * 2 / 256, rounded: sine * $50
$02:FB4D  46 01         LSR $01                     ; \
$02:FB4F  90 03         BCC $FB54             ; |
$02:FB51  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FB53  1A            INC A                       ; / Angle bit 8 set (second half): negate A
$02:FB54  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = X offset from the ring center
$02:FB56  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; \
$02:FB58  8D 02 42      STA.W $4202                 ; / Multiplicand A = cosine low byte
$02:FB5B  A9 50         LDA.B #$50                  ; A = $50: ring radius in pixels
$02:FB5D  A4 07         LDY $07                     ; \
$02:FB5F  D0 0F         BNE $FB70             ; / Cosine high byte non-zero: use $50 unchanged ($02FB70)
$02:FB61  8D 03 42      STA.W $4203                 ; Multiplier B = $50: start the multiplication
$02:FB64  EA            NOP                          ; Wait for the multiplication (4 NOPs)
$02:FB65  EA            NOP 
$02:FB66  EA            NOP 
$02:FB67  EA            NOP 
$02:FB68  0E 16 42      ASL.W $4216                 ; \
$02:FB6B  AD 17 42      LDA.W $4217                 ; |
$02:FB6E  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; / A = product * 2 / 256, rounded: cosine * $50
$02:FB70  46 03         LSR $03                     ; \
$02:FB72  90 03         BCC $FB77             ; |
$02:FB74  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FB76  1A            INC A                       ; / Angle + 90 bit 8 ([$03]) set: negate A
$02:FB77  85 06         STA $06                     ; [$06] = Y offset from the ring center
$02:FB79  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = cluster sprite slot (saved in [$15E9])
$02:FB7C  BC 86 0F      LDY.W $0F86,X               ; Y = ring number
$02:FB7F  64 00         STZ $00                     ; \
$02:FB81  A5 04         LDA $04                     ; |
$02:FB83  10 02         BPL $FB87             ; |
$02:FB85  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; / [$00] = sign extension of the X offset
$02:FB87  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:FB88  79 B2 0F      ADC.W $0FB2,Y               ; |
$02:FB8B  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FB8E  B9 B4 0F      LDA.W $0FB4,Y               ; |
$02:FB91  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |
$02:FB93  9D 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,X               ; / Cluster X (16-bit) = ring center X + X offset
$02:FB96  64 01         STZ $01                     ; \
$02:FB98  A5 06         LDA $06                     ; |
$02:FB9A  10 02         BPL $FB9E             ; |
$02:FB9C  C6 01         DEC $01                     ; / [$01] = sign extension of the Y offset
$02:FB9E  18            CLC                          ; \
$02:FB9F  79 B6 0F      ADC.W $0FB6,Y               ; |
$02:FBA2  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FBA5  B9 B8 0F      LDA.W $0FB8,Y               ; |
$02:FBA8  65 01         ADC $01                     ; |
$02:FBAA  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; / Cluster Y (16-bit) = ring center Y + Y offset
$02:FBAD  20 8D FC      JSR.W $FC8D           ; Draw the Boo if it is near the screen ($FC8D)
$02:FBB0  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FBB1  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:FBB3  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FBB5  D0 03         BNE $FBBA            ; / Test contact only 1 frame in 4 per slot (staggered)
$02:FBB7  20 71 FE      JSR.W $FE71           ; Test contact with Mario ($FE71); hurts Mario
$02:FBBA  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $FBBB..FBBD: Table: Boo speed steps and limits ;;;
{
$02:FBBB                .db $01,$FF                 ; Boo X speed acceleration: +1, -1 (used by $FBC7 sprites)

$02:FBBD                .db $08,$F8                 ; Boo X speed limits: +8, -8

}

;;; $FBBF: Cluster sprites 3 and 8: Boo/bat ceiling (BooRingTiles) ;;;
{
;; Cluster sprite types 3 and 8 (probably Boo ceiling and bat ceiling), 20 slots, type in [$1892], state in [$0F86].
;; State 0: idle on the ceiling, swaying and bobbing (bats only hang). Slot 0 wakes a random idle slot every 8 frames.
;; State 1: after a short delay swoops at Mario (aimed speed), then returns to its home height and goes idle.
;; Hurts Mario on contact. Also holds the shared drawing routine ($02FD48).
$02:FBBF                .db $88,$8C,$A8,$8E,$AA,$AE,$88,$8C ; Boo tiles, index = (slot AND 3) * 2 + animation frame: $88,$8C / $A8,$8E / $AA,$AE / $88,$8C

$02:FBC7  E0 00         CPX.B #$00                  ; \
$02:FBC9  F0 03         BEQ $FBCE             ; |
$02:FBCB  4C 41 FC      JMP.W $FC41           ; / Only slot 0 runs the wake-up logic; other slots skip to $02FC41

$02:FBCE  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:FBD0  29 07         AND.B #$07                  ; |
$02:FBD2  05 9D         ORA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; |
$02:FBD4  D0 68         BNE $FC3E             ; / Only every 8th frame and not while sprites are locked; else skip to $02FC3E
$02:FBD6  22 F9 AC 01   JSL.L GetRand               ; A = random number
$02:FBDA  29 1F         AND.B #$1F                  ; \
$02:FBDC  C9 14         CMP.B #$14                  ; |
$02:FBDE  90 02         BCC $FBE2             ; |
$02:FBE0  E9 14         SBC.B #$14                  ; |
$02:FBE2  AA            TAX                          ; / X = random slot 0-19 (rolls of 20-31 wrap to 0-11, so low slots are likelier)
$02:FBE3  BD 86 0F      LDA.W $0F86,X               ; \
$02:FBE6  D0 56         BNE $FC3E             ; / Slot [$0F86] is already awake: skip
$02:FBE8  FE 86 0F      INC.W $0F86,X               ; Wake this slot: state [$0F86] = 1
$02:FBEB  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; \
$02:FBED  9D 9A 0F      STA.W $0F9A,X               ; / Delay timer [$0F9A] = $20 frames before it swoops
$02:FBF0  64 00         STZ $00                     ; \
$02:FBF2  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FBF5  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FBF7  65 1A         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FBF9  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:FBFA  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |
$02:FBFC  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FBFF  85 E4         STA RAM_SpriteXLo           ; |
$02:FC01  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:FC03  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FC05  28            PLP                          ; |
$02:FC06  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FC08  9D 3E 1E      STA.W $1E3E,X               ; |
$02:FC0B  8D E0 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteXHi         ; } Re-anchor X position to the current screen (probably), copy to sprite 0 position vars
$02:FC0E  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FC11  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:FC13  65 1C         ADC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:FC15  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FC18  85 D8         STA RAM_SpriteYLo           ; |
$02:FC1A  29 FC         AND.B #$FC                  ; |
$02:FC1C  9D 72 0F      STA.W $0F72,X               ; |
$02:FC1F  A5 1D         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; |
$02:FC21  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FC23  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FC26  8D D4 14      STA.W RAM_SpriteYHi         ; } Same for Y; [$0F72] = home Y (Y AND $FC), used to detect the return to the ceiling
$02:FC29  DA            PHX                          ; \
$02:FC2A  A2 00         LDX.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FC2C  A9 10         LDA.B #$10                  ; |
$02:FC2E  20 FB D2      JSR.W $D2FB           ; } Aim at Mario with speed $10 ($D2FB): [$00] = Y speed, [$01] = X speed
$02:FC31  FA            PLX                          ; /
$02:FC32  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FC34  69 09         ADC.B #$09                  ; |
$02:FC36  9D 52 1E      STA.W $1E52,X               ; / Y speed [$1E52] = aimed Y speed + 9 (downward bias)
$02:FC39  A5 01         LDA $01                     ; \
$02:FC3B  9D 66 1E      STA.W $1E66,X               ; / X speed [$1E66] = aimed X speed
$02:FC3E  AE E9 15      LDX.W $15E9                 ; X = current cluster sprite slot [$15E9]
$02:FC41  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:FC43  D0 08         BNE $FC4D             ; / Sprites locked: skip the timer
$02:FC45  BD 9A 0F      LDA.W $0F9A,X               ; \
$02:FC48  F0 03         BEQ $FC4D             ; |
$02:FC4A  DE 9A 0F      DEC.W $0F9A,X               ; / Count down timer [$0F9A] if non-zero
$02:FC4D  BD 86 0F      LDA.W $0F86,X               ; \
$02:FC50  D0 03         BNE $FC55             ; |
$02:FC52  4C E2 FC      JMP.W $FCE2           ; / State 0 (idle on the ceiling): go to $02FCE2

$02:FC55  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:FC57  D0 34         BNE $FC8D             ; / Sprites locked: skip the movement
$02:FC59  BD 9A 0F      LDA.W $0F9A,X               ; \
$02:FC5C  D0 1A         BNE $FC78             ; / Delay timer still running: skip the movement
$02:FC5E  20 98 FF      JSR.W $FF98           ; Apply X speed to X position
$02:FC61  20 A3 FF      JSR.W $FFA3           ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$02:FC64  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FC65  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:FC67  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FC69  D0 0D         BNE $FC78             ; / Only every 4th frame (staggered per slot)
$02:FC6B  20 71 FE      JSR.W $FE71           ; Check contact with Mario (hurts him)
$02:FC6E  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FC71  C9 E1         CMP.B #$E1                  ; |
$02:FC73  30 03         BMI $FC78             ; |
$02:FC75  DE 52 1E      DEC.W $1E52,X               ; / Y speed -= 1 each time while it is above about -31 (swoops back up)
$02:FC78  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FC7B  29 FC         AND.B #$FC                  ; |
$02:FC7D  DD 72 0F      CMP.W $0F72,X               ; |
$02:FC80  D0 0B         BNE $FC8D             ; / Skip unless Y (AND $FC) is back at the home height [$0F72]
$02:FC82  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FC85  10 06         BPL $FC8D             ; / ...and Y speed is negative (moving up)
$02:FC87  9E 86 0F      STZ.W $0F86,X               ; Back on the ceiling: state [$0F86] = 0
$02:FC8A  9E 66 1E      STZ.W $1E66,X               ; X speed = 0
$02:FC8D  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FC90  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:FC92  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; |
$02:FC95  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$00] = X position (16-bit)
$02:FC97  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:FC99  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FC9B  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FC9C  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FC9E  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FC9F  69 40 00      ADC.W #$0040                ; |
$02:FCA2  C9 80 01      CMP.W #$0180                ; / Visible if (X - screen X + $40) < $0180 (within -$40..$13F)
$02:FCA5  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:FCA7  B0 2F         BCS $FCD8            ; Off-screen horizontally: return without drawing
$02:FCA9  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; \
$02:FCAB  20 48 FD      JSR.W $FD48           ; / Draw with palette bits $02 ($FD48)
$02:FCAE  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FCB1  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FCB2  69 10         ADC.B #$10                  ; |
$02:FCB4  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:FCB5  C5 1C         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:FCB7  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FCBA  E5 1D         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYHi      ; |
$02:FCBC  28            PLP                          ; |
$02:FCBD  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FCBF  D0 18         BNE $FCD9             ; } Non-zero if Y is outside the screen height: hide it ($02FCD9)
$02:FCC1  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FCC4  C5 1A         CMP RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FCC6  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; |
$02:FCC9  E5 1B         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:FCCB  F0 0B         BEQ $FCD8            ; / X high byte same as the screen's: on the main page, done
$02:FCCD  BD 50 FF      LDA.W $FF50,X         ; \
$02:FCD0  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FCD1  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FCD2  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:FCD3  A9 03         LDA.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FCD5  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; } Sprite is on the next page: OAM size entry = 3 (16x16, X bit 8 set)
$02:FCD8  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FCD9  BC 50 FF      LDY.W $FF50,X         ; \
$02:FCDC  A9 F0         LDA.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:FCDE  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / Hide the sprite: OAM Y = $F0 (off-screen)
$02:FCE1  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FCE2  A5 9D         LDA RAM_SpritesLocked       ; \
$02:FCE4  D0 60         BNE $FD46             ; / Sprites locked: just draw
$02:FCE6  BD 92 18      LDA.W $1892,X               ; \
$02:FCE9  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |
$02:FCEB  F0 59         BEQ $FD46             ; / Cluster type 8 (bat ceiling) does not sway: just draw
$02:FCED  BD 9A 0F      LDA.W $0F9A,X               ; \
$02:FCF0  D0 28         BNE $FD1A             ; / Pause timer [$0F9A] running: skip the sway step
$02:FCF2  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:FCF4  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FCF6  D0 22         BNE $FD1A             ; / Only on even frames
$02:FCF8  BD 4A 0F      LDA.W $0F4A,X               ; \
$02:FCFB  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FCFD  A8            TAY                          ; / Y = sway direction [$0F4A] bit 0
$02:FCFE  BD 66 1E      LDA.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:FD01  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FD02  79 BB FB      ADC.W $FBBB,Y         ; |
$02:FD05  9D 66 1E      STA.W $1E66,X               ; } X speed [$1E66] += +1 or -1 ($FBBB)
$02:FD08  D9 BD FB      CMP.W $FBBD,Y         ; \
$02:FD0B  D0 0D         BNE $FD1A             ; / Limit reached (+8 or -8, $FBBD)? else skip
$02:FD0D  FE 4A 0F      INC.W $0F4A,X               ; Reverse the sway direction
$02:FD10  AD 8D 14      LDA.W RAM_RandomByte1       ; \
$02:FD13  29 FF         AND.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FD15  09 3F         ORA.B #$3F                  ; |
$02:FD17  9D 9A 0F      STA.W $0F9A,X               ; / Pause timer [$0F9A] = random, at least $3F frames
$02:FD1A  20 98 FF      JSR.W $FF98           ; Apply X speed to X position
$02:FD1D  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FD1E  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:FD20  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FD22  D0 22         BNE $FD46             ; / Only every 4th frame (staggered per slot)
$02:FD24  64 00         STZ $00                     ; \
$02:FD26  A0 01         LDY.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FD28  8A            TXA                          ; |
$02:FD29  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FD2A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FD2B  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FD2C  65 13         ADC RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:FD2E  29 40         AND.B #$40                  ; |
$02:FD30  F0 04         BEQ $FD36             ; |
$02:FD32  A0 FF         LDY.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FD34  C6 00         DEC $00                     ; } Bob direction from bit 6 of (slot * 8 + frame): Y = +1, or -1 with [$00] = $FF
$02:FD36  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:FD37  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FD38  7D 02 1E      ADC.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FD3B  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FD3E  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; |
$02:FD40  7D 2A 1E      ADC.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FD43  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; } Y position += +1 or -1 (16-bit)
$02:FD46  A9 0E         LDA.B #$0E                  ; Palette bits $0E for the idle draw
$02:FD48  85 02         STA $02                     ; [$02] = palette bits ORed into the OAM property byte
$02:FD4A  BC 50 FF      LDY.W $FF50,X         ; Y = OAM offset for this slot ($FF50)
$02:FD4D  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FD50  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FD51  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FD53  99 00 03      STA.W OAM_DispX,Y           ; / OAM X = sprite X - screen X
$02:FD56  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FD59  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FD5A  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:FD5C  99 01 03      STA.W OAM_DispY,Y           ; / OAM Y = sprite Y - screen Y
$02:FD5F  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:FD61  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD62  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD63  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD64  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FD66  85 00         STA $00                     ; } [$00] = animation frame, toggles every 8 frames
$02:FD68  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FD69  29 03         AND.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FD6B  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FD6C  65 00         ADC $00                     ; |
$02:FD6E  DA            PHX                          ; |
$02:FD6F  AA            TAX                          ; } X = (slot AND 3) * 2 + animation frame
$02:FD70  BD BF FB      LDA.W BooRingTiles,X        ; Tile from BooRingTiles
$02:FD73  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile
$02:FD76  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X = slot
$02:FD77  BD 66 1E      LDA.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:FD7A  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FD7B  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FD7D  B0 02         BCS $FD81             ; |
$02:FD7F  A9 40         LDA.B #$40                  ; |
$02:FD81  09 31         ORA.B #$31                  ; |
$02:FD83  05 02         ORA $02                     ; } Flip X ($40) unless X speed is negative; property = $31 | [$02]
$02:FD85  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; OAM property (palette, priority 3)
$02:FD88  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:FD89  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD8A  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD8B  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:FD8C  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; |
$02:FD8E  99 60 04      STA.W OAM_TileSize,Y        ; } OAM size entry = 2 (16x16)
$02:FD91  BD 92 18      LDA.W $1892,X               ; \
$02:FD94  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; |
$02:FD96  D0 1F         BNE $FDB7            ; / Only cluster type 8 (bat) continues
$02:FD98  BC 50 FF      LDY.W $FF50,X         ; Y = OAM offset for this slot
$02:FD9B  A5 14         LDA RAM_FrameCounterB       ; \
$02:FD9D  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD9E  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FD9F  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FDA1  85 00         STA $00                     ; } [$00] = bat wing frame, toggles every 4 frames
$02:FDA3  BD 86 0F      LDA.W $0F86,X               ; \
$02:FDA6  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FDA7  05 00         ORA $00                     ; |
$02:FDA9  DA            PHX                          ; |
$02:FDAA  AA            TAX                          ; } X = state * 2 + wing frame
$02:FDAB  BD B8 FD      LDA.W BatCeilingTiles,X     ; Tile from BatCeilingTiles (replaces the Boo tile)
$02:FDAE  99 02 03      STA.W OAM_Tile,Y            ; OAM tile
$02:FDB1  A9 37         LDA.B #$37                  ; \
$02:FDB3  99 03 03      STA.W OAM_Prop,Y            ; / OAM property = $37 (bat palette, priority 3)
$02:FDB6  FA            PLX                          ; Restore X = slot
$02:FDB7  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $FDB8: Bonus 1-up cluster sprite, Mario contact (BatCeilingTiles) ;;;
{
;; BatCeilingTiles: bat tile table. Then $02FDBC: cluster sprite type 1 (bonus game 1-up): falls, bounces off the edges,
;; gives a 1-UP score sprite when Mario touches it, and draws using OAM slots at $90-$AC.
;; $02FE71: cluster sprite contact check; calls $F9F5 (hurt Mario or lose Yoshi) on overlap.
;; Parameters: X: cluster slot.
$02:FDB8                .db $AE,$AE,$C0,$EB         ; Bat tiles: state 0 hanging $AE,$AE; state 1 swooping $C0,$EB (wing flap)

$02:FDBC  20 A3 FF      JSR.W $FFA3           ; Apply Y speed to Y position
$02:FDBF  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FDC2  C9 40         CMP.B #$40                  ; |
$02:FDC4  10 06         BPL $FDCC             ; |
$02:FDC6  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FDC7  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FDC9  9D 52 1E      STA.W $1E52,X               ; } Gravity: Y speed += 3 until $40
$02:FDCC  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; \
$02:FDCF  F0 0F         BEQ $FDE0             ; / Y high byte zero: not at the floor
$02:FDD1  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FDD4  C9 80         CMP.B #$80                  ; |
$02:FDD6  90 08         BCC $FDE0             ; / Y low byte < $80: not at the floor
$02:FDD8  29 F0         AND.B #$F0                  ; \
$02:FDDA  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FDDD  9E 52 1E      STZ.W $1E52,X               ; } Landed: snap Y to a multiple of 16 and Y speed = 0
$02:FDE0  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FDE1  45 13         EOR RAM_FrameCounter        ; |
$02:FDE3  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FDE4  90 62         BCC $FE48             ; / Move horizontally only every other frame (staggered per slot)
$02:FDE6  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FDE9  D0 25         BNE $FE10             ; / Still falling: skip horizontal movement
$02:FDEB  BD 66 1E      LDA.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:FDEE  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FDEF  7D 16 1E      ADC.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FDF2  9D 16 1E      STA.W $1E16,X               ; } X position low byte += X speed [$1E66]
$02:FDF5  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FDF8  5D 66 1E      EOR.W $1E66,X               ; |
$02:FDFB  10 13         BPL $FE10             ; / Sign of result differs from X speed? else skip bounce check
$02:FDFD  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FE00  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FE01  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; |
$02:FE03  C9 30         CMP.B #$30                  ; |
$02:FE05  B0 09         BCS $FE10             ; } Bounce only if X low byte is in $E0-$0F (near an edge)
$02:FE07  BD 66 1E      LDA.W $1E66,X               ; \
$02:FE0A  49 FF         EOR.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FE0C  1A            INC A                       ; |
$02:FE0D  9D 66 1E      STA.W $1E66,X               ; } Reverse X speed
$02:FE10  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:FE12  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FE13  FD 16 1E      SBC.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FE16  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FE17  69 0C         ADC.B #$0C                  ; |
$02:FE19  C9 1E         CMP.B #$1E                  ; |
$02:FE1B  B0 2B         BCS $FE48             ; } Skip unless Mario X is within 30 pixels of the 1-up
$02:FE1D  A9 20         LDA.B #$20                  ; Hit height $20 (small or ducking)
$02:FE1F  A4 73         LDY RAM_IsDucking           ; \
$02:FE21  D0 06         BNE $FE29             ; / Ducking: keep $20
$02:FE23  A4 19         LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp        ; \
$02:FE25  F0 02         BEQ $FE29             ; / Small: keep $20
$02:FE27  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; Big and standing: hit height $30
$02:FE29  85 00         STA $00                     ; [$00] = hit height
$02:FE2B  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \
$02:FE2D  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FE2E  FD 02 1E      SBC.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FE31  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FE32  69 20         ADC.B #$20                  ; |
$02:FE34  C5 00         CMP $00                     ; |
$02:FE36  B0 10         BCS $FE48             ; } Skip unless Mario Y is within the hit height of the 1-up
$02:FE38  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Collected: free the cluster slot [$1892] = 0
$02:FE3B  20 6C FF      JSR.W $FF6C           ; Spawn a 1-UP score sprite
$02:FE3E  CE 20 19      DEC.W $1920                 ; \
$02:FE41  D0 05         BNE $FE48             ; / [$1920]-- (probably count of 1-ups left); skip while non-zero
$02:FE43  A9 58         LDA.B #$58                  ; \
$02:FE45  8D AB 14      STA.W $14AB                 ; / None left: [$14AB] = $58 (probably bonus game end timer)
$02:FE48  BC 64 FF      LDY.W $FF64,X         ; Y = OAM offset for this 1-up slot ($FF64)
$02:FE4B  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FE4E  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FE4F  E5 1A         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; |
$02:FE51  99 00 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispX,Y   ; / OAM X = sprite X - screen X
$02:FE54  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FE57  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FE58  E5 1C         SBC RAM_ScreenBndryYLo      ; |
$02:FE5A  99 01 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedDispY,Y   ; / OAM Y = sprite Y - screen Y
$02:FE5D  A9 24         LDA.B #$24                  ; \
$02:FE5F  99 02 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedTile,Y    ; / OAM tile = $24 (1-UP mushroom)
$02:FE62  A9 3A         LDA.B #$3A                  ; \
$02:FE64  99 03 02      STA.W OAM_ExtendedProp,Y    ; / OAM property = $3A
$02:FE67  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:FE68  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FE69  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FE6A  A8            TAY                          ; |
$02:FE6B  A9 02         LDA.B #$02                  ; |
$02:FE6D  99 20 04      STA.W $0420,Y               ; } OAM size entry = 2 (16x16)
$02:FE70  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FE71  A9 14         LDA.B #$14                  ; \
$02:FE73  80 02         BRA $FE77             ; / Contact width = $14

$02:FE75  A9 0C         LDA.B #$0C                  ; Unused: contact width $0C
$02:FE77  85 02         STA $02                     ; \
$02:FE79  64 03         STZ $03                     ; / [$02] = width, [$03] = 0
$02:FE7B  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FE7E  85 00         STA $00                     ; |
$02:FE80  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; |
$02:FE83  85 01         STA $01                     ; / [$00] = sprite X position (16-bit)
$02:FE85  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:FE87  A5 94         LDA RAM_MarioXPos           ; \
$02:FE89  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FE8A  E5 00         SBC $00                     ; |
$02:FE8C  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FE8D  69 0A 00      ADC.W #$000A                ; |
$02:FE90  C5 02         CMP $02                     ; / Mario X - sprite X + $0A must be below the width
$02:FE92  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:FE94  B0 2E         BCS $FEC4            ; No horizontal overlap: return
$02:FE96  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FE99  69 03         ADC.B #$03                  ; |
$02:FE9B  85 02         STA $02                     ; |
$02:FE9D  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FEA0  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FEA2  85 03         STA $03                     ; } [$02] = sprite Y + 3 (16-bit)
$02:FEA4  C2 20         REP #$20                    ; A 16-bit
$02:FEA6  A9 14 00      LDA.W #$0014                ; \
$02:FEA9  A4 19         LDY RAM_MarioPowerUp        ; |
$02:FEAB  F0 03         BEQ $FEB0             ; / Mario hit height [$04] = $14 if small, ...
$02:FEAD  A9 20 00      LDA.W #$0020                ; ... $20 if powered up
$02:FEB0  85 04         STA $04                     ; [$04] = height
$02:FEB2  A5 96         LDA RAM_MarioYPos           ; \
$02:FEB4  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FEB5  E5 02         SBC $02                     ; |
$02:FEB7  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FEB8  69 1C 00      ADC.W #$001C                ; |
$02:FEBB  C5 04         CMP $04                     ; / Mario Y - sprite Y + $1C must be below the height
$02:FEBD  E2 20         SEP #$20                    ; A 8-bit
$02:FEBF  B0 03         BCS $FEC4            ; No vertical overlap: return
$02:FEC1  20 F5 F9      JSR.W $F9F5           ; Hurt Mario (or lose Yoshi)
$02:FEC4  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $FEC5..FECB: Unused: cluster despawn distance tables ;;;
{
;; Used only by the unused despawn code at $02FECD.
$02:FEC5                .db $40,$B0                 ; Unused: vertical despawn distance, low bytes ($40, $B0)

$02:FEC7                .db $01,$FF                 ; Unused: vertical despawn distance, high bytes ($01, $FF)

$02:FEC9                .db $30,$C0                 ; Unused: horizontal despawn distance, low bytes ($30, $C0)

$02:FECB                .db $01,$FF                 ; Unused: horizontal despawn distance, high bytes ($01, $FF)

}

;;; $FECD: Cluster despawn (unused), OAM table, helpers ;;;
{
;; $02FECD: unused off-screen despawn check. $02FF50/$02FF64: OAM offset tables.
;; $02FF6C: spawn a 1-UP score sprite at the cluster sprite. $02FF98/$02FFA3: apply X / Y speed to position (16-bit, 4-bit fraction).
;; $02FFD1: Wiggler helper that sets sprite Y speed (0 or $18).
$02:FECD  A5 5B         LDA RAM_IsVerticalLvl       ; \
$02:FECF  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FED1  D0 4B         BNE $FF1E             ; / Vertical level: use the Y-based check at $02FF1E
$02:FED3  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FED6  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FED7  69 50         ADC.B #$50                  ; |
$02:FED9  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FEDC  69 00         ADC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FEDE  C9 02         CMP.B #$02                  ; |
$02:FEE0  10 2C         BPL $FF0E             ; } Y + $50 >= $200: far below, despawn ($02FF0E)
$02:FEE2  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:FEE4  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; |
$02:FEE6  85 01         STA $01                     ; |
$02:FEE8  A8            TAY                          ; / [$01] = Y = frame parity: alternates right and left bound
$02:FEE9  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:FEEB  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FEEC  79 C9 FE      ADC.W $FEC9,Y         ; |
$02:FEEF  26 00         ROL $00                     ; |
$02:FEF1  DD 16 1E      CMP.W $1E16,X               ; |
$02:FEF4  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:FEF5  A5 1B         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXHi      ; |
$02:FEF7  46 00         LSR $00                     ; |
$02:FEF9  79 CB FE      ADC.W $FECB,Y         ; |
$02:FEFC  28            PLP                          ; |
$02:FEFD  FD 3E 1E      SBC.W $1E3E,X               ; |
$02:FF00  85 00         STA $00                     ; } A = bound - sprite X (high byte); bit 7 set = beyond the bound
$02:FF02  46 01         LSR $01                     ; \
$02:FF04  90 04         BCC $FF0A             ; |
$02:FF06  49 80         EOR.B #$80                  ; |
$02:FF08  85 00         STA $00                     ; / Invert the sign test for the left bound
$02:FF0A  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FF0C  10 0F         BPL $FF1D            ; / Still within bounds: return
$02:FF0E  BC 86 0F      LDY.W $0F86,X               ; \
$02:FF11  C0 FF         CPY.B #$FF                  ; |
$02:FF13  F0 05         BEQ $FF1A             ; / Y = load status index [$0F86]; $FF = not from the level
$02:FF15  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:FF17  99 38 19      STA.W RAM_SprLoadStatus,Y   ; / Let the level loader respawn the sprite
$02:FF1A  9E 92 18      STZ.W $1892,X               ; Free the cluster slot [$1892] = 0
$02:FF1D  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FF1E  A5 13         LDA RAM_FrameCounter        ; \
$02:FF20  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FF21  B0 FA         BCS $FF1D            ; / Vertical levels: check only every other frame
$02:FF23  29 01         AND.B #$01                  ; \
$02:FF25  85 01         STA $01                     ; |
$02:FF27  A8            TAY                          ; / [$01] = Y = frame parity: alternates the two bounds
$02:FF28  A5 1A         LDA RAM_ScreenBndryXLo      ; \
$02:FF2A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FF2B  79 C5 FE      ADC.W $FEC5,Y         ; |
$02:FF2E  26 00         ROL $00                     ; |
$02:FF30  DD 02 1E      CMP.W $1E02,X               ; |
$02:FF33  08            PHP                          ; |
$02:FF34  AD 1D 00      LDA.W RAM_ScreenBndryYHi    ; |
$02:FF37  46 00         LSR $00                     ; |
$02:FF39  79 C7 FE      ADC.W $FEC7,Y         ; |
$02:FF3C  28            PLP                          ; |
$02:FF3D  FD 2A 1E      SBC.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FF40  85 00         STA $00                     ; } A = bound - sprite Y (high byte); bit 7 set = beyond the bound
$02:FF42  A4 01         LDY $01                     ; \
$02:FF44  F0 04         BEQ $FF4A             ; |
$02:FF46  49 80         EOR.B #$80                  ; |
$02:FF48  85 00         STA $00                     ; / Invert the sign test for the other bound
$02:FF4A  A5 00         LDA $00                     ; \
$02:FF4C  10 CF         BPL $FF1D            ; / Still within bounds: return
$02:FF4E  30 BE         BMI $FF0E             ; Always: go despawn ($02FF0E)

$02:FF50                .db $E0,$E4,$E8,$EC,$F0,$F4,$F8,$FC ; OAM offsets for cluster slots 0-7: $E0-$FC
$02:FF58                .db $5C,$58,$54,$50,$4C,$48,$44,$40 ; OAM offsets for slots 8-15: $5C-$40
$02:FF60                .db $3C,$38,$34,$30         ; OAM offsets for slots 16-19: $3C-$30

$02:FF64                .db $90,$94,$98,$9C,$A0,$A4,$A8,$AC ; OAM offsets for 1-up cluster slots 0-7: $90-$AC

$02:FF6C  22 34 AD 02   JSL.L $AD34           ; Y = free score sprite slot
$02:FF70  A9 0D         LDA.B #$0D                  ; \
$02:FF72  99 E1 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprNum,Y     ; / Score sprite type $0D = 1-UP
$02:FF75  BD 02 1E      LDA.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FF78  38            SEC                          ; |
$02:FF79  E9 08         SBC.B #$08                  ; |
$02:FF7B  99 E7 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYLo,Y     ; |
$02:FF7E  BD 2A 1E      LDA.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FF81  E9 00         SBC.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FF83  99 F9 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprYHi,Y     ; } Score sprite Y = sprite Y - 8 (16-bit)
$02:FF86  BD 16 1E      LDA.W $1E16,X               ; \
$02:FF89  99 ED 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXLo,Y     ; / Score sprite X low = sprite X low
$02:FF8C  BD 3E 1E      LDA.W $1E3E,X               ; \
$02:FF8F  99 F3 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprXHi,Y     ; / Score sprite X high = sprite X high
$02:FF92  A9 30         LDA.B #$30                  ; \
$02:FF94  99 FF 16      STA.W RAM_ScoreSprSpeedY,Y  ; / Score sprite rise speed = $30
$02:FF97  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FF98  DA            PHX                          ; Save slot
$02:FF99  8A            TXA                          ; \
$02:FF9A  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FF9B  69 14         ADC.B #$14                  ; |
$02:FF9D  AA            TAX                          ; / X += $14: selects the X-speed and X-position arrays
$02:FF9E  20 A3 FF      JSR.W $FFA3           ; Apply speed (as the X axis)
$02:FFA1  FA            PLX                          ; Restore slot
$02:FFA2  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FFA3  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FFA6  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FFA7  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FFA8  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FFA9  0A            ASL                          ; |
$02:FFAA  18            CLC                          ; |
$02:FFAB  7D 7A 1E      ADC.W $1E7A,X               ; |
$02:FFAE  9D 7A 1E      STA.W $1E7A,X               ; } Y fraction [$1E7A] += speed * 16 (low nibble)
$02:FFB1  08            PHP                          ; Save carry
$02:FFB2  BD 52 1E      LDA.W $1E52,X               ; \
$02:FFB5  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FFB6  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FFB7  4A            LSR                          ; |
$02:FFB8  4A            LSR                          ; } A = speed / 16
$02:FFB9  C9 08         CMP.B #$08                  ; \
$02:FFBB  A0 00         LDY.B #$00                  ; |
$02:FFBD  90 03         BCC $FFC2             ; |
$02:FFBF  09 F0         ORA.B #$F0                  ; |
$02:FFC1  88            DEY                          ; / If bit 3 set, sign extend: A |= $F0, Y = $FF
$02:FFC2  28            PLP                          ; Restore carry
$02:FFC3  7D 02 1E      ADC.W $1E02,X               ; \
$02:FFC6  9D 02 1E      STA.W $1E02,X               ; / Position low += speed / 16 + carry
$02:FFC9  98            TYA                          ; \
$02:FFCA  7D 2A 1E      ADC.W $1E2A,X               ; |
$02:FFCD  9D 2A 1E      STA.W $1E2A,X               ; / Position high += sign extension + carry
$02:FFD0  60            RTS                          ; Return

$02:FFD1  BD 88 15      LDA.W RAM_SprObjStatus,X    ; \
$02:FFD4  30 07         BMI $FFDD             ; / Wiggler: [$1588] bit 7 set: Y speed $18
$02:FFD6  A9 00         LDA.B #$00                  ; \
$02:FFD8  BC B8 15      LDY.W $15B8,X               ; |
$02:FFDB  F0 02         BEQ $FFDF             ; / Else Y speed 0 unless on a slope ([$15B8] non-zero)
$02:FFDD  A9 18         LDA.B #$18                  ; Y speed = $18
$02:FFDF  95 AA         STA RAM_SpriteSpeedY,X      ; Sprite Y speed = A
$02:FFE1  60            RTS                          ; Return


}

;;; $FFE2..FFFA: Padding ($FF) to the end of the bank ;;;
{
$02:FFE2                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:FFEA                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:FFF2                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
$02:FFFA                .db $FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF,$FF
